<?php

namespace App\Domain;

use App\Models\Account;
use App\Models\AuditHead;
use App\Models\Category;
use App\Models\Channel;
use App\Models\Payer;
use App\Models\PayeBand;
use App\Models\Setting;
use App\Models\TaxRate;
use App\Models\WhtType;

/** Seeds a new database and upgrades an existing one (idempotent; never overwrites values the user has changed). */
final class ReferenceData
{
    public static function seedOrUpgrade(): string
    {
        if (Account::find(1010) === null) {
            self::seed();

            return 'seeded';
        }
        self::upgrade();

        return 'upgraded';
    }

    public static function seed(): void
    {
        foreach (ReferenceTables::COA as [$code, $name, $typ, $stmt, $line, $normal, $cf, $ctl]) {
            Account::updateOrCreate(['code' => $code], ['name' => $name, 'acct_type' => $typ, 'statement' => $stmt, 'line' => $line,
                'normal' => $normal, 'cf_class' => $cf, 'control' => $ctl]);
        }
        foreach (ReferenceTables::SETTINGS as $k => $v) {
            Setting::updateOrCreate(['key' => $k], ['value' => $v]);
        }
        foreach (ReferenceTables::TAX as [$code, $desc, $vat, $nhil, $getf, $basis]) {
            TaxRate::create(['code' => $code, 'description' => $desc, 'vat' => $vat, 'nhil' => $nhil, 'getfund' => $getf,
                'effective_from' => '2026-01-01', 'effective_to' => ReferenceTables::FAR, 'legal_basis' => $basis]);
        }
        foreach (ReferenceTables::CATEGORIES as [$n, $i, $r, $c]) {
            Category::updateOrCreate(['name' => $n], ['inventory_account' => $i, 'revenue_account' => $r, 'cogs_account' => $c]);
        }
        foreach (ReferenceTables::CHANNELS as [$n, $a]) {
            Channel::updateOrCreate(['name' => $n], ['account' => $a]);
        }
        Payer::create(['code' => 'RETAIL', 'name' => 'Walk-in retail customer', 'payer_type' => 'Retail', 'copay_pct' => '1',
            'expected_reduction_pct' => '0', 'credit_limit' => '0', 'claim_deadline_days' => 0, 'payment_terms_days' => 30]);
        self::upgrade();
    }

    public static function upgrade(): void
    {
        foreach (ReferenceTables::COA as [$code, $name, $typ, $stmt, $line, $normal, $cf, $ctl]) {
            if (Account::find($code) === null) {
                Account::create(['code' => $code, 'name' => $name, 'acct_type' => $typ, 'statement' => $stmt, 'line' => $line,
                    'normal' => $normal, 'cf_class' => $cf, 'control' => $ctl]);
            }
        }
        if (AuditHead::find(1) === null) {
            AuditHead::create(['id' => 1, 'last_hash' => Integrity::GENESIS, 'last_id' => 0]);
        }
        foreach (ReferenceTables::MODULE_ONLY_SINCE_V09 as $code) {
            Account::where('code', $code)->where('control', 'Manual allowed')->update(['control' => 'Module only']);
        }
        foreach (ReferenceTables::CHANNELS as [$n, $a]) {
            if (Channel::find($n) === null) {
                Channel::create(['name' => $n, 'account' => $a]);
            }
        }
        if (! Payer::where('code', 'SUNDRY')->exists()) {
            Payer::create(['code' => 'SUNDRY', 'name' => 'Sundry cash customers', 'payer_type' => 'Corporate', 'copay_pct' => '1',
                'expected_reduction_pct' => '0', 'credit_limit' => '0', 'claim_deadline_days' => 0, 'payment_terms_days' => 0]);
        }
        Account::where('code', 2320)->where('line', 'Deferred tax')->update(['line' => 'Deferred tax liability']); // v1.3
        Account::where('code', 2015)->where('name', 'Goods received not invoiced')->update(['name' => 'Goods and services received not invoiced']);
        foreach (ReferenceTables::SETTINGS as $k => $v) {
            if (Setting::find($k) === null) {
                Setting::create(['key' => $k, 'value' => $v]);
            }
        }
        foreach (ReferenceTables::WHT as [$n, $r, $a, $rent, $code, $res, $final, $always, $thr, $desc]) {
            $w = WhtType::find($n);
            $attrs = ['gra_code' => $code, 'residency' => $res, 'final' => $final, 'always_withhold' => $always,
                'threshold_applies' => $thr, 'description' => $desc];
            if ($w === null) {
                WhtType::create(['name' => $n, 'rate' => $r, 'account' => $a, 'is_rent' => $rent] + $attrs);
            } elseif ($w->gra_code === null && $code) {
                $w->update($attrs);
            }
        }
        if (! PayeBand::query()->exists()) {
            foreach (ReferenceTables::ANNUAL_PAYE_BANDS as $i => [$w, $r]) {
                PayeBand::create(['effective_from' => ReferenceTables::PAYE_EFFECTIVE_FROM, 'effective_to' => ReferenceTables::FAR,
                    'seq' => $i + 1, 'annual_width' => $w, 'rate' => $r, 'legal_basis' => ReferenceTables::PAYE_LEGAL_BASIS]);
            }
        }
    }
}

        ['PE-dividend', '0.08', 2170, false, 'WNRPDF', 'NRPermanentEstb', true, false, false, 'Non-resident permanent establishment: dividend'],
        ['PE-interest', '0.08', 2170, false, 'WNRPIF', 'NRPermanentEstb', true, false, false, 'Non-resident permanent establishment: interest'],
    ];

    public const ANNUAL_PAYE_BANDS = [
        ['7056', '0'],
        ['960', '0.05'],
        ['1200', '0.10'],
        ['34800', '0.175'],
        ['192000', '0.25'],
        ['363984', '0.30'],
        [null, '0.35'],
    ];
}

####################################################################################################
##### FILE: app/Domain/Reports.php
####################################################################################################

<?php

namespace App\Domain;

use App\Models\Account;
use App\Models\ARInvoice;
use App\Models\Branch;
use Brick\Math\BigDecimal;
use Brick\Math\RoundingMode;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

/**
 * Reports straight from the ledger: TB, P&L, balance sheet, cash flow (indirect), VAT return, sales KPIs, period engine
 * (month / quarter / half-year / YTD / full year), consolidation with inter-branch elimination and profit by branch.
 * Every journal line carries its unit, so consolidation is a query over all units. Port of services/reports.py.
 */
final class Reports
{
    public const PL_LINES = [
        ['rev', 'Revenue', 'Revenue'], ['cos', 'Cost of sales', 'Cost of sales'], ['gp', 'Gross profit', null],
        ['emp', 'Employee costs', 'Employee costs'], ['prem', 'Premises costs', 'Premises costs'], ['adm', 'Administrative expenses', 'Administrative expenses'],
        ['sell', 'Selling and distribution', 'Selling and distribution'], ['dep', 'Depreciation and amortisation', 'Depreciation and amortisation'],
        ['imp', 'Impairment losses', 'Impairment losses'], ['op', 'Operating profit', null], ['oth', 'Other income and gains', 'Other income'],
        ['fin', 'Finance costs', 'Finance costs'], ['pbt', 'Profit before tax', null], ['tax', 'Income tax (company variant)', 'Income tax'],
        ['profit', 'Profit for the period', null],
    ];

    public const ASSET_LINES = ['Property, plant and equipment', 'Intangible assets', 'Deposits and other non-current assets', 'Deferred tax', 'Inventories',
        'Trade and other receivables', 'Prepayments and other current assets', 'Current tax assets', 'Cash and cash equivalents'];

    public const LIAB_LINES = ['Trade and other payables', 'Tax payables', 'Employee-related payables', 'Provisions', 'Borrowings – current',
        'Borrowings – non-current', 'Provisions – non-current', 'Deferred tax liability'];

    public const EQUITY_LINES = ['Owner capital', 'Owner drawings', 'Retained earnings', 'Company equity (variant)', 'Revaluation reserve'];

    public const WC_LINES = ['Inventories', 'Trade and other receivables', 'Prepayments and other current assets', 'Current tax assets',
        'Trade and other payables', 'Tax payables', 'Employee-related payables'];

    public const SHARED_LIAB_LINES = ['Tax payables', 'Employee-related payables', 'Borrowings – current', 'Borrowings – non-current'];

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ periods
    public static function monthEnd(string $d): string
    {
        return date('Y-m-t', strtotime($d));
    }

    public static function addMonths(string $d, int $n): string
    {
        [$y, $m] = [(int) substr($d, 0, 4), (int) substr($d, 5, 2)];
        $k = $m - 1 + $n;

        return sprintf('%04d-%02d-01', $y + intdiv($k - (($k % 12 + 12) % 12), 12), ($k % 12 + 12) % 12 + 1);
    }

    /** kind: month (n 1-12), quarter (1-4), half (1-2), ytd (n = last month), year. */
    public static function periodRange(string $fyStart, string $kind, int $n = 1): array
    {
        [$first, $last] = match ($kind) {
            'month' => [$n, $n], 'quarter' => [3 * $n - 2, 3 * $n], 'half' => [6 * $n - 5, 6 * $n], 'ytd' => [1, $n], 'year' => [1, 12],
            default => throw new BusinessRuleError('Period must be month, quarter, half, ytd or year'),
        };

        return [self::addMonths($fyStart, $first - 1), self::monthEnd(self::addMonths($fyStart, $last - 1))];
    }

    public static function comparativeRange(string $fyStart, string $kind, int $n): ?array
    {
        if (in_array($kind, ['ytd', 'year'], true)) {
            return self::periodRange(self::addMonths($fyStart, -12), $kind, $n);
        }

        return $n === 1 ? null : self::periodRange($fyStart, $kind, $n - 1);
    }

    public static function accounts(): array
    {
        static $cache = null;
        if ($cache === null || count($cache) !== Account::count()) {
            $cache = Account::all()->keyBy('code')->all();
        }

        return $cache;
    }
    private static function lines(?array $branchIds)
    {
        $q = DB::table('journal_line')->join('journal', 'journal.id', '=', 'journal_line.journal_id');
        if ($branchIds) {
            $q->whereIn('journal.branch_id', $branchIds);
        }

        return $q;
    }

    public static function accountBalance(int $code, string $asOf, ?array $branchIds = null): BigDecimal
    {
        $v = self::lines($branchIds)->where('journal_line.account_code', $code)->where('journal.entry_date', '<=', $asOf)
            ->selectRaw('COALESCE(SUM(journal_line.debit - journal_line.credit), 0) AS b')->value('b');

        return Money::db($v ?? '0');
    }

    public static function partyBalance(int $code, string $party, string $asOf, ?array $branchIds = null): BigDecimal
    {
        $v = self::lines($branchIds)->where('journal_line.account_code', $code)->where('journal_line.party', $party)->where('journal.entry_date', '<=', $asOf)
            ->selectRaw('COALESCE(SUM(journal_line.debit - journal_line.credit), 0) AS b')->value('b');

        return Money::db($v ?? '0');
    }

    /** Dr +. Balance-sheet accounts cumulative to $end; P&L accounts for $start..$end; earlier P&L rolled into 3020. */
    public static function trialBalance(string $start, string $end, ?array $branchIds = null): array
    {
        $rows = self::lines($branchIds)->join('account', 'account.code', '=', 'journal_line.account_code')
            ->where('journal.entry_date', '<=', $end)->groupBy('journal_line.account_code', 'account.statement')
            ->selectRaw('journal_line.account_code AS code, account.statement AS st, SUM(journal_line.debit - journal_line.credit) AS total, '
                .'SUM(CASE WHEN journal.entry_date >= ? THEN journal_line.debit - journal_line.credit ELSE 0 END) AS period', [$start])->get();
        $tb = [];
        $rolled = BigDecimal::zero();
        foreach ($rows as $r) {
            [$total, $period] = [Money::db($r->total), Money::db($r->period)];
            if ($r->st === 'PL') {
                $tb[(int) $r->code] = $period;
                $rolled = $rolled->plus($total->minus($period));
            } else {
                $tb[(int) $r->code] = $total;
            }
        }
        if (! $rolled->isZero()) {
            $tb[3020] = ($tb[3020] ?? BigDecimal::zero())->plus($rolled);
        }
        $out = [];
        foreach ($tb as $k => $v) {
            if (! $v->isZero()) {
                $out[$k] = Money::q2($v);
            }
        }
        ksort($out);

        return $out;
    }

    /** Balance-sheet position at a date: all P&L to date inside 3020. */
    public static function position(string $asOf, ?array $branchIds = null): array
    {
        return self::trialBalance(date('Y-m-d', strtotime($asOf.' +1 day')), $asOf, $branchIds);
    }

    public static function byLine(array $tb): array
    {
        $meta = self::accounts();
        $lines = [];
        foreach ($tb as $code => $v) {
            $l = $meta[$code]->line;
            $lines[$l] = ($lines[$l] ?? BigDecimal::zero())->plus($v);
        }

        return $lines;
    }

    private static function g(array $a, string $k): BigDecimal
    {
        return $a[$k] ?? BigDecimal::zero();
    }

    public static function incomeStatement(array $tb): array
    {
        $lines = self::byLine($tb);
        $out = [];
        foreach (self::PL_LINES as [$k, , $line]) {
            if ($line) {
                $out[$k] = self::g($lines, $line)->negated();
            }
        }
        $out['gp'] = $out['rev']->plus($out['cos']);
        $out['op'] = $out['gp']->plus(Money::sum(array_map(fn ($k) => $out[$k], ['emp', 'prem', 'adm', 'sell', 'dep', 'imp'])));
        $out['pbt'] = $out['op']->plus($out['oth'])->plus($out['fin']);
        $out['profit'] = $out['pbt']->plus($out['tax']);
        $res = [];
        foreach (array_column(self::PL_LINES, 0) as $k) {
            $res[$k] = Money::q2($out[$k]);
        }
        $res['gross_margin'] = $out['rev']->isZero() ? BigDecimal::zero() : $out['gp']->dividedBy($out['rev'], 4, RoundingMode::HALF_EVEN);

        return $res;
    }

    public static function balanceSheet(array $tb, bool $eliminateInterbranch = false): array
    {
        $lines = self::byLine($tb);
        $profit = self::incomeStatement($tb)['profit'];
        $ib = $tb[1195] ?? BigDecimal::zero();
        $assets = [];
        foreach (self::ASSET_LINES as $l) {
            $assets[$l] = self::g($lines, $l);
        }
        if ($eliminateInterbranch) { // both units' 1195 removed; any residual is in transit and must be explained
            $assets['Prepayments and other current assets'] = $assets['Prepayments and other current assets']->minus($ib);
            $assets['In transit between branches'] = $ib;
        }
        $liab = [];
        foreach (self::LIAB_LINES as $l) {
            $liab[$l] = self::g($lines, $l)->negated();
        }
        $eq = [];
        foreach (self::EQUITY_LINES as $l) {
            $eq[$l] = self::g($lines, $l)->negated();
        }
        $eq['Profit for the period'] = $profit;
        $susp = self::g($lines, 'Suspense and clearing');
        [$ta, $tl, $te] = [Money::sum($assets), Money::sum($liab), Money::sum($eq)];

        return ['assets' => $assets, 'liabilities' => $liab, 'equity' => $eq, 'total_assets' => Money::q2($ta), 'total_liabilities' => Money::q2($tl),
            'total_equity' => Money::q2($te), 'suspense' => Money::q2($susp), 'check' => Money::q2($ta->minus($tl)->minus($te)->minus($susp))];
    }

    /**
     * Indirect method (Section 7) from movements between the opening position and the period-end trial balance, with the
     * fixed-asset register's disposals separated: cost and accumulated depreciation removed, gain or loss reversed out of
     * profit, proceeds in investing activities.
     */
    public static function cashFlow(string $start, string $end, ?array $branchIds = null): array
    {
        $opening = self::position(date('Y-m-d', strtotime("{$start} -1 day")), $branchIds);
        $closing = self::trialBalance($start, $end, $branchIds);
        $meta = self::accounts();
        $z = BigDecimal::zero();
        $mov = [];
        foreach (array_unique(array_merge(array_keys($opening), array_keys($closing))) as $code) {
            if ($meta[$code]->statement === 'BS') {
                $mov[$code] = ($closing[$code] ?? $z)->minus($opening[$code] ?? $z);
            }
        }
        $by = function (string $cls, ?string $line = null) use ($mov, $meta) {
            $t = BigDecimal::zero();
            foreach ($mov as $c => $v) {
                if ($meta[$c]->cf_class === $cls && ($line === null || $meta[$c]->line === $line)) {
                    $t = $t->plus($v);
                }
            }

            return $t->negated();
        };
        $d = Assets::disposals($start, $end, $branchIds);
        $profit = self::incomeStatement($closing)['profit'];
        $reval = ($mov[3060] ?? $z)->negated(); // revaluation surplus (OCI): no cash on either side
        $nonCash = $by('Non-cash')->plus($d['accumulated'])->minus($reval);
        $gainAdj = Money::d($d['gain'])->negated();
        $wc = [];
        foreach (self::WC_LINES as $l) {
            $wc[$l] = $by('Operating', $l);
        }
        $otherOp = $by('Operating')->minus(Money::sum($wc));
        $op = $profit->plus($nonCash)->plus($gainAdj)->plus(Money::sum($wc))->plus($otherOp);
        $ppe = $by('Investing', 'Property, plant and equipment')->minus($d['cost'])->plus($reval);
        $intang = $by('Investing', 'Intangible assets')->minus($d['intangible_cost']);
        $deposits = $by('Investing')->minus($by('Investing', 'Property, plant and equipment'))->minus($by('Investing', 'Intangible assets'));
        $inv = $ppe->plus($intang)->plus($deposits)->plus($d['proceeds']);
        $fin = $by('Financing');
        $susp = $by('n/a');
        $cashOf = fn (array $tb) => Money::sum(array_map(fn ($c) => $tb[$c], array_values(array_filter(array_keys($tb), fn ($c) => $meta[$c]->cf_class === 'Cash'))));
        [$openCash, $closeCash] = [$cashOf($opening), $cashOf($closing)];
        $net = $op->plus($inv)->plus($fin)->plus($susp);

        return ['profit' => $profit, 'non_cash' => Money::q2($nonCash), 'gain_on_disposal' => Money::q2($gainAdj),
            'working_capital' => array_map(fn ($v) => Money::q2($v), $wc), 'other_operating' => Money::q2($otherOp), 'operating' => Money::q2($op),
            'purchase_ppe' => Money::q2($ppe), 'purchase_intangibles' => Money::q2($intang), 'deposits' => Money::q2($deposits), 'disposal_proceeds' => $d['proceeds'],
            'investing' => Money::q2($inv), 'financing' => Money::q2($fin), 'capital_introduced' => Money::q2($by('Financing', 'Owner capital')),
            'drawings' => Money::q2($by('Financing', 'Owner drawings')), 'suspense' => Money::q2($susp), 'net' => Money::q2($net), 'opening_cash' => Money::q2($openCash),
            'closing_cash' => Money::q2($openCash->plus($net)), 'bs_cash' => Money::q2($closeCash), 'check' => Money::q2($openCash->plus($net)->minus($closeCash))];
    }

    public static function vatReturn(string $start, string $end, ?array $branchIds = null): array
    {
        $v = self::lines($branchIds)->where('journal.entry_date', '>=', $start)->where('journal.entry_date', '<=', $end)
            ->whereIn('journal_line.account_code', [2100, 2105, 2110, 2115, 2120, 2125])->whereNotIn('journal.source', ['VATCLOSE', 'TAXPAY'])
            ->groupBy('journal_line.account_code')->selectRaw('journal_line.account_code AS c, SUM(journal_line.credit - journal_line.debit) AS x')->get()
            ->mapWithKeys(fn ($r) => [(int) $r->c => Money::db($r->x)])->all();
        $z = BigDecimal::zero();
        $out = ['output_vat' => $v[2100] ?? $z, 'output_nhil' => $v[2105] ?? $z, 'output_getfund' => $v[2110] ?? $z,
            'input_vat' => ($v[2115] ?? $z)->negated(), 'input_nhil' => ($v[2120] ?? $z)->negated(), 'input_getfund' => ($v[2125] ?? $z)->negated()];
        $sq = DB::table('sale_line')->join('sale', 'sale_line.sale_id', '=', 'sale.id')->join('product', 'sale_line.product_id', '=', 'product.id')
            ->where('sale.sale_date', '>=', $start)->where('sale.sale_date', '<=', $end);
        if ($branchIds) {
            $sq->whereIn('sale.branch_id', $branchIds);
        }
        $supplies = [];
        foreach ($sq->groupBy('product.tax_code')->selectRaw('product.tax_code AS code, COALESCE(SUM(sale_line.base), 0) AS base, COALESCE(SUM(sale_line.gross), 0) AS gross')->get() as $r) {
            $supplies[$r->code] = [Money::db($r->base), Money::db($r->gross)];
        }
        foreach (self::arSupplies($start, $end, $branchIds) as $code => [$base, $gross]) { // invoices raised outside the till
            [$b0, $g0] = $supplies[$code] ?? [$z, $z];
            $supplies[$code] = [$b0->plus($base), $g0->plus($gross)];
        }
        $out['standard_rated_supplies_excl_tax'] = ($supplies['SR20'] ?? [$z, $z])[0];
        $out['zero_rated_supplies'] = ($supplies['ZR'] ?? [$z, $z])[1];
        $out['exempt_supplies'] = ($supplies['EX'] ?? [$z, $z])[1];
        $out['net_payable'] = $out['output_vat']->plus($out['output_nhil'])->plus($out['output_getfund'])
            ->minus($out['input_vat'])->minus($out['input_nhil'])->minus($out['input_getfund']);
        $w = self::lines($branchIds)->where('journal.entry_date', '>=', $start)->where('journal.entry_date', '<=', $end)->where('journal_line.account_code', 1175)
            ->whereNotIn('journal.source', ['VATCLOSE', 'TAXPAY'])->selectRaw('COALESCE(SUM(journal_line.debit - journal_line.credit), 0) AS b')->value('b');
        $out['withholding_vat_credits'] = Money::db($w ?? '0');
        $out['net_after_withholding_credits'] = $out['net_payable']->minus($out['withholding_vat_credits']);

        return array_map(fn ($x) => Money::q2($x), $out);
    }

    /** AR invoices (net of credit notes) by tax code: [code => [base, gross]]. */
    public static function arSupplies(string $start, string $end, ?array $branchIds = null): array
    {
        $q = ARInvoice::where('invoice_date', '>=', $start)->where('invoice_date', '<=', $end)->orderBy('id');
        if ($branchIds) {
            $q->whereIn('branch_id', $branchIds);
        }
        $out = [];
        foreach ($q->get() as $inv) {
            $sg = $inv->kind === 'CREDIT' ? -1 : 1;
            foreach (json_decode($inv->lines_json, true) as $x) {
                $code = $x['tax_code'] ?? 'SR20';
                $tx = Tax::addExclusive((string) $x['net'], Tax::ratesFor($code, $inv->invoice_date));
                [$b0, $g0] = $out[$code] ?? [BigDecimal::zero(), BigDecimal::zero()];
                $out[$code] = [$b0->plus($tx['base']->multipliedBy($sg)), $g0->plus($tx['gross']->multipliedBy($sg))];
            }
        }

        return $out;
    }

    /** Gross takings per day (till sales incl. returns) – the dashboard chart. */
    public static function salesByDay(string $start, string $end, ?array $branchIds = null): array
    {
        $q = DB::table('sale')->join('sale_line', 'sale_line.sale_id', '=', 'sale.id')->where('sale.sale_date', '>=', $start)->where('sale.sale_date', '<=', $end);
        if ($branchIds) {
            $q->whereIn('sale.branch_id', $branchIds);
        }
        $by = $q->groupBy('sale.sale_date')->selectRaw('sale.sale_date AS d, COALESCE(SUM(sale_line.gross), 0) AS v')->get()
            ->mapWithKeys(fn ($r) => [substr((string) $r->d, 0, 10) => Money::q2(Money::db($r->v))])->all();
        $out = [];
        for ($d = $start; $d <= $end; $d = date('Y-m-d', strtotime("{$d} +1 day"))) {
            $out[] = ['date' => $d, 'gross' => $by[$d] ?? Money::zero()];
        }

        return $out;
    }

    public static function topSellers(string $start, string $end, ?array $branchIds = null, int $limit = 5): array
    {
        $q = DB::table('product')->join('sale_line', 'sale_line.product_id', '=', 'product.id')->join('sale', 'sale_line.sale_id', '=', 'sale.id')
            ->where('sale.sale_date', '>=', $start)->where('sale.sale_date', '<=', $end);
        if ($branchIds) {
            $q->whereIn('sale.branch_id', $branchIds);
        }

        return $q->groupBy('product.sku', 'product.name')->orderByRaw('SUM(sale_line.net_revenue) DESC')->limit($limit)
            ->selectRaw('product.sku AS sku, product.name AS name, SUM(sale_line.qty) AS u, SUM(sale_line.net_revenue) AS r')->get()
            ->map(fn ($x) => ['sku' => $x->sku, 'product' => $x->name, 'units' => Money::db($x->u), 'net_revenue' => Money::q2(Money::db($x->r))])->all();
    }

    public static function salesKpis(string $start, string $end, ?array $branchIds = null): array
    {
        $base = function () use ($start, $end, $branchIds) {
            $q = DB::table('sale')->join('sale_line', 'sale_line.sale_id', '=', 'sale.id')->where('sale.sale_date', '>=', $start)->where('sale.sale_date', '<=', $end);
            if ($branchIds) {
                $q->whereIn('sale.branch_id', $branchIds);
            }

            return $q;
        };
        $r = $base()->selectRaw('COUNT(DISTINCT sale.id) AS n, COALESCE(SUM(sale_line.gross), 0) AS gross, COALESCE(SUM(sale_line.net_revenue), 0) AS net,
            COALESCE(SUM(sale_line.cost), 0) AS cost, COALESCE(SUM(sale_line.discount), 0) AS disc,
            COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sale_line.qty > 0 THEN sale_line.qty ELSE 0 END), 0) AS units, COALESCE(SUM(sale_line.payer_portion), 0) AS payer')->first();
        // returns are included as negative lines so the KPIs agree with revenue; the receipt count excludes return documents
        $rr = $base()->whereNotNull('sale.original_sale_id')->selectRaw('COUNT(DISTINCT sale.id) AS n, COALESCE(SUM(sale_line.gross), 0) AS gross')->first();
        $n = (int) $r->n - (int) $rr->n;
        [$gross, $net, $cost] = [Money::db($r->gross), Money::db($r->net), Money::db($r->cost)];
        $gp = Money::q2($net->minus($cost));

        return ['receipts' => $n, 'gross_sales' => Money::q2($gross), 'net_revenue' => Money::q2($net), 'cost_of_sales' => Money::q2($cost), 'gross_profit' => $gp,
            'margin' => $net->isZero() ? BigDecimal::zero() : $gp->dividedBy($net, 4, RoundingMode::HALF_EVEN),
            'basket' => $n ? Money::q2(Money::div20($gross, $n)) : BigDecimal::zero(), 'discounts' => Money::q2(Money::db($r->disc)),
            'units' => Money::db($r->units), 'payer_portion' => Money::q2(Money::db($r->payer)), 'returns' => Money::q2(Money::db($rr->gross)->negated())];
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ consolidation and period pack
    /** Per-unit statements, combined totals, and the inter-branch elimination (1195 must net to nil). */
    public static function consolidated(string $start, string $end): array
    {
        $out = ['branches' => [], 'period' => [$start, $end]];
        foreach (Branch::orderBy('code')->get() as $b) {
            $tb = self::trialBalance($start, $end, [$b->id]);
            $out['branches'][$b->code] = ['pl' => self::incomeStatement($tb), 'bs' => self::balanceSheet($tb), 'interbranch' => $tb[1195] ?? Money::zero()];
        }
        $tb = self::trialBalance($start, $end);
        $out['consolidated'] = ['tb' => $tb, 'pl' => self::incomeStatement($tb), 'bs' => self::balanceSheet($tb, true), 'cash_flow' => self::cashFlow($start, $end),
            'in_transit' => $tb[1195] ?? Money::zero(), 'tb_difference' => Money::q2(Money::sum($tb))];

        return $out;
    }

    /** Months, quarters, halves and the year side by side (workbook Period_Pack). */
    public static function periodPack(string $fyStart, ?array $branchIds = null): array
    {
        $cols = [];
        for ($m = 1; $m <= 12; $m++) {
            $cols[] = [date('M Y', strtotime(self::addMonths($fyStart, $m - 1))), ...self::periodRange($fyStart, 'month', $m)];
        }
        for ($q = 1; $q <= 4; $q++) {
            $cols[] = ["Q{$q}", ...self::periodRange($fyStart, 'quarter', $q)];
        }
        foreach ([1, 2] as $h) {
            $cols[] = ["H{$h}", ...self::periodRange($fyStart, 'half', $h)];
        }
        $cols[] = ['Year', ...self::periodRange($fyStart, 'year')];
        $pack = [];
        foreach ($cols as [$label, $a, $b]) {
            $tb = self::trialBalance($a, $b, $branchIds);
            $pack[$label] = ['pl' => self::incomeStatement($tb), 'kpis' => self::salesKpis($a, $b, $branchIds),
                'bs_check' => self::balanceSheet($tb, ! $branchIds)['check'], 'cash' => self::cashFlow($a, $b, $branchIds)['bs_cash']];
        }

        return $pack;
    }

    /**
     * Reports → Financial → Profit by branch: each branch side by side, then the head office unit, then the total, which equals
     * the consolidated P&L. Liabilities: each branch shows its own trade and other payables; tax obligations and other
     * liabilities are presented in the "Head office / shared" column (presentation only).
     */
    public static function profitByBranch(string $start, string $end): array
    {
        $units = Branch::orderBy('is_head_office')->orderBy('code')->get();
        $ho = $units->where('is_head_office', true)->values();
        [$cols, $pl] = [[], []];
        foreach ($units as $u) {
            $pl[$u->code] = self::incomeStatement(self::trialBalance($start, $end, [$u->id]));
            $cols[] = ['code' => $u->code, 'name' => $u->name, 'head_office' => (bool) $u->is_head_office];
        }
        $total = self::incomeStatement(self::trialBalance($start, $end));
        $rows = [];
        $agrees = true;
        foreach (self::PL_LINES as [$k, $label]) {
            $by = [];
            foreach ($cols as $c) {
                $by[$c['code']] = $pl[$c['code']][$k];
            }
            $rows[] = ['key' => $k, 'label' => $label, 'by_unit' => $by, 'total' => $total[$k]];
            $agrees = $agrees && Money::q2(Money::sum($by))->isEqualTo($total[$k]);
        }
        $shared = $ho->isNotEmpty() ? $ho[0]->code : 'SHARED';
        $liab = [];
        foreach ($units as $u) {
            $lines = self::byLine(self::position($end, [$u->id]));
            foreach (self::LIAB_LINES as $ln) {
                $col = (in_array($ln, self::SHARED_LIAB_LINES, true) || $u->is_head_office) ? $shared : $u->code;
                $liab[$ln][$col] = ($liab[$ln][$col] ?? BigDecimal::zero())->plus(self::g($lines, $ln)->negated());
            }
        }
        $cons = self::byLine(self::position($end));
        $liabRows = array_map(fn ($ln) => ['label' => $ln, 'by_unit' => array_map(fn ($v) => Money::q2($v), $liab[$ln] ?? []),
            'total' => Money::q2(self::g($cons, $ln)->negated())], self::LIAB_LINES);
        $columns = array_values(array_filter($cols, fn ($c) => ! $c['head_office']));
        $columns = array_merge($columns, $ho->isNotEmpty() ? array_values(array_filter($cols, fn ($c) => $c['head_office']))
            : [['code' => 'SHARED', 'name' => 'Head office / shared', 'head_office' => true]]);
        foreach ($columns as &$c) {
            if ($c['head_office']) {
                $c['name'] = $ho->isNotEmpty() ? "Head office / shared ({$c['code']})" : 'Head office / shared';
            }
        }
        unset($c);

        return ['period' => [$start, $end], 'columns' => $columns, 'profit_and_loss' => $rows, 'liabilities' => $liabRows, 'total_agrees_to_consolidated' => $agrees,
            'note' => "Tax obligations and other liabilities are shown under Head office / shared for all branches. Each branch's own "
                ."trial balance still balances; inter-branch balances (1195) eliminate on consolidation."];
    }

    /** The combined dashboard: KPI cards, 14-day sales, top sellers, statutory deadlines, VAT position, integrity. */
    public static function dashboard(string $today, ?array $branchIds = null): array
    {
        $m0 = substr($today, 0, 7).'-01';
        $pl = self::incomeStatement(self::trialBalance($m0, $today, $branchIds));
        [$kToday, $kMonth] = [self::salesKpis($today, $today, $branchIds), self::salesKpis($m0, $today, $branchIds)];
        $cash = Money::q2(Money::sum(array_map(fn ($c) => self::accountBalance($c, $today, $branchIds), [1010, 1015, 1020, 1030, 1035, 1040, 1045])));
        $rec = Statements::receivablesAgeing($today, $branchIds);
        [$owedBy, $overdueBy] = [BigDecimal::zero(), BigDecimal::zero()];
        foreach (['claims', 'corporate'] as $grp) {
            foreach ($rec[$grp] as $r) {
                $owedBy = $owedBy->plus($r['total']);
                foreach (['31-60', '61-90', 'over 90'] as $bk) {
                    $overdueBy = $overdueBy->plus($r[$bk]);
                }
            }
        }
        $owedBy = Money::q2($owedBy->minus($rec['allowance_expected_reductions']));
        $owedTo = Money::q2(Money::sum(array_map(fn ($c) => self::accountBalance($c, $today, $branchIds), [2010, 2020]))->negated());
        $overdueTo = BigDecimal::zero();
        foreach (Statements::ageing([2010, 2020], $today, $branchIds, -1) as $r) {
            foreach (['31-60', '61-90', 'over 90'] as $bk) {
                $overdueTo = $overdueTo->plus($r[$bk]);
            }
        }
        $bids = $branchIds ?: Branch::where('is_head_office', false)->orderBy('id')->pluck('id')->all();
        [$stock, $low] = [[], 0];
        foreach ($bids as $b) {
            if (Branch::find($b)?->is_head_office) {
                continue;
            }
            $rows = Inventory::valuation($b, $today);
            $stock = array_merge($stock, $rows);
            foreach (Branches::reorderProducts($b) as $p) {
                $oh = Money::sum(array_map(fn ($r) => $r['saleable'], array_filter($rows, fn ($r) => $r['sku'] === $p->sku)));
                if ($oh->isLessThanOrEqualTo(Branches::reorderLevel($b, $p))) {
                    $low++;
                }
            }
        }
        $prev = self::addMonths($m0, -1);
        $deadlines = array_merge(Schedules::calendar((int) substr($prev, 0, 4), (int) substr($prev, 5, 2), $today),
            Schedules::calendar((int) substr($today, 0, 4), (int) substr($today, 5, 2), $today));
        $vat = Controls::vatThresholdMonitor($today);

        return ['as_of' => $today, 'today_sales' => $kToday['gross_sales'], 'today_receipts' => $kToday['receipts'], 'month_sales' => $kMonth['net_revenue'],
            'month_receipts' => $kMonth['receipts'], 'gross_profit_month' => Money::q2($pl['gp']), 'net_profit_month' => Money::q2($pl['profit']), 'cash_and_bank' => $cash,
            'customers_owe' => $owedBy, 'customers_overdue' => Money::q2($overdueBy), 'ar_invoices_overdue' => Ar::ageing($today)['overdue'], 'we_owe_suppliers' => $owedTo,
            'suppliers_overdue' => Money::q2($overdueTo), 'low_stock_items' => $low,
            'expiring_soon' => count(array_filter($stock, fn ($r) => $r['alert'] === 'NEAR EXPIRY')),
            'expired_in_stock' => count(array_filter($stock, fn ($r) => $r['alert'] === 'EXPIRED')), 'near_expiry_days' => (int) Ledger::setting('near_expiry_days', '90'),
            'sales_last_14_days' => self::salesByDay(date('Y-m-d', strtotime("{$today} -13 days")), $today, $branchIds), 'top_sellers_month' => self::topSellers($m0, $today, $branchIds),
            'statutory_deadlines' => array_values(array_filter($deadlines, fn ($d) => $d['status'] !== 'Before trading start')),
            'vat' => ['registered' => $vat['registered'], 'message' => $vat['registered'] ? null : $vat['message'], 'share' => $vat['share']],
            'integrity' => Integrity::summary("{$today} 23:00:00")];
    }
}
