<?php

namespace App\Domain;

use App\Models\WhtCredit;
use App\Models\WhvatCredit;

/**
 * Tax withheld FROM the pharmacy when a customer, corporate account or insurer pays: income tax WHT → Dr 1170 (credit against
 * the proprietor's income tax); withholding VAT (Act 1151 s.56) → Dr 1175 (credit on the VAT return). Both need the payer's
 * certificate number. Port of services/withholding.py.
 */
final class Withholding
{
    /** @return array{0: \Brick\Math\BigDecimal, 1: array} net cash and the extra debit lines */
    public static function linesAndCheck(mixed $amount, mixed $wht = 0, ?string $whtCertificateNo = null, mixed $whvat = 0, ?string $whvatCertificateNo = null): array
    {
        [$amt, $wht, $whvat] = [Money::q2($amount), Money::q2($wht ?: 0), Money::q2($whvat ?: 0)];
        if ($wht->isNegative() || $whvat->isNegative() || $wht->plus($whvat)->isGreaterThanOrEqualTo($amt)) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Tax withheld must be positive and less than the amount settled');
        }
        if (! $wht->isZero() && ! $whtCertificateNo) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("Enter the payer's WHT credit certificate number – without it the credit cannot be claimed");
        }
        if (! $whvat->isZero() && ! $whvatCertificateNo) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Enter the Withholding VAT Credit Certificate number – without it the credit cannot be claimed');
        }
        $extra = [];
        if (! $wht->isZero()) {
            $extra[] = [1170, $wht, '0'];
        }
        if (! $whvat->isZero()) {
            $extra[] = [1175, $whvat, '0'];
        }

        return [$amt->minus($wht)->minus($whvat), $extra];
    }

    public static function record(int $branchId, string $payerCode, string $on, ?string $reference, int $journalId, mixed $amount, mixed $wht = 0,
        ?string $whtCertificateNo = null, mixed $whvat = 0, mixed $whvatTaxableValue = null, ?string $whvatCertificateNo = null): void
    {
        [$wht, $whvat] = [Money::q2($wht ?: 0), Money::q2($whvat ?: 0)];
        if (! $wht->isZero()) {
            WhtCredit::create(['branch_id' => $branchId, 'payer_code' => $payerCode, 'receipt_date' => $on, 'reference' => $reference,
                'gross_amount' => (string) Money::q2($amount), 'amount' => (string) $wht, 'certificate_no' => $whtCertificateNo, 'journal_id' => $journalId]);
        }
        if (! $whvat->isZero()) {
            $rate = Ledger::setting('whvat_rate', '0.07');
            WhvatCredit::create(['branch_id' => $branchId, 'payer_code' => $payerCode, 'receipt_date' => $on, 'invoice_ref' => $reference,
                'taxable_value' => (string) ($whvatTaxableValue !== null ? Money::q2($whvatTaxableValue) : Money::q2(Money::div20($whvat, $rate))),
                'amount' => (string) $whvat, 'certificate_no' => $whvatCertificateNo, 'journal_id' => $journalId]);
        }
    }
}

####################################################################################################
##### FILE: app/Domain/Inventory.php
####################################################################################################

<?php

namespace App\Domain;

use App\Models\Branch;
use App\Models\Category;
use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\StockCount;
use App\Models\StockCountLine;
use App\Models\StockLot;
use App\Models\StockMove;
use App\Models\Supplier;
use Brick\Math\BigDecimal;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

/**
 * Inventory: goods receipts, FEFO picking, costing, adjustments, quarantine, transfers, stock counts, NRV, valuation.
 * Port of the Python edition's services/inventory.py (v1.3).
 *
 * Cost formula (Settings cost_formula, IFRS for SMEs Section 13): WEIGHTED_AVERAGE (default) or BATCH (the workbook's method).
 * Cost pool (cost_pool): COMPANY – one weighted average per product across all branches while picking stays FEFO in each
 * branch; equalise() revalues every branch's stock of the product to quantity x company average after a receipt or return,
 * against 1195 (party COST-POOL), so each branch balances and no profit arises. BRANCH – a separate average per branch.
 * Every stock move carries a signed cost value, so the sub-ledger agrees to the ledger at any date.
 */
final class Inventory
{
    public const INPUT_TAX = [2115, 2120, 2125];

    public const POLICIES = ['WEIGHTED_AVERAGE', 'BATCH'];

    /** type => [debit account (null = inventory), credit account (null = inventory), bucket out, bucket in, needs document] */
    public const ADJ = [
        'Count shortage' => [5050, null, 'SALEABLE', null, false],
        'Count surplus' => [null, 5050, null, 'SALEABLE', false],
        'Damage write-off' => [5060, null, 'SALEABLE', null, false],
        'Expiry write-off' => [5060, null, 'SALEABLE', null, false],
        'Quarantine' => [1240, null, 'SALEABLE', 'QUARANTINE', false],
        'Quarantine write-off' => [5060, 1240, 'QUARANTINE', null, true],
        'Supplier return' => [2010, null, 'SALEABLE', null, true],
    ];

    public static function policy(): string
    {
        $p = Ledger::setting('cost_formula', 'WEIGHTED_AVERAGE');
        if (! in_array($p, self::POLICIES, true)) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('cost_formula must be one of WEIGHTED_AVERAGE, BATCH');
        }

        return $p;
    }

    public static function companyPool(): bool
    {
        return Ledger::setting('cost_pool', 'COMPANY') === 'COMPANY';
    }

    public static function productByCode(string $code): Product
    {
        $p = Product::where('sku', $code)->orWhere('barcode', $code)->first();
        if ($p === null) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("Barcode/SKU not found: {$code}");
        }

        return $p;
    }

    public static function inventoryAccount(Product $p): int
    {
        return (int) Category::find($p->category_name)->inventory_account;
    }

    public static function onHand(int $lotId, string $bucket = 'SALEABLE', ?string $asOf = null): BigDecimal
    {
        $q = StockMove::where('lot_id', $lotId)->where('bucket', $bucket);
        if ($asOf) {
            $q->where('move_date', '<=', $asOf);
        }

        return Money::db($q->sum('qty') ?: '0');
    }

    /** @return array{0: BigDecimal, 1: BigDecimal} (qty, value) */
    private static function sums(callable $where, ?string $asOf = null): array
    {
        $q = DB::table('stock_move')->join('stock_lot', 'stock_lot.id', '=', 'stock_move.lot_id');
        $where($q);
        if ($asOf) {
            $q->where('stock_move.move_date', '<=', $asOf);
        }
        $r = $q->selectRaw('COALESCE(SUM(stock_move.qty),0) AS q, COALESCE(SUM(stock_move.value),0) AS v')->first();

        return [Money::db($r->q), Money::db($r->v)];
    }

    /** (qty, value) of a product's stock in the cost pool: the whole company (COMPANY) or the branch. */
    public static function pool(int $branchId, int $productId, ?string $asOf = null, string $bucket = 'SALEABLE'): array
    {
        $company = self::companyPool();

        return self::sums(function ($q) use ($company, $branchId, $productId, $bucket) {
            $q->where('stock_lot.product_id', $productId)->where('stock_move.bucket', $bucket);
            if (! $company) {
                $q->where('stock_lot.branch_id', $branchId);
            }
        }, $asOf);
    }

    public static function lotPool(int $lotId, string $bucket = 'SALEABLE', ?string $asOf = null): array
    {
        return self::sums(fn ($q) => $q->where('stock_move.lot_id', $lotId)->where('stock_move.bucket', $bucket), $asOf);
    }

    /** Takes product row locks in id order BEFORE stock rows are written (avoids deadlocks between parallel receipts). */
    public static function lockProducts(iterable $productIds): void
    {
        $ids = [];
        foreach ($productIds as $i) {
            if ($i !== null) {
                $ids[(int) $i] = true;
            }
        }
        $ids = array_keys($ids);
        sort($ids);
        if ($ids && self::policy() === 'WEIGHTED_AVERAGE' && self::companyPool()) {
            Product::whereIn('id', $ids)->orderBy('id')->lockForUpdate()->pluck('id');
        }
    }

    public static function unitCost(StockLot $lot, ?string $asOf = null): BigDecimal
    {
        [$q, $v] = self::policy() === 'BATCH' ? self::lotPool($lot->id, 'SALEABLE', $asOf) : self::pool($lot->branch_id, $lot->product_id, $asOf);

        return $q->isZero() ? Money::d($lot->unit_cost) : Money::div20($v, $q);
    }

    /** Cost of taking qty out of saleable stock; the last unit out takes the remaining value (no residue). */
    public static function issueCost(StockLot $lot, mixed $qty): BigDecimal
    {
        $qty = Money::d($qty);
        [$q, $v] = self::policy() === 'BATCH' ? self::lotPool($lot->id) : self::pool($lot->branch_id, $lot->product_id);
        if (! $q->isPositive()) {
            return Money::q2($qty->multipliedBy($lot->unit_cost));
        }

        return $qty->isGreaterThanOrEqualTo($q) ? Money::q2($v) : Money::q2(Money::div20($qty->multipliedBy($v), $q));
    }

    public static function move(StockLot $lot, mixed $qty, mixed $value, string $kind, string $ref, string $on, string $bucket = 'SALEABLE', ?int $journalId = null): StockMove
    {
        return StockMove::create(['lot_id' => $lot->id, 'move_date' => $on, 'qty' => (string) Money::d($qty), 'value' => (string) Money::q2($value),
            'bucket' => $bucket, 'kind' => $kind, 'ref' => substr($ref, 0, 60), 'journal_id' => $journalId]);
    }

    /** Company weighted average: each branch's saleable stock of the product revalued to branch qty x company average. */
    public static function equalise(int $productId, string $on, string $ref, string $user): array
    {
        if (self::policy() !== 'WEIGHTED_AVERAGE' || ! self::companyPool()) {
            return [];
        }
        self::lockProducts([$productId]);
        $rows = DB::table('stock_move')->join('stock_lot', 'stock_lot.id', '=', 'stock_move.lot_id')
            ->where('stock_lot.product_id', $productId)->where('stock_move.bucket', 'SALEABLE')
            ->groupBy('stock_lot.branch_id')
            ->selectRaw('stock_lot.branch_id AS b, COALESCE(SUM(stock_move.qty),0) AS q, COALESCE(SUM(stock_move.value),0) AS v')->get();
        $by = [];
        foreach ($rows as $r) {
            $by[(int) $r->b] = [Money::db($r->q), Money::db($r->v)];
        }
        $tq = Money::sum(array_column($by, 0));
        $tv = Money::sum(array_column($by, 1));
        if (! $tq->isPositive() || count($by) < 2) {
            return [];
        }
        $target = [];
        foreach ($by as $bid => [$q, $v]) {
            $target[$bid] = Money::q2(Money::div20($q->multipliedBy($tv), $tq));
        }
        $biggest = null;
        foreach ($by as $bid => [$q, $v]) { // most units; ties to the lowest id
            if ($biggest === null || $q->isGreaterThan($by[$biggest][0]) || ($q->isEqualTo($by[$biggest][0]) && $bid < $biggest)) {
                $biggest = $bid;
            }
        }
        $target[$biggest] = $target[$biggest]->plus(Money::q2($tv->minus(Money::sum($target))));
        $prod = Product::find($productId);
        $inv = self::inventoryAccount($prod);
        $avg = Money::div20($tv, $tq)->toScale(6, \Brick\Math\RoundingMode::HALF_UP);
        $out = [];
        ksort($by);
        foreach ($by as $bid => [$q, $v]) {
            $diff = Money::q2($target[$bid]->minus($v));
            if ($diff->isZero()) {
                continue;
            }
            $lot = StockLot::where('branch_id', $bid)->where('product_id', $productId)->orderByDesc('received_on')->orderByDesc('id')->first();
            $lines = $diff->isPositive() ? [[$inv, $diff, '0'], [1195, '0', $diff, 'COST-POOL']] : [[1195, $diff->negated(), '0', 'COST-POOL'], [$inv, '0', $diff->negated()]];
            $j = Ledger::post($bid, $on, 'COSTPOOL', substr("AVG-{$prod->sku}-{$ref}", 0, 60), $lines, $user, "Company average cost {$avg} for {$prod->sku}");
            self::move($lot, '0', $diff, 'AVG_EQUALISE', $ref, $on, 'SALEABLE', $j->id);
            $out[] = [$bid, $diff];
        }

        return $out;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ receipts
    /** Creates the cost layer for a delivery line: [lot, units, inventory cost, tax split, recoverable]. */
    public static function newLot(int $branchId, Supplier $sup, Product $prod, ?string $batchNo, ?string $expiry, mixed $packs, mixed $costPerPack, string $on, string $ref, mixed $nrvPerUnit = null): array
    {
        Branches::requireTrading($branchId);
        if (! $batchNo || ! $expiry) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("Batch and expiry are required ({$prod->sku})");
        }
        if ($expiry <= $on) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("{$prod->sku} batch {$batchNo} is already expired – do not receive it into saleable stock");
        }
        $registered = Ledger::setting('vat_registered', 'Yes') === 'Yes';
        $units = Money::d($packs)->multipliedBy(Money::d($prod->units_per_pack ?: '1'));
        if (! $units->isPositive()) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Quantity must be positive');
        }
        $net = Money::q2(Money::d($packs)->multipliedBy(Money::d($costPerPack)));
        $charged = $sup->vat_registered && $prod->tax_code === 'SR20';
        $tx = Tax::addExclusive($net, $charged ? Tax::ratesFor('SR20', $on, false) : Tax::rates(0, 0, 0));
        $recover = $registered && $charged && $tx['vat']->plus($tx['nhil'])->plus($tx['getfund'])->isPositive();
        $invCost = $recover ? $net : $tx['gross'];
        $lot = StockLot::create(['branch_id' => $branchId, 'product_id' => $prod->id, 'batch_no' => $batchNo, 'expiry' => $expiry, 'received_on' => $on,
            'unit_cost' => (string) Money::div20($invCost, $units)->toScale(6, \Brick\Math\RoundingMode::HALF_UP), 'source_ref' => $ref,
            'supplier_id' => $sup->id, 'nrv_per_unit' => $nrvPerUnit === null ? null : (string) $nrvPerUnit]);

        return [$lot, $units, $invCost, $tx, $recover];
    }

    /** Delivery and invoice together (no purchase order); a second person approves when goods_without_order_approval = Yes. */
    public static function receiveGoods(int $branchId, string $supplierCode, string $invoiceNo, string $on, array $lines, string $user, ?string $approver = null): int
    {
        if (Ledger::setting('goods_without_order_approval', 'Yes') === 'Yes' && (! $approver || $approver === $user)) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Goods received without a purchase order need approval by someone other than the receiver');
        }
        $sup = Supplier::where('code', $supplierCode)->first();
        if ($sup === null) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("Unknown supplier {$supplierCode}");
        }
        if (StockLot::where('supplier_id', $sup->id)->where('source_ref', $invoiceNo)->exists()) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("Invoice {$invoiceNo} from {$supplierCode} has already been received");
        }
        self::lockProducts(array_map(fn ($l) => self::productByCode($l['sku'])->id, $lines));
        $p = new Poster;
        $pending = [];
        foreach ($lines as $ln) {
            $prod = self::productByCode($ln['sku']);
            [$lot, $units, $invCost, $tx, $recover] = self::newLot($branchId, $sup, $prod, $ln['batch_no'] ?? null, $ln['expiry'] ?? null, $ln['packs'],
                $ln['cost_per_pack'], $on, $invoiceNo, $ln['nrv_per_unit'] ?? null);
            $pending[] = [$lot, $units, $invCost];
            $p->dr(self::inventoryAccount($prod), $invCost);
            if ($recover) {
                foreach (array_combine(self::INPUT_TAX, [$tx['vat'], $tx['nhil'], $tx['getfund']]) as $acct => $amt) {
                    $p->dr($acct, $amt);
                }
            }
            $p->cr(2010, $tx['gross'], $sup->code);
        }
        $j = Ledger::post($branchId, $on, 'RECEIPT', $invoiceNo, $p->lines(), $user, null, $approver);
        foreach ($pending as [$lot, $units, $value]) {
            self::move($lot, $units, $value, 'RECEIPT', $invoiceNo, $on, 'SALEABLE', $j->id);
        }
        $pids = array_unique(array_map(fn ($x) => $x[0]->product_id, $pending));
        sort($pids);
        foreach ($pids as $pid) {
            self::equalise($pid, $on, $invoiceNo, $user);
        }

        return $j->id;
    }

    public static function estimateValue(int $branchId, string $sku, string $batchNo, mixed $qty): BigDecimal
    {
        $prod = self::productByCode($sku);
        $lot = StockLot::where('branch_id', $branchId)->where('product_id', $prod->id)->where('batch_no', $batchNo)->first();

        return $lot ? Money::q2(Money::d($qty)->multipliedBy($lot->unit_cost)) : Money::zero();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ picking
    /** Saleable lots, first-expiry-first-out: received by the date and not expired; locked (two tills cannot oversell). */
    public static function fefoLots(int $branchId, int $productId, string $on, ?string $batchNo = null): array
    {
        $q = StockLot::where('branch_id', $branchId)->where('product_id', $productId)->where('received_on', '<=', $on)->where('expiry', '>=', $on)
            ->orderBy('expiry')->orderBy('received_on')->orderBy('id')->lockForUpdate();
        if ($batchNo) {
            $q->where('batch_no', $batchNo);
        }
        $out = [];
        foreach ($q->get() as $lot) {
            $oh = self::onHand($lot->id);
            if ($oh->isPositive()) {
                $out[] = [$lot, $oh];
            }
        }

        return $out;
    }

    /** Allocates qty across lots (FEFO); a line may split across batches. */
    public static function pick(int $branchId, Product $product, mixed $qty, string $on, ?string $batchNo = null): array
    {
        $need = Money::d($qty);
        $out = [];
        foreach (self::fefoLots($branchId, $product->id, $on, $batchNo) as [$lot, $oh]) {
            $take = $need->isLessThan($oh) ? $need : $oh;
            $out[] = [$lot, $take];
            $need = $need->minus($take);
            if ($need->isZero()) {
                return $out;
            }
        }
        $what = $batchNo ? "batch {$batchNo}" : 'unexpired stock';
        throw new BusinessRuleError("Not enough {$what} of {$product->sku}: short by ".self::qtyText($need));
    }

    public static function qtyText(BigDecimal $q): string
    {
        $s = (string) $q->stripTrailingZeros();

        return $s;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ adjustments
    private static function allocBatch(int $branchId, Product $prod, string $batchNo, mixed $qty, ?string $bucket): array
    {
        $lots = StockLot::where('branch_id', $branchId)->where('product_id', $prod->id)->where('batch_no', $batchNo)->orderBy('received_on')->orderBy('id')->get();
        if ($lots->isEmpty()) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("Batch {$batchNo} not found for {$prod->sku}");
        }
        $need = Money::d($qty);
        $alloc = [];
        foreach ($lots as $lot) {
            $oh = $bucket ? self::onHand($lot->id, $bucket) : $need;
            $take = $need->isLessThan($oh) ? $need : $oh;
            if ($take->isPositive()) {
                $alloc[] = [$lot, $take];
                $need = $need->minus($take);
            }
            if ($need->isZero()) {
                break;
            }
        }
        if ($need->isPositive()) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Only '.self::qtyText(Money::d($qty)->minus($need)).' units available in '.strtolower($bucket)." stock of batch {$batchNo}");
        }

        return $alloc;
    }

    /** Posts one adjustment over [lot, qty] pairs. Values follow the costing policy; quarantine keeps its own value. */
    public static function adjustLots(int $branchId, string $on, Product $prod, array $alloc, string $adjType, string $user, ?string $approver, ?string $documentNo = null, string $reason = ''): int
    {
        if (! isset(self::ADJ[$adjType])) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("Unknown adjustment type {$adjType}");
        }
        if (! $approver || $approver === $user) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Adjustments need an approver other than the person entering them');
        }
        [$drAcct, $crAcct, $bOut, $bIn, $needsDoc] = self::ADJ[$adjType];
        if ($needsDoc && ! $documentNo) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Credit note / disposal certificate number required');
        }
        $inv = self::inventoryAccount($prod);
        $cat = Category::find($prod->category_name);
        $p = new Poster;
        $pending = [];
        $ref = $documentNo ?: ($reason ?: $adjType);
        foreach ($alloc as [$lot, $take]) {
            if ($bOut === 'QUARANTINE') {
                [$q, $v] = self::lotPool($lot->id, 'QUARANTINE');
                $value = $take->isGreaterThanOrEqualTo($q) ? Money::q2($v) : Money::q2(Money::div20($take->multipliedBy($v), $q));
            } elseif ($bOut) {
                $value = self::issueCost($lot, $take);
            } else {
                $value = Money::q2($take->multipliedBy(self::unitCost($lot)));
            }
            if ($adjType === 'Supplier return') {
                $sup = $lot->supplier_id ? Supplier::find($lot->supplier_id) : null;
                if ($sup === null) {
                    throw new BusinessRuleError('This batch has no supplier (opening stock or transfer); return it through the original supplier record');
                }
                $creditNote = Money::q2($take->multipliedBy($lot->unit_cost));
                $p->dr(2010, $creditNote, $sup->code);
                $p->cr($inv, $value);
                if (! $creditNote->isEqualTo($value)) {
                    $p->dr((int) $cat->cogs_account, $value->minus($creditNote));
                }
                if (Ledger::setting('vat_registered', 'Yes') === 'Yes' && $prod->tax_code === 'SR20' && $sup->vat_registered) {
                    $tx = Tax::addExclusive($creditNote, Tax::ratesFor('SR20', $on, false));
                    foreach (array_combine(self::INPUT_TAX, [$tx['vat'], $tx['nhil'], $tx['getfund']]) as $acct => $amt) {
                        $p->dr(2010, $amt, $sup->code);
                        $p->cr($acct, $amt);
                    }
                }
            } else {
                $p->dr($drAcct ?? $inv, $value);
                $p->cr($crAcct ?? $inv, $value);
            }
            $kind = strtoupper(str_replace(' ', '_', $adjType));
            if ($bOut) {
                $pending[] = self::move($lot, $take->negated(), $value->negated(), $kind, $ref, $on, $bOut);
            }
            if ($bIn) {
                $pending[] = self::move($lot, $take, $value, $kind, $ref, $on, $bIn);
            }
        }
        $j = Ledger::post($branchId, $on, 'ADJUST', $documentNo ?: "ADJ-{$prod->sku}-{$on}", $p->lines(), $user, "{$adjType}: {$reason}", $approver);
        foreach ($pending as $m) {
            $m->update(['journal_id' => $j->id]);
        }

        return $j->id;
    }

    public static function adjust(int $branchId, string $on, string $sku, string $batchNo, string $adjType, mixed $qty, string $user, ?string $approver, ?string $documentNo = null, string $reason = ''): int
    {
        if (! isset(self::ADJ[$adjType])) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("Unknown adjustment type {$adjType}");
        }
        $prod = self::productByCode($sku);
        $alloc = self::allocBatch($branchId, $prod, $batchNo, $qty, self::ADJ[$adjType][2]);

        return self::adjustLots($branchId, $on, $prod, $alloc, $adjType, $user, $approver, $documentNo, $reason);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ transfers
    /** Moves stock between branches at cost: 1195 in both branches, equal and opposite. */
    public static function transfer(int $fromBranchId, int $toBranchId, string $sku, mixed $qty, string $on, ?string $noteNo, string $user, ?string $approver, ?string $batchNo = null): BigDecimal
    {
        if ($fromBranchId === $toBranchId) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Choose two different branches');
        }
        Branches::requireTrading($fromBranchId);
        Branches::requireTrading($toBranchId);
        if (! $noteNo) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Transfer note number required');
        }
        if (! $approver || $approver === $user) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Transfers need an approver other than the person entering them');
        }
        $prod = self::productByCode($sku);
        [$a, $b] = [Branch::find($fromBranchId), Branch::find($toBranchId)];
        $inv = self::inventoryAccount($prod);
        $total = Money::zero();
        $pending = [];
        foreach (self::pick($fromBranchId, $prod, $qty, $on, $batchNo) as [$lot, $take]) {
            $value = self::issueCost($lot, $take);
            $total = $total->plus($value);
            $new = StockLot::create(['branch_id' => $toBranchId, 'product_id' => $prod->id, 'batch_no' => $lot->batch_no, 'expiry' => $lot->expiry,
                'received_on' => $on, 'unit_cost' => (string) Money::div20($value, $take)->toScale(6, \Brick\Math\RoundingMode::HALF_UP),
                'source_ref' => $noteNo, 'nrv_per_unit' => $lot->nrv_per_unit]);
            $out = self::move($lot, $take->negated(), $value->negated(), 'TRANSFER_OUT', $noteNo, $on);
            $pending[] = [$out, $new, $take, $value];
        }
        $pa = new Poster;
        $pb = new Poster;
        $pa->dr(1195, $total, "BR-{$b->code}");
        $pa->cr($inv, $total);
        $pb->dr($inv, $total);
        $pb->cr(1195, $total, "BR-{$a->code}");
        $ja = Ledger::post($a->id, $on, 'TRANSFER', $noteNo, $pa->lines(), $user, "Transfer to branch {$b->code}", $approver);
        $jb = Ledger::post($b->id, $on, 'TRANSFER', $noteNo, $pb->lines(), $user, "Transfer from branch {$a->code}", $approver);
        foreach ($pending as [$out, $new, $take, $value]) {
            $out->update(['journal_id' => $ja->id]);
            self::move($new, $take, $value, 'TRANSFER_IN', $noteNo, $on, 'SALEABLE', $jb->id);
        }

        return $total;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ valuation, NRV, reconciliation
    public static function valuation(int $branchId, string $asOf): array
    {
        $rows = [];
        $near = (int) Ledger::setting('near_expiry_days', '90');
        foreach (StockLot::where('branch_id', $branchId)->where('received_on', '<=', $asOf)->orderBy('id')->get() as $lot) {
            $sal = self::onHand($lot->id, 'SALEABLE', $asOf);
            $qua = self::onHand($lot->id, 'QUARANTINE', $asOf);
            if ($sal->isZero() && $qua->isZero()) {
                continue;
            }
            $uc = self::unitCost($lot, $asOf);
            $qv = self::lotPool($lot->id, 'QUARANTINE', $asOf)[1];
            $wd = ($lot->nrv_per_unit !== null && $sal->isPositive())
                ? Money::q2(BigDecimal::max(BigDecimal::zero(), $uc->minus($lot->nrv_per_unit))->multipliedBy($sal)) : Money::zero();
            $days = (int) floor((strtotime($lot->expiry) - strtotime($asOf)) / 86400);
            $prod = Product::find($lot->product_id);
            $rows[] = ['lot_id' => $lot->id, 'sku' => $prod->sku, 'batch' => $lot->batch_no, 'expiry' => $lot->expiry, 'saleable' => (string) $sal,
                'quarantine' => (string) $qua, 'unit_cost' => (string) $uc->toScale(6, \Brick\Math\RoundingMode::HALF_UP),
                'value' => Money::q2($sal->multipliedBy($uc)), 'quarantine_value' => Money::q2($qv), 'nrv_writedown' => $wd,
                'alert' => $days < 0 && $sal->isPositive() ? 'EXPIRED' : ($days <= $near && $sal->isPositive() ? 'NEAR EXPIRY' : '')];
        }

        return $rows;
    }

    public static function nrvTrueUp(int $branchId, string $on, string $user): ?int
    {
        $required = Money::sum(array_column(self::valuation($branchId, $on), 'nrv_writedown'));
        $current = Reports::accountBalance(1250, $on, [$branchId])->negated();
        $delta = Money::q2($required->minus($current));
        if ($delta->isZero()) {
            return null;
        }
        $lines = $delta->isPositive() ? [[5065, $delta, '0'], [1250, '0', $delta]] : [[1250, $delta->negated(), '0'], [5065, '0', $delta->negated()]];

        return Ledger::post($branchId, $on, 'ADJUST', "NRV-{$on}", $lines, $user, 'NRV allowance true-up')->id;
    }

    /** Stock sub-ledger (sum of move values) by inventory account versus the ledger – must agree to the pesewa. */
    public static function reconciliation(int $branchId, string $asOf): array
    {
        $rows = DB::table('stock_move')->join('stock_lot', 'stock_lot.id', '=', 'stock_move.lot_id')->join('product', 'product.id', '=', 'stock_lot.product_id')
            ->where('stock_lot.branch_id', $branchId)->where('stock_move.move_date', '<=', $asOf)
            ->groupBy('product.category_name', 'stock_move.bucket')
            ->selectRaw('product.category_name AS c, stock_move.bucket AS b, COALESCE(SUM(stock_move.value),0) AS v')->get();
        $sub = [];
        foreach ($rows as $r) {
            $acct = $r->b === 'QUARANTINE' ? 1240 : (int) Category::find($r->c)->inventory_account;
            $sub[$acct] = ($sub[$acct] ?? BigDecimal::zero())->plus(Money::db($r->v));
        }
        $out = [];
        $accts = array_unique(array_merge(array_keys($sub), [1200, 1205, 1210, 1215, 1220, 1240]));
        sort($accts);
        $ok = true;
        foreach ($accts as $acct) {
            $gl = Reports::accountBalance($acct, $asOf, [$branchId]);
            $s = $sub[$acct] ?? BigDecimal::zero();
            $out[$acct] = ['subledger' => Money::q2($s), 'gl' => Money::q2($gl), 'difference' => Money::q2($gl->minus($s))];
            $ok = $ok && $out[$acct]['difference']->isZero();
        }
        $out['ok'] = $ok;

        return $out;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ stock count (blind count, second-person approval)
    public static function openCount(int $branchId, string $on, string $user): StockCount
    {
        Branches::requireTrading($branchId);
        if (StockCount::where('branch_id', $branchId)->where('status', '<>', 'APPROVED')->exists()) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('A stock count is already open for this branch');
        }
        $c = StockCount::create(['branch_id' => $branchId, 'count_date' => $on, 'status' => 'OPEN', 'opened_by' => $user]);
        foreach (StockLot::where('branch_id', $branchId)->where('received_on', '<=', $on)->orderBy('product_id')->orderBy('expiry')->get() as $lot) {
            $q = self::onHand($lot->id, 'SALEABLE', $on);
            if (! $q->isZero()) {
                StockCountLine::create(['count_id' => $c->id, 'lot_id' => $lot->id, 'system_qty' => (string) $q]);
            }
        }

        return $c;
    }

    /** What the counter sees: product, batch and expiry – never the system quantity. */
    public static function countSheet(StockCount $c): array
    {
        return StockCountLine::where('count_id', $c->id)->orderBy('id')->get()->map(function ($l) {
            $lot = StockLot::find($l->lot_id);
            $p = Product::find($lot->product_id);

            return ['line_id' => $l->id, 'sku' => $p->sku, 'product' => $p->name, 'batch' => $lot->batch_no, 'expiry' => $lot->expiry, 'counted' => $l->counted_qty];
        })->all();
    }

    public static function recordCounts(StockCount $c, array $counts, string $counter): void
    {
        if ($c->status !== 'OPEN') {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Count is not open');
        }
        $lines = StockCountLine::where('count_id', $c->id)->get()->keyBy('id');
        foreach ($counts as $lid => $q) {
            if (! isset($lines[(int) $lid]) || Money::d($q)->isNegative()) {
                throw new BusinessRuleError("Invalid count line {$lid}");
            }
            $lines[(int) $lid]->update(['counted_qty' => (string) $q]);
        }
        if (StockCountLine::where('count_id', $c->id)->whereNull('counted_qty')->doesntExist()) {
            $c->update(['status' => 'COUNTED', 'counted_by' => $counter]);
        }
    }

    /** A second person reviews the variances and posts them (5050); the counter cannot approve their own count. */
    public static function approveCount(StockCount $c, string $approver): array
    {
        if ($c->status !== 'COUNTED') {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('All lines must be counted before approval');
        }
        if (in_array($approver, [$c->counted_by, $c->opened_by], true)) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('The approver must not be the counter or the person who opened the count');
        }
        $variances = [];
        $byProd = [];
        foreach (StockCountLine::where('count_id', $c->id)->orderBy('id')->get() as $l) {
            $diff = Money::d($l->counted_qty)->minus($l->system_qty);
            if (! $diff->isZero()) {
                $lot = StockLot::find($l->lot_id);
                $key = $lot->product_id.'|'.($diff->isPositive() ? '1' : '0');
                $byProd[$key][] = [$lot, $diff->abs()];
                $variances[] = ['sku' => Product::find($lot->product_id)->sku, 'batch' => $lot->batch_no, 'system' => $l->system_qty,
                    'counted' => $l->counted_qty, 'difference' => (string) $diff];
            }
        }
        foreach ($byProd as $key => $alloc) {
            [$pid, $surplus] = explode('|', $key);
            self::adjustLots($c->branch_id, $c->count_date, Product::find((int) $pid), $alloc, $surplus === '1' ? 'Count surplus' : 'Count shortage',
                $c->counted_by, $approver, "COUNT-{$c->id}", 'Stock count variance');
        }
        $c->update(['status' => 'APPROVED', 'approved_by' => $approver]);

        return $variances;
    }
}

####################################################################################################
##### FILE: app/Domain/Sales.php
####################################################################################################

<?php

namespace App\Domain;

use App\Models\Branch;
use App\Models\Category;
use App\Models\Channel;
use App\Models\Claim;
use App\Models\Payer;
use App\Models\PriceListItem;
use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\Sale;
use App\Models\SaleLine;
use App\Models\SalePayment;
use App\Models\StockLot;
use Brick\Math\BigDecimal;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

/**
 * Point of sale: one checkout = one receipt, one journal, stock moves and (if insured) a claim. Port of services/sales.py.
 * Postings: Dr cash / MoMo / card (patient portion), Dr 1106 or 1110 (payer portion), Cr revenue (net), Cr 2100/2105/2110
 * (output tax), Dr cost of sales / Cr inventory, Dr 4055 / Cr 1109 (expected claim reduction).
 */
final class Sales
{
    public const OUTPUT_TAX = [2100, 2105, 2110];

    public const RX_CATEGORIES = ['Prescription medicine', 'Controlled drug'];

    public static function blocked(Product $p): bool
    {
        return in_array($p->tax_code, [null, '', 'REVIEW'], true) || ! $p->sale_unit;
    }

    public static function unitPrice(Payer $payer, Product $product, string $on, ?int $branchId = null): BigDecimal
    {
        if ($payer->payer_type !== 'Retail') {
            $row = PriceListItem::where('payer_id', $payer->id)->where('product_id', $product->id)->where('effective_from', '<=', $on)
                ->orderByDesc('effective_from')->first();
            if ($row) {
                return Money::d($row->price);
            }
        }

        return Branches::retailPrice($branchId, $product);
    }

    /** Splits an amount over quantities; the last part takes the rounding. */
    private static function alloc(BigDecimal $total, array $parts): array
    {
        $qty = Money::sum($parts);
        [$out, $used] = [[], BigDecimal::zero()];
        foreach (array_values($parts) as $i => $p) {
            $a = $i === count($parts) - 1 ? $total->minus($used) : Money::q2(Money::div20($total->multipliedBy($p), $qty));
            $out[] = $a;
            $used = $used->plus($a);
        }

        return $out;
    }

    /**
     * items: [code (SKU or barcode), qty, discount?, price_override?, batch_no?]; payments: [channel, amount] = patient portion.
     * client_uuid: re-sending the same sale (offline sync, retry) returns the original. Prescription-only and controlled
     * medicines need prescription_ref and prescriber; controlled drugs also the dispensing pharmacist (not the cashier).
     */
    public static function checkout(int $branchId, string $receiptNo, string $on, string $till, string $payerCode, array $items, array $payments,
        string $cashier, ?string $memberRef = null, ?string $claimNo = null, ?string $approver = null, mixed $tendered = null, ?string $clientUuid = null,
        ?string $prescriptionRef = null, ?string $prescriber = null, ?string $dispensedBy = null): Sale
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($branchId, $receiptNo, $on, $till, $payerCode, $items, $payments, $cashier, $memberRef, $claimNo,
            $approver, $tendered, $clientUuid, $prescriptionRef, $prescriber, $dispensedBy) {
            Branches::requireTrading($branchId, 'sales or tills');
            Inventory::lockProducts(array_map(fn ($it) => Inventory::productByCode($it['code'])->id, $items));
            if ($clientUuid && ($done = Sale::where('client_uuid', $clientUuid)->first())) {
                return $done;
            }
            $payer = Payer::where('code', $payerCode)->first();
            if ($payer === null) {
                throw new BusinessRuleError("Unknown payer {$payerCode}");
            }
            if (Sale::where('branch_id', $branchId)->where('receipt_no', $receiptNo)->exists()) {
                throw new BusinessRuleError("Receipt number {$receiptNo} already used");
            }
            $insured = in_array($payer->payer_type, ['NHIS', 'Insurer'], true);
            if ($insured && ! $claimNo) {
                throw new BusinessRuleError('Claim ID required for NHIS and insurer sales');
            }
            $needsApproval = false;
            foreach ($items as $i) {
                $needsApproval = $needsApproval || ! Money::d($i['discount'] ?? 0)->isZero() || isset($i['price_override']);
            }
            if ($needsApproval && (! $approver || $approver === $cashier)) {
                throw new BusinessRuleError("Discount or price override needs a supervisor's approval (not the cashier)");
            }
            $sale = Sale::create(['branch_id' => $branchId, 'receipt_no' => $receiptNo, 'sale_date' => $on, 'till' => $till, 'payer_id' => $payer->id,
                'member_ref' => $memberRef, 'cashier' => $cashier, 'approved_by' => $needsApproval ? $approver : null, 'client_uuid' => $clientUuid,
                'prescription_ref' => $prescriptionRef, 'prescriber' => $prescriber, 'dispensed_by' => $dispensedBy, 'evat_status' => 'PENDING']);
            $p = new Poster;
            $claimParty = $insured ? "CLM:{$claimNo}" : null;
            $moves = [];
            [$totPatient, $totPayer, $totExp] = [BigDecimal::zero(), BigDecimal::zero(), BigDecimal::zero()];
            foreach ($items as $it) {
                $prod = Inventory::productByCode($it['code']);
                if (self::blocked($prod)) {
                    throw new BusinessRuleError("{$prod->sku} is blocked: tax code missing or under REVIEW");
                }
                if (! Branches::isActive($branchId, $prod)) {
                    throw new BusinessRuleError("{$prod->sku} is not sold in this branch (inactive here)");
                }
                $needsRx = (in_array($prod->category_name, self::RX_CATEGORIES, true) || $prod->controlled) && Ledger::setting('require_prescription', 'Yes') === 'Yes';
                if ($needsRx && ! ($prescriptionRef && $prescriber)) {
                    throw new BusinessRuleError("{$prod->sku} is prescription-only: enter the prescription reference and prescriber");
                }
                if ($prod->controlled && (! $dispensedBy || $dispensedBy === $cashier)) {
                    throw new BusinessRuleError("{$prod->sku} is a controlled drug: the dispensing pharmacist (not the cashier) must be recorded");
                }
                $qty = Money::d($it['qty']);
                if (! $qty->isPositive()) {
                    throw new BusinessRuleError('Use returnSale() for returns');
                }
                $price = isset($it['price_override']) ? Money::d($it['price_override']) : self::unitPrice($payer, $prod, $on, $branchId);
                $allocs = Inventory::pick($branchId, $prod, $qty, $on, $it['batch_no'] ?? null);
                $discs = self::alloc(Money::d($it['discount'] ?? 0), array_column($allocs, 1));
                $rates = Tax::ratesFor($prod->tax_code, $on);
                $cat = Category::find($prod->category_name);
                foreach ($allocs as $k => [$lot, $q]) {
                    $disc = $discs[$k];
                    $sp = Tax::splitInclusive($q->multipliedBy($price)->minus($disc), $rates);
                    if ($sp['gross']->isNegative()) {
                        throw new BusinessRuleError('Discount exceeds the line value');
                    }
                    $patient = $payer->payer_type === 'Retail' ? $sp['gross'] : Money::q2($sp['gross']->multipliedBy($payer->copay_pct));
                    $payerPart = $sp['gross']->minus($patient);
                    $expRed = $insured ? Money::q2($payerPart->multipliedBy($payer->expected_reduction_pct)) : Money::zero();
                    $cost = Inventory::issueCost($lot, $q);
                    $moves[] = Inventory::move($lot, $q->negated(), $cost->negated(), 'SALE', $receiptNo, $on);
                    SaleLine::create(['sale_id' => $sale->id, 'product_id' => $prod->id, 'lot_id' => $lot->id, 'qty' => (string) $q, 'unit_price' => (string) $price,
                        'discount' => (string) $disc, 'gross' => (string) $sp['gross'], 'base' => (string) $sp['base'], 'vat' => (string) $sp['vat'],
                        'nhil' => (string) $sp['nhil'], 'getfund' => (string) $sp['getfund'], 'net_revenue' => (string) $sp['net_revenue'],
                        'patient_portion' => (string) $patient, 'payer_portion' => (string) $payerPart, 'expected_reduction' => (string) $expRed,
                        'unit_cost' => (string) Money::div20($cost, $q)->toScale(6, \Brick\Math\RoundingMode::HALF_UP), 'cost' => (string) $cost]);
                    $p->cr((int) $cat->revenue_account, $sp['net_revenue']);
                    foreach (array_combine(self::OUTPUT_TAX, [$sp['vat'], $sp['nhil'], $sp['getfund']]) as $acct => $amt) {
                        $p->cr($acct, $amt);
                    }
                    $p->dr((int) $cat->cogs_account, $cost);
                    $p->cr((int) $cat->inventory_account, $cost);
                    if (! $expRed->isZero()) {
                        $p->dr(4055, $expRed);
                        $p->cr(1109, $expRed, $claimParty);
                    }
                    $totPatient = $totPatient->plus($patient);
                    $totPayer = $totPayer->plus($payerPart);
                    $totExp = $totExp->plus($expRed);
                }
            }
            // Screens: one payment line may say BALANCE – it takes whatever the patient still owes after the other lines.
            if (in_array('BALANCE', array_column($payments, 'amount'), true)) {
                $rest = Money::q2($totPatient)->minus(Money::sum(array_map(fn ($x) => $x['amount'] === 'BALANCE' ? '0' : $x['amount'], $payments)));
                if ($rest->isNegative() || count(array_keys(array_column($payments, 'amount'), 'BALANCE', true)) > 1) {
                    throw new BusinessRuleError('Payments entered exceed the patient portion '.Money::q2($totPatient));
                }
                $payments = array_values(array_filter(array_map(fn ($x) => $x['amount'] === 'BALANCE' ? ['channel' => $x['channel'], 'amount' => (string) $rest] : $x, $payments),
                    fn ($x) => ! Money::d($x['amount'])->isZero()));
            }
            $paid = Money::q2(Money::sum(array_column($payments, 'amount')));
            if (! $paid->isEqualTo(Money::q2($totPatient))) {
                throw new BusinessRuleError("Payments {$paid} must equal the patient portion ".Money::q2($totPatient));
            }
            foreach ($payments as $x) {
                $ch = Channel::find($x['channel']);
                if ($ch === null || $ch->name === 'Inter-branch') {
                    throw new BusinessRuleError("Invalid payment channel {$x['channel']}");
                }
                if ($ch->name === 'Credit' && $payer->payer_type !== 'Corporate') {
                    throw new BusinessRuleError('Credit sales are for corporate customers only');
                }
                $p->dr((int) $ch->account, $x['amount'], (int) $ch->account === 1110 ? $payer->code : null);
                SalePayment::create(['sale_id' => $sale->id, 'channel' => $ch->name, 'amount' => (string) Money::q2($x['amount'])]);
            }
            if (! $totPayer->isZero()) {
                $payer->payer_type === 'Corporate' ? $p->dr(1110, $totPayer, $payer->code) : $p->dr(1106, $totPayer, $claimParty);
            }
            if ($payer->payer_type === 'Corporate') {
                $credit = Money::sum(array_map(fn ($x) => $x['channel'] === 'Credit' ? $x['amount'] : '0', $payments));
                $exposure = Reports::partyBalance(1110, $payer->code, $on)->plus($totPayer)->plus($credit);
                if (Money::d($payer->credit_limit)->isPositive() && $exposure->isGreaterThan($payer->credit_limit)) {
                    throw new BusinessRuleError("Credit limit exceeded for {$payer->code}: {$exposure} > {$payer->credit_limit}");
                }
            }
            if ($insured) {
                $claim = Claim::where('payer_id', $payer->id)->where('claim_no', $claimNo)->first()
                    ?? Claim::create(['branch_id' => $branchId, 'payer_id' => $payer->id, 'claim_no' => $claimNo, 'status' => 'Pending', 'amount' => '0',
                        'expected_reduction' => '0', 'approved_amount' => '0', 'paid_amount' => '0', 'disputed_amount' => '0']);
                if ($claim->status !== 'Pending') {
                    throw new BusinessRuleError("Claim {$claimNo} is already {$claim->status}; open a new claim ID");
                }
                $claim->update(['amount' => (string) Money::d($claim->amount)->plus($totPayer), 'expected_reduction' => (string) Money::d($claim->expected_reduction)->plus($totExp)]);
                $sale->claim_id = $claim->id;
            }
            if ($tendered !== null) {
                $cash = Money::sum(array_map(fn ($x) => $x['channel'] === 'Cash' ? $x['amount'] : '0', $payments));
                if (Money::d($tendered)->isLessThan($cash)) {
                    throw new BusinessRuleError('Amount tendered is less than the cash due');
                }
                $sale->tendered = (string) Money::q2($tendered);
                $sale->change_due = (string) Money::q2(Money::d($tendered)->minus($cash));
            }
            $j = Ledger::post($branchId, $on, 'SALE', $receiptNo, $p->lines(), $cashier, null, $sale->approved_by);
            $sale->journal_id = $j->id;
            $sale->save();
            foreach ($moves as $m) {
                $m->update(['journal_id' => $j->id]);
            }

            return $sale->fresh();
        });
    }

    /** items: [line_id, qty]. Stock goes back to the same batch at the cost it left; tax reversed at the original rates. */
    public static function returnSale(int $branchId, string $originalReceipt, string $returnNo, string $on, array $items, string $refundChannel, string $cashier, ?string $approver): Sale
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($branchId, $originalReceipt, $returnNo, $on, $items, $refundChannel, $cashier, $approver) {
            $orig = Sale::where('branch_id', $branchId)->where('receipt_no', $originalReceipt)->first();
            if ($orig === null) {
                throw new BusinessRuleError('Original receipt not found');
            }
            if (! $approver || $approver === $cashier) {
                throw new BusinessRuleError("Returns need a supervisor's approval");
            }
            $origLines = SaleLine::where('sale_id', $orig->id)->get()->keyBy('id');
            Inventory::lockProducts($origLines->pluck('product_id'));
            $payer = Payer::find($orig->payer_id);
            if (in_array($payer->payer_type, ['NHIS', 'Insurer'], true) && Claim::find($orig->claim_id)->status !== 'Pending') {
                throw new BusinessRuleError('Claim already submitted: adjust it with the payer instead');
            }
            $ret = Sale::create(['branch_id' => $branchId, 'receipt_no' => $returnNo, 'sale_date' => $on, 'till' => $orig->till, 'payer_id' => $orig->payer_id,
                'member_ref' => $orig->member_ref, 'claim_id' => $orig->claim_id, 'cashier' => $cashier, 'approved_by' => $approver,
                'original_sale_id' => $orig->id, 'evat_status' => 'PENDING']);
            $p = new Poster;
            $moves = [];
            [$refund, $payerBack, $expBack] = [BigDecimal::zero(), BigDecimal::zero(), BigDecimal::zero()];
            $prior = SaleLine::whereIn('sale_id', Sale::where('original_sale_id', $orig->id)->where('id', '<>', $ret->id)->pluck('id'))->get();
            foreach ($items as $it) {
                $ol = $origLines[(int) $it['line_id']] ?? null;
                if ($ol === null) {
                    throw new BusinessRuleError('Line not on the original receipt');
                }
                $q = Money::d($it['qty']);
                $already = Money::sum($prior->filter(fn ($l) => $l->lot_id === $ol->lot_id && $l->product_id === $ol->product_id)->pluck('qty')->all())->negated();
                if (! $q->isPositive() || $q->plus($already)->isGreaterThan($ol->qty)) {
                    throw new BusinessRuleError('Return quantity exceeds what was sold on that line');
                }
                $part = fn ($k) => Money::q2(Money::div20(Money::d($ol->{$k})->multipliedBy($q), $ol->qty));
                $parts = [];
                foreach (['gross', 'vat', 'nhil', 'getfund', 'patient_portion', 'expected_reduction'] as $k) {
                    $parts[$k] = $part($k);
                }
                $net = $parts['gross']->minus($parts['vat'])->minus($parts['nhil'])->minus($parts['getfund']);
                $payerPart = $parts['gross']->minus($parts['patient_portion']);
                $cost = $q->isEqualTo($ol->qty) ? Money::d($ol->cost) : Money::q2(Money::div20(Money::d($ol->cost)->multipliedBy($q), $ol->qty));
                $cat = Category::find(Product::find($ol->product_id)->category_name);
                SaleLine::create(['sale_id' => $ret->id, 'product_id' => $ol->product_id, 'lot_id' => $ol->lot_id, 'qty' => (string) $q->negated(),
                    'unit_price' => $ol->unit_price, 'discount' => '0', 'gross' => (string) $parts['gross']->negated(), 'base' => (string) $net->negated(),
                    'vat' => (string) $parts['vat']->negated(), 'nhil' => (string) $parts['nhil']->negated(), 'getfund' => (string) $parts['getfund']->negated(),
                    'net_revenue' => (string) $net->negated(), 'patient_portion' => (string) $parts['patient_portion']->negated(),
                    'payer_portion' => (string) $payerPart->negated(), 'expected_reduction' => (string) $parts['expected_reduction']->negated(),
                    'unit_cost' => $ol->unit_cost, 'cost' => (string) $cost->negated()]);
                $p->dr((int) $cat->revenue_account, $net);
                foreach (array_combine(self::OUTPUT_TAX, [$parts['vat'], $parts['nhil'], $parts['getfund']]) as $acct => $amt) {
                    $p->dr($acct, $amt);
                }
                $p->dr((int) $cat->inventory_account, $cost);
                $p->cr((int) $cat->cogs_account, $cost);
                if (! $parts['expected_reduction']->isZero()) {
                    $p->dr(1109, $parts['expected_reduction'], 'CLM:'.Claim::find($orig->claim_id)->claim_no);
                    $p->cr(4055, $parts['expected_reduction']);
                }
                $moves[] = [StockLot::find($ol->lot_id), $q, $cost];
                $refund = $refund->plus($parts['patient_portion']);
                $payerBack = $payerBack->plus($payerPart);
                $expBack = $expBack->plus($parts['expected_reduction']);
            }
            $ch = Channel::find($refundChannel);
            if ($ch === null || $ch->name === 'Inter-branch' || ($ch->name === 'Credit' && $payer->payer_type !== 'Corporate')) {
                throw new BusinessRuleError("Invalid refund channel {$refundChannel}");
            }
            if (! $refund->isZero()) {
                $p->cr((int) $ch->account, $refund, (int) $ch->account === 1110 ? $payer->code : null);
                SalePayment::create(['sale_id' => $ret->id, 'channel' => $ch->name, 'amount' => (string) $refund->negated()]);
            }
            if (! $payerBack->isZero()) {
                if ($payer->payer_type === 'Corporate') {
                    $p->cr(1110, $payerBack, $payer->code);
                } else {
                    $claim = Claim::find($orig->claim_id);
                    $p->cr(1106, $payerBack, "CLM:{$claim->claim_no}");
                    $claim->update(['amount' => (string) Money::d($claim->amount)->minus($payerBack),
                        'expected_reduction' => (string) Money::d($claim->expected_reduction)->minus($expBack)]);
                }
            }
            $j = Ledger::post($branchId, $on, 'SALE', $returnNo, $p->lines(), $cashier, "Return against {$originalReceipt}", $approver);
            $ret->update(['journal_id' => $j->id]);
            foreach ($moves as [$lot, $q, $cost]) {
                Inventory::move($lot, $q, $cost, 'RETURN', $returnNo, $on, 'SALEABLE', $j->id);
            }
            Ledger::audit($cashier, 'RETURN', 'sale', $ret->id, "against {$originalReceipt}");
            $pids = array_unique(array_map(fn ($m) => $m[0]->product_id, $moves));
            sort($pids);
            foreach ($pids as $pid) {
                Inventory::equalise($pid, $on, $returnNo, $cashier);
            }

            return $ret->fresh();
        });
    }

    /** Plain-text receipt for an 80 mm thermal printer. Not a GRA VAT invoice until an E-VAT reference is attached. */
    public static function receiptText(int $saleId, int $width = 42): string
    {
        $sale = Sale::find($saleId);
        if ($sale === null) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Sale not found');
        }
        $br = Branch::find($sale->branch_id);
        $payer = Payer::find($sale->payer_id);
        $lines = SaleLine::where('sale_id', $sale->id)->orderBy('id')->get();
        $c = function ($t) use ($width) { // as Python's str.center
            $marg = $width - mb_strlen($t);
            if ($marg <= 0) {
                return $t;
            }
            $left = intdiv($marg, 2) + ($marg & $width & 1);

            return str_repeat(' ', $left).$t.str_repeat(' ', $marg - $left);
        };
        $rr = function ($a, $b) use ($width) {
            $w = $width - mb_strlen($b) - 1;

            $a = mb_substr($a, 0, $w);

            return $a.str_repeat(' ', max(0, $w - mb_strlen($a))).' '.$b;
        };
        $L = [$c(Ledger::setting('business_name', 'Pharmacy')), $c($br->name), $c('TIN: '.Ledger::setting('business_tin', '-')), str_repeat('-', $width),
            ($sale->original_sale_id ? 'CREDIT NOTE / RETURN' : 'RECEIPT')." {$sale->receipt_no}",
            date('d-M-Y', strtotime($sale->sale_date))."  Till {$sale->till}  Cashier {$sale->cashier}"];
        if ($sale->member_ref) {
            $L[] = "{$payer->name} ref: {$sale->member_ref}";
        }
        if ($sale->prescription_ref) {
            $L[] = "Rx: {$sale->prescription_ref}";
        }
        $L[] = str_repeat('-', $width);
        foreach ($lines as $l) {
            $prod = Product::find($l->product_id);
            $L[] = mb_substr($prod->name, 0, $width);
            $L[] = $rr('  '.Money::q2($l->qty)." x {$l->unit_price} [{$prod->tax_code}]", (string) Money::q2(Money::d($l->gross)->plus($l->discount)));
            if (! Money::d($l->discount)->isZero()) {
                $L[] = $rr('  Discount', '-'.Money::q2($l->discount));
            }
        }
        $tot = fn ($k) => (string) Money::q2(Money::sum($lines->pluck($k)->all()));
        array_push($L, str_repeat('-', $width), $rr('TOTAL (tax inclusive)', $tot('gross')), $rr('  of which VAT 15%', $tot('vat')),
            $rr('  NHIL 2.5%', $tot('nhil')), $rr('  GETFund 2.5%', $tot('getfund')));
        if (! Money::d($tot('payer_portion'))->isZero()) {
            array_push($L, $rr("Paid by {$payer->code}", $tot('payer_portion')), $rr('PATIENT PAYS', $tot('patient_portion')));
        }
        foreach (SalePayment::where('sale_id', $sale->id)->orderBy('id')->get() as $pm) {
            $L[] = $rr("  {$pm->channel}", (string) Money::q2($pm->amount));
        }
        if ($sale->tendered !== null) {
            array_push($L, $rr('  Tendered', (string) Money::q2($sale->tendered)), $rr('  Change', (string) Money::q2($sale->change_due)));
        }
        array_push($L, str_repeat('-', $width), $c($sale->evat_ref ? "E-VAT: {$sale->evat_ref}" : 'Not a VAT invoice - E-VAT pending'), $c('Thank you'));

        return implode("\n", $L);
    }
}

####################################################################################################
##### FILE: app/Domain/Claims.php
####################################################################################################

<?php

namespace App\Domain;

use App\Models\Channel;
use App\Models\Claim;
use App\Models\ClaimEvent;
use App\Models\Payer;

/**
 * NHIS / insurer claims: Pending → Submitted → Approved → Part-paid / Settled; Denied; Disputed. Revenue was recognised net
 * of the expected vetting reduction (1109); at vetting the estimate is released and the shortfall classified. Port of claims.py.
 */
final class Claims
{
    public const SHORTFALL = ['Contractual pricing' => 4055, 'Documentation error' => 4055, 'Credit loss' => 6600, 'Disputed' => null];

    public static function get(string $payerCode, string $claimNo): Claim
    {
        $payer = Payer::where('code', $payerCode)->first();
        $c = $payer ? Claim::where('payer_id', $payer->id)->where('claim_no', $claimNo)->first() : null;
        if ($c === null) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("Claim {$payerCode}/{$claimNo} not found");
        }

        return $c;
    }

    private static function event(Claim $c, string $on, string $event, mixed $amount, ?int $jid = null, ?string $cls = null): void
    {
        ClaimEvent::create(['claim_id' => $c->id, 'event_date' => $on, 'event' => $event, 'amount' => (string) Money::q2($amount), 'journal_id' => $jid,
            'shortfall_class' => $cls]);
    }

    public static function submit(Claim $c, string $on, string $user): int
    {
        if ($c->status !== 'Pending') {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("Claim is {$c->status}");
        }
        $party = "CLM:{$c->claim_no}";
        $j = Ledger::post($c->branch_id, $on, 'CLAIM', "SUB-{$c->claim_no}", [[1107, $c->amount, '0', $party], [1106, '0', $c->amount, $party]], $user);
        $c->update(['status' => 'Submitted', 'submitted_on' => $on]);
        self::event($c, $on, 'Submitted', $c->amount, $j->id);

        return $j->id;
    }

    public static function vet(Claim $c, string $on, mixed $approvedAmount, string $user, string $shortfallClass = 'Contractual pricing'): int
    {
        if ($c->status !== 'Submitted') {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("Claim is {$c->status}; submit it first");
        }
        $approved = Money::q2($approvedAmount);
        $shortfall = Money::q2(Money::d($c->amount)->minus($approved));
        if ($approved->isNegative() || $shortfall->isNegative()) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Approved amount must be between 0 and the claimed amount');
        }
        if (! $shortfall->isZero() && ! array_key_exists($shortfallClass, self::SHORTFALL)) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Shortfall class must be one of '.implode(', ', array_keys(self::SHORTFALL)));
        }
        $party = "CLM:{$c->claim_no}";
        $p = new Poster;
        if (! Money::d($c->expected_reduction)->isZero()) {
            $p->dr(1109, $c->expected_reduction, $party);
            $p->cr(4055, $c->expected_reduction);
        }
        if (! $shortfall->isZero()) {
            $acct = self::SHORTFALL[$shortfallClass];
            if ($acct) {
                $p->dr($acct, $shortfall);
                $p->cr(1107, $shortfall, $party);
            } else {
                $c->disputed_amount = (string) $shortfall;
            }
        }
        if (! $approved->isZero()) {
            $p->dr(1108, $approved, $party);
            $p->cr(1107, $approved, $party);
        }
        $j = Ledger::post($c->branch_id, $on, 'CLAIM', "VET-{$c->claim_no}", $p->lines(), $user);
        $c->approved_amount = (string) $approved;
        $c->status = $approved->isZero() && $shortfallClass !== 'Disputed' ? 'Denied'
            : ($shortfallClass === 'Disputed' && ! $shortfall->isZero() ? 'Disputed' : 'Approved');
        $c->save();
        self::event($c, $on, 'Vetted', $approved, $j->id, $shortfall->isZero() ? null : $shortfallClass);

        return $j->id;
    }

    public static function receivePayment(Claim $c, string $on, mixed $amount, string $channel, string $user, mixed $whtWithheld = 0, ?string $whtCertificateNo = null,
        mixed $whvatWithheld = 0, ?string $whvatCertificateNo = null): int
    {
        $amt = Money::q2($amount);
        $outstanding = Money::d($c->approved_amount)->minus($c->paid_amount);
        if (! $amt->isPositive() || $amt->isGreaterThan($outstanding)) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("Payment must be between 0 and the approved balance {$outstanding}");
        }
        [$net, $extra] = Withholding::linesAndCheck($amt, $whtWithheld, $whtCertificateNo, $whvatWithheld, $whvatCertificateNo);
        $ch = Channel::find($channel);
        if ($ch === null || ! in_array((int) $ch->account, [1010, 1030, 1040, 1045], true)) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Invalid channel');
        }
        $party = "CLM:{$c->claim_no}";
        $j = Ledger::post($c->branch_id, $on, 'CLAIM', "PAY-{$c->claim_no}", array_merge([[(int) $ch->account, $net, '0']], $extra, [[1108, '0', $amt, $party]]), $user);
        Withholding::record($c->branch_id, Payer::find($c->payer_id)->code, $on, $c->claim_no, $j->id, $amt, $whtWithheld, $whtCertificateNo, $whvatWithheld, null, $whvatCertificateNo);
        $paid = Money::d($c->paid_amount)->plus($amt);
        $disputed = ! Money::d($c->disputed_amount)->isZero();
        $c->update(['paid_amount' => (string) $paid,
            'status' => $paid->isEqualTo($c->approved_amount) && ! $disputed ? 'Settled' : ($disputed ? 'Disputed' : 'Part-paid')]);
        self::event($c, $on, 'Paid', $amt, $j->id);

        return $j->id;
    }

    /** Closes a disputed shortfall: what the payer agrees to pay moves to approved (1108); the rest is written off. */
    public static function resolveDispute(Claim $c, string $on, mixed $recovered, string $user, string $writeOffClass = 'Contractual pricing'): int
    {
        if ($c->status !== 'Disputed' || Money::d($c->disputed_amount)->isZero()) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Claim has no open dispute');
        }
        [$rec, $dispute] = [Money::q2($recovered), Money::d($c->disputed_amount)];
        if ($rec->isNegative() || $rec->isGreaterThan($dispute)) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("Recovered amount must be between 0 and the disputed {$dispute}");
        }
        $acct = self::SHORTFALL[$writeOffClass] ?? null;
        $rest = $dispute->minus($rec);
        if (! $rest->isZero() && ! $acct) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Write-off class must be Contractual pricing, Documentation error or Credit loss');
        }
        $party = "CLM:{$c->claim_no}";
        $p = new Poster;
        if (! $rec->isZero()) {
            $p->dr(1108, $rec, $party);
            $p->cr(1107, $rec, $party);
        }
        if (! $rest->isZero()) {
            $p->dr($acct, $rest);
            $p->cr(1107, $rest, $party);
        }
        $j = Ledger::post($c->branch_id, $on, 'CLAIM', "DSP-{$c->claim_no}", $p->lines(), $user);
        $approved = Money::d($c->approved_amount)->plus($rec);
        $c->update(['approved_amount' => (string) $approved, 'disputed_amount' => '0',
            'status' => Money::d($c->paid_amount)->isEqualTo($approved) ? 'Settled' : (Money::d($c->paid_amount)->isZero() ? 'Approved' : 'Part-paid')]);
        self::event($c, $on, 'Dispute resolved', $rec, $j->id, $rest->isZero() ? null : $writeOffClass);

        return $j->id;
    }
}
