<?php

namespace App\Domain;

use App\Models\BankStatementLine;
use App\Models\Branch;
use App\Models\CashUp;
use App\Models\Channel;
use App\Models\JournalLine;
use App\Models\Sale;
use Brick\Math\BigDecimal;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

/**
 * Cash and banking: blind till cash-up with supervisor approval, cash banking, inter-branch cash, and bank / MoMo / card
 * statement import, matching and reconciliation. Port of services/cash.py (and opening.cash_transfer).
 */
final class CashBook
{
    public const RECONCILABLE = [1030, 1040, 1045];

    public static function expectedCash(int $branchId, string $till, string $on): BigDecimal
    {
        $v = DB::table('sale_payment')->join('sale', 'sale.id', '=', 'sale_payment.sale_id')->where('sale.branch_id', $branchId)
            ->where('sale.till', $till)->where('sale.sale_date', $on)->where('sale_payment.channel', 'Cash')->sum('sale_payment.amount');

        return Money::q2(Money::db($v ?: '0'));
    }

    /** Blind count: the cashier declares the cash counted before seeing what the system expects. */
    public static function declareCash(int $branchId, string $till, string $on, string $cashier, mixed $counted): array
    {
        Branches::requireTrading($branchId, 'tills');
        if (CashUp::where('branch_id', $branchId)->where('till', $till)->where('cash_date', $on)->exists()) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("Cash for till {$till} on {$on} has already been declared");
        }
        if (Money::d($counted)->isNegative()) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Counted cash cannot be negative');
        }
        $c = CashUp::create(['branch_id' => $branchId, 'till' => $till, 'cash_date' => $on, 'cashier' => $cashier, 'declared' => (string) Money::q2($counted), 'status' => 'DECLARED']);

        return ['cashup_id' => $c->id, 'status' => 'DECLARED'];
    }

    public static function approveCashup(int $cashupId, string $supervisor, ?string $reason = null): array
    {
        $c = CashUp::find($cashupId);
        if ($c === null || $c->status !== 'DECLARED') {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Cash-up not found or already approved');
        }
        if (! $supervisor || $supervisor === $c->cashier) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('A supervisor other than the cashier must approve the cash-up');
        }
        $exp = self::expectedCash($c->branch_id, $c->till, $c->cash_date);
        $var = Money::q2(Money::d($c->declared)->minus($exp));
        if ($var->abs()->isGreaterThan(Ledger::setting('cashup_tolerance', '5')) && ! $reason) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("Variance {$var} is above the tolerance: record the investigation result as the reason");
        }
        $jid = null;
        if (! $var->isZero()) {
            $lines = $var->isPositive() ? [[1010, $var, '0'], [6700, '0', $var]] : [[6700, $var->negated(), '0'], [1010, '0', $var->negated()]];
            $jid = Ledger::post($c->branch_id, $c->cash_date, 'CASHUP', "CU-{$c->till}-{$c->cash_date}", $lines, $c->cashier, $reason ?: 'Cash over/short within tolerance', $supervisor)->id;
        }
        $c->update(['expected' => (string) $exp, 'variance' => (string) $var, 'supervisor' => $supervisor, 'status' => 'APPROVED', 'journal_id' => $jid]);

        return ['expected' => $exp, 'declared' => $c->declared, 'variance' => $var, 'journal_id' => $jid];
    }

    /** Days and tills with cash takings but no approved cash-up. */
    public static function missingCashups(int $branchId, string $start, string $end): array
    {
        $sold = DB::table('sale')->join('sale_payment', 'sale_payment.sale_id', '=', 'sale.id')->where('sale.branch_id', $branchId)
            ->whereBetween('sale.sale_date', [$start, $end])->where('sale_payment.channel', 'Cash')->distinct()->get(['sale.till', 'sale.sale_date']);
        $done = CashUp::where('branch_id', $branchId)->where('status', 'APPROVED')->get()->map(fn ($c) => $c->till.'|'.$c->cash_date)->all();
        $out = [];
        foreach ($sold as $r) {
            if (! in_array($r->till.'|'.$r->sale_date, $done, true)) {
                $out[] = ['till' => $r->till, 'date' => $r->sale_date];
            }
        }
        usort($out, fn ($a, $b) => [$a['date'], $a['till']] <=> [$b['date'], $b['till']]);

        return $out;
    }

    /** Cash taken from the safe to the bank: Dr bank, Cr cash on hand. */
    public static function bankCash(int $branchId, string $on, mixed $amount, ?string $depositRef, string $user, ?string $approver, int $toAccount = 1030): int
    {
        if (! $depositRef) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Enter the bank deposit slip reference');
        }
        $amt = Money::q2($amount);
        if (! $amt->isPositive() || $amt->isGreaterThan(Reports::accountBalance(1010, $on, [$branchId]))) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Amount must be positive and not more than the cash on hand');
        }

        return Ledger::post($branchId, $on, 'CASH', $depositRef, [[$toAccount, $amt, '0'], [1010, '0', $amt]], $user, 'Cash banked', $approver)->id;
    }

    /** Money sent from one branch to another: both sides post in the same transaction through 1195. */
    public static function interBranch(int $fromBranchId, int $toBranchId, string $on, mixed $amount, string $fromChannel, string $toChannel, ?string $reference, string $user, ?string $approver): BigDecimal
    {
        if ($fromBranchId === $toBranchId || ! $reference) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Two different branches and a transfer reference are required');
        }
        if (! $approver || $approver === $user) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Inter-branch transfers need an approver other than the preparer');
        }
        [$fc, $tc] = [Channel::find($fromChannel), Channel::find($toChannel)];
        $ok = [1010, 1015, 1030, 1040];
        if ($fc === null || $tc === null || ! in_array((int) $fc->account, $ok, true) || ! in_array((int) $tc->account, $ok, true)) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Use Cash, Bank or MoMo channels for inter-branch cash');
        }
        [$a, $b, $amt] = [Branch::find($fromBranchId), Branch::find($toBranchId), Money::q2($amount)];
        if (! $amt->isPositive()) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Amount must be positive');
        }
        Ledger::post($a->id, $on, 'TRANSFER', $reference, [[1195, $amt, '0', "BR-{$b->code}"], [(int) $fc->account, '0', $amt]], $user, "Cash to branch {$b->code}", $approver);
        Ledger::post($b->id, $on, 'TRANSFER', $reference, [[(int) $tc->account, $amt, '0'], [1195, '0', $amt, "BR-{$a->code}"]], $user, "Cash from branch {$a->code}", $approver);

        return $amt;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ bank / MoMo / card reconciliation
    /** lines: [date, description, amount (+ in / - out), reference]. Exact duplicates are refused. */
    public static function importStatement(int $branchId, int $accountCode, array $lines, string $user): int
    {
        if (! in_array($accountCode, self::RECONCILABLE, true)) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Reconcile accounts 1030, 1040, 1045 only');
        }
        $n = 0;
        foreach ($lines as $ln) {
            $amt = (string) Money::q2($ln['amount']);
            $dup = BankStatementLine::where('branch_id', $branchId)->where('account_code', $accountCode)->where('line_date', $ln['date'])
                ->where('amount', $amt)->where('description', $ln['description'])->where('reference', $ln['reference'] ?? null)->exists();
            if ($dup) {
                throw new BusinessRuleError("Statement line already imported: {$ln['date']} {$ln['description']} {$ln['amount']}");
            }
            BankStatementLine::create(['branch_id' => $branchId, 'account_code' => $accountCode, 'line_date' => $ln['date'], 'description' => $ln['description'],
                'amount' => $amt, 'reference' => $ln['reference'] ?? null]);
            $n++;
        }
        Ledger::audit($user, 'STATEMENT_IMPORT', 'bank_statement_line', $accountCode, "{$n} lines");

        return $n;
    }

    private static function glLines(int $branchId, int $accountCode, ?string $start = null, ?string $end = null)
    {
        $matched = BankStatementLine::whereNotNull('matched_line_id')->pluck('matched_line_id');
        $q = DB::table('journal_line')->join('journal', 'journal.id', '=', 'journal_line.journal_id')->where('journal.branch_id', $branchId)
            ->where('journal_line.account_code', $accountCode)->whereNotIn('journal_line.id', $matched)
            ->orderBy('journal.entry_date')->orderBy('journal_line.id')
            ->select('journal_line.id', 'journal_line.debit', 'journal_line.credit', 'journal.entry_date', 'journal.source_ref');
        if ($start) {
            $q->where('journal.entry_date', '>=', $start);
        }
        if ($end) {
            $q->where('journal.entry_date', '<=', $end);
        }

        return $q->get();
    }

    /** Matches each unmatched statement line to one unmatched ledger line of the same amount within the date window. */
    public static function autoMatch(int $branchId, int $accountCode, int $windowDays = 3, ?string $glFrom = null): int
    {
        $n = 0;
        foreach (BankStatementLine::where('branch_id', $branchId)->where('account_code', $accountCode)->whereNull('matched_line_id')->orderBy('line_date')->get() as $st) {
            $best = null;
            foreach (self::glLines($branchId, $accountCode, $glFrom) as $jl) {
                $gap = abs((strtotime($jl->entry_date) - strtotime($st->line_date)) / 86400);
                if (Money::db($jl->debit)->minus(Money::db($jl->credit))->isEqualTo($st->amount) && $gap <= $windowDays && ($best === null || $gap < $best[0])) {
                    $best = [$gap, $jl->id];
                }
            }
            if ($best) {
                $st->update(['matched_line_id' => $best[1]]);
                $n++;
            }
        }

        return $n;
    }

    public static function match(int $statementLineId, int $journalLineId): void
    {
        [$st, $jl] = [BankStatementLine::find($statementLineId), JournalLine::find($journalLineId)];
        if ($st === null || $jl === null || (int) $jl->account_code !== (int) $st->account_code) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Statement line and ledger line must exist and be on the same account');
        }
        if (! Money::d($jl->debit)->minus($jl->credit)->isEqualTo($st->amount)) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Amounts differ – post the difference separately');
        }
        $st->update(['matched_line_id' => $jl->id]);
    }

    /** Bank charges, interest, direct receipts found on the statement: posts them and matches in one step. */
    public static function postStatementItem(int $statementLineId, int $contraAccount, string $user, ?string $approver = null, ?string $memo = null): int
    {
        $st = BankStatementLine::find($statementLineId);
        if ($st === null || $st->matched_line_id) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Statement line not found or already matched');
        }
        $amt = Money::d($st->amount);
        $lines = $amt->isPositive() ? [[$st->account_code, $amt, '0'], [$contraAccount, '0', $amt]] : [[$contraAccount, $amt->negated(), '0'], [$st->account_code, '0', $amt->negated()]];
        $j = Ledger::post($st->branch_id, $st->line_date, 'BANK', $st->reference ?: "STMT-{$st->id}", $lines, $user, $memo ?: $st->description, $approver);
        $st->update(['matched_line_id' => JournalLine::where('journal_id', $j->id)->where('account_code', $st->account_code)->value('id')]);

        return $j->id;
    }

    /** Statement balance + uncleared lodgements − unpresented payments = ledger + statement items not yet in the ledger. */
    public static function reconciliation(int $branchId, int $accountCode, string $asOf, mixed $statementBalance, ?string $glFrom = null): array
    {
        $gl = Reports::accountBalance($accountCode, $asOf, [$branchId]);
        $openGl = self::glLines($branchId, $accountCode, $glFrom, $asOf);
        $openSt = BankStatementLine::where('branch_id', $branchId)->where('account_code', $accountCode)->where('line_date', '<=', $asOf)->whereNull('matched_line_id')->get();
        $in = Money::q2(Money::sum($openGl->map(fn ($x) => Money::db($x->debit))->all()));
        $out = Money::q2(Money::sum($openGl->map(fn ($x) => Money::db($x->credit))->all()));
        $notInGl = Money::q2(Money::sum($openSt->pluck('amount')->all()));
        $adjSt = Money::q2(Money::d($statementBalance)->plus($in)->minus($out));
        $adjGl = Money::q2($gl->plus($notInGl));
        $stale = $openGl->filter(fn ($x) => (strtotime($asOf) - strtotime($x->entry_date)) / 86400 > 30)->count();

        return ['account' => $accountCode, 'as_of' => $asOf, 'statement_balance' => Money::q2($statementBalance), 'uncleared_lodgements' => $in,
            'unpresented_payments' => $out, 'adjusted_statement_balance' => $adjSt, 'gl_balance' => Money::q2($gl), 'statement_items_not_in_gl' => $notInGl,
            'adjusted_gl_balance' => $adjGl, 'difference' => Money::q2($adjSt->minus($adjGl)),
            'open_ledger_items' => $openGl->map(fn ($x) => ['line_id' => $x->id, 'date' => $x->entry_date, 'ref' => $x->source_ref,
                'amount' => Money::q2(Money::db($x->debit)->minus(Money::db($x->credit)))])->all(),
            'open_statement_items' => $openSt->map(fn ($x) => ['id' => $x->id, 'date' => $x->line_date, 'description' => $x->description, 'amount' => $x->amount])->all(),
            'items_older_than_30_days' => $stale];
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Domain;

use App\Models\Branch;
use App\Models\Category;
use App\Models\Channel;
use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\StockLot;
use App\Models\StockUpload;
use App\Models\Supplier;
use App\Models\TaxRate;
use Brick\Math\BigDecimal;
use Brick\Math\Exception\MathException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

/**
 * Upload products & stock: one CSV row per product batch. Port of services/uploads.py.
 * validate() checks every row and keeps a report – nothing else is saved. confirm() (uploader plus a second person) re-checks
 * and loads everything in one transaction: products created or updated, branch prices and reorder levels, OPENING stock
 * (OPENSTOCK journal, Cr 9030) and CASH_PURCHASE stock (Cr Cash / Petty cash / MoMo / Bank, optionally paid by head office).
 * Supplier-credit rows are refused (they go through Purchases); the same file cannot be confirmed twice without the override.
 */
final class Uploads
{
    public const COLUMNS = ['branch_code', 'source', 'sku', 'name', 'barcode', 'category', 'tax_code', 'units_per_pack', 'retail_price', 'reorder_level',
        'branch_retail_price', 'branch_reorder_level', 'controlled', 'batch_no', 'expiry', 'quantity', 'unit_cost', 'date', 'payment_channel', 'paid_by',
        'supplier_code', 'supplier_vat_invoice', 'invoice_no', 'nrv_per_unit'];

    public const REQUIRED = ['branch_code', 'source', 'sku'];

    public const SOURCES = ['OPENING', 'CASH_PURCHASE', 'PRODUCT_ONLY'];

    public const PAY_CHANNELS = ['Cash', 'Petty cash', 'MoMo', 'Bank'];

    public const EXAMPLES = [
        ['branch_code' => 'A', 'source' => 'OPENING', 'sku' => 'P001', 'name' => 'Paracetamol 500mg tablets (pack of 100)', 'barcode' => '6001234500017',
            'category' => 'OTC medicine', 'tax_code' => 'EX', 'units_per_pack' => '1', 'retail_price' => '25.00', 'reorder_level' => '20', 'batch_no' => 'PCM2611',
            'expiry' => '2028-10-31', 'quantity' => '120', 'unit_cost' => '14.50', 'date' => '2026-11-30'],
        ['branch_code' => 'B', 'source' => 'OPENING', 'sku' => 'P001', 'branch_retail_price' => '26.00', 'branch_reorder_level' => '10', 'batch_no' => 'PCM2611',
            'expiry' => '2028-10-31', 'quantity' => '60', 'unit_cost' => '14.50', 'date' => '2026-11-30'],
        ['branch_code' => 'A', 'source' => 'CASH_PURCHASE', 'sku' => 'P010', 'name' => 'Vitamin C 1000mg effervescent (tube of 20)',
            'category' => 'Non-medicine (cosmetics, supplements)', 'tax_code' => 'SR20', 'retail_price' => '60.00', 'batch_no' => 'VC2701', 'expiry' => '2027-12-31',
            'quantity' => '24', 'unit_cost' => '36.00', 'date' => '2026-12-02', 'payment_channel' => 'Petty cash', 'supplier_code' => 'S-CASH1',
            'supplier_vat_invoice' => 'Yes', 'invoice_no' => 'CR-5521'],
        ['branch_code' => 'A', 'source' => 'PRODUCT_ONLY', 'sku' => 'P011', 'name' => 'Digital thermometer', 'category' => 'Medical device/consumable',
            'tax_code' => 'SR20', 'retail_price' => '45.00', 'reorder_level' => '5'],
    ];

    private static function csvLine(array $values): string
    {
        return implode(',', array_map(function ($v) {
            $v = (string) $v;

            return preg_match('/[",\r\n]/', $v) ? '"'.str_replace('"', '""', $v).'"' : $v;
        }, $values))."\r\n";
    }

    public static function template(bool $withExamples = false): string
    {
        $out = "\xEF\xBB\xBF".self::csvLine(self::COLUMNS);
        if ($withExamples) {
            foreach (self::EXAMPLES as $r) {
                $out .= self::csvLine(array_map(fn ($c) => $r[$c] ?? '', self::COLUMNS));
            }
        }

        return $out;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ parsing and checks
    public static function parse(string $raw): array
    {
        if (str_starts_with($raw, 'PK') || str_starts_with($raw, "\xD0\xCF\x11\xE0")) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('This is an Excel workbook. Uploads are CSV only: in Excel use Save as → CSV UTF-8 (comma delimited)');
        }
        if (str_starts_with($raw, "\xEF\xBB\xBF")) {
            $raw = substr($raw, 3);
        } elseif (! mb_check_encoding($raw, 'UTF-8')) {
            $raw = mb_convert_encoding($raw, 'UTF-8', 'Windows-1252');
        }
        $first = strtok($raw, "\n") ?: '';
        $delims = [',' => substr_count($first, ','), ';' => substr_count($first, ';'), "\t" => substr_count($first, "\t")];
        arsort($delims);
        $delim = array_key_first($delims);
        $fh = fopen('php://temp', 'r+');
        fwrite($fh, $raw);
        rewind($fh);
        $head = fgetcsv($fh, 0, $delim, '"', '');
        if ($head === false || $head === [null]) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('The file is empty');
        }
        $heads = array_map(fn ($h) => strtolower(trim((string) $h)), $head);
        $missing = array_diff(self::REQUIRED, $heads);
        if ($missing) {
            sort($missing);
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Missing columns: '.implode(', ', $missing).'. Download the template');
        }
        $unknown = array_values(array_filter($heads, fn ($h) => $h !== '' && ! in_array($h, self::COLUMNS, true)));
        if ($unknown) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Unknown columns: '.implode(', ', $unknown).'. Download the template');
        }
        $rows = [];
        while (($vals = fgetcsv($fh, 0, $delim, '"', '')) !== false) {
            $r = [];
            foreach ($heads as $i => $h) {
                if ($h !== '') {
                    $r[$h] = trim((string) ($vals[$i] ?? ''));
                }
            }
            if (array_filter($r, fn ($v) => $v !== '')) {
                $rows[] = $r;
            }
        }
        fclose($fh);
        if (! $rows) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('The file has a header but no rows');
        }
        if (count($rows) > 5000) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('At most 5,000 rows per file – split the file');
        }

        return $rows;
    }

    private static function num(?string $v, string $field, array &$errs, bool $positive = false): ?BigDecimal
    {
        if ($v === null || $v === '') {
            return null;
        }
        try {
            $x = BigDecimal::of(str_replace(',', '', $v));
        } catch (MathException) {
            $errs[] = "{$field} '{$v}' is not a number";

            return null;
        }
        if ($x->isNegative() || ($positive && ! $x->isPositive())) {
            $errs[] = "{$field} must be ".($positive ? 'positive' : 'zero or more');

            return null;
        }

        return $x;
    }

    private static function date(?string $v, string $field, array &$errs): ?string
    {
        if (! $v) {
            return null;
        }
        if (! Admin::isDate($v)) {
            $errs[] = "{$field} '{$v}' must be a date written YYYY-MM-DD";

            return null;
        }

        return $v;
    }

    private static function yes(?string $v): bool
    {
        return in_array(strtolower(trim((string) $v)), ['yes', 'y', 'true', '1'], true);
    }

    /** Validates every row against the database as it is now. Returns the report (nothing is written). */
    public static function check(array $rows): array
    {
        $branches = Branch::all()->keyBy('code');
        $cats = Category::pluck('name')->all();
        $codes = TaxRate::distinct()->pluck('code')->all();
        [$seenNew, $seenBatch, $out, $totals] = [[], [], [], []];
        $registered = Ledger::setting('vat_registered', 'Yes') === 'Yes';
        $whtAgent = Ledger::setting('wht_agent', 'No') === 'Yes';
        foreach ($rows as $idx => $r) {
            $n = $idx + 2; // row 1 is the header
            [$errs, $warns, $actions] = [[], [], []];
            $src = strtoupper($r['source'] ?? '');
            if (! in_array($src, self::SOURCES, true)) {
                $errs[] = 'source must be one of '.implode(', ', self::SOURCES);
            }
            $bcode = strtoupper($r['branch_code'] ?? '');
            $b = $branches[$bcode] ?? null;
            if (($r['branch_code'] ?? '') !== '' && $b === null) {
                $errs[] = "Unknown branch {$r['branch_code']}";
            } elseif ($b === null && $src !== 'PRODUCT_ONLY') {
                $errs[] = 'branch_code is required for stock rows';
            } elseif ($b !== null && $b->is_head_office) {
                $errs[] = "{$b->code} is the head office unit and holds no stock or products – use a trading branch";
            }
            $sku = $r['sku'] ?? '';
            if ($sku === '') {
                $errs[] = 'sku is required';
            }
            $prod = $sku !== '' ? Product::where('sku', $sku)->first() : null;
            $new = $prod === null && ! isset($seenNew[$sku]);
            $f = [];
            foreach (['retail_price', 'branch_retail_price'] as $k) {
                $f[$k] = self::num($r[$k] ?? null, $k, $errs, true);
            }
            foreach (['reorder_level', 'branch_reorder_level'] as $k) {
                $f[$k] = self::num($r[$k] ?? null, $k, $errs);
            }
            $f['units_per_pack'] = self::num($r['units_per_pack'] ?? null, 'units_per_pack', $errs, true);
            if (($r['category'] ?? '') !== '' && ! in_array($r['category'], $cats, true)) {
                $sorted = $cats;
                sort($sorted);
                $errs[] = "Unknown category '{$r['category']}' (use one of: ".implode(', ', $sorted).')';
            }
            if (($r['tax_code'] ?? '') !== '' && ! in_array($r['tax_code'], $codes, true)) {
                $errs[] = "Unknown tax code '{$r['tax_code']}'";
            }
            if (($r['barcode'] ?? '') !== '') {
                $other = Product::where('barcode', $r['barcode'])->where('sku', '<>', $sku)->value('sku');
                if ($other) {
                    $errs[] = "Barcode {$r['barcode']} already belongs to {$other}";
                }
            }
            if ($new) {
                foreach (['name', 'category', 'tax_code', 'retail_price'] as $k) {
                    if (($r[$k] ?? '') === '') {
                        $errs[] = "{$k} is required for a new product";
                    }
                }
                if ($sku !== '') {
                    $seenNew[$sku] = $n;
                }
                $actions[] = 'create product';
            } elseif ($prod !== null) {
                $changed = array_values(array_filter(['name', 'barcode', 'category', 'tax_code', 'retail_price', 'reorder_level', 'units_per_pack'], fn ($k) => ($r[$k] ?? '') !== ''));
                if (($r['tax_code'] ?? '') !== '' && $r['tax_code'] !== $prod->tax_code) {
                    $warns[] = "tax code changes from {$prod->tax_code} to {$r['tax_code']} for every branch";
                }
                if ($f['units_per_pack'] !== null && ! $f['units_per_pack']->isEqualTo($prod->units_per_pack) && StockLot::where('product_id', $prod->id)->exists()) {
                    $errs[] = 'units_per_pack cannot change once the product has stock';
                }
                if ($changed) {
                    $actions[] = 'update product: '.implode(', ', $changed);
                }
            }
            if (($f['branch_retail_price'] !== null || $f['branch_reorder_level'] !== null) && $b !== null) {
                $actions[] = "branch {$b->code} price/reorder level";
            }
            [$qty, $cost] = [null, null];
            $when = self::date($r['date'] ?? null, 'date', $errs);
            if (in_array($src, ['OPENING', 'CASH_PURCHASE'], true)) {
                foreach (['batch_no', 'expiry', 'quantity', 'unit_cost', 'date'] as $k) {
                    if (($r[$k] ?? '') === '') {
                        $errs[] = "{$k} is required for {$src} rows";
                    }
                }
                $qty = self::num($r['quantity'] ?? null, 'quantity', $errs, true);
                $cost = self::num($r['unit_cost'] ?? null, 'unit_cost', $errs, true);
                self::num($r['nrv_per_unit'] ?? null, 'nrv_per_unit', $errs);
                $exp = self::date($r['expiry'] ?? null, 'expiry', $errs);
                if ($exp && $when && $exp <= $when) {
                    $errs[] = "batch {$r['batch_no']} has expired (expiry {$exp}) – it cannot go into saleable stock";
                }
                $locked = Ledger::setting('locked_through');
                if ($when && $locked && $when <= $locked) {
                    $errs[] = "date {$when} is in a locked period (locked through {$locked})";
                }
                $key = implode('|', [$bcode, $sku, $r['batch_no'] ?? '', $src, $r['invoice_no'] ?? '']);
                if (isset($seenBatch[$key])) {
                    $errs[] = 'the same branch, product, batch and invoice appear twice – combine them into one row';
                }
                $seenBatch[$key] = true;
                if ($src === 'OPENING' && $b !== null && $when !== null && StockLot::where('branch_id', $b->id)->where('received_on', '<=', $when)->exists()) {
                    $warns[] = "branch {$b->code} already has stock on or before {$when}: opening stock is normally loaded once, at go-live";
                }
            }
            $sup = null;
            if ($src === 'CASH_PURCHASE') {
                $ch = $r['payment_channel'] ?? '';
                if (strtolower($ch) === 'credit' || $ch === '' || ! in_array($ch, self::PAY_CHANNELS, true)) {
                    $errs[] = 'payment_channel must be Cash, Petty cash, MoMo or Bank. Stock bought on supplier credit goes through Purchases, not the upload';
                }
                if (($r['invoice_no'] ?? '') === '') {
                    $errs[] = 'invoice_no (the receipt or invoice number) is required for a cash purchase';
                }
                if (($r['supplier_code'] ?? '') !== '') {
                    $sup = Supplier::where('code', $r['supplier_code'])->first();
                    if ($sup === null) {
                        $errs[] = "Unknown supplier {$r['supplier_code']} – add it first or leave supplier_code blank";
                    } elseif ($whtAgent && ! in_array($sup->wht_type, [null, 'None'], true)) {
                        $errs[] = "{$sup->code} is subject to withholding tax: pay through Purchases / supplier payments so WHT is withheld";
                    } elseif (($r['invoice_no'] ?? '') !== '' && StockLot::where('supplier_id', $sup->id)->where('source_ref', $r['invoice_no'])->exists()) {
                        $errs[] = "invoice {$r['invoice_no']} from {$sup->code} has already been loaded";
                    }
                }
                if (self::yes($r['supplier_vat_invoice'] ?? '') && ($sup === null || ! $sup->vat_registered)) {
                    $errs[] = 'supplier_vat_invoice = Yes needs a VAT-registered supplier_code (input VAT is claimed only on a VAT invoice)';
                }
                if (($r['paid_by'] ?? '') !== '' && ! isset($branches[strtoupper($r['paid_by'])])) {
                    $errs[] = "Unknown paying unit {$r['paid_by']}";
                }
            } elseif (array_filter(['payment_channel', 'paid_by', 'supplier_code', 'invoice_no'], fn ($k) => ($r[$k] ?? '') !== '')) {
                $warns[] = 'payment and supplier columns are ignored for this source';
            }
            $value = null;
            if ($qty !== null && $cost !== null && ! $errs) {
                $prodTax = ($r['tax_code'] ?? '') !== '' ? $r['tax_code'] : ($prod?->tax_code ?? '');
                if ($src === 'CASH_PURCHASE' && self::yes($r['supplier_vat_invoice'] ?? '') && $prodTax === 'SR20') {
                    $net = Money::q2($qty->multipliedBy($cost));
                    $tx = Tax::addExclusive($net, Tax::ratesFor('SR20', $when, false));
                    $value = $registered ? $net : $tx['gross'];
                    $paid = $tx['gross'];
                    $vatIn = $registered ? $tx['vat']->plus($tx['nhil'])->plus($tx['getfund']) : Money::zero();
                } else {
                    $value = $paid = Money::q2($qty->multipliedBy($cost));
                    $vatIn = Money::zero();
                }
                $t = $totals[$b->code] ?? ['opening_stock' => Money::zero(), 'cash_purchases' => Money::zero(), 'input_tax' => Money::zero(), 'paid' => Money::zero(), 'rows' => 0];
                $t['rows']++;
                if ($src === 'OPENING') {
                    $t['opening_stock'] = $t['opening_stock']->plus($value);
                } else {
                    $t['cash_purchases'] = $t['cash_purchases']->plus($value);
                    $t['input_tax'] = $t['input_tax']->plus($vatIn);
                    $t['paid'] = $t['paid']->plus($paid);
                }
                $totals[$b->code] = $t;
                $actions[] = 'load '.$qty->stripTrailingZeros()." units, batch {$r['batch_no']}, value {$value}";
            }
            $out[] = ['row' => $n, 'sku' => $sku, 'branch' => $r['branch_code'] ?? '', 'source' => $src,
                'status' => $errs ? 'ERROR' : ($warns ? 'WARNING' : 'OK'), 'errors' => $errs, 'warnings' => $warns, 'actions' => $actions,
                'value' => $value === null ? null : (string) $value];
        }
        $totals = array_map(fn ($t) => array_map(fn ($v) => $v instanceof BigDecimal ? (string) $v : $v, $t), $totals);

        return ['rows' => $out, 'error_count' => count(array_filter($out, fn ($x) => (bool) $x['errors'])),
            'warning_count' => count(array_filter($out, fn ($x) => $x['warnings'] && ! $x['errors'])), 'totals' => $totals];
    }

    /** Step 1: checks the file and keeps the report. Nothing else is saved. */
    public static function validate(string $fileName, string $raw, string $user): StockUpload
    {
        if (! str_ends_with(strtolower($fileName), '.csv')) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Uploads are CSV only. In Excel use Save as → CSV UTF-8 (comma delimited)');
        }
        $rows = self::parse($raw);
        $digest = hash('sha256', $raw);
        $report = self::check($rows);
        $dup = StockUpload::where('file_hash', $digest)->where('status', 'CONFIRMED')->orderBy('id')->value('id');
        if ($dup) {
            $report['duplicate_warning'] = "This exact file was already loaded (upload {$dup}). Confirming again is blocked unless you tick the override";
        }
        $u = StockUpload::create(['file_name' => substr($fileName, 0, 200), 'file_hash' => $digest, 'status' => 'VALIDATED', 'uploaded_by' => $user,
            'uploaded_at' => Ledger::utcnow(), 'row_count' => count($rows), 'error_count' => $report['error_count'], 'duplicate_of' => $dup,
            'rows' => json_encode($rows, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE), 'report' => json_encode($report, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE), 'override_duplicate' => false]);
        Ledger::audit($user, 'UPLOAD_VALIDATE', 'stock_upload', $u->id, "{$fileName}: ".count($rows)." rows, {$report['error_count']} with errors");

        return $u;
    }

    public static function report(StockUpload $u): array
    {
        return ['upload_id' => $u->id, 'file_name' => $u->file_name, 'status' => $u->status, 'rows' => $u->row_count, 'errors' => $u->error_count,
            'duplicate_of' => $u->duplicate_of, 'report' => json_decode($u->report, true)];
    }

    public static function cancel(int $uploadId, string $user): void
    {
        $u = StockUpload::find($uploadId);
        if ($u === null || $u->status !== 'VALIDATED') {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Only a validated upload that has not been confirmed can be cancelled');
        }
        $u->update(['status' => 'CANCELLED']);
        Ledger::audit($user, 'UPLOAD_CANCEL', 'stock_upload', $u->id);
    }

    /** Step 2: loads everything in one transaction, or nothing. Needs a second person (approver). */
    public static function confirm(int $uploadId, string $user, ?string $approver, bool $overrideDuplicate = false): array
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($uploadId, $user, $approver, $overrideDuplicate) {
            $u = StockUpload::whereKey($uploadId)->lockForUpdate()->first();
            if ($u === null) {
                throw new BusinessRuleError('Upload not found');
            }
            if ($u->status !== 'VALIDATED') {
                throw new BusinessRuleError("Upload {$u->id} is {$u->status}");
            }
            if (! $approver || $approver === $user) {
                throw new BusinessRuleError('Confirming an upload needs approval by a second person');
            }
            $dup = StockUpload::where('file_hash', $u->file_hash)->where('status', 'CONFIRMED')->value('id');
            if ($dup && ! $overrideDuplicate) {
                throw new BusinessRuleError("This exact file was already loaded (upload {$dup}). Tick the override only if loading it again is intended");
            }
            $rows = json_decode($u->rows, true);
            $rep = self::check($rows);
            if ($rep['error_count']) {
                $first = [];
                foreach ($rep['rows'] as $x) {
                    if ($x['errors']) {
                        $first[] = "row {$x['row']}: {$x['errors'][0]}";
                    }
                }
                throw new BusinessRuleError("{$rep['error_count']} rows now have errors (".mb_substr(implode('; ', $first), 0, 400).') – fix the file and upload it again');
            }
            $branches = Branch::all()->keyBy('code');
            Inventory::lockProducts(Product::whereIn('sku', array_unique(array_map(fn ($r) => $r['sku'], array_filter($rows, fn ($r) => strtoupper($r['source']) !== 'PRODUCT_ONLY'))))->pluck('id'));
            foreach ($rows as $r) { // 1. products (shared list)
                $prod = Product::where('sku', $r['sku'])->first();
                $vals = [];
                foreach (['name', 'barcode', 'tax_code'] as $k) {
                    if (($r[$k] ?? '') !== '') {
                        $vals[$k] = $r[$k];
                    }
                }
                if (($r['category'] ?? '') !== '') {
                    $vals['category_name'] = $r['category'];
                }
                foreach (['retail_price', 'reorder_level', 'units_per_pack'] as $k) {
                    if (($r[$k] ?? '') !== '') {
                        $vals[$k] = str_replace(',', '', $r[$k]);
                    }
                }
                if (($r['controlled'] ?? '') !== '') {
                    $vals['controlled'] = self::yes($r['controlled']);
                }
                if ($prod === null) {
                    $prod = Product::create($vals + ['sku' => $r['sku'], 'sale_unit' => 'Unit', 'units_per_pack' => $vals['units_per_pack'] ?? '1',
                        'reorder_level' => $vals['reorder_level'] ?? '0', 'controlled' => $vals['controlled'] ?? false, 'cold_chain' => false]);
                    Ledger::audit($user, 'PRODUCT_CREATE', 'product', $prod->sku, "upload {$u->id}");
                } elseif ($vals) {
                    $prod->update($vals);
                    Ledger::audit($user, 'PRODUCT_UPDATE', 'product', $prod->sku, "upload {$u->id}: ".implode(', ', array_keys($vals)));
                }
                if (($r['branch_code'] ?? '') !== '' && (($r['branch_retail_price'] ?? '') !== '' || ($r['branch_reorder_level'] ?? '') !== '')) {
                    Branches::setProductBranch($prod, $branches[strtoupper($r['branch_code'])]->id, $user,
                        ($r['branch_retail_price'] ?? '') !== '' ? str_replace(',', '', $r['branch_retail_price']) : null,
                        ($r['branch_reorder_level'] ?? '') !== '' ? str_replace(',', '', $r['branch_reorder_level']) : null);
                }
            }
            $registered = Ledger::setting('vat_registered', 'Yes') === 'Yes';
            $groups = [];
            foreach ($rows as $r) { // 2. stock: one journal per branch/date (opening) or per branch/receipt (cash purchase)
                $src = strtoupper($r['source']);
                if ($src === 'PRODUCT_ONLY') {
                    continue;
                }
                $b = $branches[strtoupper($r['branch_code'])];
                $key = implode('|', [$b->id, $src, $r['date'], $r['invoice_no'] ?? '', $r['supplier_code'] ?? '', $r['payment_channel'] ?? '', strtoupper($r['paid_by'] ?? '')]);
                $groups[$key][] = $r;
            }
            $journals = [];
            foreach ($groups as $key => $items) {
                [$bid, $src, $when, $invNo, $supCode, $channel, $payer] = explode('|', $key);
                $bid = (int) $bid;
                $sup = $supCode !== '' ? Supplier::where('code', $supCode)->first() : null;
                $p = new Poster;
                $pending = [];
                $ref = $src === 'OPENING' ? "UPL-{$u->id}-OB" : $invNo;
                foreach ($items as $r) {
                    $prod = Product::where('sku', $r['sku'])->first();
                    $qty = BigDecimal::of(str_replace(',', '', $r['quantity']));
                    $cost = BigDecimal::of(str_replace(',', '', $r['unit_cost']));
                    $net = Money::q2($qty->multipliedBy($cost));
                    $vatInvoice = $src === 'CASH_PURCHASE' && self::yes($r['supplier_vat_invoice'] ?? '') && $prod->tax_code === 'SR20';
                    $tx = Tax::addExclusive($net, $vatInvoice ? Tax::ratesFor('SR20', $when, false) : Tax::rates(0, 0, 0));
                    $recover = $vatInvoice && $registered;
                    $value = ($recover || ! $vatInvoice) ? $net : $tx['gross'];
                    $lot = StockLot::create(['branch_id' => $bid, 'product_id' => $prod->id, 'batch_no' => $r['batch_no'], 'expiry' => $r['expiry'], 'received_on' => $when,
                        'unit_cost' => (string) Money::div20($value, $qty)->toScale(6, \Brick\Math\RoundingMode::HALF_UP), 'source_ref' => $ref, 'supplier_id' => $sup?->id,
                        'nrv_per_unit' => ($r['nrv_per_unit'] ?? '') !== '' ? $r['nrv_per_unit'] : null]);
                    $pending[] = [$lot, $qty, $value];
                    $p->dr(Inventory::inventoryAccount($prod), $value);
                    if ($src === 'OPENING') {
                        $p->cr(9030, $value);
                    } else {
                        if ($recover) {
                            foreach (array_combine(Inventory::INPUT_TAX, [$tx['vat'], $tx['nhil'], $tx['getfund']]) as $acct => $amt) {
                                $p->dr($acct, $amt);
                            }
                        }
                        $p->cr((int) Channel::find($channel)->account, $vatInvoice ? $tx['gross'] : $net);
                    }
                }
                $memo = "Upload {$u->id}: ".($src === 'OPENING' ? 'opening stock' : "cash purchase {$invNo}".($supCode ? " from {$supCode}" : ''));
                $post = fn () => Ledger::post($bid, $when, $src === 'OPENING' ? 'OPENSTOCK' : 'RECEIPT', $ref, $p->lines(), $user, $memo, $approver);
                $j = ($payer !== '' && $src === 'CASH_PURCHASE') ? Ledger::paidBy($branches[$payer]->id, $post) : $post();
                $journals[] = $j->id;
                foreach ($pending as [$lot, $qty, $value]) {
                    Inventory::move($lot, $qty, $value, $src === 'OPENING' ? 'OPENING' : 'RECEIPT', $ref, $when, 'SALEABLE', $j->id);
                }
                $pids = array_unique(array_map(fn ($x) => $x[0]->product_id, $pending));
                sort($pids);
                foreach ($pids as $pid) {
                    Inventory::equalise($pid, $when, $ref, $user);
                }
            }
            $override = $dup && $overrideDuplicate;
            $u->update(['status' => 'CONFIRMED', 'confirmed_by' => $user, 'approved_by' => $approver, 'confirmed_at' => Ledger::utcnow(),
                'override_duplicate' => (bool) $override, 'report' => json_encode($rep, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE)]);
            Ledger::audit($user, 'UPLOAD_CONFIRM', 'stock_upload', $u->id, count($rows).' rows, '.count($journals)." journals, approved {$approver}"
                .($override ? ", DUPLICATE OF {$dup} (override)" : ''));

            return ['upload_id' => $u->id, 'status' => 'CONFIRMED', 'journals' => $journals, 'products' => count(array_unique(array_column($rows, 'sku'))),
                'stock_rows' => array_sum(array_map('count', $groups))];
        });
    }
}

####################################################################################################
##### FILE: app/Domain/Opening.php
####################################################################################################

<?php

namespace App\Domain;

use App\Models\Journal;
use App\Models\StockLot;
use Brick\Math\BigDecimal;

/**
 * Go-live opening balances: one OPENING journal per unit, with stock loaded as lots so the batch sub-ledger equals the
 * inventory accounts, and with parties so the supplier / claim / customer sub-ledgers open correctly. Port of opening.py.
 */
final class Opening
{
    public const INVENTORY = [1200, 1205, 1210, 1215, 1220];

    /**
     * @param  array  $balances  [[account, amount Dr+ / Cr-, party?], ...] – balance-sheet balances at $asOf (P&L inside 3020)
     * @param  array  $stock  [[sku, batch_no, expiry, units, unit_cost, nrv_per_unit?], ...] as associative arrays
     */
    public static function load(int $branchId, string $asOf, array $balances, array $stock, string $user, ?string $approver): int
    {
        if ($stock) {
            Branches::requireTrading($branchId);
        }
        if (Journal::where('branch_id', $branchId)->where('source', 'OPENING')->exists()) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Opening balances already loaded for this branch; reverse them first');
        }
        $total = Money::q2(Money::sum(array_column($balances, 1)));
        if (! $total->isZero()) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("Opening trial balance does not balance (difference {$total})");
        }
        Inventory::lockProducts(array_map(fn ($l) => Inventory::productByCode($l['sku'])->id, $stock));
        [$byAcct, $lots] = [[], []];
        foreach ($stock as $ln) {
            $prod = Inventory::productByCode($ln['sku']);
            $lot = StockLot::create(['branch_id' => $branchId, 'product_id' => $prod->id, 'batch_no' => $ln['batch_no'], 'expiry' => $ln['expiry'],
                'received_on' => $asOf, 'unit_cost' => (string) Money::d($ln['unit_cost'])->toScale(6, \Brick\Math\RoundingMode::HALF_UP),
                'source_ref' => 'OPENING', 'nrv_per_unit' => $ln['nrv_per_unit'] ?? null]);
            $acct = Inventory::inventoryAccount($prod);
            $val = Money::q2(Money::d($ln['units'])->multipliedBy($ln['unit_cost']));
            $lots[] = [$lot, Money::d($ln['units']), $val, $acct];
            $byAcct[$acct] = ($byAcct[$acct] ?? BigDecimal::zero())->plus($val);
        }
        $glInv = [];
        foreach ($balances as $b) {
            if (in_array((int) $b[0], self::INVENTORY, true)) {
                $glInv[(int) $b[0]] = ($glInv[(int) $b[0]] ?? BigDecimal::zero())->plus(Money::d($b[1]));
            }
        }
        foreach (array_unique(array_merge(array_keys($byAcct), array_keys($glInv))) as $acct) {
            $sub = $byAcct[$acct] ?? BigDecimal::zero();
            $gl = $glInv[$acct] ?? BigDecimal::zero();
            if ($sub->minus($gl)->abs()->isGreaterThanOrEqualTo(1)) {
                throw new BusinessRuleError("Opening stock lots ({$sub}) do not agree to account {$acct} ({$gl})");
            }
            $diff = Money::q2($gl->minus($sub)); // unit-cost rounding: the last lot absorbs it so sub-ledger = ledger
            if (! $diff->isZero()) {
                for ($i = count($lots) - 1; $i >= 0; $i--) {
                    if ($lots[$i][3] === $acct) {
                        $lots[$i][2] = $lots[$i][2]->plus($diff);
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        $p = new Poster;
        foreach ($balances as $b) {
            $amt = Money::d($b[1]);
            $amt->isPositive() ? $p->dr((int) $b[0], $amt, $b[2] ?? null) : $p->cr((int) $b[0], $amt->abs(), $b[2] ?? null);
        }
        $j = Ledger::post($branchId, $asOf, 'OPENING', "OB-{$asOf}", $p->lines(), $user, 'Opening balances from the interim workbook', $approver);
        foreach ($lots as [$lot, $units, $val]) {
            Inventory::move($lot, $units, $val, 'OPENING', 'OPENING', $asOf, 'SALEABLE', $j->id);
        }
        $pids = array_unique(array_map(fn ($l) => $l[0]->product_id, $lots));
        sort($pids);
        foreach ($pids as $pid) {
            Inventory::equalise($pid, $asOf, "OB-{$asOf}", $user);
        }

        return $j->id;
    }
}

####################################################################################################
##### FILE: app/Domain/Payables.php
####################################################################################################

<?php

namespace App\Domain;

use App\Models\Account;
use App\Models\Channel;
use App\Models\Expense;
use App\Models\Supplier;
use App\Models\SupplierPayment;
use App\Models\WhtType;
use Brick\Math\BigDecimal;

/**
 * Supplier master data, supplier payments and expenses with withholding tax and withholding VAT. Port of services/payables.py.
 * WHT: types flagged always_withhold (rent) are always withheld; other types only when the business is a withholding agent
 * (Settings wht_agent = Yes), and goods, works and services only once the payee's calendar-year total for that type exceeds
 * the threshold (GHS 2,000). WHVAT: only for an agent appointed in writing (whvat_agent = Yes; Act 1151 s.55): 7% of the
 * VAT-exclusive value paid to a VAT-registered supplier.
 */
final class Payables
{
    public const SUPPLIER_FIELDS = ['name', 'tin', 'vat_registered', 'wht_type', 'resident_status', 'location', 'payment_terms_days', 'bank_name',
        'bank_account', 'momo_number'];

    /** The WHT code must match the payee's residence (a Resident code for a resident payee, and so on) – DT 0110 rule. */
    public static function checkResidency(?string $whtType, ?string $residentStatus): WhtType
    {
        $wt = WhtType::find($whtType ?: 'None');
        if ($wt === null) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("Unknown WHT type {$whtType}");
        }
        if ($wt->gra_code && $wt->residency !== ($residentStatus ?: 'Resident')) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("WHT type {$wt->name} ({$wt->gra_code}) is for {$wt->residency} payees, not {$residentStatus}");
        }

        return $wt;
    }

    public static function createSupplier(array $x, string $user, string $approver): Supplier
    {
        self::checkResidency($x['wht_type'] ?? 'None', $x['resident_status'] ?? 'Resident');
        if (Supplier::where('code', $x['code'])->exists()) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("Supplier {$x['code']} already exists");
        }
        $s = Supplier::create(array_intersect_key($x, array_flip(array_merge(['code'], self::SUPPLIER_FIELDS))) + ['vat_registered' => true,
            'wht_type' => 'None', 'resident_status' => 'Resident', 'payment_terms_days' => 30]);
        Ledger::audit($user, 'SUPPLIER_CREATE', 'supplier', $x['code'], "approved by {$approver}");

        return $s;
    }

    /** Supplier master data feeds the WHT and VAT returns, so changes are approved by a second person and logged. */
    public static function updateSupplier(string $code, array $changes, string $reason, string $user, ?string $approver): Supplier
    {
        if (! $approver || $approver === $user) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("Supplier changes need a second person's approval");
        }
        $sup = Supplier::where('code', $code)->first();
        if ($sup === null) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("Unknown supplier {$code}");
        }
        $bad = array_diff(array_keys($changes), self::SUPPLIER_FIELDS);
        if ($bad) {
            sort($bad);
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Fields '.json_encode(array_values($bad)).' cannot be changed here');
        }
        self::checkResidency($changes['wht_type'] ?? $sup->wht_type, $changes['resident_status'] ?? $sup->resident_status);
        $sup->update($changes);
        $keys = array_keys($changes);
        sort($keys);
        Ledger::audit($user, 'SUPPLIER_UPDATE', 'supplier', $code, json_encode($keys).": {$reason} (approved {$approver})");

        return $sup;
    }

    /** @return array{0:WhtType,1:BigDecimal} */
    private static function wht(?string $whtType, mixed $base, mixed $ytdBase): array
    {
        $wt = WhtType::find($whtType ?: 'None');
        if ($wt === null) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("Unknown WHT type {$whtType}");
        }
        if (Money::d($wt->rate)->isZero()) {
            return [$wt, Money::zero()];
        }
        if ($wt->always_withhold || $wt->is_rent) {
            return [$wt, Money::q2(Money::d($base)->multipliedBy($wt->rate))];
        }
        if (Ledger::setting('wht_agent', 'No') !== 'Yes') {
            return [$wt, Money::zero()];
        }
        if ($wt->threshold_applies && Money::d($ytdBase)->isLessThanOrEqualTo(Money::d(Ledger::setting('wht_threshold', '2000')))) {
            return [$wt, Money::zero()];
        }

        return [$wt, Money::q2(Money::d($base)->multipliedBy($wt->rate))];
    }

    private static function whvat(mixed $base, bool $payeeVatRegistered): BigDecimal
    {
        $base = Money::q2($base ?? 0);
        if (! $base->isPositive()) {
            return Money::zero();
        }
        if (Ledger::setting('whvat_agent', 'No') !== 'Yes') {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Withholding VAT applies only to agents appointed in writing by GRA (Settings whvat_agent)');
        }
        if (! $payeeVatRegistered) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Withholding VAT applies only to payments to VAT-registered suppliers');
        }

        return Money::q2($base->multipliedBy(Ledger::setting('whvat_rate', '0.07')));
    }

    /** Records the number of a WHT or WHVAT credit certificate issued after the payment (no ledger effect). */
    public static function setCertificate(int $journalId, string $kind, string $certificateNo, string $user): void
    {
        $doc = SupplierPayment::where('journal_id', $journalId)->first() ?? Expense::where('journal_id', $journalId)->first();
        if ($doc === null) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('No supplier payment or expense for that journal');
        }
        if ($kind === 'WHT') {
            if (Money::d($doc->wht_amount)->isZero()) {
                throw new BusinessRuleError('No WHT was withheld on this payment');
            }
            $field = $doc instanceof SupplierPayment ? 'certificate_no' : 'wht_certificate_no';
        } else {
            if (Money::d($doc->whvat_amount)->isZero()) {
                throw new BusinessRuleError('No withholding VAT was withheld on this payment');
            }
            $field = 'whvat_certificate_no';
        }
        $old = $doc->{$field};
        $doc->update([$field => $certificateNo]);
        Ledger::audit($user, 'CERTIFICATE', $doc->getTable(), $journalId, "{$kind}: ".($old ?? 'None')." -> {$certificateNo}");
    }

    /**
     * whvat_base: VAT-exclusive value of standard-rated supplies covered by this payment (exempt medicines carry no WHVAT).
     * payable_account: 2010 trade payables (stock suppliers) or 2020 other payables (service and expense bills).
     */
    public static function paySupplier(int $branchId, string $supplierCode, string $on, mixed $gross, mixed $whtBase, string $channel, string $user,
        ?string $certificateNo = null, ?string $whtOverride = null, ?string $approver = null, mixed $contractAmount = null, ?string $invoiceNo = null,
        ?string $invoiceDate = null, mixed $whvatBase = 0, ?string $whvatCertificateNo = null, int $payableAccount = 2010, ?string $sourceRef = null): array
    {
        if (! in_array($payableAccount, [2010, 2020], true)) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Payments settle 2010 trade payables or 2020 other payables');
        }
        $sup = Supplier::where('code', $supplierCode)->first() ?? throw new BusinessRuleError("Unknown supplier {$supplierCode}");
        $wtype = $whtOverride ?: $sup->wht_type;
        self::checkResidency($wtype, $sup->resident_status);
        if (! Money::d($whvatBase)->isZero() && Money::q2($whvatBase)->isGreaterThan(Money::q2($gross))) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('The WHVAT taxable value cannot exceed the payment');
        }
        $ytd = Money::sum(SupplierPayment::where('supplier_id', $sup->id)->where('wht_type', $wtype)->where('pay_date', '>=', substr($on, 0, 4).'-01-01')
            ->where('pay_date', '<=', $on)->pluck('wht_base')->all())->plus(Money::d($whtBase));
        [$wt, $wht] = self::wht($wtype, $whtBase, $ytd);
        $whvat = self::whvat($whvatBase, (bool) $sup->vat_registered);
        $ch = Channel::find($channel) ?? throw new BusinessRuleError("Unknown channel {$channel}");
        if ($wht->plus($whvat)->isGreaterThanOrEqualTo(Money::q2($gross))) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Taxes withheld cannot reach the payment');
        }
        $net = Money::q2($gross)->minus($wht)->minus($whvat);
        $p = new Poster;
        $p->dr($payableAccount, $gross, $sup->code);
        $p->cr((int) $ch->account, $net);
        $p->cr((int) $wt->account, $wht);
        $p->cr(2178, $whvat);
        $j = Ledger::post($branchId, $on, 'SUPPAY', $sourceRef ?: "PAY-{$sup->code}-{$on}", $p->lines(), $user, null, $approver);
        SupplierPayment::create(['branch_id' => $branchId, 'supplier_id' => $sup->id, 'pay_date' => $on, 'gross' => (string) Money::q2($gross),
            'wht_base' => (string) Money::q2($whtBase), 'wht_type' => $wtype, 'wht_amount' => (string) $wht, 'channel' => $channel, 'certificate_no' => $certificateNo,
            'journal_id' => $j->id, 'contract_amount' => $contractAmount !== null ? (string) Money::q2($contractAmount) : null, 'invoice_no' => $invoiceNo,
            'invoice_date' => $invoiceDate, 'whvat_base' => (string) Money::q2($whvatBase ?? 0), 'whvat_amount' => (string) $whvat,
            'whvat_certificate_no' => $whvatCertificateNo]);

        return ['journal_id' => $j->id, 'wht' => $wht, 'whvat' => $whvat, 'net' => $net, 'certificate_due' => ! $wht->isZero() && ! $certificateNo,
            'whvat_certificate_due' => ! $whvat->isZero() && ! $whvatCertificateNo];
    }

    /** use: Taxable / Exempt / Shared – input tax recovery 100% / 0% / Settings shared_input_recovery. */
    public static function recordExpense(int $branchId, string $on, string $payee, int $accountCode, mixed $net, string $taxCode, bool $supplierChargesVat,
        string $use, string $channel, string $user, string $whtType = 'None', ?string $payeeTin = null, ?string $approver = null,
        string $payeeResidentStatus = 'Resident', ?string $payeeLocation = null, mixed $contractAmount = null, ?string $certificateNo = null,
        ?string $invoiceNo = null, ?string $invoiceDate = null, ?string $whvatCertificateNo = null): array
    {
        self::checkResidency($whtType, $payeeResidentStatus);
        $acct = Account::find($accountCode);
        if ($acct === null || $acct->control !== 'Manual allowed') {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("Account {$accountCode} cannot take expenses (module-controlled)");
        }
        $charged = $supplierChargesVat && $taxCode === 'SR20';
        $tx = Tax::addExclusive($net, $charged ? Tax::ratesFor('SR20', $on, false) : Tax::rates(0, 0, 0));
        if (Ledger::setting('vat_registered', 'Yes') !== 'Yes') {
            $pct = BigDecimal::zero();
        } else {
            $pct = match ($use) {
                'Taxable' => BigDecimal::one(), 'Exempt' => BigDecimal::zero(), 'Shared' => Money::d(Ledger::setting('shared_input_recovery', '0.5')),
                default => throw new BusinessRuleError('Use must be Taxable, Exempt or Shared'),
            };
        }
        $rec = array_map(fn ($t) => Money::q2($t->multipliedBy($pct)), [$tx['vat'], $tx['nhil'], $tx['getfund']]);
        $ytd = Money::sum(Expense::where('payee', $payee)->where('wht_type', $whtType)->where('exp_date', '>=', substr($on, 0, 4).'-01-01')->pluck('net')->all())
            ->plus(Money::q2($net));
        [$wt, $wht] = self::wht($whtType, $net, $ytd);
        $whvat = Ledger::setting('whvat_agent', 'No') === 'Yes' ? self::whvat($charged ? $net : 0, true) : Money::zero();
        $ch = Channel::find($channel) ?? throw new BusinessRuleError("Unknown channel {$channel}");
        $p = new Poster;
        $p->dr($accountCode, $tx['gross']->minus(Money::sum($rec)));
        foreach (array_combine(Inventory::INPUT_TAX, $rec) as $a => $v) {
            $p->dr($a, $v);
        }
        $p->cr((int) $ch->account, $tx['gross']->minus($wht)->minus($whvat));
        $p->cr((int) $wt->account, $wht);
        $p->cr(2178, $whvat);
        $j = Ledger::post($branchId, $on, 'EXPENSE', 'EXP-'.mb_substr($payee, 0, 20)."-{$on}", $p->lines(), $user, null, $approver);
        Expense::create(['branch_id' => $branchId, 'exp_date' => $on, 'payee' => $payee, 'payee_tin' => $payeeTin, 'account_code' => $accountCode,
            'net' => (string) Money::q2($net), 'tax_code' => $taxCode, 'vat' => (string) $tx['vat'], 'nhil' => (string) $tx['nhil'], 'getfund' => (string) $tx['getfund'],
            'wht_type' => $whtType, 'wht_amount' => (string) $wht, 'channel' => $channel, 'journal_id' => $j->id, 'payee_resident_status' => $payeeResidentStatus,
            'payee_location' => $payeeLocation, 'contract_amount' => $contractAmount !== null ? (string) Money::q2($contractAmount) : null,
            'wht_certificate_no' => $certificateNo, 'invoice_no' => $invoiceNo, 'invoice_date' => $invoiceDate,
            'whvat_base' => (string) ($whvat->isZero() ? Money::zero() : Money::q2($net)), 'whvat_amount' => (string) $whvat, 'whvat_certificate_no' => $whvatCertificateNo]);

        return ['journal_id' => $j->id, 'gross' => $tx['gross'], 'wht' => $wht, 'whvat' => $whvat];
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Domain;

use App\Models\Sale;
use Throwable;

final class Evat
{
    public static function submitPending(EvatGateway $gateway, int $limit = 100): array
    {
        [$done, $failed] = [0, []];
        foreach (Sale::where('evat_status', 'PENDING')->orderBy('id')->limit($limit)->get() as $sale) {
            try {
                $sale->update(['evat_ref' => $gateway->submit($sale), 'evat_status' => 'SUBMITTED']);
                $done++;
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                $failed[] = [$sale->receipt_no, $e->getMessage()];
            }
        }

        return [$done, $failed];
    }
}

/**

 * to be a certified invoice.

{

    public function submit(Sale $sale): string;
}

    /** Receipts and the eight sample sales of the workbook, in one branch. */
    public static function loadBranchMonth(string $branchCode, string $user = 'SAMPLE Storekeeper'): Branch
    {

        $byInv = [];
        foreach (self::RECEIPTS as [$d, $inv, $sup, $sku, $batch, $exp, $packs, $cpp]) {
            $byInv["{$d}|{$inv}|{$sup}"][] = ['sku' => $sku, 'batch_no' => $batch, 'expiry' => $exp, 'packs' => (string) $packs, 'cost_per_pack' => (string) $cpp,
                'nrv_per_unit' => $batch === 'ALU2606' ? '20' : null];
        }
        foreach ($byInv as $k => $lines) {
            [$d, $inv, $sup] = explode('|', $k);
            Inventory::receiveGoods($b->id, $sup, "{$inv}-{$branchCode}", $d, $lines, $user, 'Pharmacist');
        }
        foreach (self::SALES as [$rc, $d, $payer, $member, $items, $pays, $claim, $appr]) {
            $codes = array_column($items, 0);
            $rx = (bool) array_intersect($codes, ['6001001000011', 'P001', 'P006', 'P007']);
            $ctl = in_array('P007', $codes, true);
            Sales::checkout($b->id, $rc, $d, 'T1', $payer,
                array_map(fn ($i) => ['code' => $i[0], 'qty' => (string) $i[1], 'discount' => (string) ($i[2] ?? 0)], $items),
                array_map(fn ($p) => ['channel' => $p[0], 'amount' => $p[1]], $pays),
                'SAMPLE Cashier', $member, $claim ? "{$claim}-{$branchCode}" : null, $appr, null, null,
                $rx ? 'SAMPLE-RX-'.substr($rc, -4) : null, $rx ? 'SAMPLE Dr (MDC reg. no.)' : null, $ctl ? 'SAMPLE Pharmacist' : null);
        }

        return $b;
    }
}

####################################################################################################
##### FILE: app/Domain/Allocations.php
####################################################################################################

<?php

namespace App\Domain;

use App\Models\Account;
use App\Models\Branch;
use App\Models\CostAllocation;
use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Models\Journal;
use Brick\Math\BigDecimal;

/**
 * Charging head office costs to branches (v1.3). Head office credits the cost account and debits 1195 (party BR-<branch>);
 * each branch debits the cost account and credits 1195 (party BR-<head office>). Each unit balances, 1195 nets to nil on
 * consolidation and consolidated profit is unchanged. Bases: FIXED, PERCENT, EQUAL, REVENUE, HEADCOUNT; rounding goes to the
 * branch with the largest share. Needs a second person; reversed as a whole. Port of services/allocations.py.
 */
final class Allocations
{
    public const BASES = ['FIXED', 'PERCENT', 'EQUAL', 'REVENUE', 'HEADCOUNT'];

    private static function shares(string $basis, $branches, array $shares, ?string $from, ?string $to): array
    {
        $out = [];
        if ($basis === 'EQUAL') {
            foreach ($branches as $b) {
                $out[$b->id] = Money::pdiv(1, count($branches));
            }

            return $out;
        }
        if ($basis === 'PERCENT') {
            $pct = [];
            foreach ($branches as $b) {
                $pct[$b->id] = Money::d((string) ($shares[$b->code] ?? 0));
            }
            if (! Money::q2(Money::sum($pct))->isEqualTo(100)) {
                throw new BusinessRuleError('Percentages must add up to 100');
            }

            return array_map(fn ($v) => Money::pdiv($v, 100), $pct);
        }
        if ($basis === 'REVENUE' || $basis === 'HEADCOUNT') {
            $w = [];
            if ($basis === 'REVENUE') {
                if (! ($from && $to)) {
                    throw new BusinessRuleError('Give the period whose revenue sets the shares');
                }
                foreach ($branches as $b) {
                    $w[$b->id] = Reports::incomeStatement(Reports::trialBalance($from, $to, [$b->id]))['rev'];
                }
            } else {
                foreach ($branches as $b) {
                    $w[$b->id] = BigDecimal::of(Employee::where('branch_id', $b->id)->count());
                }
            }
            $tot = Money::sum($w);
            if (! $tot->isPositive()) {
                throw new BusinessRuleError($basis === 'REVENUE' ? 'No revenue in that period to share by' : "No employees on the branches' payrolls to share by");
            }

            return array_map(fn ($v) => Money::pdiv($v, $tot), $w);
        }
        throw new BusinessRuleError('Basis must be one of '.implode(', ', self::BASES));
    }

    /** lines: [[account_code, amount]] – the head office costs to charge out (positive amounts). */
    public static function allocate(int $fromUnitId, string $on, array $lines, ?string $basis, string $user, ?string $approver, ?array $toBranches = null,
        ?array $shares = null, ?string $driverStart = null, ?string $driverEnd = null, ?string $memo = null): array
    {
        if (! $approver || $approver === $user) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("Allocations need a second person's approval");
        }
        $basis = strtoupper((string) $basis);
        $src = Branch::find($fromUnitId) ?? throw new BusinessRuleError('Unknown unit');
        $q = Branch::where('id', '<>', $fromUnitId)->orderBy('code');
        $toBranches ? $q->whereIn('code', $toBranches) : $q->where('is_head_office', false);
        $branches = $q->get();
        if ($branches->isEmpty()) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Choose at least one branch to charge');
        }
        if (! $lines) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Give at least one cost account and amount');
        }
        $clean = [];
        foreach ($lines as $ln) {
            $a = Account::find((int) $ln['account_code']);
            if ($a === null || $a->statement !== 'PL' || in_array($a->line, ['Revenue', 'Income tax'], true)) {
                throw new BusinessRuleError("Account {$ln['account_code']} is not a cost that can be allocated (use profit-or-loss expense accounts)");
            }
            $amt = Money::q2((string) $ln['amount']);
            if (! $amt->isPositive()) {
                throw new BusinessRuleError('Amounts must be positive');
            }
            $clean[] = [(int) $a->code, $amt];
        }
        $total = Money::q2(Money::sum(array_column($clean, 1)));
        if ($basis === 'FIXED') {
            $fixed = [];
            foreach ($branches as $b) {
                $fixed[$b->id] = Money::q2((string) (($shares ?? [])[$b->code] ?? 0));
            }
            $tf = Money::q2(Money::sum($fixed));
            if (! $tf->isEqualTo($total)) {
                throw new BusinessRuleError("Fixed amounts add to {$tf}, not the {$total} being allocated");
            }
            $ratio = array_map(fn ($v) => Money::pdiv($v, $total), $fixed);
        } else {
            $ratio = self::shares($basis, $branches, $shares ?? [], $driverStart, $driverEnd);
        }
        $biggest = null;
        foreach ($ratio as $k => $r) { // largest share; ties go to the lowest id
            if ($biggest === null || $r->isGreaterThan($ratio[$biggest]) || ($r->isEqualTo($ratio[$biggest]) && $k < $biggest)) {
                $biggest = $k;
            }
        }
        $split = [];
        foreach ($clean as [$code, $amt]) {
            $parts = array_map(fn ($r) => Money::q2($amt->multipliedBy($r)), $ratio);
            $parts[$biggest] = $parts[$biggest]->plus($amt->minus(Money::sum($parts)));
            foreach ($parts as $bid => $v) {
                if (! $v->isZero()) {
                    $split[$bid][$code] = ($split[$bid][$code] ?? BigDecimal::zero())->plus($v);
                }
            }
        }
        $ref = sprintf('ALC-%06d', CostAllocation::count() + 1);
        $codes = $branches->pluck('code', 'id')->all();
        $srcP = new Poster;
        foreach ($split as $bid => $accts) {
            $p = new Poster;
            foreach ($accts as $code => $v) {
                $p->dr($code, $v);
                $p->cr(1195, $v, "BR-{$src->code}");
                $srcP->dr(1195, $v, "BR-{$codes[$bid]}");
                $srcP->cr($code, $v);
            }
            Ledger::post($bid, $on, 'ALLOCATE', $ref, $p->lines(), $user, trim("Charged by {$src->code} ({$basis}): ".($memo ?? '')), $approver);
        }
        Ledger::post($src->id, $on, 'ALLOCATE', $ref, $srcP->lines(), $user, trim("Charged to branches ({$basis}): ".($memo ?? '')), $approver);
        $by = [];
        foreach ($split as $bid => $v) {
            $by[$codes[$bid]] = Money::q2(Money::sum($v));
        }
        CostAllocation::create(['ref' => $ref, 'from_unit_id' => $src->id, 'alloc_date' => $on, 'basis' => $basis,
            'accounts' => json_encode(array_map(fn ($c) => ['account_code' => $c[0], 'amount' => (string) $c[1]], $clean)),
            'shares' => json_encode(array_map('strval', $by)), 'total' => (string) $total, 'memo' => $memo, 'created_by' => $user, 'approved_by' => $approver]);
        Ledger::audit($user, 'ALLOCATE', 'cost_allocation', $ref, "{$total} {$basis} from {$src->code} (approved {$approver})");

        return ['ref' => $ref, 'total' => $total, 'by_branch' => $by];
    }

    public static function reverse(string $ref, string $on, string $user, string $reason): void
    {
        $rec = CostAllocation::where('ref', $ref)->first() ?? throw new BusinessRuleError('Allocation not found');
        if ($rec->reversed_on) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("Already reversed on {$rec->reversed_on}");
        }
        foreach (Journal::with('lines')->where('source', 'ALLOCATE')->where('source_ref', $ref)->orderBy('id')->get() as $j) {
            Ledger::postOne($j->branch_id, $on, 'REVERSAL', "REV-{$j->id}", $j->lines->map(fn ($l) => [$l->account_code, $l->credit, $l->debit, $l->party,
                "Reversal: {$reason}"])->all(), $user, $reason, $j->approved_by, $j->id);
        }
        $rec->update(['reversed_on' => $on]);
        Ledger::audit($user, 'ALLOCATE_REVERSE', 'cost_allocation', $ref, $reason);
    }

    public static function listing(): array
    {
        return CostAllocation::orderBy('id')->get()->map(fn ($r) => ['ref' => $r->ref, 'date' => $r->alloc_date, 'basis' => $r->basis, 'total' => $r->total,
            'shares' => json_decode($r->shares, true), 'reversed_on' => $r->reversed_on, 'memo' => $r->memo])->all();
    }
}

####################################################################################################
##### FILE: app/Domain/Ap.php

<?php

namespace App\Domain;

use App\Models\Account;
use App\Models\APAllocation;
use App\Models\APInvoice;
use App\Models\POLine;
use App\Models\PurchaseOrder;
use App\Models\RecurringBill;
use App\Models\Supplier;
use App\Models\SupplierPayment;
use Brick\Math\BigDecimal;

/**
 * Procure to pay, part 2: supplier invoices and credit notes, three-way match, held invoices, payments against invoices,
 * payment proposals, supplier statement reconciliation, ageing, payment advice, price variances and recurring bills.
 * Matched to an order: Dr 2015 (value received for the invoiced quantity), Dr recoverable input tax, Dr 5085 (goods) or the
 * service's expense account (difference), Cr 2010. Outside match_price_tolerance / match_qty_tolerance the invoice is HELD
 * (nothing posted) until someone with ap.release approves it. Without an order: Dr expense (net plus tax not recovered),
 * Dr recoverable input tax, Cr 2020. Payments go through Payables::paySupplier, so WHT and WHVAT work as for direct payments.
 * Port of services/ap.py.
 */
final class Ap
{
    public const PPV = 5085;

    private static function supplier(string $code): Supplier
    {
        return Supplier::where('code', $code)->first() ?? throw new BusinessRuleError("Unknown supplier {$code}");
    }

    private static function recovery(string $use): BigDecimal
    {
        if (Ledger::setting('vat_registered', 'Yes') !== 'Yes') {
            return BigDecimal::zero();
        }

        return match ($use) {
            'Taxable' => BigDecimal::one(), 'Exempt' => BigDecimal::zero(), 'Shared' => Money::d(Ledger::setting('shared_input_recovery', '0.5')),
            default => throw new BusinessRuleError('use must be Taxable, Exempt or Shared'),
        };
    }

    /** [split, recoverable per tax, non-recoverable total, charged]. */
    private static function tax(Supplier $sup, ?string $taxCode, BigDecimal $net, string $on, string $use): array
    {
        $charged = $sup->vat_registered && $taxCode === 'SR20';
        $tx = Tax::addExclusive($net, $charged ? Tax::ratesFor('SR20', $on, false) : Tax::rates(0, 0, 0));
        $pct = self::recovery($use);
        $rec = array_map(fn ($t) => Money::q2($t->multipliedBy($pct)), [$tx['vat'], $tx['nhil'], $tx['getfund']]);

        return [$tx, $rec, $tx['vat']->plus($tx['nhil'])->plus($tx['getfund'])->minus(Money::sum($rec)), $charged];
    }

    private static function poLine(PurchaseOrder $po, array $x): POLine
    {
        return $po->lines->first(fn ($l) => (int) $l->line_no === (int) $x['line_no']) ?? throw new BusinessRuleError("Order {$po->po_no} has no line {$x['line_no']}");
    }

    /**
     * lines – matched to an order: [line_no, qty, unit_price]; without an order: [account_code, description, net, tax_code, use].
     */
    public static function postInvoice(int $branchId, string $supplierCode, ?string $invoiceNo, string $invoiceDate, array $lines, string $user, ?string $dueDate = null,
        ?string $poNo = null, string $kind = 'INVOICE', ?string $creditOf = null): APInvoice
    {
        if (! in_array($kind, ['INVOICE', 'CREDIT', 'DEBIT'], true)) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("kind must be INVOICE, CREDIT (supplier's credit note) or DEBIT (our debit note to the supplier)");
        }
        $sup = self::supplier($supplierCode);
        if (! $invoiceNo || ! $lines) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Invoice number and lines are required');
        }
        if (APInvoice::where('supplier_id', $sup->id)->where('kind', $kind)->where('invoice_no', $invoiceNo)->exists()) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError(ucfirst(strtolower($kind))." {$invoiceNo} from {$supplierCode} is already recorded");
        }
        $po = $poNo ? Purchasing::getPo($poNo) : null;
        if ($po !== null) {
            if ($kind !== 'INVOICE') {
                throw new BusinessRuleError('Goods returned to a supplier go through a supplier return; credit notes here are for non-order items');
            }
            if ($po->supplier_id !== $sup->id) {
                throw new BusinessRuleError("Order {$po->po_no} is not for {$supplierCode}");
            }
        }
        $goods = $po !== null && collect($lines)->contains(fn ($x) => self::poLine($po, $x)->product_id);
        $inv = new APInvoice(['branch_id' => $branchId, 'supplier_id' => $sup->id, 'kind' => $kind, 'invoice_no' => $invoiceNo, 'invoice_date' => $invoiceDate,
            'due_date' => $dueDate ?? date('Y-m-d', strtotime("{$invoiceDate} +".($sup->payment_terms_days ?: 30).' days')), 'po_id' => $po?->id,
            'payable_account' => $goods ? 2010 : 2020, 'net' => '0', 'gross' => '0', 'paid' => '0', 'status' => 'OPEN', 'lines_json' => json_encode($lines),
            'entered_by' => $user]);
        if ($creditOf) {
            $orig = APInvoice::where('supplier_id', $sup->id)->where('kind', 'INVOICE')->where('invoice_no', $creditOf)->first()
                ?? throw new BusinessRuleError("Invoice {$creditOf} not found for {$supplierCode}");
            $inv->credit_of_id = $orig->id;
        }
        $reasons = $po ? self::matchCheck($po, $lines) : [];
        if ($reasons) {
            $inv->status = 'HELD';
            $inv->hold_reason = implode('; ', $reasons);
            self::amounts($inv, $sup, $po, $lines, false);
            $inv->save();
            Ledger::audit($user, 'AP_HELD', 'ap_invoice', $inv->id, $inv->hold_reason);

            return $inv;
        }
        self::post($inv, $sup, $po, $lines, $user, null);

        return $inv;
    }

    private static function matchCheck(PurchaseOrder $po, array $lines): array
    {
        [$tolP, $tolQ] = [Money::d(Ledger::setting('match_price_tolerance', '0.02')), Money::d(Ledger::setting('match_qty_tolerance', '0'))];
        $out = [];
        foreach ($lines as $x) {
            $ln = self::poLine($po, $x);
            [$qty, $price] = [Money::d((string) $x['qty']), Money::d((string) $x['unit_price'])];
            if (! $qty->isPositive()) {
                throw new BusinessRuleError('Invoiced quantity must be positive');
            }
            $open = Money::d($ln->qty_received)->minus($ln->qty_invoiced);
            if ($qty->isGreaterThan($open->multipliedBy($tolQ->plus(1)))) {
                $out[] = "line {$ln->line_no}: invoiced {$qty} but only {$open} received and not yet invoiced";
            }
            $up = Money::d($ln->unit_price);
            if (! $up->isZero() && $price->minus($up)->abs()->isGreaterThan($up->multipliedBy($tolP))) {
                $out[] = "line {$ln->line_no}: price {$price} vs order {$ln->unit_price} (tolerance ".$tolP->multipliedBy(100).'%)';
            }
        }

        return $out;
    }

    /** Computes the invoice totals and (when posting) the journal lines. */
    private static function amounts(APInvoice $inv, Supplier $sup, ?PurchaseOrder $po, array $lines, bool $posting): Poster
    {
        $p = new Poster;
        [$netT, $srNet] = [BigDecimal::zero(), BigDecimal::zero()];
        $taxes = [BigDecimal::zero(), BigDecimal::zero(), BigDecimal::zero()];
        $sign = $inv->kind === 'INVOICE' ? 1 : -1;
        foreach ($lines as $x) {
            if ($po !== null) {
                $ln = self::poLine($po, $x);
