                $qty = Money::d((string) $x['qty']);
                $net = Money::q2($qty->multipliedBy((string) $x['unit_price']));
                $use = $ln->product_id ? 'Taxable' : ($x['use'] ?? 'Shared');
                [$tx, $rec, $nonrec, $charged] = self::tax($sup, $ln->tax_code, $net, $inv->invoice_date, $use);
                $remQ = Money::d($ln->qty_received)->minus($ln->qty_invoiced);
                $remV = Money::d($ln->value_received)->minus($ln->value_invoiced);
                $clear = $qty->isGreaterThanOrEqualTo($remQ) ? Money::q2($remV)
                    : ($remQ->isZero() ? BigDecimal::zero() : Money::q2(Money::pdiv($remV->multipliedBy($qty), $remQ)));
                $cost = $net->plus($nonrec);
                if ($posting) {
                    $p->dr(Purchasing::GRNI, $clear, "PO:{$po->po_no}");
                    $diff = Money::q2($cost->minus($clear));
                    if (! $diff->isZero()) {
                        $target = $ln->product_id ? self::PPV : (int) $ln->account_code;
                        $diff->isPositive() ? $p->dr($target, $diff) : $p->cr($target, $diff->abs());
                    }
                    $ln->update(['qty_invoiced' => (string) Money::d($ln->qty_invoiced)->plus($qty), 'value_invoiced' => (string) Money::d($ln->value_invoiced)->plus($clear)]);
                }
            } else {
                $acct = Account::find($x['account_code'] ?? 0);
                if ($acct === null || $acct->control !== 'Manual allowed' || in_array((int) $acct->code, [1010, 1015, 1030, 1035, 1040, 1045, 2010, 2020], true)) {
                    throw new BusinessRuleError('Account '.($x['account_code'] ?? 'None').' cannot be used on a supplier invoice');
                }
                $net = Money::q2((string) $x['net']);
                if (! $net->isPositive()) {
                    throw new BusinessRuleError('Line amounts must be positive');
                }
                [$tx, $rec, $nonrec, $charged] = self::tax($sup, $x['tax_code'] ?? 'OS', $net, $inv->invoice_date, $x['use'] ?? 'Shared');
                if ($posting) {
                    $sign > 0 ? $p->dr((int) $acct->code, $net->plus($nonrec)) : $p->cr((int) $acct->code, $net->plus($nonrec));
                }
            }
            if ($posting) {
                foreach (array_combine(Inventory::INPUT_TAX, $rec) as $a => $v) {
                    $sign > 0 ? $p->dr($a, $v) : $p->cr($a, $v);
                }
            }
            $netT = $netT->plus($net);
            $srNet = $srNet->plus($charged ? $net : BigDecimal::zero());
            $taxes = [$taxes[0]->plus($tx['vat']), $taxes[1]->plus($tx['nhil']), $taxes[2]->plus($tx['getfund'])];
        }
        $inv->net = (string) Money::q2($netT);
        $inv->standard_rated_net = (string) Money::q2($srNet);
        [$inv->vat, $inv->nhil, $inv->getfund] = array_map(fn ($t) => (string) Money::q2($t), $taxes);
        $gross = Money::q2($netT->plus(Money::sum($taxes)));
        $inv->gross = (string) $gross;
        if ($posting) {
            $sign > 0 ? $p->cr((int) $inv->payable_account, $gross, $sup->code) : $p->dr((int) $inv->payable_account, $gross, $sup->code);
        }

        return $p;
    }

    private static function post(APInvoice $inv, Supplier $sup, ?PurchaseOrder $po, array $lines, string $user, ?string $approver): int
    {
        $p = self::amounts($inv, $sup, $po, $lines, true);
        $src = ['INVOICE' => 'APINV', 'CREDIT' => 'APCRN', 'DEBIT' => 'APDBN'][$inv->kind];
        $j = Ledger::post($inv->branch_id, $inv->invoice_date, $src, "{$sup->code}/{$inv->invoice_no}", $p->lines(), $user,
            "{$sup->name} ".strtolower($inv->kind)." {$inv->invoice_no}".($po ? " ({$po->po_no})" : ''), $approver);
        $inv->journal_id = $j->id;
        $inv->status = 'OPEN';
        $inv->save();
        if (in_array($inv->kind, ['CREDIT', 'DEBIT'], true) && $inv->credit_of_id) {
            $orig = APInvoice::find($inv->credit_of_id);
            $amt = BigDecimal::min(self::openAmount($orig), Money::d($inv->gross));
            if ($amt->isPositive()) {
                self::allocate($orig, $amt, $inv->invoice_date, $j->id, $inv);
                $paid = Money::d($inv->paid)->plus($amt);
                $inv->update(['paid' => (string) $paid, 'status' => $paid->isGreaterThanOrEqualTo($inv->gross) ? 'PAID' : 'PART_PAID']);
            }
        }
        Ledger::audit($user, 'AP_POST', 'ap_invoice', $inv->id, "{$sup->code} {$inv->invoice_no} {$inv->gross}");

        return $j->id;
    }

    /** Accepts a held invoice after review; the approver must not be the person who entered it. */
    public static function releaseHeld(int $invoiceId, ?string $approver, string $user, string $reason): int
    {
        $inv = APInvoice::find($invoiceId);
        if ($inv === null || $inv->status !== 'HELD') {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('No held invoice with that id');
        }
        if (! $approver || in_array($approver, [$user, $inv->entered_by], true)) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('A held invoice must be released by someone other than the person who entered it');
        }
        $po = $inv->po_id ? PurchaseOrder::with('lines')->find($inv->po_id) : null;
        $inv->released_by = $approver;
        $inv->hold_reason = "{$inv->hold_reason} | released: {$reason}";

        return self::post($inv, $inv->supplier, $po, json_decode($inv->lines_json, true), $user, $approver);
    }

    public static function openAmount(APInvoice $inv): BigDecimal
    {
        return Money::q2(Money::d($inv->gross)->minus(Money::d($inv->paid)));
    }

    private static function allocate(APInvoice $inv, mixed $amount, string $on, ?int $journalId, ?APInvoice $creditNote = null): void
    {
        APAllocation::create(['invoice_id' => $inv->id, 'alloc_date' => $on, 'amount' => (string) Money::q2($amount), 'journal_id' => $journalId,
            'credit_note_id' => $creditNote?->id]);
        $paid = Money::d($inv->paid)->plus(Money::q2($amount));
        $inv->update(['paid' => (string) $paid, 'status' => $paid->isGreaterThanOrEqualTo($inv->gross) ? 'PAID' : 'PART_PAID']);
    }

    /**
     * allocations: [[invoice_id, amount]]. One payment journal per supplier and payable account; WHT on the tax-exclusive
     * share paid, withholding VAT (agents only) on the standard-rated share.
     */
    public static function payInvoices(int $branchId, string $on, string $channel, array $allocations, string $user, ?string $approver, ?string $certificateNo = null,
        ?string $whvatCertificateNo = null): array
    {
        if (! $allocations) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Select at least one invoice');
        }
        $groups = [];
        foreach ($allocations as $a) {
            $inv = APInvoice::find($a['invoice_id']);
            if ($inv === null || $inv->kind !== 'INVOICE') {
                throw new BusinessRuleError("Invoice {$a['invoice_id']} not found");
            }
            if ($inv->status === 'HELD') {
                throw new BusinessRuleError("Invoice {$inv->invoice_no} is held – release it first");
            }
            $amt = Money::q2((string) $a['amount']);
            if (! $amt->isPositive() || $amt->isGreaterThan(self::openAmount($inv))) {
                throw new BusinessRuleError("Payment on {$inv->invoice_no} must be positive and not more than ".self::openAmount($inv));
            }
            $groups["{$inv->supplier_id}|{$inv->payable_account}"][] = [$inv, $amt];
        }
        $agent = Ledger::setting('whvat_agent', 'No') === 'Yes';
        $out = [];
        foreach ($groups as $key => $items) {
            [$supId, $account] = array_map('intval', explode('|', $key));
            $sup = Supplier::find($supId);
            $gross = Money::q2(Money::sum(array_column($items, 1)));
            $whtBase = Money::q2(Money::sum(array_map(fn ($x) => Money::pdiv($x[1]->multipliedBy($x[0]->net), $x[0]->gross), $items)));
            $whvatBase = $agent && $sup->vat_registered
                ? Money::q2(Money::sum(array_map(fn ($x) => Money::pdiv($x[1]->multipliedBy($x[0]->standard_rated_net ?? '0'), $x[0]->gross), $items))) : Money::zero();
            $refs = implode(',', array_map(fn ($x) => $x[0]->invoice_no, $items));
            $r = Payables::paySupplier($branchId, $sup->code, $on, $gross, $whtBase, $channel, $user, $certificateNo, null, $approver, null, mb_substr($refs, 0, 40),
                min(array_map(fn ($x) => $x[0]->invoice_date, $items)), $whvatBase, $whvatCertificateNo, $account, mb_substr("PAY-{$sup->code}-{$on}-{$refs}", 0, 60));
            foreach ($items as [$inv, $amt]) {
                self::allocate($inv, $amt, $on, $r['journal_id']);
            }
            $out[] = ['supplier' => $sup->code, 'invoices' => $refs] + $r;
        }

        return $out;
    }

    /** Uses an unallocated supplier credit note against an open invoice (no cash moves). */
    public static function applyCredit(int $creditId, int $invoiceId, mixed $amount, string $on, string $user): void
    {
        [$cn, $inv] = [APInvoice::find($creditId), APInvoice::find($invoiceId)];
        if ($cn === null || ! in_array($cn->kind, ['CREDIT', 'DEBIT'], true) || $inv === null || $inv->kind !== 'INVOICE' || $cn->supplier_id !== $inv->supplier_id) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Credit note and invoice must belong to the same supplier');
        }
        $amt = Money::q2($amount);
        if (! $amt->isPositive() || $amt->isGreaterThan(self::openAmount($inv)) || $amt->isGreaterThan(self::openAmount($cn))) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Amount exceeds what is open on the invoice or the credit note');
        }
        if ((int) $cn->payable_account !== (int) $inv->payable_account) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Credit note and invoice sit in different payable accounts');
        }
        self::allocate($inv, $amt, $on, null, $cn);
        $paid = Money::d($cn->paid)->plus($amt);
        $cn->update(['paid' => (string) $paid, 'status' => $paid->isGreaterThanOrEqualTo($cn->gross) ? 'PAID' : 'PART_PAID']);
        Ledger::audit($user, 'AP_CREDIT_APPLY', 'ap_invoice', $inv->id, "credit {$cn->invoice_no} {$amt}");
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ reports
    /** Open invoices due on or before $dueBy, oldest first: the basis for a payment run. */
    public static function proposePayments(string $dueBy, ?int $branchId = null, ?string $supplierCode = null): array
    {
        $q = APInvoice::with('supplier')->where('kind', 'INVOICE')->whereIn('status', ['OPEN', 'PART_PAID'])->where('due_date', '<=', $dueBy);
        if ($branchId) {
            $q->where('branch_id', $branchId);
        }
        if ($supplierCode) {
            $q->where('supplier_id', self::supplier($supplierCode)->id);
        }
        $rows = $q->orderBy('due_date')->orderBy('id')->get()->map(fn ($i) => ['invoice_id' => $i->id, 'supplier' => $i->supplier->code, 'invoice_no' => $i->invoice_no,
            'due' => $i->due_date, 'open' => self::openAmount($i)])->all();

        return ['due_by' => $dueBy, 'rows' => $rows, 'total' => Money::q2(Money::sum(array_column($rows, 'open')))];
    }

    public const BUCKETS = [['not due', null, 0], ['1-30', 1, 30], ['31-60', 31, 60], ['61-90', 61, 90], ['over 90', 91, null]];

    public static function bucket(int $days): string
    {
        foreach (self::BUCKETS as [$b, $lo, $hi]) {
            if (($lo === null && $days <= 0) || ($lo !== null && $days >= $lo && ($hi === null || $days <= $hi))) {
                return $b;
            }
        }

        return 'over 90';
    }

    public static function days(string $from, string $to): int
    {
        return (int) round((strtotime($to) - strtotime($from)) / 86400);
    }

    /** Open supplier invoices by days past due date. */
    public static function ageing(string $asOf): array
    {
        $out = [];
        foreach (APInvoice::with('supplier')->whereIn('status', ['OPEN', 'PART_PAID', 'HELD'])->orderBy('id')->get() as $i) {
            $name = self::bucket(self::days($i->due_date, $asOf));
            $code = $i->supplier->code;
            $out[$code] ??= array_fill_keys(array_column(self::BUCKETS, 0), BigDecimal::zero()) + ['supplier' => $i->supplier->name];
            $out[$code][$name] = $out[$code][$name]->plus(self::openAmount($i)->multipliedBy($i->kind === 'INVOICE' ? 1 : -1));
        }
        $rows = array_values($out);
        [$overdue, $total] = [BigDecimal::zero(), BigDecimal::zero()];
        foreach ($rows as $r) {
            foreach (self::BUCKETS as $k => [$b]) {
                $total = $total->plus($r[$b]);
                if ($k > 0) {
                    $overdue = $overdue->plus($r[$b]);
                }
            }
        }

        return ['as_of' => $asOf, 'rows' => $rows, 'overdue' => Money::q2($overdue), 'total' => Money::q2($total)];
    }

    public static function held(): array
    {
        return APInvoice::with('supplier')->where('status', 'HELD')->orderBy('id')->get()->map(fn ($i) => ['invoice_id' => $i->id, 'supplier' => $i->supplier->code,
            'invoice_no' => $i->invoice_no, 'gross' => $i->gross, 'reason' => $i->hold_reason])->all();
    }

    /** statement_lines: [[document, amount]] as the supplier shows them; compares invoice by invoice and the closing balance (2010 + 2020). */
    public static function statementReconciliation(string $supplierCode, array $statementLines, mixed $closingBalance, string $asOf): array
    {
        $sup = self::supplier($supplierCode);
        $ours = [];
        foreach (APInvoice::where('supplier_id', $sup->id)->where('invoice_date', '<=', $asOf)->where('status', '<>', 'HELD')->orderBy('id')->get() as $i) {
            $ours[$i->invoice_no] = Money::d($i->gross)->multipliedBy($i->kind === 'INVOICE' ? 1 : -1);
        }
        $theirs = [];
        foreach ($statementLines as $x) {
            $theirs[(string) $x['document']] = Money::d((string) $x['amount']);
        }
        [$missHere, $missThere, $differ] = [[], [], []];
        foreach ($theirs as $k => $v) {
            if ($v->isPositive() && ! isset($ours[$k])) {
                $missHere[] = ['document' => (string) $k, 'amount' => $v];
            }
            if (isset($ours[$k]) && ! Money::q2($ours[$k])->isEqualTo(Money::q2($v))) {
                $differ[] = ['document' => (string) $k, 'ours' => $ours[$k], 'theirs' => $v];
            }
        }
        foreach ($ours as $k => $v) {
            if ($v->isPositive() && ! isset($theirs[$k])) {
                $missThere[] = ['document' => (string) $k, 'amount' => $v];
            }
        }
        $book = Reports::partyBalance(2010, $sup->code, $asOf)->plus(Reports::partyBalance(2020, $sup->code, $asOf))->negated();
        $held = Money::q2(Money::sum(APInvoice::where('supplier_id', $sup->id)->where('status', 'HELD')->pluck('gross')->all()));

        return ['supplier' => $sup->code, 'balance_per_statement' => Money::q2($closingBalance), 'balance_per_books' => Money::q2($book),
            'difference' => Money::q2(Money::d($closingBalance)->minus($book)), 'invoices_on_statement_not_in_books' => $missHere,
            'invoices_in_books_not_on_statement' => $missThere, 'amounts_differ' => $differ, 'held_invoices_not_yet_in_books' => $held];
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ v1.1: payment advice, price variances, recurring bills
    /** Per payment on the date: the supplier's bank or mobile-money details, invoices paid, gross, WHT, WHVAT and net paid. */
    public static function paymentAdvice(string $on, ?int $branchId = null): array
    {
        $q = SupplierPayment::where('pay_date', $on)->orderBy('id');
        if ($branchId) {
            $q->where('branch_id', $branchId);
        }
        $rows = [];
        foreach ($q->get() as $p) {
            $sup = Supplier::find($p->supplier_id);
            $invs = APAllocation::where('journal_id', $p->journal_id)->orderBy('id')->get()->map(fn ($a) => APInvoice::find($a->invoice_id)->invoice_no)->implode(', ');
            $rows[] = ['supplier' => $sup->code, 'name' => $sup->name, 'bank_name' => $sup->bank_name ?? '', 'bank_account' => $sup->bank_account ?? '',
                'momo' => $sup->momo_number ?? '', 'invoices' => $invs ?: ($p->invoice_no ?: 'on account'), 'gross' => Money::d($p->gross), 'wht' => Money::d($p->wht_amount),
                'wht_certificate' => $p->certificate_no ?? '', 'whvat' => Money::d($p->whvat_amount),
                'net_paid' => Money::q2(Money::d($p->gross)->minus($p->wht_amount)->minus($p->whvat_amount)), 'channel' => $p->channel];
        }
        $exc = [];
        foreach ($rows as $r) {
            if (in_array($r['channel'], ['Bank', 'MoMo'], true) && ! ($r['bank_account'] || $r['momo'])) {
                $exc[] = "{$r['supplier']}: BANK OR MOBILE-MONEY DETAILS MISSING";
            }
        }

        return ['date' => $on, 'rows' => $rows, 'total_net' => Money::q2(Money::sum(array_column($rows, 'net_paid'))), 'exceptions' => $exc];
    }

    public static function paymentAdviceXlsx(string $on, ?int $branchId = null): string
    {
        $adv = self::paymentAdvice($on, $branchId);
        $x = new Xlsx;
        $ws = $x->sheet('Supplier_Payment_Advice', 'Supplier payment advice – '.date('d M Y', strtotime($on)));
        $cols = ['supplier', 'name', 'bank_name', 'bank_account', 'momo', 'invoices', 'gross', 'wht', 'wht_certificate', 'whvat', 'net_paid', 'channel'];
        $r = $x->table($ws, $adv['rows'], 3, array_combine($cols, array_map(fn ($c) => ucwords(str_replace('_', ' ', $c)), $cols)));
        $x->put($ws, $r + 1, 1, 'Total net paid', true);
        $x->put($ws, $r + 1, 11, $adv['total_net'], true);
        foreach ($adv['exceptions'] as $k => $e) {
            $x->put($ws, $r + 3 + $k, 1, $e);
        }

        return $x->bytes();
    }

    /** Invoices matched to orders in the period: order vs invoice price, quantity and variance, tied to 5085 for goods. */
    public static function priceVarianceReport(string $start, string $end): array
    {
        $rows = [];
        foreach (APInvoice::with('supplier')->whereNotNull('po_id')->whereNotNull('journal_id')->where('invoice_date', '>=', $start)->where('invoice_date', '<=', $end)
            ->orderBy('invoice_date')->orderBy('id')->get() as $inv) {
            $po = PurchaseOrder::with('lines')->find($inv->po_id);
            foreach (json_decode($inv->lines_json, true) as $x) {
                $ln = self::poLine($po, $x);
                $var = Money::q2(Money::d((string) $x['unit_price'])->minus($ln->unit_price)->multipliedBy((string) $x['qty']));
                if (! $var->isZero()) {
                    $rows[] = ['invoice' => $inv->invoice_no, 'supplier' => $inv->supplier->code, 'po' => $po->po_no, 'item' => $ln->description,
                        'qty' => Money::d((string) $x['qty']), 'order_price' => Money::d($ln->unit_price), 'invoice_price' => Money::d((string) $x['unit_price']),
                        'variance' => $var, 'goods' => (bool) $ln->product_id, 'released_by' => $inv->released_by];
                }
            }
        }
        $goods = Money::q2(Money::sum(array_map(fn ($r) => $r['variance'], array_filter($rows, fn ($r) => $r['goods']))));
        $gl = Money::q2(Reports::accountBalance(self::PPV, $end)->minus(Reports::accountBalance(self::PPV, date('Y-m-d', strtotime("{$start} -1 day")))));

        return ['rows' => $rows, 'goods_variance' => $goods, 'gl_5085_movement' => $gl, 'note' => '5085 also carries tax not recovered on price differences, if any'];
    }

    public static function createRecurringBill(string $code, int $branchId, string $supplierCode, array $lines, string $startMonth, string $user, ?string $approver,
        int $dayOfMonth = 1, ?string $endMonth = null): RecurringBill
    {
        if (! $approver || $approver === $user) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("Recurring bills need a second person's approval");
        }
        $sup = self::supplier($supplierCode);
        foreach ($lines as $x) {
            $acct = Account::find($x['account_code'] ?? 0);
            if ($acct === null || $acct->control !== 'Manual allowed' || ! Money::d((string) ($x['net'] ?? '0'))->isPositive()) {
                throw new BusinessRuleError('Each line needs an open expense account and a positive amount');
            }
        }
        if ($dayOfMonth < 1 || $dayOfMonth > 28) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Day of month must be 1 to 28');
        }
        $r = RecurringBill::create(['code' => $code, 'branch_id' => $branchId, 'supplier_id' => $sup->id, 'lines' => json_encode($lines), 'day_of_month' => $dayOfMonth,
            'start_month' => substr($startMonth, 0, 7).'-01', 'end_month' => $endMonth, 'created_by' => $user, 'approved_by' => $approver, 'active' => true]);
        Ledger::audit($user, 'RECURRING_BILL', 'recurring_bill', $code, "{$supplierCode} approved {$approver}");

        return $r;
    }

    /** One AP batch draft per unit with every bill due for the month; invoice number = code-YYYYMM. Returns batch numbers. */
    public static function generateRecurringBills(string $periodEnd, string $user): array
    {
        $period = substr($periodEnd, 0, 7);
        $made = [];
        foreach (RecurringBill::with('supplier')->where('active', true)->where('start_month', '<=', $periodEnd)->orderBy('id')->get() as $r) {
            if (($r->end_month && $r->end_month < substr($periodEnd, 0, 7).'-01') || $r->last_generated === $period) {
                continue;
            }
            $made[$r->branch_id] ??= Batches::createBatch('AP', $r->branch_id, "Recurring bills {$period}", 0, 1, $user, "RECURRING BILLS {$period}");
            $b = $made[$r->branch_id];
            $invDate = sprintf('%s-%02d', $period, $r->day_of_month);
            $ref = "{$r->code}-".str_replace('-', '', $period);
            Batches::addEntry($b->batch_no, 'INVOICE', $invDate, $ref, $user, ['supplier' => $r->supplier->code, 'invoice_no' => $ref, 'invoice_date' => $invDate,
                'lines' => json_decode($r->lines, true)]);
            $r->update(['last_generated' => $period]);
        }
        foreach ($made as $b) {
            $t = Batches::totals($b->fresh());
            $b->update(['control_total' => (string) $t['entered_total'], 'control_count' => $t['entered_count']]);
        }

        return array_values(array_map(fn ($b) => $b->batch_no, $made));
    }
}

####################################################################################################
##### FILE: app/Domain/Ar.php
####################################################################################################

<?php

namespace App\Domain;

use App\Models\Account;
use App\Models\ARAllocation;
use App\Models\ARInvoice;
use App\Models\Payer;
use Brick\Math\BigDecimal;

/**
 * Receivables outside the till: invoices and credit notes to credit customers (services, rebates, rent received, other income),
 * open-item allocation of receipts and ageing by due date. Stock sold on credit still goes through the till.
 * Invoice: Dr 1110 customer (gross), Cr income (net), Cr output VAT/NHIL/GETFund. Credit note: the reverse; needs a second person
 * (ar.credit.approve) and is allocated to the invoice it corrects. Port of services/ar.py.
 */
final class Ar
{
    public const OUTPUT_TAX = [2100, 2105, 2110];

    public const INCOME_TYPES = ['Revenue', 'Other income'];

    private static function payer(string $code): Payer
    {
        $p = Payer::where('code', $code)->first();
        if ($p === null || ! in_array($p->payer_type, ['Corporate', 'Insurer'], true)) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Invoices are raised to corporate customers or insurers');
        }

        return $p;
    }

    /** lines: [account_code (income account), description, net, tax_code 'SR20'/'EX'/'ZR'/'OS']. */
    public static function createInvoice(int $branchId, string $payerCode, string $on, array $lines, string $user, string $kind = 'INVOICE', ?string $creditOf = null,
        ?string $approver = null, ?string $dueDate = null): ARInvoice
    {
        if (! in_array($kind, ['INVOICE', 'DEBIT', 'CREDIT'], true)) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('kind must be INVOICE, DEBIT (additional charge) or CREDIT');
        }
        if ($kind === 'CREDIT' && (! $approver || $approver === $user)) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Credit notes need approval by someone other than the person raising them');
        }
        $payer = self::payer($payerCode);
        if (! $lines) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('An invoice needs at least one line');
        }
        $p = new Poster;
        $sign = $kind === 'CREDIT' ? -1 : 1;
        $netT = BigDecimal::zero();
        $taxes = [BigDecimal::zero(), BigDecimal::zero(), BigDecimal::zero()];
        foreach ($lines as $x) {
            $acct = Account::find($x['account_code'] ?? 0);
            if ($acct === null || ! in_array($acct->acct_type, self::INCOME_TYPES, true) || $acct->control !== 'Manual allowed') {
                throw new BusinessRuleError('Account '.($x['account_code'] ?? 'None').' is not an income account open to invoicing');
            }
            $net = Money::q2((string) $x['net']);
            if (! $net->isPositive()) {
                throw new BusinessRuleError('Line amounts must be positive');
            }
            $tx = Tax::addExclusive($net, Tax::ratesFor($x['tax_code'] ?? 'SR20', $on));
            $sign > 0 ? $p->cr((int) $acct->code, $net) : $p->dr((int) $acct->code, $net);
            foreach (array_combine(self::OUTPUT_TAX, [$tx['vat'], $tx['nhil'], $tx['getfund']]) as $a => $v) {
                $sign > 0 ? $p->cr($a, $v) : $p->dr($a, $v);
            }
            $netT = $netT->plus($net);
            $taxes = [$taxes[0]->plus($tx['vat']), $taxes[1]->plus($tx['nhil']), $taxes[2]->plus($tx['getfund'])];
        }
        $gross = Money::q2($netT->plus(Money::sum($taxes)));
        $sign > 0 ? $p->dr(1110, $gross, $payer->code) : $p->cr(1110, $gross, $payer->code);
        $no = Purchasing::nextNo(ARInvoice::class, 'invoice_no', ['INVOICE' => 'INV-', 'DEBIT' => 'DBN-', 'CREDIT' => 'CRN-'][$kind]);
        $creditOfId = null;
        if ($creditOf) {
            $orig = ARInvoice::where('invoice_no', $creditOf)->whereIn('kind', ['INVOICE', 'DEBIT'])->first();
            if ($orig === null || $orig->payer_id !== $payer->id) {
                throw new BusinessRuleError("Invoice {$creditOf} not found for {$payerCode}");
            }
            if ($kind === 'CREDIT' && $gross->isGreaterThan(self::openAmount($orig))) {
                throw new BusinessRuleError("Credit note {$gross} exceeds what is open on {$creditOf} (".self::openAmount($orig).')');
            }
            $creditOfId = $orig->id;
        }
        $j = Ledger::post($branchId, $on, ['INVOICE' => 'ARINV', 'DEBIT' => 'ARDBN', 'CREDIT' => 'ARCRN'][$kind], $no, $p->lines(), $user,
            "{$payer->name} ".strtolower($kind), $approver);
        $inv = ARInvoice::create(['branch_id' => $branchId, 'payer_id' => $payer->id, 'kind' => $kind, 'invoice_no' => $no, 'invoice_date' => $on,
            'due_date' => $dueDate ?? date('Y-m-d', strtotime("{$on} +".($payer->payment_terms_days ?: 30).' days')), 'net' => (string) Money::q2($netT),
            'vat' => (string) Money::q2($taxes[0]), 'nhil' => (string) Money::q2($taxes[1]), 'getfund' => (string) Money::q2($taxes[2]), 'gross' => (string) $gross,
            'paid' => '0', 'status' => 'OPEN', 'lines_json' => json_encode($lines), 'journal_id' => $j->id, 'credit_of_id' => $creditOfId]);
        if ($creditOfId && $kind === 'CREDIT') {
            self::allocate(ARInvoice::find($creditOfId), $gross, $on, $j->id);
            $inv->update(['paid' => (string) $gross, 'status' => 'PAID']);
        }
        Ledger::audit($user, 'AR_POST', 'ar_invoice', $inv->invoice_no, "{$payer->code} {$gross}");

        return $inv->load('payer');
    }

    public static function openAmount(ARInvoice $inv): BigDecimal
    {
        return Money::q2(Money::d($inv->gross)->minus(Money::d($inv->paid)));
    }

    private static function allocate(ARInvoice $inv, mixed $amount, string $on, ?int $journalId): void
    {
        ARAllocation::create(['invoice_id' => $inv->id, 'alloc_date' => $on, 'amount' => (string) Money::q2($amount), 'journal_id' => $journalId]);
        $paid = Money::d($inv->paid)->plus(Money::q2($amount));
        $inv->update(['paid' => (string) $paid, 'status' => $paid->isGreaterThanOrEqualTo($inv->gross) ? 'PAID' : 'PART_PAID']);
    }

    /** allocations: [[invoice_no, amount]]; none = oldest due first. Anything left settles till credit sales (in 1110 without an invoice). */
    public static function allocateReceipt(string $payerCode, mixed $amount, string $on, int $journalId, ?array $allocations = null): BigDecimal
    {
        $payer = self::payer($payerCode);
        $left = Money::q2($amount);
        if ($allocations) {
            foreach ($allocations as $a) {
                $inv = ARInvoice::where('invoice_no', $a['invoice_no'])->where('payer_id', $payer->id)->whereIn('kind', ['INVOICE', 'DEBIT'])->first();
                $amt = Money::q2((string) $a['amount']);
                if ($inv === null || ! $amt->isPositive() || $amt->isGreaterThan(self::openAmount($inv)) || $amt->isGreaterThan($left)) {
                    throw new BusinessRuleError("Allocation to {$a['invoice_no']} is not valid");
                }
                self::allocate($inv, $amt, $on, $journalId);
                $left = $left->minus($amt);
            }

            return $left;
        }
        foreach (ARInvoice::where('payer_id', $payer->id)->whereIn('kind', ['INVOICE', 'DEBIT'])->whereIn('status', ['OPEN', 'PART_PAID'])->orderBy('due_date')->orderBy('id')->get() as $inv) {
            if (! $left->isPositive()) {
                break;
            }
            $amt = BigDecimal::min($left, self::openAmount($inv));
            self::allocate($inv, $amt, $on, $journalId);
            $left = $left->minus($amt);
        }

        return $left;
    }

    public static function ageing(string $asOf): array
    {
        $out = [];
        foreach (ARInvoice::with('payer')->whereIn('kind', ['INVOICE', 'DEBIT'])->whereIn('status', ['OPEN', 'PART_PAID'])->orderBy('id')->get() as $i) {
            $name = Ap::bucket(Ap::days($i->due_date, $asOf));
            $code = $i->payer->code;
            $out[$code] ??= array_fill_keys(array_column(Ap::BUCKETS, 0), BigDecimal::zero()) + ['customer' => $i->payer->name];
            $out[$code][$name] = $out[$code][$name]->plus(self::openAmount($i));
        }
        $rows = array_values($out);
        $overdue = BigDecimal::zero();
        foreach ($rows as $r) {
            foreach (array_slice(Ap::BUCKETS, 1) as [$b]) {
                $overdue = $overdue->plus($r[$b]);
            }
        }

        return ['as_of' => $asOf, 'rows' => $rows, 'overdue' => Money::q2($overdue)];
    }
}

####################################################################################################
##### FILE: app/Domain/Assets.php
####################################################################################################

<?php

namespace App\Domain;

use App\Models\Channel;
use App\Models\DepreciationLine;
use App\Models\FixedAsset;
use App\Models\Journal;
use Brick\Math\BigDecimal;
use Brick\Math\RoundingMode;

/**
 * Fixed asset register (IFRS for SMEs Sections 17 / 18): straight-line depreciation, disposals with gain or loss (7040),
 * register-to-GL reconciliation and the PPE movement note. Depreciation starts the month after acquisition and stops after
 * the month before disposal; it never takes the carrying amount below the residual value. Port of services/assets.py.
 */
final class Assets
{
    public const ACCUM = [1510 => 1515, 1520 => 1525, 1530 => 1535, 1540 => 1545, 1550 => 1555, 1560 => 1565, 1580 => 1585];

    public static function expenseAccount(int $assetAccount): int
    {
        return $assetAccount === 1580 ? 6510 : 6500;
    }

    /** Registers an asset; with a pay channel the purchase is posted here, otherwise it must already be posted through Expenses. */
    public static function add(int $branchId, string $tag, string $description, int $assetAccount, mixed $cost, string $acquiredOn, int $lifeMonths, string $user,
        mixed $residual = 0, ?string $payChannel = null, ?string $approver = null): FixedAsset
    {
        if (! isset(self::ACCUM[$assetAccount])) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Asset account must be one of [1510, 1520, 1530, 1540, 1550, 1560, 1580]');
        }
        if ($lifeMonths <= 0 || ! Money::d($cost)->isPositive() || Money::d($residual)->isNegative() || Money::d($residual)->isGreaterThanOrEqualTo(Money::d($cost))) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Cost, useful life and residual value must be valid (residual below cost)');
        }
        if (FixedAsset::where('tag', $tag)->exists()) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("Asset tag {$tag} already used");
        }
        $a = FixedAsset::create(['branch_id' => $branchId, 'tag' => $tag, 'description' => $description, 'asset_account' => $assetAccount,
            'cost' => (string) Money::q2($cost), 'residual' => (string) Money::q2($residual), 'acquired_on' => $acquiredOn, 'life_months' => $lifeMonths]);
        if ($payChannel) {
            $ch = Channel::find($payChannel) ?? throw new BusinessRuleError('Unknown payment channel');
            Ledger::post($branchId, $acquiredOn, 'ASSET', "FA-{$tag}", [[$assetAccount, $a->cost, '0'], [(int) $ch->account, '0', $a->cost]], $user,
                "Purchase of {$description}", $approver);
        }

        return $a;
    }

    public static function accumulated(FixedAsset $a, ?string $throughPeriod = null): BigDecimal
    {
        $q = DepreciationLine::where('asset_id', $a->id);
        if ($throughPeriod) {
            $q->where('period', '<=', $throughPeriod);
        }

        return Money::q2(Money::sum($q->pluck('amount')->all()));
    }

    private static function monthly(FixedAsset $a): BigDecimal
    {
        return Money::q2(Money::div20(Money::d($a->cost)->minus($a->residual), $a->life_months));
    }

    private static function firstMonth(FixedAsset $a): string
    {
        return Reports::addMonths(substr($a->acquired_on, 0, 7).'-01', 1);
    }

    /** One journal per unit per month; refuses to run twice for the same month. */
    public static function runDepreciation(int $branchId, string $periodEnd, string $user, ?string $approver): ?int
    {
        if (! $approver || $approver === $user) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Depreciation runs need an approver other than the preparer');
        }
        $period = substr($periodEnd, 0, 7);
        if (Journal::where('branch_id', $branchId)->where('source', 'DEPRECIATION')->where('source_ref', "DEP-{$period}")->exists()) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("Depreciation for {$period} already posted");
        }
        $p = new Poster;
        $rows = [];
        foreach (FixedAsset::where('branch_id', $branchId)->where('acquired_on', '<=', $periodEnd)->orderBy('id')->get() as $a) {
            if ($periodEnd < self::firstMonth($a) || ($a->disposed_on && $a->disposed_on <= $periodEnd)) {
                continue;
            }
            $remaining = Money::d($a->cost)->minus($a->residual)->minus(self::accumulated($a));
            $amt = BigDecimal::min(self::monthly($a), Money::q2($remaining));
            if (! $amt->isPositive()) {
                continue;
            }
            $p->dr(self::expenseAccount((int) $a->asset_account), $amt);
            $p->cr(self::ACCUM[(int) $a->asset_account], $amt);
            $rows[] = [$a, $amt];
        }
        if (! $rows) {
            return null;
        }
        $j = Ledger::post($branchId, $periodEnd, 'DEPRECIATION', "DEP-{$period}", $p->lines(), $user, "Depreciation {$period}", $approver);
        foreach ($rows as [$a, $amt]) {
            DepreciationLine::create(['asset_id' => $a->id, 'journal_id' => $j->id, 'period' => $period, 'amount' => (string) $amt]);
        }

        return $j->id;
    }

    private static function duePeriods(FixedAsset $a, string $through): array
    {
        $out = [];
        for ($m = self::firstMonth($a); substr($m, 0, 7) <= $through; $m = Reports::addMonths($m, 1)) {
            $out[] = substr($m, 0, 7);
        }
        $mon = self::monthly($a);
        $remaining = $mon->isZero() ? 0 : Money::d($a->cost)->minus($a->residual)->dividedBy($mon, 0, RoundingMode::CEILING)->toInt();

        return array_slice($out, 0, $remaining);
    }

    public static function dispose(string $tag, string $on, mixed $proceeds, ?string $channel, string $user, ?string $approver): array
    {
        $a = FixedAsset::where('tag', $tag)->first();
        if ($a === null || $a->disposed_on) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Asset not found or already disposed');
        }
        if (! $approver || $approver === $user) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Disposals need an approver other than the preparer');
        }
        if ($on < $a->acquired_on) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Disposal date is before acquisition');
        }
        $prev = substr(Reports::addMonths(substr($on, 0, 7).'-01', -1), 0, 7);
        $due = array_values(array_filter(self::duePeriods($a, $prev), fn ($p) => ! DepreciationLine::where('asset_id', $a->id)->where('period', $p)->exists()));
        if ($due) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("Run depreciation up to {$prev} before disposing (missing: ".implode(', ', array_slice($due, 0, 3)).(count($due) > 3 ? '…' : '').')');
        }
        [$acc, $cost, $pr] = [self::accumulated($a), Money::d($a->cost), Money::q2($proceeds)];
        $gain = Money::q2($pr->minus($cost->minus($acc)));
        $p = new Poster;
        $p->dr(self::ACCUM[(int) $a->asset_account], $acc);
        $p->cr((int) $a->asset_account, $cost);
        if (! $pr->isZero()) {
            $ch = Channel::find((string) $channel) ?? throw new BusinessRuleError('Unknown channel for the proceeds');
            $p->dr((int) $ch->account, $pr);
        }
        $gain->isPositive() ? $p->cr(7040, $gain) : $p->dr(7040, $gain->negated());
        $j = Ledger::post($a->branch_id, $on, 'ASSET', "DISP-{$tag}", $p->lines(), $user, "Disposal of {$a->description}", $approver);
        $a->update(['disposed_on' => $on, 'proceeds' => (string) $pr, 'accumulated_at_disposal' => (string) $acc, 'gain_loss' => (string) $gain]);

        return ['journal_id' => $j->id, 'carrying_amount' => Money::q2($cost->minus($acc)), 'proceeds' => $pr, 'gain_loss' => $gain];
    }

    public static function register(int $branchId, string $asOf): array
    {
        $period = substr($asOf, 0, 7);
        [$rows, $byAcct] = [[], []];
        foreach (FixedAsset::where('branch_id', $branchId)->where('acquired_on', '<=', $asOf)->orderBy('tag')->get() as $a) {
            $disposed = $a->disposed_on !== null && $a->disposed_on <= $asOf;
            $acc = $disposed ? Money::zero() : self::accumulated($a, $period);
            $cost = $disposed ? Money::zero() : Money::d($a->cost);
            $rows[] = ['tag' => $a->tag, 'description' => $a->description, 'account' => (int) $a->asset_account, 'acquired' => $a->acquired_on,
                'cost' => Money::q2($a->cost), 'life_months' => (int) $a->life_months, 'accumulated' => $acc, 'carrying_amount' => Money::q2($cost->minus($acc)),
                'disposed_on' => $a->disposed_on, 'gain_loss' => $a->gain_loss];
            $k = $byAcct[(int) $a->asset_account] ?? [BigDecimal::zero(), BigDecimal::zero()];
            $byAcct[(int) $a->asset_account] = [$k[0]->plus($cost), $k[1]->plus($acc)];
        }
        $recon = [];
        $accts = array_unique(array_merge(array_keys($byAcct), array_keys(self::ACCUM)));
        sort($accts);
        foreach ($accts as $acct) {
            [$rc, $ra] = $byAcct[$acct] ?? [BigDecimal::zero(), BigDecimal::zero()];
            $gc = Reports::accountBalance($acct, $asOf, [$branchId]);
            $ga = Reports::accountBalance(self::ACCUM[$acct], $asOf, [$branchId])->negated();
            if (! ($rc->isZero() && $gc->isZero() && $ra->isZero() && $ga->isZero())) {
                $recon[$acct] = ['register_cost' => Money::q2($rc), 'gl_cost' => Money::q2($gc), 'register_accumulated' => Money::q2($ra), 'gl_accumulated' => Money::q2($ga),
                    'ok' => Money::q2($rc)->isEqualTo(Money::q2($gc)) && Money::q2($ra)->isEqualTo(Money::q2($ga))];
            }
        }

        return ['assets' => $rows, 'reconciliation' => $recon, 'ok' => ! in_array(false, array_column($recon, 'ok'), true)];
    }

    public static function disposals(string $start, string $end, ?array $branchIds = null): array
    {
        $q = FixedAsset::where('disposed_on', '>=', $start)->where('disposed_on', '<=', $end);
        if ($branchIds) {
            $q->whereIn('branch_id', $branchIds);
        }
        $z = BigDecimal::zero();
        $out = ['cost' => $z, 'accumulated' => $z, 'proceeds' => $z, 'gain' => $z, 'intangible_cost' => $z];
        foreach ($q->get() as $a) {
            $k = (int) $a->asset_account !== 1580 ? 'cost' : 'intangible_cost';
            $out[$k] = $out[$k]->plus($a->cost);
            $out['accumulated'] = $out['accumulated']->plus(Money::d($a->accumulated_at_disposal));
            $out['proceeds'] = $out['proceeds']->plus(Money::d($a->proceeds));
            $out['gain'] = $out['gain']->plus(Money::d($a->gain_loss));
        }

        return array_map(fn ($v) => Money::q2($v), $out);
    }

    /** PPE and intangibles movement: opening, additions, disposals, depreciation, closing; $accounts limits to one class (17.31). */
    public static function movementNote(string $start, string $end, ?array $branchIds = null, ?array $accounts = null): array
    {
        $q = FixedAsset::where('acquired_on', '<=', $end);
        if ($branchIds) {
            $q->whereIn('branch_id', $branchIds);
        }
        if ($accounts) {
            $q->whereIn('asset_account', $accounts);
        }
        $before = date('Y-m-d', strtotime("{$start} -1 day"));
        $z = BigDecimal::zero();
        $n = ['cost_open' => $z, 'additions' => $z, 'disposals_cost' => $z, 'cost_close' => $z, 'acc_open' => $z, 'charge' => $z, 'disposals_acc' => $z, 'acc_close' => $z];
        foreach ($q->orderBy('id')->get() as $a) {
            $heldOpen = $a->acquired_on <= $before && ! ($a->disposed_on && $a->disposed_on <= $before);
            $heldClose = ! ($a->disposed_on && $a->disposed_on <= $end);
            if ($heldOpen) {
                $n['cost_open'] = $n['cost_open']->plus($a->cost);
                $n['acc_open'] = $n['acc_open']->plus(self::accumulated($a, substr($before, 0, 7)));
            }
            if ($start <= $a->acquired_on && $a->acquired_on <= $end) {
                $n['additions'] = $n['additions']->plus($a->cost);
            }
            if ($a->disposed_on && $start <= $a->disposed_on && $a->disposed_on <= $end) {
                $n['disposals_cost'] = $n['disposals_cost']->plus($a->cost);
                $n['disposals_acc'] = $n['disposals_acc']->plus(Money::d($a->accumulated_at_disposal));
            }
            $n['charge'] = $n['charge']->plus(Money::q2(Money::sum(DepreciationLine::where('asset_id', $a->id)->where('period', '>=', substr($start, 0, 7))
                ->where('period', '<=', substr($end, 0, 7))->pluck('amount')->all())));
            if ($heldClose) {
                $n['cost_close'] = $n['cost_close']->plus($a->cost);
                $n['acc_close'] = $n['acc_close']->plus(self::accumulated($a, substr($end, 0, 7)));
            }
        }
        $n = array_map(fn ($v) => Money::q2($v), $n);
        $n['carrying_open'] = Money::q2($n['cost_open']->minus($n['acc_open']));
        $n['carrying_close'] = Money::q2($n['cost_close']->minus($n['acc_close']));
        $n['check'] = Money::q2($n['cost_open']->plus($n['additions'])->minus($n['disposals_cost'])->minus($n['cost_close']))
            ->plus(Money::q2($n['acc_open']->plus($n['charge'])->minus($n['disposals_acc'])->minus($n['acc_close'])));

        return $n;
    }
}

####################################################################################################
##### FILE: app/Domain/Batches.php
####################################################################################################

<?php

namespace App\Domain;

use App\Models\Account;
use App\Models\Batch;
use App\Models\BatchEntry;
use App\Models\Branch;
use App\Models\Channel;
use App\Models\Journal;
use App\Models\RecurringJournal;
use App\Models\StockCount;
use Brick\Math\BigDecimal;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

/**
 * Batch entry (as in Sage): entries of one type are keyed into a DRAFT batch against a control total and count, checked,
 * approved by a second person and posted together in ONE transaction – if any entry fails nothing is posted. Every journal
 * carries the batch id; a posted batch is locked (GL, cash, petty cash and bank batches are corrected by a reversal batch;
 * document batches by credit notes, returns or adjustments). Types: GL, CASH, AR, AP, INV, PETTY (petty cash vault: VOUCHER,
 * RECEIPT, TOPUP, BANKING) and BANK (RECEIPT, PAYMENT, TRANSFER, CHARGES, INTEREST). Port of services/batches.py.
 */
final class Batches
{
    public const KINDS = [
        'GL' => ['JOURNAL'],
        'CASH' => ['RECEIPT', 'PAYMENT', 'TRANSFER'],
        'AR' => ['INVOICE', 'DEBIT_NOTE', 'CREDIT_NOTE', 'RECEIPT', 'CLAIM_PAYMENT'],
        'AP' => ['INVOICE', 'DEBIT_NOTE', 'CREDIT_NOTE', 'PAYMENT'],
        'INV' => ['ADJUST', 'TRANSFER', 'RECEIPT', 'RECEIPT_PO', 'SERVICE_CONFIRM', 'COUNT'],
        'PETTY' => ['VOUCHER', 'RECEIPT', 'TOPUP', 'BANKING'],
        'BANK' => ['RECEIPT', 'PAYMENT', 'TRANSFER', 'CHARGES', 'INTEREST'],
    ];

    public const REVERSIBLE = ['GL', 'CASH', 'PETTY', 'BANK'];

    public const BANK_CHANNELS = ['Bank', 'Bank FX', 'MoMo'];

    public const CASH_ACCOUNTS = [1010, 1015, 1030, 1035, 1040, 1045];

    private static function n(mixed $v): BigDecimal
    {
        return Money::d($v === null || $v === '' ? '0' : (is_float($v) ? (string) $v : $v));
    }

    public static function entryAmount(string $kind, array $p): BigDecimal
    {
        $sum = fn (array $xs) => Money::q2(Money::sum($xs));

        return match (true) {
            $kind === 'JOURNAL' => $sum(array_map(fn ($l) => self::n($l['debit'] ?? 0), $p['lines'] ?? [])),
            $kind === 'RECEIPT' && isset($p['lines']) => $sum(array_map(fn ($l) => self::n($l['packs']), $p['lines'])),
            $kind === 'COUNT' => Money::zero(),
            in_array($kind, ['RECEIPT', 'TRANSFER', 'CLAIM_PAYMENT'], true) && isset($p['amount']) => Money::q2(self::n($p['amount'])),
            $kind === 'PAYMENT' && isset($p['allocations']) => $sum(array_map(fn ($a) => self::n($a['amount']), $p['allocations'])),
            in_array($kind, ['PAYMENT', 'VOUCHER'], true) => Money::q2(self::n($p['net'] ?? null)),
            in_array($kind, ['TOPUP', 'BANKING', 'CHARGES', 'INTEREST'], true) => Money::q2(self::n($p['amount'] ?? null)),
            in_array($kind, ['INVOICE', 'CREDIT_NOTE', 'DEBIT_NOTE'], true) => $sum(array_map(fn ($l) => isset($l['net']) ? self::n($l['net'])
                : self::n($l['qty'])->multipliedBy(self::n($l['unit_price'])), $p['lines'] ?? [])),
            in_array($kind, ['ADJUST', 'TRANSFER'], true) => Money::q2(self::n($p['qty'] ?? null)),
            in_array($kind, ['RECEIPT_PO', 'SERVICE_CONFIRM'], true) => $sum(array_map(fn ($l) => self::n($l['qty']), $p['lines'] ?? [])),
            default => throw new BusinessRuleError("Unknown entry kind {$kind}"),
        };
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ draft
    public static function createBatch(string $batchType, int $branchId, string $description, mixed $controlTotal, int $controlCount, string $user, ?string $source = null): Batch
    {
        if (! isset(self::KINDS[$batchType])) {
            $k = array_keys(self::KINDS);
            sort($k);
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Batch type must be one of '.Payroll::pyList($k));
        }
        if ($controlCount <= 0) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Enter the number of entries you are about to key (control count)');
        }
        $b = Batch::create(['batch_no' => Purchasing::nextNo(Batch::class, 'batch_no', "{$batchType}-"), 'batch_type' => $batchType, 'branch_id' => $branchId,
            'description' => $description, 'control_total' => (string) Money::q2((string) $controlTotal), 'control_count' => $controlCount, 'created_by' => $user,
            'source' => $source, 'status' => 'DRAFT', 'created_at' => Ledger::utcnow()]);
        Ledger::audit($user, 'BATCH_CREATE', 'batch', $b->batch_no, "{$batchType} control {$b->control_total} / {$b->control_count}");

        return $b;
    }

    public static function get(string $batchNo): Batch
    {
        return Batch::with('entries')->where('batch_no', $batchNo)->first() ?? throw new BusinessRuleError("Unknown batch {$batchNo}");
    }

    private static function draft(Batch $b): void
    {
        if ($b->status !== 'DRAFT') {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("Batch {$b->batch_no} is {$b->status} – posted batches cannot be changed");
        }
    }

    private static function entries(Batch $b)
    {
        return BatchEntry::where('batch_id', $b->id)->orderBy('seq')->get();
    }

    public static function addEntry(string $batchNo, string $kind, string $entryDate, ?string $reference, string $user, array $payload): BatchEntry
    {
        $b = self::get($batchNo);
        self::draft($b);
        if (! in_array($kind, self::KINDS[$b->batch_type], true)) {
            $k = self::KINDS[$b->batch_type];
            sort($k);
            throw new BusinessRuleError("A {$b->batch_type} batch takes ".Payroll::pyList($k).", not {$kind}");
        }
        if (! $reference) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Each entry needs a reference');
        }
        $amt = self::entryAmount($kind, $payload);
        $seq = (int) BatchEntry::where('batch_id', $b->id)->max('seq') + 1;

        return BatchEntry::create(['batch_id' => $b->id, 'seq' => $seq, 'kind' => $kind, 'entry_date' => $entryDate, 'reference' => $reference,
            'amount' => (string) $amt, 'payload' => json_encode($payload)]);
    }

    public static function updateEntry(string $batchNo, int $seq, string $user, ?string $entryDate = null, ?string $reference = null, ?array $payload = null): BatchEntry
    {
        $b = self::get($batchNo);
        self::draft($b);
        $e = BatchEntry::where('batch_id', $b->id)->where('seq', $seq)->first() ?? throw new BusinessRuleError("Batch {$batchNo} has no entry {$seq}");
        if ($entryDate) {
            $e->entry_date = $entryDate;
        }
        if ($reference) {
            $e->reference = $reference;
        }
        if ($payload !== null) {
            $e->payload = json_encode($payload);
            $e->amount = (string) self::entryAmount($e->kind, $payload);
        }
        $e->save();

        return $e;
    }

    public static function deleteEntry(string $batchNo, int $seq, string $user): void
    {
        $b = self::get($batchNo);
        self::draft($b);
        $e = BatchEntry::where('batch_id', $b->id)->where('seq', $seq)->first() ?? throw new BusinessRuleError("Batch {$batchNo} has no entry {$seq}");
        $e->delete();
    }

    public static function deleteBatch(string $batchNo, string $user): void
    {
        $b = self::get($batchNo);
        self::draft($b);
        Ledger::audit($user, 'BATCH_DELETE', 'batch', $b->batch_no, self::entries($b)->count().' entries');
        BatchEntry::where('batch_id', $b->id)->delete();
        $b->delete();
    }

    public static function totals(Batch $b): array
    {
        $es = self::entries($b);
        $t = Money::q2(Money::sum($es->pluck('amount')->all()));
        $diff = Money::q2(Money::d($b->control_total)->minus($t));

        return ['control_total' => Money::q2($b->control_total), 'entered_total' => $t, 'total_difference' => $diff, 'control_count' => (int) $b->control_count,
            'entered_count' => $es->count(), 'count_difference' => (int) $b->control_count - $es->count(),
            'balanced' => $diff->isZero() && (int) $b->control_count === $es->count()];
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ posting
    /** A CASH, AP or BANK PAYMENT entry may carry "paid_by": <unit code> – head office pays for the branch (1195 both sides). */
    private static function dispatch(Batch $b, BatchEntry $e, string $user, ?string $approver): mixed
    {
        $payer = json_decode($e->payload, true)['paid_by'] ?? null;
        if ($payer && $e->kind === 'PAYMENT' && in_array($b->batch_type, ['CASH', 'AP', 'BANK'], true)) {
            $unit = Branch::where('code', $payer)->first() ?? throw new BusinessRuleError("Unknown paying unit {$payer}");

            return Ledger::paidBy($unit->id, fn () => self::dispatchEntry($b, $e, $user, $approver));
        }

        return self::dispatchEntry($b, $e, $user, $approver);
    }

    private static function dispatchEntry(Batch $b, BatchEntry $e, string $user, ?string $approver): mixed
    {
        $p = json_decode($e->payload, true);
        [$k, $on, $ref, $br] = [$e->kind, substr((string) $e->entry_date, 0, 10), $e->reference, (int) $b->branch_id];
        if ($b->batch_type === 'GL') {
            $lines = array_map(fn ($l) => [(int) $l['account'], self::n($l['debit'] ?? 0), self::n($l['credit'] ?? 0), $l['party'] ?? null, $l['memo'] ?? null], $p['lines']);

            return Ledger::post($br, $on, 'MANUAL', $ref, $lines, $user, $p['memo'] ?? null, $approver);
        }
        if ($b->batch_type === 'PETTY') {
            if ($k === 'VOUCHER') {
                [$k, $p] = ['PAYMENT', ['channel' => 'Petty cash'] + $p];
                $p['channel'] = 'Petty cash';
            } elseif ($k === 'RECEIPT') {
                $p['channel'] = 'Petty cash';
            } elseif ($k === 'TOPUP') {
                if (($p['from_channel'] ?? null) === 'Petty cash') {
                    throw new BusinessRuleError('Top up petty cash from Bank, MoMo or Cash');
                }
                [$k, $p['to_channel']] = ['TRANSFER', 'Petty cash'];
            } elseif ($k === 'BANKING') {
                if (! in_array($p['to_channel'] ?? null, self::BANK_CHANNELS, true)) {
                    throw new BusinessRuleError('Bank surplus petty cash into Bank or MoMo');
                }
                [$k, $p['from_channel']] = ['TRANSFER', 'Petty cash'];
            }
            $out = self::cashEntry($k, $p, $on, $ref, $br, $user, $approver);
            PettyCash::checkAfterPosting($br, $on, $e->kind);

            return $out;
        }
        if ($b->batch_type === 'BANK') {
            foreach (['channel', 'from_channel', 'to_channel'] as $f) {
                if (isset($p[$f]) && ! in_array($p[$f], self::BANK_CHANNELS, true) && ! ($k === 'TRANSFER' && in_array($p[$f], ['Petty cash', 'Cash'], true))) {
                    throw new BusinessRuleError("Bank batches use Bank, Bank FX or MoMo ({$p[$f]} given) – use a PETTY or CASH batch");
                }
            }
            if (in_array($k, ['CHARGES', 'INTEREST'], true)) {
                [$ch, $amt] = [self::channel($p['channel']), Money::q2(self::n($p['amount']))];
                $lines = $k === 'CHARGES' ? [[6330, $amt, '0'], [(int) $ch->account, '0', $amt]] : [[(int) $ch->account, $amt, '0'], [7010, '0', $amt]];

                return Ledger::post($br, $on, 'BANKBOOK', $ref, $lines, $user, ($p['memo'] ?? null) ?: ucfirst(strtolower($k)), $approver);
            }

            return self::cashEntry($k, $p, $on, $ref, $br, $user, $approver);
        }
        if ($b->batch_type === 'CASH') {
            return self::cashEntry($k, $p, $on, $ref, $br, $user, $approver);
        }

        return self::otherEntry($b, $k, $p, $on, $ref, $br, $user, $approver);
    }

    private static function cashEntry(string $k, array $p, string $on, string $ref, int $br, string $user, ?string $approver): mixed
    {
        if ($k === 'RECEIPT' && ! in_array($p['tax_code'] ?? null, [null, '', 'OS'], true)) {
            // taxable sundry income: invoiced to SUNDRY and settled at once, so output tax and the VAT return stay right
            $sp = Tax::splitInclusive(self::n($p['amount']), Tax::ratesFor($p['tax_code'], $on));
            $inv = Ar::createInvoice($br, 'SUNDRY', $on, [['account_code' => (int) $p['account'], 'description' => ($p['memo'] ?? null) ?: $ref, 'net' => (string) $sp['base'],
                'tax_code' => $p['tax_code']]], $user, 'INVOICE', null, null, $on);

            return Periodend::customerReceipt($br, 'SUNDRY', $on, $inv->gross, $p['channel'], $ref, $user, 0, null, 0, null, null,
                [['invoice_no' => $inv->invoice_no, 'amount' => $inv->gross]]);
        }
        if ($k === 'RECEIPT') {
            [$ch, $acct] = [self::channel($p['channel']), Account::find((int) $p['account'])];
            if ($acct === null || $acct->control !== 'Manual allowed' || in_array((int) $acct->code, self::CASH_ACCOUNTS, true)) {
                throw new BusinessRuleError("Account {$p['account']} cannot take a sundry receipt (use AR or the till for sales)");
            }
            $amt = Money::q2(self::n($p['amount']));

            return Ledger::post($br, $on, 'CASHBOOK', $ref, [[(int) $ch->account, $amt, '0'], [(int) $acct->code, '0', $amt, $p['party'] ?? null]], $user,
                $p['memo'] ?? null, $approver);
        }
        if ($k === 'PAYMENT') {
            return Payables::recordExpense($br, $on, $p['payee'], (int) $p['account_code'], self::n($p['net']), $p['tax_code'] ?? 'OS', (bool) ($p['supplier_charges_vat'] ?? false),
                $p['use'] ?? 'Shared', $p['channel'], $user, $p['wht_type'] ?? 'None', $p['payee_tin'] ?? null, $approver, 'Resident', $p['payee_location'] ?? null,
                null, null, ($p['invoice_no'] ?? null) ?: $ref, $p['invoice_date'] ?? null);
        }
        if ($k === 'TRANSFER') {
            [$a, $c] = [self::channel($p['from_channel']), self::channel($p['to_channel'])];
            if ((int) $a->account === (int) $c->account) {
                throw new BusinessRuleError('Choose two different cash or bank accounts');
            }
            $amt = Money::q2(self::n($p['amount']));

            return Ledger::post($br, $on, 'CASHBOOK', $ref, [[(int) $c->account, $amt, '0'], [(int) $a->account, '0', $amt]], $user,
                "{$p['from_channel']} to {$p['to_channel']}", $approver);
        }

        return null;
    }

    private static function otherEntry(Batch $b, string $k, array $p, string $on, string $ref, int $br, string $user, ?string $approver): mixed
    {
        if ($b->batch_type === 'AR') {
            if ($k === 'CLAIM_PAYMENT') {
                $c = Claims::get($p['payer'], $p['claim_no']);
                if ((int) $c->branch_id !== $br) {
                    throw new BusinessRuleError("Claim {$p['claim_no']} belongs to another branch");
                }

                return Claims::receivePayment($c, $on, self::n($p['amount']), $p['channel'] ?? 'Bank', $user, self::n($p['wht_withheld'] ?? 0), $p['wht_certificate_no'] ?? null,
                    self::n($p['whvat_withheld'] ?? 0), $p['whvat_certificate_no'] ?? null);
            }
            if (in_array($k, ['INVOICE', 'CREDIT_NOTE', 'DEBIT_NOTE'], true)) {
                return Ar::createInvoice($br, $p['payer'], $on, $p['lines'], $user, ['INVOICE' => 'INVOICE', 'CREDIT_NOTE' => 'CREDIT', 'DEBIT_NOTE' => 'DEBIT'][$k],
                    $p['credit_of'] ?? null, $approver, $p['due_date'] ?? null);
            }

            return Periodend::customerReceipt($br, $p['payer'], $on, self::n($p['amount']), $p['channel'], $ref, $user, self::n($p['wht_withheld'] ?? 0),
                $p['wht_certificate_no'] ?? null, self::n($p['whvat_withheld'] ?? 0), null, $p['whvat_certificate_no'] ?? null, $p['allocations'] ?? null);
        }
        if ($b->batch_type === 'AP') {
            if (in_array($k, ['INVOICE', 'CREDIT_NOTE', 'DEBIT_NOTE'], true)) {
                $inv = Ap::postInvoice($br, $p['supplier'], ($p['invoice_no'] ?? null) ?: $ref, ($p['invoice_date'] ?? null) ?: $on, $p['lines'], $user, $p['due_date'] ?? null,
                    $p['po_no'] ?? null, ['INVOICE' => 'INVOICE', 'CREDIT_NOTE' => 'CREDIT', 'DEBIT_NOTE' => 'DEBIT'][$k], $p['credit_of'] ?? null);
                if ($inv->status === 'HELD') {
                    throw new BusinessRuleError("Invoice {$inv->invoice_no} does not match its order ({$inv->hold_reason}) – enter it outside the batch to hold it, or correct it");
                }

                return $inv;
            }

            return Ap::payInvoices($br, $on, $p['channel'], $p['allocations'], $user, $approver, $p['certificate_no'] ?? null, $p['whvat_certificate_no'] ?? null);
        }
        if ($b->batch_type === 'INV') {
            return match ($k) {
                'RECEIPT' => Inventory::receiveGoods($br, $p['supplier'], ($p['invoice_no'] ?? null) ?: $ref, $on, array_map(fn ($l) => array_map(fn ($v) => is_float($v) || is_int($v) ? (string) $v : $v, $l), $p['lines']), $user, $approver),
                'COUNT' => (function () use ($p, $br, $approver) {
                    $c = StockCount::find((int) $p['count_id']);
                    if ($c === null || (int) $c->branch_id !== $br) {
                        throw new BusinessRuleError("Stock count {$p['count_id']} not found for this branch");
                    }
                    if ($c->counted_by === $approver) {
                        throw new BusinessRuleError('The person who counted cannot approve the count');
                    }

                    return Inventory::approveCount($c, (string) $approver);
                })(),
                'ADJUST' => Inventory::adjust($br, $on, $p['sku'], (string) ($p['batch_no'] ?? ''), $p['adj_type'], self::n($p['qty']), $user, $approver,
                    ($p['document_no'] ?? null) ?: $ref, $p['reason'] ?? ''),
                'TRANSFER' => Inventory::transfer($br, (Branch::where('code', $p['to_branch'])->first() ?? throw new BusinessRuleError("Unknown branch {$p['to_branch']}"))->id,
                    $p['sku'], self::n($p['qty']), $on, ($p['note_no'] ?? null) ?: $ref, $user, $approver, $p['batch_no'] ?? null),
                'RECEIPT_PO' => Purchasing::receive($p['po_no'], $on, $p['lines'], $user, ($p['delivery_note'] ?? null) ?: $ref),
                default => Purchasing::confirmService($p['po_no'], $on, $p['lines'], $user, ($p['reference'] ?? null) ?: $ref),
            };
        }
        throw new BusinessRuleError("Cannot post {$k} in a {$b->batch_type} batch");
    }

    private static function channel(?string $name)
    {
        $ch = Channel::find((string) $name);
        if ($ch === null || ! in_array((int) $ch->account, self::CASH_ACCOUNTS, true)) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("{$name} is not a cash or bank channel");
        }

        return $ch;
    }

    /** Posts every entry; raises on the first failure (caller rolls back). */
    private static function run(Batch $b, string $user, ?string $approver): array
    {
        $out = [];
        foreach (self::entries($b) as $e) {
            $before = (int) (Journal::max('id') ?? 0);
            try {
                self::dispatch($b, $e, $user, $approver);
            } catch (BusinessRuleError $err) {
                throw new BusinessRuleError("Entry {$e->seq} ({$e->reference}): ".$err->getMessage(), 0, $err);
            }
            $ids = Journal::where('id', '>', $before)->orderBy('id')->pluck('id')->all();
            Journal::whereIn('id', $ids)->update(['batch_id' => $b->id]);
            $out[] = ['seq' => (int) $e->seq, 'reference' => $e->reference, 'journals' => $ids];
        }

        return $out;
    }

    /**
     * Trial run: posts the entries in order inside a savepoint (each entry sees the ones before it, as when posting) and then
     * rolls everything back – shows which entries would fail, changes nothing.
     */
    public static function check(string $batchNo, string $user): array
    {
        $b = self::get($batchNo);
        self::draft($b);
        $errors = [];
        DB::beginTransaction();
        try {
            foreach (self::entries($b) as $e) {
                DB::beginTransaction();
                try {
                    self::dispatch($b, $e, $user, 'batch-check');
                    DB::commit();
                } catch (BusinessRuleError $err) {
                    DB::rollBack();
                    $errors[] = ['seq' => (int) $e->seq, 'reference' => $e->reference, 'error' => $err->getMessage()];
                }
            }
        } finally {
            DB::rollBack();
        }
        $t = self::totals($b);

        return ['batch' => $b->batch_no] + $t + ['errors' => $errors, 'ready' => $t['balanced'] && ! $errors];
    }

    /** Approver = someone other than whoever created the batch. All entries post, or none. */
    public static function postBatch(string $batchNo, string $user, ?string $approver): array
    {
        $b = self::get($batchNo);
        self::draft($b);
        if (! $approver || in_array($approver, [$user, $b->created_by], true)) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('A batch must be approved by someone other than the person who keyed it');
        }
        if (self::entries($b)->isEmpty()) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('The batch is empty');
        }
        $t = self::totals($b);
        if (! $t['balanced']) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("Batch does not agree to its controls: total difference {$t['total_difference']}, count difference {$t['count_difference']}");
        }
        $results = DB::transaction(fn () => self::run($b, $user, $approver));
        $b->update(['status' => 'POSTED', 'approved_by' => $approver, 'posted_at' => Ledger::utcnow()]);
        Ledger::audit($approver, 'BATCH_POST', 'batch', $b->batch_no, count($results)." entries, total {$t['entered_total']}");

        return ['batch' => $b->batch_no, 'posted' => count($results), 'entries' => $results];
    }

    public static function reverseBatch(string $batchNo, string $on, string $reason, string $user, ?string $approver): Batch
    {
        $b = self::get($batchNo);
        if ($b->status !== 'POSTED') {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Only posted batches can be reversed');
        }
        if (! in_array($b->batch_type, self::REVERSIBLE, true)) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Document batches are corrected with credit notes, returns or adjustments, not reversed');
        }
        if (! $approver || $approver === $user) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("Reversals need a second person's approval");
        }
        $rb = Batch::create(['batch_no' => Purchasing::nextNo(Batch::class, 'batch_no', "{$b->batch_type}-"), 'batch_type' => $b->batch_type, 'branch_id' => $b->branch_id,
            'description' => "Reversal of {$b->batch_no}: {$reason}", 'control_total' => $b->control_total, 'control_count' => $b->control_count, 'status' => 'POSTED',
            'created_by' => $user, 'approved_by' => $approver, 'posted_at' => Ledger::utcnow(), 'created_at' => Ledger::utcnow(), 'reversal_of_id' => $b->id, 'source' => 'REVERSAL']);
        foreach (Journal::where('batch_id', $b->id)->orderBy('id')->pluck('id') as $jid) {
            if (Journal::where('reversal_of_id', $jid)->exists()) {
                continue; // a head office twin already reversed with its branch journal
            }
            $before = (int) Journal::max('id');
            Ledger::reverse($jid, $on, $user, $reason);
            Journal::where('id', '>', $before)->update(['batch_id' => $rb->id, 'approved_by' => $approver]);
        }
        $b->update(['status' => 'REVERSED']);
        Ledger::audit($approver, 'BATCH_REVERSE', 'batch', $b->batch_no, "by {$rb->batch_no}: {$reason}");

        return $rb;
    }

    /** Batch listing for review and the audit file: header, controls, entries and (once posted) the journals. */
    public static function listing(string $batchNo): array
    {
        $b = self::get($batchNo);
        $journals = [];
        foreach (Journal::with('lines')->where('batch_id', $b->id)->orderBy('id')->get() as $j) {
            $journals[$j->id] = ['date' => $j->entry_date, 'source' => $j->source, 'reference' => $j->source_ref,
                'lines' => $j->lines->map(fn ($l) => ['account' => $l->account_code, 'debit' => $l->debit, 'credit' => $l->credit, 'party' => $l->party])->all()];
        }

        return ['batch_no' => $b->batch_no, 'type' => $b->batch_type, 'status' => $b->status, 'description' => $b->description, 'branch_id' => $b->branch_id,
            'created_by' => $b->created_by, 'approved_by' => $b->approved_by, 'posted_at' => $b->posted_at] + self::totals($b) + [
                'entries' => self::entries($b)->map(fn ($e) => ['seq' => (int) $e->seq, 'kind' => $e->kind, 'date' => $e->entry_date, 'reference' => $e->reference,
                    'amount' => $e->amount, 'payload' => json_decode($e->payload, true)])->all(), 'journals' => $journals];
    }

    public static function openBatches(?array $branchIds = null): array
    {
        $q = Batch::where('status', 'DRAFT')->orderBy('id');
        if ($branchIds) {
            $q->whereIn('branch_id', $branchIds);
        }

        return $q->get()->map(fn ($b) => ['batch_no' => $b->batch_no, 'type' => $b->batch_type, 'description' => $b->description, 'created_by' => $b->created_by]
            + self::totals($b))->all();
    }

    /** All batches filtered by created date, person, status, type and unit – the batch register. */
    public static function register(?string $start = null, ?string $end = null, ?string $user = null, ?string $status = null, ?string $batchType = null, ?array $branchIds = null): array
    {
        $q = Batch::orderBy('id');
        if ($start) {
            $q->where('created_at', '>=', "{$start} 00:00:00");
        }
        if ($end) {
            $q->where('created_at', '<=', "{$end} 23:59:59");
        }
        if ($user) {
            $q->where(fn ($w) => $w->where('created_by', $user)->orWhere('approved_by', $user));
        }
        if ($status) {
            $q->where('status', $status);
        }
        if ($batchType) {
            $q->where('batch_type', $batchType);
        }
        if ($branchIds) {
            $q->whereIn('branch_id', $branchIds);
        }

        return $q->get()->map(fn ($b) => ['batch_no' => $b->batch_no, 'type' => $b->batch_type, 'status' => $b->status, 'description' => $b->description,
            'created_by' => $b->created_by, 'created_at' => $b->created_at, 'approved_by' => $b->approved_by, 'posted_at' => $b->posted_at, 'source' => $b->source,
            'entries' => self::entries($b)->count(), 'total' => self::totals($b)['entered_total']])->all();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ CSV import and recurring journals
    /** Columns: date, reference, account, debit, credit, party, memo. Lines sharing a reference form one journal. */
    public static function importGlCsv(string $batchNo, string $text, string $user): int
    {
        $b = self::get($batchNo);
        self::draft($b);
        if ($b->batch_type !== 'GL') {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('CSV journal import goes into a GL batch');
        }
        $lines = preg_split('/\r\n|\n|\r/', trim(preg_replace('/^\xEF\xBB\xBF/', '', $text)));
        $head = array_map('trim', str_getcsv(array_shift($lines), ',', '"', ''));
        $need = ['account', 'credit', 'date', 'debit', 'reference'];
        if (! $lines || array_diff($need, $head)) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("CSV needs the columns ['account', 'credit', 'date', 'debit', 'reference'] (plus optional party, memo)");
        }
        $groups = [];
        foreach ($lines as $i => $ln) {
            $n = $i + 2;
            $r = array_combine($head, array_pad(str_getcsv($ln, ',', '"', ''), count($head), ''));
            $d = trim($r['date']);
            if (! Admin::isDate($d) || ! ctype_digit(trim($r['account'])) || ! is_numeric($r['debit'] ?: '0') || ! is_numeric($r['credit'] ?: '0')) {
                throw new BusinessRuleError("CSV row {$n}: invalid date, account or amount");
            }
            $line = ['account' => (int) $r['account'], 'debit' => (string) Money::d($r['debit'] ?: '0'), 'credit' => (string) Money::d($r['credit'] ?: '0'),
                'party' => ($r['party'] ?? '') ?: null, 'memo' => ($r['memo'] ?? '') ?: null];
            $ref = trim($r['reference']);
            $groups[$ref] ??= ['date' => $d, 'lines' => []];
            if ($groups[$ref]['date'] !== $d) {
                throw new BusinessRuleError("CSV row {$n}: all lines of {$r['reference']} must have the same date");
            }
            $groups[$ref]['lines'][] = $line;
        }
        foreach ($groups as $ref => $g) {
            self::addEntry($batchNo, 'JOURNAL', $g['date'], (string) $ref, $user, ['lines' => $g['lines'], 'memo' => "CSV import {$ref}"]);
        }
        Ledger::audit($user, 'BATCH_IMPORT', 'batch', $batchNo, count($groups).' journals from CSV');

        return count($groups);
    }

    /** A monthly journal template (rent, loan interest, service contracts). Approved once; each month still goes through a GL batch. */
    public static function createRecurring(string $name, int $branchId, array $lines, string $startMonth, string $user, ?string $approver, ?string $endMonth = null): RecurringJournal
    {
        if (! $approver || $approver === $user) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("Recurring journals need a second person's approval");
        }
        $dr = Money::sum(array_map(fn ($l) => self::n($l['debit'] ?? 0), $lines));
        $cr = Money::sum(array_map(fn ($l) => self::n($l['credit'] ?? 0), $lines));
        if (! $lines || ! Money::q2($dr)->isEqualTo(Money::q2($cr)) || ! $dr->isPositive()) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('The template must balance');
        }
        foreach ($lines as $l) {
            $acct = Account::find((int) $l['account']);
            if ($acct === null || $acct->control !== 'Manual allowed') {
                throw new BusinessRuleError("Account {$l['account']} cannot be used in a manual journal");
            }
        }
        $r = RecurringJournal::create(['name' => $name, 'branch_id' => $branchId, 'lines' => json_encode($lines), 'start_month' => substr($startMonth, 0, 7).'-01',
            'end_month' => $endMonth, 'created_by' => $user, 'approved_by' => $approver, 'active' => true]);
        Ledger::audit($user, 'RECURRING_CREATE', 'recurring_journal', $name, "approved {$approver}");

        return $r;
    }

    /** One DRAFT GL batch per unit with every template due for the month (not yet generated). Returns batch numbers. */
    public static function generateRecurring(string $periodEnd, string $user): array
    {
        $period = substr($periodEnd, 0, 7);
        $made = [];
        foreach (RecurringJournal::where('active', true)->where('start_month', '<=', $periodEnd)->orderBy('id')->get() as $r) {
            if (($r->end_month && $r->end_month < "{$period}-01") || $r->last_generated === $period) {
                continue;
            }
            $made[$r->branch_id] ??= self::createBatch('GL', $r->branch_id, "Recurring journals {$period}", 0, 1, $user, "RECURRING {$period}");
            self::addEntry($made[$r->branch_id]->batch_no, 'JOURNAL', Reports::monthEnd($periodEnd), mb_substr("{$r->name}-{$period}", 0, 60), $user,
                ['lines' => json_decode($r->lines, true), 'memo' => "Recurring: {$r->name}"]);
            $r->update(['last_generated' => $period]);
        }
        foreach ($made as $b) {
            $t = self::totals($b);
            $b->update(['control_total' => (string) $t['entered_total'], 'control_count' => $t['entered_count']]);
        }

        return array_values(array_map(fn ($b) => $b->batch_no, $made));
    }
}
