<?php

namespace App\Domain;

use App\Models\BankStatementLine;
use App\Models\Branch;
use App\Models\CashUp;
use App\Models\Claim;
use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\Sale;
use App\Models\StockLot;
use App\Models\StockMove;
use Brick\Math\BigDecimal;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

/** Exception alerts, the VAT-registration threshold monitor and the controlled-drug register, computed from the books on demand. Port of services/controls.py. */
final class Controls
{
    public static function alerts(string $start, string $end, ?array $branchIds = null, ?string $today = null): array
    {
        $today ??= $end;
        $out = [];
        $add = function ($sev, $kind, $branch, $detail, $ref = null) use (&$out) {
            $out[] = ['severity' => $sev, 'type' => $kind, 'branch' => $branch, 'detail' => $detail, 'reference' => $ref];
        };
        $codes = Branch::orderBy('id')->get()->filter(fn ($b) => ! $branchIds || in_array($b->id, $branchIds, true))->pluck('code', 'id')->all();
        $ids = array_keys($codes);
        $discPct = Money::d(Ledger::setting('discount_alert_pct', '0.10'));
        foreach (Sale::with(['lines.product', 'payer'])->where('sale_date', '>=', $start)->where('sale_date', '<=', $end)->whereIn('branch_id', $ids)
            ->whereNull('original_sale_id')->orderBy('id')->get() as $sale) {
            foreach ($sale->lines as $l) {
                $disc = Money::d($l->discount);
                $list = Money::d($l->gross)->plus($disc);
                if (! $disc->isZero() && ! $list->isZero() && Money::pdiv($disc, $list)->isGreaterThan($discPct)) {
                    $add('Medium', 'Large discount', $codes[$sale->branch_id], "{$l->product->sku} discount ".Money::q2($disc).' ('
                        .Money::q2(Money::pdiv($disc, $list)->multipliedBy(100))."%) approved by {$sale->approved_by}", $sale->receipt_no);
                }
                if (Money::d($l->net_revenue)->isLessThan(Money::d($l->cost))) {
                    $add('Medium', 'Sold below cost', $codes[$sale->branch_id], "{$l->product->sku} net {$l->net_revenue} vs cost {$l->cost}", $sale->receipt_no);
                }
                if ($l->unit_price && $sale->approved_by && ! Money::eq($l->unit_price, $l->product->retail_price) && $sale->payer->payer_type === 'Retail') {
                    $add('Low', 'Price override', $codes[$sale->branch_id], "{$l->product->sku} at {$l->unit_price} (list {$l->product->retail_price})", $sale->receipt_no);
                }
            }
        }
        $lim = Money::d(Ledger::setting('adjustment_alert_value', '500'));
        $moves = StockMove::join('stock_lot', 'stock_lot.id', '=', 'stock_move.lot_id')->where('stock_move.move_date', '>=', $start)->where('stock_move.move_date', '<=', $end)
            ->whereIn('stock_lot.branch_id', $ids)->whereIn('stock_move.kind', ['COUNT_SHORTAGE', 'COUNT_SURPLUS', 'DAMAGE_WRITE-OFF', 'EXPIRY_WRITE-OFF', 'QUARANTINE_WRITE-OFF'])
            ->orderBy('stock_move.id')->select('stock_move.*', 'stock_lot.branch_id AS lot_branch', 'stock_lot.batch_no AS lot_batch', 'stock_lot.product_id AS lot_product')->get();
        foreach ($moves as $m) {
            if (Money::d($m->value)->abs()->isGreaterThan($lim)) {
                $add('High', 'Large stock adjustment', $codes[$m->lot_branch], "{$m->kind} ".Product::find($m->lot_product)->sku." batch {$m->lot_batch}: ".Money::q2($m->value), $m->ref);
            }
        }
        $yesterday = date('Y-m-d', strtotime("{$today} -1 day"));
        foreach ($codes as $bid => $code) {
            $branch = Branch::find($bid);
            if (! $branch->is_head_office) {
                foreach (Inventory::valuation($bid, $end) as $r) {
                    if ($r['alert'] === 'EXPIRED') {
                        $add('High', 'Expired stock in saleable stock', $code, "{$r['sku']} batch {$r['batch']} expired {$r['expiry']}: quarantine it");
                    } elseif ($r['alert'] === 'NEAR EXPIRY') {
                        $add('Low', 'Near expiry', $code, "{$r['sku']} batch {$r['batch']} expires {$r['expiry']} ({$r['saleable']} units)");
                    }
                }
                foreach (Branches::reorderProducts($bid) as $p) {
                    $oh = Money::db(DB::table('stock_move')->join('stock_lot', 'stock_lot.id', '=', 'stock_move.lot_id')->where('stock_lot.branch_id', $bid)
                        ->where('stock_lot.product_id', $p->id)->where('stock_move.bucket', 'SALEABLE')->where('stock_move.move_date', '<=', $end)
                        ->selectRaw('COALESCE(SUM(stock_move.qty), 0) AS v')->value('v') ?? '0');
                    $rl = Branches::reorderLevel($bid, $p);
                    if ($oh->isLessThanOrEqualTo($rl)) {
                        $add('Low', 'Reorder', $code, "{$p->sku} on hand {$oh} ≤ reorder level {$rl}");
                    }
                }
            }
            foreach (CashBook::missingCashups($bid, $start, min($end, $yesterday)) as $m) {
                $add('High', 'Cash-up missing', $code, "Till {$m['till']} on {$m['date']}");
            }
            $tol = Money::d(Ledger::setting('cashup_tolerance', '5'));
            foreach (CashUp::where('branch_id', $bid)->where('cash_date', '>=', $start)->where('cash_date', '<=', $end)->where('status', 'APPROVED')->orderBy('id')->get() as $c) {
                if (Money::d($c->variance)->abs()->isGreaterThan($tol)) {
                    $add('High', 'Cash-up variance', $code, "Till {$c->till} on {$c->cash_date}: {$c->variance}");
                }
            }
            foreach (BankStatementLine::where('branch_id', $bid)->whereNull('matched_line_id')->where('line_date', '<=', date('Y-m-d', strtotime("{$today} -30 days")))
                ->orderBy('id')->get() as $st) {
                $add('Medium', 'Unreconciled statement item', $code, "{$st->account_code} {$st->line_date} {$st->description} {$st->amount}");
            }
        }
        foreach (Claim::with('payer')->where('status', 'Pending')->whereIn('branch_id', $ids)->orderBy('id')->get() as $c) {
            $first = Sale::where('claim_id', $c->id)->min('sale_date');
            $days = (int) ($c->payer->claim_deadline_days ?? 0);
            if ($first && $days && $today > date('Y-m-d', strtotime(substr($first, 0, 10)." +{$days} days"))) {
                $add('High', 'Claim not submitted by the deadline', $codes[$c->branch_id], "{$c->payer->code} {$c->claim_no}: {$c->amount}", $c->claim_no);
            }
        }
        $prev = Reports::addMonths(substr($today, 0, 7).'-01', -1);
        foreach (Schedules::calendar((int) substr($prev, 0, 4), (int) substr($prev, 5, 2), $today) as $r) {
            if (str_contains($r['status'], 'OVERDUE')) {
                $add('High', 'Statutory filing overdue', 'ALL', "{$r['tax']} {$r['period']} due {$r['due']}: {$r['status']}");
            }
        }
        if ((int) substr($today, 5, 2) <= 5) {
            $st = Schedules::annualReturnStatus((int) substr($today, 0, 4) - 1, $today);
            if (in_array($st['status'], ['OVERDUE', 'Due within 30 days', 'Due by 30 April'], true)) {
                $add($st['status'] === 'OVERDUE' ? 'High' : 'Medium', 'Annual PAYE return', 'ALL', "{$st['tax']} {$st['year']} due {$st['due']}: {$st['status']}");
            }
        }
        [$y, $m] = [(int) substr($end, 0, 4), (int) substr($end, 5, 2)];
        $gaps = ['WHT return' => Schedules::wht($y, $m)['exceptions'], 'WHVAT return' => Schedules::whvat($y, $m)['exceptions'],
            'PAYE return' => Schedules::paye($y, $m)['exceptions'], 'SSNIT Tier 1' => PayrollReports::tier1($y, $m)['exceptions'],
            'Tier 2' => PayrollReports::tier2($y, $m)['exceptions'], 'Bank advice' => PayrollReports::bankAdvice($y, $m)['exceptions']];
        foreach ($gaps as $kind => $items) {
            foreach ($items as $e) {
                $add('Medium', "Return data missing – {$kind}", 'ALL', $e);
            }
        }
        if (Ledger::setting('whvat_agent', 'No') === 'Yes') {
            $rows = DB::table('supplier_payment')->join('supplier', 'supplier_payment.supplier_id', '=', 'supplier.id')->where('supplier_payment.pay_date', '>=', $start)
                ->where('supplier_payment.pay_date', '<=', $end)->where('supplier.vat_registered', true)->where('supplier_payment.whvat_amount', 0)
                ->orderBy('supplier_payment.id')->select('supplier_payment.*', 'supplier.name AS sup_name')->get();
            foreach ($rows as $p) {
                $add('Medium', 'Withholding VAT not applied', $codes[$p->branch_id] ?? '?', "{$p->sup_name} paid ".Money::q2(Money::db($p->gross))." on {$p->pay_date}: check for standard-rated supplies");
            }
        }
        $v = self::vatThresholdMonitor($today);
        if ($v['alert']) {
            $add($v['over'] ? 'High' : 'Medium', 'VAT registration threshold', 'ALL', $v['message']);
        }
        $order = ['High' => 0, 'Medium' => 1, 'Low' => 2];
        usort($out, fn ($a, $b) => $order[$a['severity']] <=> $order[$b['severity']] ?: strcmp($a['type'], $b['type']));

        return $out;
    }

    /** While not VAT-registered: taxable supplies (standard and zero-rated) over the last 12 months against the Act 1151 threshold. */
    public static function vatThresholdMonitor(string $today): array
    {
        $threshold = Money::d(Ledger::setting('vat_threshold', '750000'));
        $start = Reports::addMonths(substr($today, 0, 7).'-01', -11);
        $total = Money::db(DB::table('sale_line')->join('sale', 'sale_line.sale_id', '=', 'sale.id')->join('product', 'sale_line.product_id', '=', 'product.id')
            ->where('sale.sale_date', '>=', $start)->where('sale.sale_date', '<=', $today)->whereIn('product.tax_code', ['SR20', 'ZR'])
            ->selectRaw('COALESCE(SUM(sale_line.gross), 0) AS v')->value('v') ?? '0');
        foreach (Reports::arSupplies($start, $today) as $code => [, $g]) {
            if (in_array($code, ['SR20', 'ZR'], true)) {
                $total = $total->plus($g);
            }
        }
        $registered = Ledger::setting('vat_registered', 'Yes') === 'Yes';
        $share = $threshold->isZero() ? BigDecimal::zero() : Money::pdiv($total, $threshold);
        $over = ! $registered && $total->isGreaterThanOrEqualTo($threshold);
        $alert = ! $registered && $share->isGreaterThanOrEqualTo('0.8');
        $msg = "Taxable supplies in the 12 months to {$today}: ".Money::q2($total).' = '.Money::q2($share->multipliedBy(100)).'% of the GHS '
            .number_format($threshold->toFloat(), 0).' threshold. '
            .($over ? 'Apply to GRA for VAT registration now and confirm the effective date.' : 'Prepare for VAT registration (E-VAT, pricing, input tax).');

        return ['registered' => $registered, 'taxable_supplies_12m' => Money::q2($total), 'threshold' => $threshold, 'share' => Money::q2($share->multipliedBy(100)),
            'over' => $over, 'alert' => $alert, 'message' => $msg];
    }

    /** Running register of every controlled-drug movement (receipts, sales with prescription and dispenser, returns, adjustments, transfers). */
    public static function controlledDrugRegister(int $branchId, string $start, string $end, ?string $sku = null): array
    {
        $q = Product::where('controlled', true)->orderBy('id');
        if ($sku) {
            $q->where('sku', $sku);
        }
        $out = [];
        foreach ($q->get() as $p) {
            $lots = StockLot::where('branch_id', $branchId)->where('product_id', $p->id)->pluck('id')->all();
            if (! $lots) {
                continue;
            }
            $bal = Money::sum(StockMove::whereIn('lot_id', $lots)->where('move_date', '<', $start)->pluck('qty')->all());
            $rows = [['date' => $start, 'reference' => 'Opening balance', 'movement' => '', 'quantity_in' => null, 'quantity_out' => null, 'balance' => $bal]];
            foreach (StockMove::whereIn('lot_id', $lots)->where('move_date', '>=', $start)->where('move_date', '<=', $end)->where('bucket', 'SALEABLE')
                ->orderBy('move_date')->orderBy('id')->get() as $m) {
                $qty = Money::d($m->qty);
                $bal = $bal->plus($qty);
                $row = ['date' => $m->move_date, 'reference' => $m->ref, 'movement' => $m->kind, 'batch' => StockLot::find($m->lot_id)->batch_no,
                    'quantity_in' => $qty->isPositive() ? $qty : null, 'quantity_out' => $qty->isNegative() ? $qty->negated() : null, 'balance' => $bal];
                if (in_array($m->kind, ['SALE', 'RETURN'], true)) {
                    $sale = Sale::where('branch_id', $branchId)->where('receipt_no', $m->ref)->first();
                    if ($sale) {
                        $row += ['prescription_ref' => $sale->prescription_ref, 'prescriber' => $sale->prescriber, 'dispensed_by' => $sale->dispensed_by,
                            'patient_ref' => $sale->member_ref];
                    }
                }
                $rows[] = $row;
            }
            $out[] = ['sku' => $p->sku, 'product' => $p->name, 'closing_balance' => $bal, 'entries' => $rows];
        }

        return $out;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Domain;

use App\Models\WhtType;
use Brick\Math\BigDecimal;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Spreadsheet;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Style\Alignment;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Style\Border;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Style\Fill;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Worksheet\PageSetup;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Worksheet\Worksheet;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Writer\Xlsx as XlsxWriter;

/**
 * GRA returns in the layout of the official forms: DT 0110 WHT return (and the "DT-110 Excel calculation helper" upload CSV),
 * the WHVAT return for appointed agents, and DT 0108B with the DT 0108A working schedule. The software prepares; the return
 * is filed on the GRA portal. The forms are re-drawn, so check them against gra.gov.gh each filing season. Port of services/gra_forms.py.
 */
final class GraForms
{
    public const WHT_HEADERS = ['RESIDENT STATUS', 'TIN', 'NAME OF TAXPAYER', 'LOCATION OF BUSINESS', 'CONTRACT AMOUNT', 'GROSS AMOUNT OF PAYMENT', 'WHT TYPE',
        'TAX RATE', 'TAX WITHHELD'];

    public const WHVAT_HEADERS = ['S/NO (A)', 'NAME OF TAXPAYER (WITHHOLDEE) (B)', 'TIN (C)', 'INVOICE DATE (D)', 'INVOICE NUMBER (E)', 'PAYMENT DATE (F)',
        'TAXABLE OUTPUT VALUE PAID (G)', 'VAT WITHHELD (7% of (G)) (H)', 'WITHHOLDING VAT CREDIT CERTIFICATE NUMBER (I)'];

    private static function c(int $col, int $row): string
    {
        return Xlsx::col($col).$row;
    }

    private static function set(Worksheet $ws, int $row, int $col, mixed $v, bool $bold = false, bool $italic = false): void
    {
        $ref = self::c($col, $row);
        if ($v instanceof BigDecimal) {
            $ws->setCellValue($ref, $v->toFloat());
        } else {
            $ws->setCellValueExplicit($ref, $v, is_int($v) || is_float($v) ? 'n' : ($v === null ? 'null' : 's'));
        }
        if ($bold || $italic) {
            $ws->getStyle($ref)->getFont()->setBold($bold)->setItalic($italic);
        }
    }

    private static function title(Worksheet $ws, string $formTitle, int $width): void
    {
        foreach ([['GHANA REVENUE AUTHORITY', 14], ['DOMESTIC TAX REVENUE DIVISION', 12], [$formTitle, 12]] as $i => [$text, $size]) {
            $r = $i + 1;
            $ws->mergeCells(self::c(1, $r).':'.self::c($width, $r));
            $ws->setCellValue(self::c(1, $r), $text);
            $ws->getStyle(self::c(1, $r))->getFont()->setBold(true)->setSize($size);
            $ws->getStyle(self::c(1, $r))->getAlignment()->setHorizontal(Alignment::HORIZONTAL_CENTER);
        }
    }

    private static function headerBlock(Worksheet $ws, int $row, string $label, string $value): int
    {
        [$name, $tin] = [Ledger::setting('business_name', '') ?? '', Ledger::setting('business_tin', '') ?? ''];
        [$office, $kind] = [Ledger::setting('tax_office', '') ?? '', Ledger::setting('tax_office_type', 'STO') ?: 'STO'];
        self::set($ws, $row, 1, 'CURRENT TAX OFFICE', true);
        foreach (['LTO', 'MTO', 'STO'] as $i => $k) {
            self::set($ws, $row, 3 + $i, $k.' '.($k === $kind ? '[X]' : '[ ]'));
        }
        self::set($ws, $row, 6, 'Name of Tax Office: '.($office ?: '________'));
        self::set($ws, $row + 1, 1, $label, true);
        self::set($ws, $row + 1, 3, $value);
        self::set($ws, $row + 2, 1, 'NAME', true);
        self::set($ws, $row + 2, 3, $name ?: 'SET Settings business_name');
        self::set($ws, $row + 3, 1, 'TIN', true);
        self::set($ws, $row + 3, 3, $tin ?: 'SET Settings business_tin');
        self::set($ws, $row + 4, 1, 'CURRENCY IN GHS', false, true);

        return $row + 6;
    }

    private static function box(Worksheet $ws, string $ref): void
    {
        $ws->getStyle($ref)->getBorders()->getAllBorders()->setBorderStyle(Border::BORDER_THIN);
    }

    private static function table(Worksheet $ws, int $row, array $headers, array $rows, array $moneyCols = [], array $widths = []): int
    {
        foreach ($headers as $i => $h) {
            $col = $i + 1;
            $ref = self::c($col, $row);
            $ws->setCellValue($ref, $h);
            $st = $ws->getStyle($ref);
            $st->getFont()->setBold(true);
            $st->getFill()->setFillType(Fill::FILL_SOLID)->getStartColor()->setRGB('D9D9D9');
            $st->getAlignment()->setWrapText(true)->setVertical(Alignment::VERTICAL_CENTER)->setHorizontal(Alignment::HORIZONTAL_CENTER);
            self::box($ws, $ref);
            $ws->getColumnDimension(Xlsx::col($col))->setWidth($widths[$col] ?? max(12, min(30, mb_strlen($h) + 2)));
        }
        $ws->getRowDimension($row)->setRowHeight(46);
        $r = $row;
        foreach ($rows as $vals) {
            $r++;
            foreach (array_values($vals) as $i => $v) {
                $col = $i + 1;
                $ref = self::c($col, $r);
                if (is_string($v) && preg_match('/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/', $v)) {
                    $ws->setCellValue($ref, \PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Shared\Date::stringToExcel($v));
                    $ws->getStyle($ref)->getNumberFormat()->setFormatCode('dd/mm/yyyy');
                } else {
                    self::set($ws, $r, $col, $v);
                    if (in_array($col, $moneyCols, true)) {
                        $ws->getStyle($ref)->getNumberFormat()->setFormatCode('#,##0.00');
                    }
                }
                self::box($ws, $ref);
            }
        }

        return $r + 1;
    }

    private static function declaration(Worksheet $ws, int $row, int $width, bool $contact = false): void
    {
        $ws->mergeCells(self::c(1, $row).':'.self::c($width, $row));
        self::set($ws, $row, 1, 'DECLARATION', true);
        $ws->getStyle(self::c(1, $row))->getAlignment()->setHorizontal(Alignment::HORIZONTAL_CENTER);
        $ws->mergeCells(self::c(1, $row + 1).':'.self::c($width, $row + 1));
        self::set($ws, $row + 1, 1, 'I, ____________________________ (Name of Declarant) hereby declare that the information provided on this '
            .'return is true, correct and complete.');
        $ws->getStyle(self::c(1, $row + 1))->getAlignment()->setWrapText(true);
        $ws->getRowDimension($row + 1)->setRowHeight(30);
        self::set($ws, $row + 3, 1, 'Designation / Position: ______________');
        self::set($ws, $row + 3, 5, $contact ? 'Contact Number: ______________' : 'Signature: ______________');
        self::set($ws, $row + 4, 1, $contact ? 'Signature: ______________' : '');
        self::set($ws, $row + 4, 5, 'Date: ______________');
        self::set($ws, $row + 6, 1, 'For official use only – Vetted by: ______________   Date: ________', false, true);
    }

    private static function exceptions(Worksheet $ws, int $row, array $items, array $ties): void
    {
        self::set($ws, $row, 1, "Preparer's checks (not part of the return)", true);
        $r = $row;
        foreach ($ties as $label => $t) {
            self::set($ws, ++$r, 1, "{$label}: schedule {$t['schedule']} / ledger {$t['gl']} – ".($t['ok'] ? 'OK' : 'DIFFERENCE'));
        }
        foreach ($items ?: ['No exceptions'] as $e) {
            self::set($ws, ++$r, 1, $e);
        }
    }

    private static function save(Spreadsheet $wb): string
    {
        foreach ($wb->getWorksheetIterator() as $ws) { // landscape, one page wide
            $ws->getPageSetup()->setOrientation(PageSetup::ORIENTATION_LANDSCAPE)->setPaperSize(PageSetup::PAPERSIZE_A4)->setFitToWidth(1)->setFitToHeight(0);
        }
        $wb->setActiveSheetIndex(0);
        ob_start();
        (new XlsxWriter($wb))->save('php://output');

        return (string) ob_get_clean();
    }

    /** Python's rate display: 5 for 0.05, 7.5 for 0.075. */
    public static function ratePct(mixed $r): int|float
    {
        $v = Money::d($r)->multipliedBy(100)->stripTrailingZeros();

        return $v->getScale() === 0 ? $v->toInt() : $v->toFloat();
    }

    private static function newBook(string $title): array
    {
        $wb = new Spreadsheet;
        $ws = $wb->getActiveSheet();
        $ws->setTitle($title);

        return [$wb, $ws];
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ DT 0110
    public static function dt0110Xlsx(int $y, int $m): string
    {
        $sch = Schedules::wht($y, $m);
        [$wb, $ws] = self::newBook('wht');
        $w = count(self::WHT_HEADERS);
        self::title($ws, 'WITHHOLDING TAX (WHT) RETURN', $w);
        $row = self::headerBlock($ws, 5, 'PERIOD (mm/yyyy)', sprintf('%02d/%d', $m, $y));
        $data = array_map(fn ($r) => [$r['resident_status'], $r['tin'] ?? '', $r['payee'], $r['location'] ?? '', $r['contract_amount'], $r['base'], $r['gra_code'] ?? '',
            $r['rate_pct']->toFloat(), $r['wht']], $sch['rows']);
        $row = self::table($ws, $row, self::WHT_HEADERS, $data, [5, 6, 9], [1 => 16, 2 => 22, 3 => 30, 4 => 28, 5 => 14, 6 => 16, 7 => 14, 8 => 10, 9 => 14]);
        self::set($ws, $row, 4, 'Total', true);
        self::set($ws, $row, 9, $sch['total_wht'], true);
        $ws->getStyle(self::c(9, $row))->getNumberFormat()->setFormatCode('#,##0.00');
        self::box($ws, self::c(9, $row));
        self::declaration($ws, $row + 2, $w);
        self::exceptions($ws, $row + 11, $sch['exceptions'], $sch['ties']);
        $codes = $wb->createSheet();
        $codes->setTitle('WHT_codes');
        $hdr = ['RESIDENCY', 'Final / On Acct', 'WHT TAX Code', 'Rate %', 'DESCRIPTION', 'Name in this system'];
        foreach ($hdr as $i => $h) {
            self::set($codes, 1, $i + 1, $h, true);
            $codes->getStyle(self::c($i + 1, 1))->getFill()->setFillType(Fill::FILL_SOLID)->getStartColor()->setRGB('D9D9D9');
        }
        $r = 1;
        foreach (WhtType::whereNotNull('gra_code')->orderBy('residency')->orderBy('gra_code')->get() as $t) {
            $r++;
            foreach ([$t->residency, $t->final ? 'Final' : 'On Account', $t->gra_code, self::ratePct($t->rate), $t->description, $t->name] as $i => $v) {
                self::set($codes, $r, $i + 1, $v);
            }
        }
        foreach (['A' => 16, 'B' => 14, 'C' => 16, 'D' => 8, 'E' => 70, 'F' => 26] as $col => $wd) {
            $codes->getColumnDimension($col)->setWidth($wd);
        }

        return self::save($wb);
    }

    private static function csvLine(array $vals): string
    {
        return implode(',', array_map(function ($v) {
            $v = (string) $v;

            return preg_match('/[",\r\n]/', $v) ? '"'.str_replace('"', '""', $v).'"' : $v;
        }, $vals))."\r\n";
    }

    /** GRA "DT-110 Excel calculation helper" layout (enum block, then TABLE DATA), Windows-1252 like GRA's file. */
    public static function whtCsv(int $y, int $m): string
    {
        $sch = Schedules::wht($y, $m);
        $tin = Ledger::setting('business_tin', '') ?? '';
        $types = WhtType::whereNotNull('gra_code')->orderBy('gra_code')->get();
        $out = self::csvLine(['ENUM VALUES', '', '', 'DT-110 EXCEL CALCULATION HELPER SHEET 2015', 'TIN', $tin, 'PERIOD (YYYY/MM)', sprintf('%d/%02d', $y, $m), '']);
        $out .= self::csvLine(['Resident Type', '', 'Withholding TaxType', 'Code Description', 'RATES', 'Legal Description', '', '', '']);
        $enums = [['NonResident', 'Non Resident'], ['NRPermanentEstb', 'NON RESIDENT WITH PERMANENT ESTABLISHMENT'], ['Resident', 'RESIDENT']];
        foreach ($types as $i => $t) {
            [$a, $b] = $enums[$i] ?? ['', ''];
            $out .= self::csvLine([$a, $b, $t->gra_code, $t->description, self::ratePct($t->rate), $t->description, '', '', '']);
        }
        $out .= self::csvLine(array_fill(0, 9, ''));
        $out .= self::csvLine(['TABLE DATA', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '']);
        $out .= self::csvLine(['Resident Type', 'TIN', 'Taxpayer Name', 'Location of business', 'Contract Sum', 'Gross Amount of Payment', 'Withholding TaxType', 'Rate',
            'Amount of Tax Withheld']);
        foreach ($sch['rows'] as $r) {
            $out .= self::csvLine([$r['resident_status'], $r['tin'] ?? '', $r['payee'], $r['location'] ?? '', (string) Money::q2($r['contract_amount']),
                (string) Money::q2($r['base']), $r['gra_code'] ?? '', (string) $r['rate_pct']->stripTrailingZeros(), (string) Money::q2($r['wht'])]);
        }

        return mb_convert_encoding($out, 'Windows-1252', 'UTF-8');
    }

    public static function whvatXlsx(int $y, int $m): string
    {

        [$wb, $ws] = self::newBook('whvat');
        $w = count(self::WHVAT_HEADERS);
        self::title($ws, 'WITHHOLDING VAT (WHVAT) RETURN', $w);

        self::set($ws, $row - 1, 1, 'If Return for the period is NIL tick here: '.($sch['nil'] ? '[X]' : '[ ]').' and proceed to the DECLARATION');
        $data = array_map(fn ($r) => [$r['serial'], $r['withholdee'], $r['tin'] ?? '', $r['invoice_date'], $r['invoice_no'] ?? '', $r['payment_date'],
            $r['taxable_value'], $r['vat_withheld'], $r['certificate'] ?? ''], $sch['rows']);
        $row = self::table($ws, $row, self::WHVAT_HEADERS, $data, [7, 8], [1 => 8, 2 => 32, 3 => 22, 4 => 13, 5 => 14, 6 => 13, 7 => 16, 8 => 16, 9 => 24]);
        self::set($ws, $row, 6, 'Total', true);
        foreach ([7 => $sch['total_taxable'], 8 => $sch['total_whvat']] as $col => $v) {
            self::set($ws, $row, $col, $v, true);
            $ws->getStyle(self::c($col, $row))->getNumberFormat()->setFormatCode('#,##0.00');
            self::box($ws, self::c($col, $row));

    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ DT 0108B and DT 0108A working schedule
    public static function dt0108Xlsx(int $year): string
    {
        $info = PayrollReports::annualEmployeeInformation($year);
        $ded = PayrollReports::annualPayeDeductions($year);
        [$wb, $ws] = self::newBook('DT0108B');
        self::title($ws, "ANNUAL EMPLOYEE'S INFORMATION SCHEDULE", 6);
        $row = self::headerBlock($ws, 5, 'YEAR OF ASSESSMENT', (string) $year);
        $data = array_map(fn ($r) => [$r['serial'], $r['name'], $r['tin'], $r['nationality'], $r['postal_address'], $r['residential_address']], $info['rows']);
        $row = self::table($ws, $row, ['Ser No', 'Name', 'TIN', 'Nationality', 'Address – Postal', 'Address – Residential'], $data, [],
            [1 => 8, 2 => 30, 3 => 20, 4 => 14, 5 => 30, 6 => 34]);
        self::set($ws, $row + 1, 1, 'Internal Use Only – Vetted By: ______________   Date: ________', false, true);
        self::exceptions($ws, $row + 3, $info['exceptions'], []);
        $ws2 = $wb->createSheet();
        $ws2->setTitle('DT0108A_working');
        self::title($ws2, "EMPLOYER'S ANNUAL PAYE TAX DEDUCTIONS – WORKING SCHEDULE (map to DT 0108A)", 13);
        $row = self::headerBlock($ws2, 5, 'YEAR OF ASSESSMENT', (string) $year);
        $hdr = ['Ser No', 'Staff ID', 'Name', 'TIN', 'Tax status', 'Months paid', 'Basic salary', 'Allowances', 'Overtime', 'Total emoluments', 'SSF employee',
            'Chargeable income', 'Total tax deducted'];
        $keys = ['basic', 'allowances', 'overtime', 'total_emoluments', 'ssf_employee', 'chargeable_income', 'total_tax'];
        $data = array_map(fn ($r) => array_merge([$r['serial'], $r['staff_id'], $r['name'], $r['tin'], $r['tax_status'], $r['months']],
            array_map(fn ($k) => $r[$k], $keys)), $ded['rows']);
        $row = self::table($ws2, $row, $hdr, $data, range(7, 13), [3 => 28, 4 => 20]);
        self::set($ws2, $row, 3, 'Total', true);
        foreach ($keys as $i => $k) {
            self::set($ws2, $row, 7 + $i, $ded['totals'][$k], true);
            $ws2->getStyle(self::c(7 + $i, $row))->getNumberFormat()->setFormatCode('#,##0.00');
        }
        $s = $ded['summary'];
        self::set($ws2, $row + 2, 1, "DT 0108 summary: {$s['number_of_employees']} employees; total emoluments {$s['total_emoluments']}; total tax deducted "
            ."{$s['total_tax_deducted']}. Due {$ded['due']}.");
        self::exceptions($ws2, $row + 4, $ded['exceptions'], $ded['checks']);

        return self::save($wb);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Domain;

use App\Models\Branch;
use App\Models\Disclosure;
use App\Models\Journal;
use Brick\Math\BigDecimal;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

/**
 * Complete general-purpose financial statements (v1.3) for the whole business, for head office alone or for any branch alone.
 * IFRS for SMEs: periods beginning before 1 January 2027 use the 2015 edition, later periods the third edition (2025).
 * The full set (Section 3.17): profit or loss and OCI; financial position (current / non-current) plus opening statements
 * where required (transition, Section 35.7) or available (go-live); changes in equity by component; cash flows (indirect)
 * with interest and tax flows and non-cash transactions; and every note always present – text the ledger cannot know comes
 * from Disclosure records and a missing one is listed as NOT YET COMPLETED in open_items, never dropped.
 * Ghana law: VAT/NHIL/GETFund (Act 1151), PAYE and WHT (Act 896), SSNIT (Act 766), withholding VAT, and for a company the
 * corporate income tax and the Growth and Sustainability Levy (Act 1095, as amended). Port of services/ifrs.py.
 */
final class Ifrs
{
    public const NON_CURRENT_ASSETS = ['Property, plant and equipment', 'Intangible assets', 'Deposits and other non-current assets', 'Deferred tax'];

    public const CURRENT_ASSETS = ['Inventories', 'Trade and other receivables', 'Prepayments and other current assets', 'Current tax assets', 'Cash and cash equivalents'];

    public const NON_CURRENT_LIABILITIES = ['Borrowings – non-current', 'Provisions – non-current', 'Deferred tax liability'];

    public const CURRENT_LIABILITIES = ['Trade and other payables', 'Tax payables', 'Employee-related payables', 'Provisions', 'Borrowings – current'];

    public const EQUITY_COMPONENTS = ["Owner's capital" => [3050, 3010], 'Drawings' => [3055, 3040], 'Retained earnings' => [3020, 3030], 'Revaluation reserve' => [3060]];

    public const PPE_CLASSES = ['Leasehold improvements and fit-out' => [1510], 'Furniture, shelving and fixtures' => [1520], 'Pharmacy equipment' => [1530],
        'Computers and POS hardware' => [1540], 'Motor vehicles' => [1550], 'Power backup' => [1560]];

    public const DISCLOSURE_KEYS = [
        'going_concern' => 'Going concern assessment (Section 3.8-3.9): at least 12 months from the reporting date',
        'judgements' => 'Significant judgements and key sources of estimation uncertainty (Section 8.6-8.7)',
        'events_after' => 'Events after the end of the reporting period (Section 32)',
        'contingencies' => 'Contingent liabilities and contingent assets (Section 21.15-21.16)',
        'capital_commitments' => 'Capital commitments not yet provided for',
        'lease_commitments' => 'Operating lease commitments: future minimum payments ≤1 year, 1-5 years, >5 years (Section 20.16)',
        'key_management' => 'Key management personnel compensation in total (Section 33.7)',
        'related_parties_other' => 'Other related-party transactions and balances (Section 33.9)',
        'borrowing_terms' => 'Borrowings: lender, security, interest rate and repayment terms (Section 11.42-11.46)',
        'approval' => 'Date the statements were authorised for issue and by whom (Section 32.9)',
        'pledged_assets' => 'Inventories or assets pledged as security for liabilities (Sections 13.22(e), 17.32)',
    ];

    private static function z(): BigDecimal
    {
        return BigDecimal::zero();
    }

    private static function get(array $tb, int $c): BigDecimal
    {
        return $tb[$c] ?? BigDecimal::zero();
    }

    private static function line(array $tb, string $line, int $sign = 1): BigDecimal
    {
        $meta = Reports::accounts();
        $t = BigDecimal::zero();
        foreach ($tb as $c => $v) {
            if ($meta[$c]->line === $line) {
                $t = $t->plus($v);
            }
        }

        return Money::q2($t->multipliedBy($sign));
    }

    private static function accounts(array $tb, array|string $lines, int $sign = 1): array
    {
        $lines = (array) $lines;
        $meta = Reports::accounts();
        ksort($tb);
        $out = [];
        foreach ($tb as $c => $v) {
            if (in_array($meta[$c]->line, $lines, true) && ! $v->isZero()) {
                $out[] = ['code' => $c, 'account' => $meta[$c]->name, 'amount' => Money::q2($v->multipliedBy($sign))];
            }
        }

        return $out;
    }

    private static function before(string $d): string
    {
        return date('Y-m-d', strtotime("{$d} -1 day"));
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ primary statements
    public static function profitOrLossAndOci(string $start, string $end, ?array $ids): array
    {
        $tb = Reports::trialBalance($start, $end, $ids);
        $pl = Reports::incomeStatement($tb);
        [$opening, $closing] = [Reports::position(self::before($start), $ids), Reports::position($end, $ids)];
        $reval = Money::q2(self::get($closing, 3060)->minus(self::get($opening, 3060))->negated());
        $finIncome = Money::q2(self::get($tb, 7010)->negated());
        $otherIncome = Money::q2($pl['oth']->minus($finIncome));
        $dist = $pl['sell'];
        $admin = Money::q2($pl['prem']->plus($pl['adm'])->plus($pl['dep'])->plus($pl['imp'])->plus($pl['emp']));
        $out = ['revenue' => $pl['rev'], 'cost_of_sales' => $pl['cos'], 'gross_profit' => $pl['gp'], 'other_income' => $otherIncome,
            'distribution_costs' => $dist, 'administrative_expenses' => $admin,
            'expenses_by_nature' => ['employee_costs' => $pl['emp'], 'premises_costs' => $pl['prem'], 'administrative' => $pl['adm'],
                'selling_and_distribution' => $pl['sell'], 'depreciation_and_amortisation' => $pl['dep'], 'impairment_losses' => $pl['imp']],
            'operating_profit' => Money::q2($pl['gp']->plus($otherIncome)->plus($dist)->plus($admin)), 'finance_income' => $finIncome,
            'finance_costs' => $pl['fin'], 'profit_before_tax' => $pl['pbt'], 'income_tax_expense' => $pl['tax'], 'profit_for_the_period' => $pl['profit'],
            'other_comprehensive_income' => ['items_not_reclassified' => ['revaluation_surplus' => $reval, 'total' => $reval],
                'items_that_may_be_reclassified' => ['exchange_differences_on_foreign_operations' => Money::zero(),
                    'note' => 'none: the business has no foreign operation (Section 30.13)', 'total' => Money::zero()], 'total' => $reval],
            'gross_margin' => $pl['gross_margin']];
        $out['total_comprehensive_income'] = Money::q2($pl['profit']->plus($reval));
        $out['check_operating_profit'] = Money::q2($out['operating_profit']->plus($finIncome)->plus($pl['fin'])->minus($pl['pbt']));

        return $out;
    }

    public static function financialPosition(string $asOf, ?array $ids, ?bool $eliminate = null): array
    {
        $eliminate ??= $ids === null;
        $tb = Reports::position($asOf, $ids);
        $bs = Reports::balanceSheet($tb, $eliminate);
        $ib = self::get($tb, 1195);
        $nca = [];
        foreach (self::NON_CURRENT_ASSETS as $l) {
            $nca[$l] = self::line($tb, $l);
        }
        $ca = [];
        foreach (self::CURRENT_ASSETS as $l) {
            $ca[$l] = self::line($tb, $l);
        }
        $ca['Prepayments and other current assets'] = $ca['Prepayments and other current assets']->minus($ib);
        $ca[$eliminate ? 'In transit between units' : 'Head office / branch current accounts (1195)'] = Money::q2($ib);
        $ncl = [];
        foreach (self::NON_CURRENT_LIABILITIES as $l) {
            $ncl[$l] = self::line($tb, $l, -1);
        }
        $cl = [];
        foreach (self::CURRENT_LIABILITIES as $l) {
            $cl[$l] = self::line($tb, $l, -1);
        }
        $eq = [];
        foreach (self::EQUITY_COMPONENTS as $comp => $codes) {
            $eq[$comp] = Money::q2(Money::sum(array_map(fn ($c) => self::get($tb, $c), $codes))->negated());
        }
        $susp = self::line($tb, 'Suspense and clearing');
        $out = ['as_of' => $asOf, 'non_current_assets' => $nca, 'total_non_current_assets' => Money::q2(Money::sum($nca)),
            'current_assets' => array_map(fn ($v) => Money::q2($v), $ca), 'total_current_assets' => Money::q2(Money::sum($ca)), 'equity' => $eq,
            'total_equity' => Money::q2(Money::sum($eq)), 'non_current_liabilities' => $ncl, 'total_non_current_liabilities' => Money::q2(Money::sum($ncl)),
            'current_liabilities' => $cl, 'total_current_liabilities' => Money::q2(Money::sum($cl)), 'suspense_and_clearing' => $susp];
        $out['total_assets'] = Money::q2($out['total_non_current_assets']->plus($out['total_current_assets']));
        $out['total_liabilities'] = Money::q2($out['total_non_current_liabilities']->plus($out['total_current_liabilities']));
        $out['check'] = Money::q2($out['total_assets']->minus($out['total_equity'])->minus($out['total_liabilities'])->minus($susp));
        $out['agrees_to_ledger_balance_sheet'] = $out['total_assets']->isEqualTo(Money::q2($bs['total_assets']));

        return $out;
    }

    /** By component (Section 6.3): opening, profit, OCI, capital introduced, drawings, transfers, closing. */
    public static function changesInEquity(string $start, string $end, ?array $ids): array
    {
        [$opening, $closing] = [Reports::position(self::before($start), $ids), Reports::position($end, $ids)];
        $profit = Reports::incomeStatement(Reports::trialBalance($start, $end, $ids))['profit'];
        $cols = [];
        foreach (self::EQUITY_COMPONENTS as $comp => $codes) {
            $o = Money::q2(Money::sum(array_map(fn ($c) => self::get($opening, $c), $codes))->negated());
            $c = Money::q2(Money::sum(array_map(fn ($c) => self::get($closing, $c), $codes))->negated());
            $cols[$comp] = ['opening' => $o, 'closing' => $c, 'movement' => Money::q2($c->minus($o))];
        }
        $rows = ['opening' => array_map(fn ($v) => $v['opening'], $cols), 'profit_for_the_period' => ['Retained earnings' => $profit],
            'other_comprehensive_income' => ['Revaluation reserve' => $cols['Revaluation reserve']['movement']],
            'capital_introduced' => ["Owner's capital" => $cols["Owner's capital"]['movement']], 'drawings' => ['Drawings' => $cols['Drawings']['movement']],
            'other_movements' => ['Retained earnings' => Money::q2($cols['Retained earnings']['movement']->minus($profit))],
            'closing' => array_map(fn ($v) => $v['closing'], $cols)];
        $out = [];
        foreach ($rows as $k => $v) {
            $out[$k] = ['by_component' => $v, 'total' => Money::q2(Money::sum($v))];
        }
        $out['check'] = Money::q2(Money::sum(array_map(fn ($k) => $out[$k]['total'], ['opening', 'profit_for_the_period', 'other_comprehensive_income',
            'capital_introduced', 'drawings', 'other_movements']))->minus($out['closing']['total']));

        return $out;
    }

    public static function cashFlows(string $start, string $end, ?array $ids): array
    {
        $cf = Reports::cashFlow($start, $end, $ids);
        $tb = Reports::trialBalance($start, $end, $ids);
        [$opening, $closing] = [Reports::position(self::before($start), $ids), Reports::position($end, $ids)];
        $mv = fn ($c) => self::get($closing, $c)->minus(self::get($opening, $c));
        $taxExp = Money::q2(self::get($tb, 8010)->plus(self::get($tb, 8030)));
        $meta = Reports::accounts();
        $comp = [];
        ksort($closing);
        foreach ($closing as $c => $v) {
            if ($meta[$c]->cf_class === 'Cash' && ! $v->isZero()) {
                $comp[$meta[$c]->name] = Money::q2($v);
            }
        }

        return ['method' => 'Indirect (Section 7.8)'] + $cf + [
            'interest_paid_included_in_operating' => Money::q2(self::get($tb, 7020)),
            'interest_received_included_in_operating' => Money::q2(self::get($tb, 7010)->negated()),
            'income_tax_paid_included_in_operating' => Money::q2($taxExp->plus($mv(2180))->plus($mv(2185))->minus($mv(1180))),
            'non_cash_transactions' => ['revaluation_of_property' => Money::q2($mv(3060)->negated()),
                'assets_acquired_on_credit_or_finance_lease' => Money::q2($mv(2215)->plus($mv(2330))->negated()),
                'note' => 'Section 7.18: investing and financing transactions that used no cash are excluded from the statement'],
            'components_of_cash_and_cash_equivalents' => $comp];
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ notes
    private static function disclosures(string $end): array
    {
        $rows = Disclosure::where('period_end', $end)->get()->keyBy('key');
        [$out, $missing] = [[], []];
        foreach (self::DISCLOSURE_KEYS as $k => $label) {
            $d = $rows[$k] ?? null;
            if ($d === null || trim((string) $d->text) === '') {
                $out[$k] = ['requirement' => $label, 'text' => 'NOT YET COMPLETED – enter before the statements are issued', 'amount' => null];
                $missing[] = $label;
            } else {
                $out[$k] = ['requirement' => $label, 'text' => $d->text, 'amount' => $d->amount, 'by' => $d->updated_by];
            }
        }

        return [$out, $missing];
    }

    public static function setDisclosure(string $key, string $periodEnd, string $text, string $user, mixed $amount = null): Disclosure
    {
        if (! isset(self::DISCLOSURE_KEYS[$key])) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("Unknown disclosure {$key}; one of ".implode(', ', array_keys(self::DISCLOSURE_KEYS)));
        }
        $d = Disclosure::firstOrNew(['key' => $key, 'period_end' => $periodEnd]);
        $d->fill(['text' => $text, 'amount' => $amount !== null && $amount !== '' ? (string) Money::q2($amount) : null, 'updated_by' => $user])->save();
        Ledger::audit($user, 'DISCLOSURE', 'disclosure', "{$key}:{$periodEnd}");

        return $d;
    }

    public static function disclosureStatus(string $periodEnd): array
    {
        return self::disclosures($periodEnd)[0];
    }

    private static function revenueByPayer(string $start, string $end, ?array $ids): array
    {
        $q = DB::table('sale_line')->join('sale', 'sale_line.sale_id', '=', 'sale.id')->join('payer', 'sale.payer_id', '=', 'payer.id')
            ->where('sale.sale_date', '>=', $start)->where('sale.sale_date', '<=', $end);
        if ($ids) {
            $q->whereIn('sale.branch_id', $ids);
        }

        return $q->groupBy('payer.payer_type')->selectRaw('payer.payer_type AS t, COALESCE(SUM(sale_line.net_revenue), 0) AS v')->get()
            ->mapWithKeys(fn ($r) => [$r->t => Money::q2(Money::db($r->v))])->all();
    }

    private static function units(?array $ids)
    {
        $q = Branch::orderBy('is_head_office')->orderBy('code');
        if ($ids) {
            $q->whereIn('id', $ids);
        }

        return $q->get();
    }

                $fa1 = $fa1->plus($v);

            }

        }
        $n['29 Authorisation for issue'] = $disc['approval'];

        return [$n, $missing];
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ the full set
    /** Opening statement of financial position: at the start of the period (transition, Section 35.7) and at go-live when opening balances were loaded. */
    private static function openingStatements(string $start, ?array $ids): array
    {
        $out = [];
        $q = Journal::whereIn('source', ['OPENING', 'OPENSTOCK']);
        if ($ids) {
            $q->whereIn('branch_id', $ids);
        }
        $goLive = $q->min('entry_date');
        if ($goLive) {
            $goLive = substr((string) $goLive, 0, 10);
            $out['at_go_live'] = self::financialPosition($goLive, $ids);
            $out['go_live_date'] = $goLive;
        }
        $out['at_start_of_period'] = self::financialPosition(self::before($start), $ids);

        return $out;
    }

    /** $unitIds null = the whole business (inter-unit balances eliminated); [id] = one branch or head office on its own. */
    public static function fullStatements(string $fyStart, string $kind = 'year', int $n = 1, ?array $unitIds = null): array
    {
        $cur = Reports::periodRange($fyStart, $kind, $n);
        $comp = Reports::comparativeRange($fyStart, $kind, $n);
        $block = function (?array $rng) use ($unitIds) {
            if ($rng === null) {
                return null;
            }
            [$a, $b] = $rng;

            return ['period' => [$a, $b], 'profit_or_loss_and_oci' => self::profitOrLossAndOci($a, $b, $unitIds), 'financial_position' => self::financialPosition($b, $unitIds),
                'changes_in_equity' => self::changesInEquity($a, $b, $unitIds), 'cash_flows' => self::cashFlows($a, $b, $unitIds)];
        };
        [$c, $p] = [$block($cur), $block($comp)];
        [$notes, $missing] = self::notes($cur[0], $cur[1], $unitIds, $c['profit_or_loss_and_oci'], $c['financial_position'], $c['cash_flows']);
        $checks = ['financial_position' => $c['financial_position']['check'], 'cash_flows' => $c['cash_flows']['check'],
            'changes_in_equity' => $c['changes_in_equity']['check'], 'operating_profit' => $c['profit_or_loss_and_oci']['check_operating_profit'],
            'ppe_note' => $notes['10 Property, plant and equipment']['total']['check'],
            'equity_agrees' => Money::q2($c['changes_in_equity']['closing']['total']->minus($c['financial_position']['total_equity']))];
        $units = self::units($unitIds);

        return ['title' => 'Financial statements of '.Ledger::setting('business_name', 'Pharmacy').($unitIds === null ? '' : ' – '.$units->pluck('code')->implode(', ')),
            'framework' => $notes['2 Basis of preparation and statement of compliance']['framework'], 'current' => $c, 'comparative' => $p,
            'opening_statement_of_financial_position' => self::openingStatements($cur[0], $unitIds), 'notes' => $notes, 'open_items' => $missing,
            'checks' => $checks, 'ok' => ! array_filter($checks, fn ($v) => ! $v->isZero())];
    }
}
