##### FILE: app/Domain/LedgerReports.php
####################################################################################################

<?php

namespace App\Domain;

use App\Models\Account;
use Brick\Math\BigDecimal;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

/**
 * Master account and sub-account reports (v1.3), for the whole business, head office or any branch. Master account = the
 * financial-statement line; account = the GL account under it; sub-account = the party on the ledger line (supplier,
 * customer, claim, employee, unit on 1195). Each row shows opening, debits, credits and closing; totals tie level by level,
 * and lines posted without a party are listed as "(no party)". Port of services/ledger_reports.py.
 */
final class LedgerReports
{
    public const SECTION_ORDER = ['BS', 'PL'];

    private static function movements(string $start, string $end, ?array $ids, bool $groupParty = false, ?int $code = null)
    {
        $cols = $groupParty ? ['journal_line.account_code', 'journal_line.party'] : ['journal_line.account_code'];
        $q = DB::table('journal_line')->join('journal', 'journal.id', '=', 'journal_line.journal_id')->where('journal.entry_date', '<=', $end)->groupBy(...$cols)
            ->selectRaw(implode(', ', $cols).', COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN journal.entry_date < ? THEN journal_line.debit - journal_line.credit ELSE 0 END), 0) AS op,
                COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN journal.entry_date >= ? THEN journal_line.debit ELSE 0 END), 0) AS dr,
                COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN journal.entry_date >= ? THEN journal_line.credit ELSE 0 END), 0) AS cr', [$start, $start, $start]);
        if ($ids) {
            $q->whereIn('journal.branch_id', $ids);
        }
        if ($code !== null) {
            $q->where('journal_line.account_code', $code);
        }

        return $q->get();
    }

    /** Master accounts with their GL accounts. Profit-or-loss accounts open at nil each period. */
    public static function masterAccounts(string $start, string $end, ?array $unitIds = null): array
    {
        $meta = Reports::accounts();
        $masters = [];
        foreach (self::movements($start, $end, $unitIds) as $r) {
            $a = $meta[(int) $r->account_code];
            $opening = $a->statement === 'BS' ? Money::db($r->op) : BigDecimal::zero();
            [$dr, $cr] = [Money::db($r->dr), Money::db($r->cr)];
            $k = $a->statement."\0".$a->line;
            $masters[$k] ??= ['statement' => $a->statement, 'master_account' => $a->line, 'accounts' => []];
            $masters[$k]['accounts'][] = ['code' => (int) $a->code, 'account' => $a->name, 'normal' => $a->normal, 'control' => $a->control,
                'opening' => Money::q2($opening), 'debits' => Money::q2($dr), 'credits' => Money::q2($cr), 'closing' => Money::q2($opening->plus($dr)->minus($cr))];
        }
        $out = array_values($masters);
        $rank = fn ($m) => [($i = array_search($m['statement'], self::SECTION_ORDER, true)) === false ? 9 : $i, min(array_column($m['accounts'], 'code'))];
        usort($out, fn ($x, $y) => $rank($x) <=> $rank($y));
        foreach ($out as &$m) {
            usort($m['accounts'], fn ($x, $y) => $x['code'] <=> $y['code']);
            foreach (['opening', 'debits', 'credits', 'closing'] as $f) {
                $m[$f] = Money::q2(Money::sum(array_column($m['accounts'], $f)));
            }
        }
        unset($m);
        $td = Money::q2(Money::sum(array_column($out, 'debits')));
        $tc = Money::q2(Money::sum(array_column($out, 'credits')));

        return ['period' => [$start, $end], 'masters' => $out, 'total_debits' => $td, 'total_credits' => $tc, 'balanced' => $td->isEqualTo($tc)];
    }

    /** Sub-ledger of one control account: each party with opening, debits, credits, closing; ties to the account. */
    public static function subAccounts(int $code, string $start, string $end, ?array $unitIds = null): array
    {
        $a = Account::find($code) ?? throw new BusinessRuleError("Unknown account {$code}");
        $rows = [];
        foreach (self::movements($start, $end, $unitIds, true, $code) as $r) {
            $opening = $a->statement === 'BS' ? Money::db($r->op) : BigDecimal::zero();
            [$dr, $cr] = [Money::db($r->dr), Money::db($r->cr)];
            $rows[] = ['sub_account' => $r->party ?: '(no party)', 'opening' => Money::q2($opening), 'debits' => Money::q2($dr), 'credits' => Money::q2($cr),
                'closing' => Money::q2($opening->plus($dr)->minus($cr))];
        }
        usort($rows, fn ($x, $y) => [$x['sub_account'] === '(no party)', 0] <=> [$y['sub_account'] === '(no party)', 0] ?: strcmp($x['sub_account'], $y['sub_account']));
        $totals = [];
        foreach (['opening', 'debits', 'credits', 'closing'] as $f) {
            $totals[$f] = Money::q2(Money::sum(array_column($rows, $f)));
        }
        $gl = null;
        foreach (self::masterAccounts($start, $end, $unitIds)['masters'] as $m) {
            foreach ($m['accounts'] as $r) {
                if ($r['code'] === $code) {
                    $gl = $r;
                }
            }
        }
        $glClose = $gl ? $gl['closing'] : Money::zero();
        $unassigned = Money::zero();
        foreach ($rows as $r) {
            if ($r['sub_account'] === '(no party)') {
                $unassigned = $r['closing'];
            }
        }

        return ['account' => $code, 'name' => $a->name, 'master_account' => $a->line, 'period' => [$start, $end], 'sub_accounts' => $rows, 'totals' => $totals,
            'gl_closing' => $glClose, 'ties_to_account' => $totals['closing']->isEqualTo($glClose), 'unassigned' => $unassigned];
    }

    /** Every ledger line of an account (optionally one sub-account) with a running balance. */
    public static function accountDetail(int $code, string $start, string $end, ?array $unitIds = null, ?string $party = null): array
    {
        return Views::accountLedger($code, $start, $end, $unitIds, $party);
    }
}

####################################################################################################
##### FILE: app/Domain/Payroll.php
####################################################################################################

<?php

namespace App\Domain;

use App\Models\Channel;
use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Models\Journal;
use App\Models\JournalLine;
use App\Models\PayeBand;
use App\Models\PayrollLine;
use Brick\Math\BigDecimal;

/**
 * Payroll: pay register, salary payment, SSNIT Tier 1 and Tier 2. Port of services/payroll.py.
 *
 * SSF (SSNIT status = Yes) on insurable earnings = basic salary within the SSNIT minimum / maximum: employee 5.5%,
 * employer 13% -> Tier 1 to SSNIT 13.5%, Tier 2 to the trustee 5% (computed directly; the employer cost absorbs pesewa
 * rounding). Resident: PAYE on (basic + allowances + non-qualifying overtime - SSF employee) with the monthly bands in
 * force on the pay date; qualifying overtime of junior staff taxed separately 5% / 10%. Non-resident: flat 25%, overtime
 * at the non-resident overtime rate. Casual: 5% final tax on the gross payment. Refunds: not income, added to net pay.
 */
final class Payroll
{
    public const TAX_STATUSES = ['Resident', 'Non-Resident', 'Casual'];

    public static function ym(string $d): string
    {
        return substr($d, 0, 7);
    }

    public static function monthName(string $d): string
    {
        return date('F Y', strtotime($d));
    }

    /** Python's format(Decimal, '%'): 0.05 -> 5%, 0.050 -> 5.0%. */
    public static function pct(mixed $x): string
    {
        $x = Money::d($x);

        return (string) $x->multipliedBy(100)->toScale(max($x->getScale() - 2, 0)).'%';
    }

    /** @return array<int, array{0:?BigDecimal,1:BigDecimal}> */
    public static function annualBands(string $on): array
    {
        $rows = PayeBand::where('effective_from', '<=', $on)->where('effective_to', '>=', $on)->orderBy('seq')->get();
        if ($rows->isEmpty()) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('No PAYE band table is in force on '.date('d M Y', strtotime($on)).'; add one under Settings > PAYE bands');
        }

        return $rows->map(fn ($r) => [$r->annual_width !== null ? Money::d($r->annual_width) : null, Money::d($r->rate)])->all();
    }

    public static function monthlyBands(string $on): array
    {
        return array_map(fn ($b) => [$b[0] !== null ? Money::div20($b[0], 12) : null, $b[1]], self::annualBands($on));
    }

    public static function defaultMonthlyBands(): array
    {
        return array_map(fn ($b) => [$b[0] !== null ? Money::div20($b[0], 12) : null, Money::d($b[1])], ReferenceTables::ANNUAL_PAYE_BANDS);
    }

    /** Graduated tax: bands are [width, rate] in order; width null = everything above. */
    public static function taxOnBands(mixed $chargeable, array $bands): BigDecimal
    {
        $left = BigDecimal::max(Money::d($chargeable), BigDecimal::zero());
        $tax = BigDecimal::zero();
        foreach ($bands as [$width, $rate]) {
            $portion = $width === null ? $left : BigDecimal::min($left, $width);
            $tax = $tax->plus($portion->multipliedBy($rate));
            $left = $left->minus($portion);
            if (! $left->isPositive()) {
                break;
            }
        }

        return Money::q2($tax);
    }

    public static function paye(mixed $chargeable, ?array $bands = null): BigDecimal
    {
        return self::taxOnBands($chargeable, $bands ?? self::defaultMonthlyBands());
    }

    public static function annualPaye(mixed $chargeable, string $on): BigDecimal
    {
        return self::taxOnBands($chargeable, self::annualBands($on));
    }

    private static function rate(string $k, string $d): BigDecimal
    {
        return Money::d(Ledger::setting($k, $d));
    }

    /** One employee, one month. */
    public static function compute(mixed $basic, mixed $allowances = 0, mixed $overtime = 0, mixed $refunds = 0, string $taxStatus = 'Resident',
        bool $ssnitStatus = true, bool $juniorStaff = false, ?string $on = null): array
    {
        [$basic, $allowances, $overtime, $refunds] = [Money::d($basic), Money::d($allowances), Money::d($overtime), Money::d($refunds)];
        foreach ([$basic, $allowances, $overtime, $refunds] as $x) {
            if ($x->isNegative()) {
                throw new BusinessRuleError('Pay amounts cannot be negative');
            }
        }
        if (! in_array($taxStatus, self::TAX_STATUSES, true)) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("Tax status must be one of ('Resident', 'Non-Resident', 'Casual')");
        }
        $on ??= date('Y-m-d');
        $z = BigDecimal::zero();
        if ($ssnitStatus) {
            $insurable = BigDecimal::max(self::rate('insurable_min', '587.80'), BigDecimal::min($basic, self::rate('insurable_max', '69000')));
            $emp = Money::q2($insurable->multipliedBy(self::rate('ssnit_employee', '0.055')));
            $tier1 = Money::q2($insurable->multipliedBy(self::rate('tier1', '0.135')));
            $tier2 = Money::q2($insurable->multipliedBy(self::rate('tier2', '0.05')));
            $employer = $tier1->plus($tier2)->minus($emp);
        } else {
            $insurable = $emp = $tier1 = $tier2 = $employer = $z;
        }
        $overtimeTax = $z;
        if ($taxStatus === 'Casual') {
            $taxable = $basic->plus($overtime)->plus($allowances);
            $tax = Money::q2($taxable->multipliedBy(self::rate('casual_rate', '0.05')));
            $basis = 'Casual: '.self::pct(self::rate('casual_rate', '0.05')).' final tax on gross payment';
        } elseif ($taxStatus === 'Non-Resident') {
            $taxable = BigDecimal::max($basic->plus($allowances)->minus($emp), $z);
            $tax = Money::q2($taxable->multipliedBy(self::rate('nonresident_rate', '0.25')));
            $overtimeTax = Money::q2($overtime->multipliedBy(self::rate('nonresident_overtime_rate', '0.20')));
            $basis = 'Non-resident: flat rate on chargeable income; overtime at the non-resident overtime rate';
        } else {
            $annual = $basic->plus($allowances)->multipliedBy(12);
            $qualifies = $juniorStaff && $annual->isLessThanOrEqualTo(self::rate('overtime_qualifying_annual_max', '18000'));
            if (! $overtime->isZero() && $qualifies) {
                $cap = $basic->multipliedBy(self::rate('overtime_band_pct', '0.5'));
                $low = BigDecimal::min($overtime, $cap);
                $overtimeTax = Money::q2($low->multipliedBy(self::rate('overtime_rate_low', '0.05'))
                    ->plus($overtime->minus($low)->multipliedBy(self::rate('overtime_rate_high', '0.10'))));
                $taxable = BigDecimal::max($basic->plus($allowances)->minus($emp), $z);
                $basis = 'Resident graduated bands; qualifying overtime taxed separately (5% / 10%)';
            } else {
                $taxable = BigDecimal::max($basic->plus($allowances)->plus($overtime)->minus($emp), $z);
                $basis = 'Resident graduated bands'.(! $overtime->isZero() ? '; overtime not qualifying – added to taxable income' : '');
            }
            $tax = self::paye($taxable, self::monthlyBands($on));
        }
        $earn = $basic->plus($overtime)->plus($refunds)->plus($allowances);
        $ded = $emp->plus($tax)->plus($overtimeTax);

        return ['basic' => Money::q2($basic), 'overtime' => Money::q2($overtime), 'refunds' => Money::q2($refunds), 'allowances' => Money::q2($allowances),
            'total_earnings' => Money::q2($earn), 'insurable' => Money::q2($insurable), 'ssnit_employee' => $emp, 'chargeable' => Money::q2($taxable),
            'paye' => $tax, 'overtime_tax' => $overtimeTax, 'total_deductions' => Money::q2($ded), 'net_pay' => Money::q2($earn->minus($ded)),
            'employer_pension' => Money::q2($employer), 'tier1_payable' => $tier1, 'tier2_payable' => $tier2, 'tax_status' => $taxStatus,
            'ssnit_status' => $ssnitStatus, 'tax_basis' => $basis];
    }

    public static function computeFor(Employee $e, string $on, mixed $overtime = 0, mixed $refunds = 0, mixed $allowances = null): array
    {
        return self::compute($e->basic, $allowances ?? $e->allowances, $overtime, $refunds, $e->tax_status ?: 'Resident',
            $e->ssnit_status === null ? true : (bool) $e->ssnit_status, (bool) $e->junior_staff, $on);
    }

    /** variables: [staff_no => [overtime, refunds, allowances]] for this month (allowances overrides the standing allowances). */
    public static function run(int $branchId, string $monthEnd, string $user, ?string $approver, array $variables = []): array
    {
        if (! $approver || $approver === $user) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Payroll needs an approver other than the preparer');
        }
        $ref = 'PAY-'.self::ym($monthEnd);
        $posted = Journal::where('branch_id', $branchId)->where('source', 'PAYROLL')->where('source_ref', $ref)->orderBy('id')->pluck('id')->all();
        $reversed = $posted ? Journal::whereIn('reversal_of_id', $posted)->pluck('reversal_of_id')->all() : [];
        $live = array_values(array_diff($posted, $reversed));
        if ($live) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Payroll for '.self::monthName($monthEnd)." has already been posted (journal {$live[0]}); reverse it to rerun");
        }
        $emps = Employee::where('branch_id', $branchId)->orderBy('staff_no')->get();
        if ($emps->isEmpty()) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('No employees in this branch');
        }
        $unknown = array_diff(array_map('strval', array_keys($variables)), $emps->pluck('staff_no')->all());
        if ($unknown) {
            sort($unknown);
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Not employees of this branch: '.self::pyList($unknown));
        }
        $refundAcct = (int) Ledger::setting('payroll_refund_account', '6038');
        $p = new Poster;
        $out = [];
        foreach ($emps as $e) {
            $v = $variables[$e->staff_no] ?? [];
            $extra = array_diff(array_keys($v), ['overtime', 'refunds', 'allowances']);
            if ($extra) {
                sort($extra);
                throw new BusinessRuleError("{$e->staff_no}: unknown pay items ".self::pyList($extra));
            }
            $c = self::computeFor($e, $monthEnd, $v['overtime'] ?? 0, $v['refunds'] ?? 0, $v['allowances'] ?? null);
            $p->dr(str_starts_with(strtolower($e->role), 'pharmacist') ? 6010 : 6015, $c['basic']);
            $p->dr(6030, $c['allowances']->plus($c['overtime']));
            $p->dr($refundAcct, $c['refunds']);
            $p->dr(6020, $c['employer_pension']);
            $p->cr(2140, $c['paye']->plus($c['overtime_tax'])); // PAYE, overtime, casual and non-resident tax all go on the PAYE return
            $p->cr(2150, $c['tier1_payable']);
            $p->cr(2155, $c['tier2_payable']);
            $p->cr(2190, $c['net_pay'], $e->staff_no);
            $out[] = [$e, $c];
        }
        $j = Ledger::post($branchId, $monthEnd, 'PAYROLL', $ref, $p->lines(), $user, null, $approver);
        foreach ($out as [$e, $c]) {
            PayrollLine::create(['journal_id' => $j->id, 'branch_id' => $branchId, 'employee_id' => $e->id, 'period_end' => $monthEnd,
                'basic' => (string) $c['basic'], 'allowances' => (string) $c['allowances'], 'overtime' => (string) $c['overtime'], 'refunds' => (string) $c['refunds'],
                'total_earnings' => (string) $c['total_earnings'], 'insurable' => (string) $c['insurable'], 'ssnit_employee' => (string) $c['ssnit_employee'],
                'chargeable' => (string) $c['chargeable'], 'paye' => (string) $c['paye'], 'overtime_tax' => (string) $c['overtime_tax'],
                'total_deductions' => (string) $c['total_deductions'], 'employer_pension' => (string) $c['employer_pension'], 'tier1' => (string) $c['tier1_payable'],
                'tier2' => (string) $c['tier2_payable'], 'net_pay' => (string) $c['net_pay'], 'tax_status' => $c['tax_status'], 'ssnit_status' => $c['ssnit_status'],
                'tax_basis' => $c['tax_basis']]);
        }

        return [$j->id, array_map(fn ($x) => [$x[0]->staff_no, $x[1]], $out)];
    }

    public static function pyList(array $xs): string
    {
        return '['.implode(', ', array_map(fn ($x) => "'{$x}'", $xs)).']';
    }

    /** Pays the month's net salaries (2190 per employee) from a cash or bank channel; inside Ledger::paidBy when head office pays. */
    public static function paySalaries(int $branchId, string $monthEnd, string $channel, string $user, ?string $approver): array
    {
        if (! $approver || $approver === $user) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Salary payments need an approver other than the preparer');
        }
        $ym = self::ym($monthEnd);
        if (Journal::where('branch_id', $branchId)->where('source', 'SALPAY')->where('source_ref', "SAL-{$ym}")->exists()) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Salaries for '.self::monthName($monthEnd).' have already been paid for this branch');
        }
        $ch = Channel::find($channel);
        if ($ch === null || ! in_array((int) $ch->account, [1010, 1015, 1030, 1040], true)) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Pay salaries from Bank, MoMo, Petty cash or Cash');
        }
        $rows = JournalLine::join('journal', 'journal.id', '=', 'journal_line.journal_id')->where('journal.branch_id', $branchId)
            ->where('journal.source_ref', "PAY-{$ym}")->where('journal.source', 'PAYROLL')->where('journal_line.account_code', 2190)
            ->groupBy('journal_line.party')->orderBy('journal_line.party')->selectRaw('journal_line.party AS party, SUM(journal_line.credit - journal_line.debit) AS amt')->get();
        $p = new Poster;
        $total = BigDecimal::zero();
        foreach ($rows as $r) {
            $amt = Money::q2(Money::db($r->amt));
            if ($amt->isPositive()) {
                $p->dr(2190, $amt, $r->party);
                $total = $total->plus($amt);
            }
        }
        if (! $total->isPositive()) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('No net salaries to pay for '.self::monthName($monthEnd).' – run payroll first');
        }
        $p->cr((int) $ch->account, $total);
        $j = Ledger::post($branchId, $monthEnd, 'SALPAY', "SAL-{$ym}", $p->lines(), $user, 'Net salaries '.self::monthName($monthEnd), $approver);

        return ['journal_id' => $j->id, 'total' => Money::q2($total), 'employees' => count($rows)];
    }
}

####################################################################################################
##### FILE: app/Domain/PayrollReports.php
####################################################################################################

<?php

namespace App\Domain;

use App\Models\Branch;
use App\Models\Employee;
use Brick\Math\BigDecimal;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

/**
 * Payroll outputs used outside the software: pay register, bank advice, SSNIT Tier 1 and Tier 2 schedules, each with totals,
 * ties to the ledger and exceptions; the annual employer return (DT 0108 set). Port of services/payroll_reports.py.
 * Register and bank advice show the live pay runs dated in the month; the Tier schedules show a later-month reversal as a
 * negative line (a filed month is never rewritten), so their totals tie to GL 2150 / 2155 for the month.
 */
final class PayrollReports
{
    public const REGISTER_COLUMNS = ['serial_number' => 'Serial Number', 'staff_id' => 'Staff ID', 'surname' => 'Surname of Employee',
        'first_name' => 'Firstname of Employee', 'other_names' => 'Other Names', 'ssnit_status' => 'SSNIT Status', 'tax_status' => 'Tax Status',
        'basic_salary' => 'Basic Salary', 'overtime_allowance' => 'Overtime Allowance', 'refunds' => 'Refunds', 'other_allowances' => 'Other Allowances',
        'total_earnings' => 'Total Earnings', 'ssf_employee' => 'SSF Employee', 'taxable_income' => 'Taxable Income', 'tax_paye' => 'Tax (PAYE)',
        'overtime_tax' => 'Overtime Tax', 'total_deductions' => 'Total Deductions', 'net_salary' => 'Net Salary'];

    public const BANK_COLUMNS = ['staff_id' => 'Staff ID', 'staff_name' => 'Staff Name', 'bank_name' => 'Bank Name', 'bank_account' => 'Bank Account',
        'net_salary' => 'Net Salary'];

    public const TIER1_COLUMNS = ['serial_number' => 'Serial Number', 'ssf_number' => 'SSF Number', 'ghana_card_number' => 'Ghana Card Number',
        'surname' => 'Surname', 'first_name' => 'First Name', 'other_names' => 'Other Names', 'basic' => 'Basic', 'ssf_13_5' => 'SSF (13.5%)', 'scheme' => 'Scheme'];

    public const TIER2_COLUMNS = ['serial_number' => 'Serial Number', 'ssf_number' => 'SSF Number', 'ghana_card_number' => 'Ghana Card Number',
        'pension_number' => 'Pension Number', 'surname' => 'Surname', 'first_name' => 'First Name', 'other_names' => 'Other Names', 'basic' => 'Basic',
        'ssf_5' => 'SSF (5%)'];

    /** Columns as [key, label] pairs, as the Python edition returns them. */
    public static function pairs(array $cols): array
    {
        return array_map(fn ($k, $v) => [$k, $v], array_keys($cols), $cols);
    }

    /** [surname, first name, other names]; legacy single-name records: last word as surname. */
    public static function names(Employee $e): array
    {
        if ($e->surname || $e->first_name) {
            return [$e->surname ?? '', $e->first_name ?? '', $e->other_names ?? ''];
        }
        $parts = preg_split('/\s+/', trim((string) $e->name), -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY);

        return [$parts ? end($parts) : '', implode(' ', array_slice($parts, 0, 1)), implode(' ', array_slice($parts, 1, max(count($parts) - 2, 0)))];
    }

    private static function liveLines(int $y, int $m, ?int $branchId = null): array
    {
        [$start, $end] = Schedules::monthBounds($y, $m);
        $lines = array_values(array_map(fn ($x) => $x[0], array_filter(Schedules::payrollLines($start, $end), fn ($x) => $x[1] === 1)));
        if ($branchId) {
            $lines = array_values(array_filter($lines, fn ($l) => $l->branch_id === $branchId));
        }
        usort($lines, fn ($a, $b) => [$a->branch_id, $a->employee->staff_no] <=> [$b->branch_id, $b->employee->staff_no]);

        return $lines;
    }

    private static function totals(array $rows, array $keys): array
    {
        $out = [];
        foreach ($keys as $k) {
            $out[$k] = Money::q2(Money::sum(array_column($rows, $k)));
        }

        return $out;
    }

    private static function netPayPosted(array $lines): BigDecimal
    {
        $ids = array_values(array_unique(array_map(fn ($l) => $l->journal_id, $lines)));
        if (! $ids) {
            return Money::zero();
        }

        return Money::q2(Money::db(DB::table('journal_line')->whereIn('journal_id', $ids)->where('account_code', 2190)
            ->selectRaw('COALESCE(SUM(credit), 0) AS v')->value('v') ?? '0'));
    }

    public static function register(int $y, int $m, ?int $branchId = null): array
    {
        $lines = self::liveLines($y, $m, $branchId);
        $rows = [];
        foreach ($lines as $i => $l) {
            $e = $l->employee;
            [$sn, $fn, $on] = self::names($e);
            $rows[] = ['serial_number' => $i + 1, 'staff_id' => $e->staff_no, 'surname' => $sn, 'first_name' => $fn, 'other_names' => $on,
                'ssnit_status' => $l->ssnit_status ? 'Yes' : 'No', 'tax_status' => $l->tax_status, 'basic_salary' => Money::d($l->basic),
                'overtime_allowance' => Money::d($l->overtime), 'refunds' => Money::d($l->refunds), 'other_allowances' => Money::d($l->allowances),
                'total_earnings' => Money::d($l->total_earnings), 'ssf_employee' => Money::d($l->ssnit_employee), 'taxable_income' => Money::d($l->chargeable),
                'tax_paye' => Money::d($l->paye), 'overtime_tax' => Money::d($l->overtime_tax), 'total_deductions' => Money::d($l->total_deductions),
                'net_salary' => Money::d($l->net_pay)];
        }
        $totals = self::totals($rows, array_slice(array_keys(self::REGISTER_COLUMNS), 7));
        $checks = ['Earnings - deductions = net' => Schedules::tie($totals['total_earnings']->minus($totals['total_deductions']), $totals['net_salary']),
            'Net salary vs pay-run journals (2190)' => Schedules::tie($totals['net_salary'], self::netPayPosted($lines))];
        $exc = [];
        foreach ($rows as $r) {
            if (! in_array($r['tax_status'], Payroll::TAX_STATUSES, true)) {
                $exc[] = "{$r['staff_id']}: tax status {$r['tax_status']}";
            }
        }

        return ['period' => Schedules::period($y, $m), 'columns' => self::pairs(self::REGISTER_COLUMNS), 'rows' => $rows, 'totals' => $totals, 'checks' => $checks, 'exceptions' => $exc];
    }

    public static function bankAdvice(int $y, int $m, ?int $branchId = null): array
    {
        $lines = self::liveLines($y, $m, $branchId);
        $rows = [];
        foreach ($lines as $l) {
            if (Money::d($l->net_pay)->isZero()) {
                continue;
            }
            $e = $l->employee;
            $rows[] = ['staff_id' => $e->staff_no, 'staff_name' => Schedules::displayName($e), 'bank_name' => $e->bank_name ?? '', 'bank_account' => $e->bank_account ?? '',
                'net_salary' => Money::d($l->net_pay)];
        }
        $total = Money::q2(Money::sum(array_column($rows, 'net_salary')));

        return ['period' => Schedules::period($y, $m), 'columns' => self::pairs(self::BANK_COLUMNS), 'rows' => $rows, 'totals' => ['net_salary' => $total],
            'checks' => ['Bank advice vs pay-run journals (2190)' => Schedules::tie($total, self::netPayPosted($lines))],
            'exceptions' => array_values(array_map(fn ($r) => "{$r['staff_id']}: BANK DETAILS MISSING", array_filter($rows, fn ($r) => ! ($r['bank_name'] && $r['bank_account']))))];
    }

    private static function tierRows(int $y, int $m): array
    {
        [$start, $end] = Schedules::monthBounds($y, $m);
        $src = array_values(array_filter(Schedules::payrollLines($start, $end), fn ($x) => (bool) $x[0]->ssnit_status));
        usort($src, fn ($a, $b) => [$a[0]->period_end, $a[0]->employee->staff_no] <=> [$b[0]->period_end, $b[0]->employee->staff_no]);

        return [$start, $end, $src];
    }

    public static function tier(int $y, int $m, int $which): array
    {
        [$start, $end, $src] = self::tierRows($y, $m);
        [$rows, $notes] = [[], []];
        foreach ($src as $i => [$l, $sg, $note]) {
            $e = $l->employee;
            [$sn, $fn, $on] = self::names($e);
            $n = $i + 1;
            $row = ['serial_number' => $n, 'ssf_number' => $e->ssnit_no ?? '', 'ghana_card_number' => $e->tin ?? ''];
            if ($which === 2) {
                $row['pension_number'] = $e->pension_no ?? '';
            }
            $row += ['surname' => $sn, 'first_name' => $fn, 'other_names' => $on, 'basic' => Money::d($l->insurable)->multipliedBy($sg)];
            if ($which === 1) {
                $row += ['ssf_13_5' => Money::d($l->tier1)->multipliedBy($sg), 'scheme' => 'N'];
            } else {
                $row['ssf_5'] = Money::d($l->tier2)->multipliedBy($sg);
            }
            $rows[] = $row;
            if ($note) {
                $notes[] = "Line {$n}: {$note}";
            }
        }
        $missing = fn ($k, $label) => array_values(array_map(fn ($r) => "Line {$r['serial_number']}: {$label} MISSING", array_filter($rows, fn ($r) => ! $r[$k])));
        if ($which === 1) {
            $total = self::totals($rows, ['basic', 'ssf_13_5']);

            return ['period' => Schedules::period($y, $m), 'columns' => self::pairs(self::TIER1_COLUMNS), 'rows' => $rows, 'totals' => $total,
                'checks' => ['Tier 1 vs GL 2150' => Schedules::tie($total['ssf_13_5'], Schedules::glMovement([2150], $start, $end))],
                'exceptions' => array_merge($missing('ssf_number', 'SSF NUMBER'), $missing('ghana_card_number', 'GHANA CARD NUMBER')), 'notes' => $notes];
        }
        $total = self::totals($rows, ['basic', 'ssf_5']);

        return ['period' => Schedules::period($y, $m), 'columns' => self::pairs(self::TIER2_COLUMNS), 'rows' => $rows, 'totals' => $total,
            'checks' => ['Tier 2 vs GL 2155' => Schedules::tie($total['ssf_5'], Schedules::glMovement([2155], $start, $end))],
            'exceptions' => array_merge($missing('pension_number', 'PENSION NUMBER'), $missing('ssf_number', 'SSF NUMBER')), 'notes' => $notes];
    }

    public static function tier1(int $y, int $m): array
    {
        return self::tier($y, $m, 1);
    }

    public static function tier2(int $y, int $m): array
    {
        return self::tier($y, $m, 2);
    }

    /** Payroll pack: Payroll and Bank_Advice per unit, SSNIT_Tier1, SSNIT_Tier2, Checks. */
    public static function excel(int $y, int $m): string
    {
        $x = new Xlsx;
        $checksWs = $x->sheet('Checks', 'Payroll checks and exceptions');
        $period = 'Period '.Schedules::period($y, $m);
        $sheet = function (string $title, string $heading, array $rep) use ($x, $period) {
            $ws = $x->sheet($title, $heading, $period);
            $cols = array_column($rep['columns'], 1, 0);
            $last = $x->table($ws, $rep['rows'], 4, $cols);
            if (! $rep['rows']) {
                return;
            }
            $r = $last + 1;
            $x->put($ws, $r, 1, 'Total', true);
            foreach (array_keys($cols) as $i => $k) {
                if (isset($rep['totals'][$k])) {
                    $x->put($ws, $r, $i + 1, $rep['totals'][$k], true);
                }
            }
            foreach ($rep['notes'] ?? [] as $n) {
                $x->put($ws, ++$r, 1, $n);
            }
        };
        $checks = [];
        foreach (Branch::orderBy('code')->get() as $b) {
            [$reg, $adv] = [self::register($y, $m, $b->id), self::bankAdvice($y, $m, $b->id)];
            if (! $reg['rows']) {
                continue;
            }
            $sheet("Payroll_{$b->code}", "Payroll – branch {$b->code}", $reg);
            $sheet("Bank_Advice_{$b->code}", "Bank advice – branch {$b->code}", $adv);
            foreach ($reg['checks'] + $adv['checks'] as $k => $v) {
                $checks[] = ["{$b->code}: {$k}", $v];
            }
            foreach (array_merge($reg['exceptions'], $adv['exceptions']) as $e) {
                $checks[] = ["{$b->code}: exception", $e];
            }
        }
        [$t1, $t2] = [self::tier1($y, $m), self::tier2($y, $m)];
        $sheet('SSNIT_Tier1', 'SSNIT Tier 1 schedule (13.5%, Scheme N)', $t1);
        $sheet('SSNIT_Tier2', 'Tier 2 schedule (5%)', $t2);
        foreach ($t1['checks'] + $t2['checks'] as $k => $v) {
            $checks[] = [$k, $v];
        }
        foreach (array_merge($t1['exceptions'], $t2['exceptions']) as $e) {
            $checks[] = ['exception', $e];
        }
        foreach ($checks as $i => [$label, $v]) {
            $r = $i + 3;
            $x->put($checksWs, $r, 1, $label);
            $x->row($checksWs, $r, is_array($v) ? [$v['schedule'], $v['gl'], $v['difference'], $v['ok'] ? 'OK' : 'DIFFERENCE'] : [$v], false, 2);
        }
        $checksWs->getColumnDimension('A')->setWidth(50);

        return $x->bytes();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ annual employer return (DT 0108 set), due 30 April
    private static function yearLines(int $year): array
    {
        return array_map(fn ($x) => [$x[0], $x[1]], Schedules::payrollLines("{$year}-01-01", "{$year}-12-31"));
    }

    /** GRA DT 0108B Annual Employees Information Schedule. */
    public static function annualEmployeeInformation(int $year): array
    {
        $emps = [];
        foreach (self::yearLines($year) as [$l]) {
            $emps[$l->employee->staff_no] ??= $l->employee;
        }
        $list = array_values($emps);
        usort($list, fn ($a, $b) => [strtoupper($a->surname ?: ($a->name ?? '')), $a->staff_no] <=> [strtoupper($b->surname ?: ($b->name ?? '')), $b->staff_no]);
        $rows = [];
        foreach ($list as $i => $e) {
            $rows[] = ['serial' => $i + 1, 'name' => Schedules::displayName($e), 'tin' => $e->tin ?? '', 'nationality' => $e->nationality ?? '',
                'postal_address' => $e->postal_address ?? '', 'residential_address' => $e->residential_address ?? '', 'staff_id' => $e->staff_no];
        }
        $exc = [];
        foreach ($rows as $r) {
            foreach (['tin', 'nationality', 'postal_address', 'residential_address'] as $k) {
                if (! $r[$k]) {
                    $exc[] = "{$r['staff_id']} {$r['name']}: ".strtoupper(str_replace('_', ' ', $k)).' MISSING';
                }
            }
        }

        return ['year' => $year, 'due' => ($year + 1).'-04-30', 'rows' => $rows, 'exceptions' => $exc];
    }

    /** Working schedule for DT 0108A and the DT 0108 summary, reconciled to GL 2140 for the year. */
    public static function annualPayeDeductions(int $year): array
    {
        $agg = [];
        $z = BigDecimal::zero();
        foreach (self::yearLines($year) as [$l, $sg]) {
            $e = $l->employee;
            $a = $agg[$e->staff_no] ?? ['staff_id' => $e->staff_no, 'name' => Schedules::displayName($e), 'tin' => $e->tin ?? '', 'tax_status' => $l->tax_status,
                'months' => [], 'basic' => $z, 'allowances' => $z, 'overtime' => $z, 'total_emoluments' => $z, 'ssf_employee' => $z, 'chargeable_income' => $z,
                'paye' => $z, 'overtime_tax' => $z];
            if ($sg > 0) {
                $a['months'][(int) substr($l->period_end, 5, 2)] = true;
            }
            $add = function ($k, $v) use (&$a, $sg) {
                $a[$k] = $a[$k]->plus(Money::d($v)->multipliedBy($sg));
            };
            $add('basic', $l->basic);
            $add('allowances', $l->allowances);
            $add('overtime', $l->overtime);
            $add('total_emoluments', Money::d($l->basic)->plus($l->allowances)->plus($l->overtime));
            $add('ssf_employee', $l->ssnit_employee);
            $add('chargeable_income', $l->chargeable);
            $add('paye', $l->paye);
            $add('overtime_tax', $l->overtime_tax);
            $agg[$e->staff_no] = $a;
        }
        $list = array_values($agg);
        usort($list, fn ($a, $b) => strtoupper($a['name']) <=> strtoupper($b['name']));
        $rows = [];
        foreach ($list as $i => $a) {
            $a = array_map(fn ($v) => $v instanceof BigDecimal ? Money::q2($v) : $v, $a);
            $a['months'] = count($a['months']);
            $a['total_tax'] = Money::q2($a['paye']->plus($a['overtime_tax']));
            $rows[] = ['serial' => $i + 1] + $a;
        }
        $totals = self::totals($rows, ['basic', 'allowances', 'overtime', 'total_emoluments', 'ssf_employee', 'chargeable_income', 'paye', 'overtime_tax', 'total_tax']);
        $gl = Schedules::glMovement([2140], "{$year}-01-01", "{$year}-12-31");

        return ['year' => $year, 'due' => ($year + 1).'-04-30', 'rows' => $rows, 'totals' => $totals,
            'summary' => ['number_of_employees' => count($rows), 'total_emoluments' => $totals['total_emoluments'], 'total_tax_deducted' => $totals['total_tax']],
            'checks' => ['Annual tax vs GL 2140 (year)' => Schedules::tie($totals['total_tax'], $gl)],
            'exceptions' => array_values(array_map(fn ($r) => "{$r['staff_id']}: TIN MISSING", array_filter($rows, fn ($r) => ! $r['tin'])))];
    }
}
