<?php

namespace App\Domain;

use Dompdf\Dompdf;
use Dompdf\Options;

/** HTML to A4 PDF with Dompdf (no remote resources; DejaVu Sans covers the cedi and dash characters). */
final class Pdf
{
    public static function fromHtml(string $html, string $title = 'PharmPOS', string $orientation = 'portrait'): string
    {
        $o = new Options;
        $o->set('isRemoteEnabled', false);
        $o->set('defaultFont', 'DejaVu Sans');
        $o->setChroot(base_path());
        $d = new Dompdf($o);
        $d->loadHtml($html, 'UTF-8');
        $d->setPaper('A4', $orientation);
        $d->addInfo('Title', $title);
        $d->render();

        return (string) $d->output();
    }
}

####################################################################################################
##### FILE: app/Domain/Periodend.php
####################################################################################################

<?php

namespace App\Domain;

use App\Models\Channel;
use App\Models\Journal;
use App\Models\Payer;
use App\Models\Schedule;
use Brick\Math\BigDecimal;

/**
 * Month-end routines: prepayment releases and accruals, MoMo/card settlements, corporate customer receipts and foreign
 * currency revaluation. Port of services/periodend.py.
 */
final class Periodend
{
    /** The payment itself is recorded through Expenses to the prepaid account (1150/1155/1160); this schedules the releases. */
    public static function addPrepayment(int $branchId, string $reference, string $description, int $prepaidAccount, int $expenseAccount, mixed $amount,
        string $firstMonth, int $months): Schedule
    {
        if (! in_array($prepaidAccount, [1150, 1155, 1160], true) || $months < 1 || ! Money::d($amount)->isPositive()) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Prepaid account 1150/1155/1160, a positive amount and at least one month are required');
        }

        return Schedule::create(['branch_id' => $branchId, 'kind' => 'PREPAYMENT', 'reference' => $reference, 'description' => $description,
            'balance_account' => $prepaidAccount, 'expense_account' => $expenseAccount, 'amount' => (string) Money::q2($amount),
            'start' => substr($firstMonth, 0, 7).'-01', 'months' => $months]);
    }

    /** Expense incurred but not yet invoiced: Dr expense, Cr 2030 at month end; reversed automatically on the 1st of next month. */
    public static function addAccrual(int $branchId, string $reference, string $description, int $expenseAccount, mixed $amount, string $monthEndDate,
        string $user, ?string $approver): void
    {
        if (! $approver || $approver === $user) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Accruals need an approver other than the preparer');
        }
        $me = Reports::monthEnd($monthEndDate);
        $amt = Money::q2($amount);
        Schedule::create(['branch_id' => $branchId, 'kind' => 'ACCRUAL', 'reference' => $reference, 'description' => $description, 'balance_account' => 2030,
            'expense_account' => $expenseAccount, 'amount' => (string) $amt, 'start' => $me, 'months' => 1]);
        Ledger::post($branchId, $me, 'PERIODEND', "ACR-{$reference}", [[$expenseAccount, $amt, '0'], [2030, '0', $amt]], $user, "Accrual: {$description}", $approver);
        Ledger::post($branchId, date('Y-m-d', strtotime("{$me} +1 day")), 'PERIODEND', "ACR-REV-{$reference}", [[2030, $amt, '0'], [$expenseAccount, '0', $amt]],
            $user, "Reversal of accrual: {$description}", $approver);
    }

    private static function idx(string $a, string $start): int
    {
        return ((int) substr($a, 0, 4) - (int) substr($start, 0, 4)) * 12 + (int) substr($a, 5, 2) - (int) substr($start, 5, 2);
    }

    /** Releases each prepayment's monthly share for the month; the last month takes the remainder. Refuses to run twice. */
    public static function runReleases(int $branchId, string $periodEnd, string $user, ?string $approver): ?int
    {
        if (! $approver || $approver === $user) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Prepayment releases need an approver other than the preparer');
        }
        $ym = substr($periodEnd, 0, 7);
        if (Journal::where('branch_id', $branchId)->where('source', 'PERIODEND')->where('source_ref', "PRE-{$ym}")->exists()) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("Prepayment releases for {$ym} already posted");
        }
        $p = new Poster;
        $n = 0;
        foreach (Schedule::where('branch_id', $branchId)->where('kind', 'PREPAYMENT')->orderBy('id')->get() as $sc) {
            $i = self::idx($periodEnd, $sc->start);
            if ($i >= 0 && $i < $sc->months) {
                $share = Money::q2(Money::div20($sc->amount, $sc->months));
                $amt = $i === $sc->months - 1 ? Money::q2(Money::d($sc->amount)->minus($share->multipliedBy($sc->months - 1))) : $share;
                $p->dr((int) $sc->expense_account, $amt);
                $p->cr((int) $sc->balance_account, $amt);
                $n++;
            }
        }
        if (! $n) {
            return null;
        }

        return Ledger::post($branchId, Reports::monthEnd($periodEnd), 'PERIODEND', "PRE-{$ym}", $p->lines(), $user, "Prepayment releases {$ym}", $approver)->id;
    }

    public static function prepaymentSchedule(int $branchId, string $asOf): array
    {
        $out = [];
        foreach (Schedule::where('branch_id', $branchId)->where('kind', 'PREPAYMENT')->orderBy('id')->get() as $sc) {
            $done = max(0, min((int) $sc->months, self::idx($asOf, $sc->start) + 1));
            $share = Money::q2(Money::div20($sc->amount, $sc->months));
            $released = $done === (int) $sc->months ? Money::d($sc->amount) : $share->multipliedBy($done);
            $out[] = ['reference' => $sc->reference, 'description' => $sc->description, 'account' => (int) $sc->balance_account, 'total' => $sc->amount,
                'months' => (int) $sc->months, 'released' => Money::q2($released), 'balance' => Money::q2(Money::d($sc->amount)->minus($released))];
        }

        return $out;
    }

    /** MoMo (1040) or card (1045) provider pays the bank: Dr bank (net), Dr 6320 fees, Cr clearing (gross). */
    public static function settleClearing(int $branchId, string $on, int $clearingAccount, mixed $gross, mixed $fees, string $reference, string $user): int
    {
        if (! in_array($clearingAccount, [1040, 1045], true)) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Clearing account must be 1040 (MoMo) or 1045 (card)');
        }
        [$g, $f] = [Money::q2($gross), Money::q2($fees)];
        if (! $g->isPositive() || $f->isNegative() || $f->isGreaterThanOrEqualTo($g)) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Gross must be positive and fees smaller than gross');
        }
        if ($g->isGreaterThan(Reports::accountBalance($clearingAccount, $on, [$branchId]))) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Settlement exceeds the takings waiting in the clearing account');
        }

        return Ledger::post($branchId, $on, 'SETTLE', $reference, [[1030, $g->minus($f), '0'], [6320, $f, '0'], [$clearingAccount, '0', $g]], $user,
            'Provider settlement')->id;
    }

    /**
     * Corporate customer pays its account (1110 by customer). Tax the customer withheld as an agent (WHT -> 1170, WHVAT -> 1175)
     * is recorded with its certificate; the cash received is the net.
     */
    public static function customerReceipt(int $branchId, string $payerCode, string $on, mixed $amount, string $channel, string $reference, string $user,
        mixed $whtWithheld = 0, ?string $whtCertificateNo = null, mixed $whvatWithheld = 0, mixed $whvatTaxableValue = null, ?string $whvatCertificateNo = null,
        ?array $allocations = null): int
    {
        $payer = Payer::where('code', $payerCode)->first();
        if ($payer === null || $payer->payer_type !== 'Corporate') {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Customer receipts are for corporate customers');
        }
        $amt = Money::q2($amount);
        $owed = Reports::partyBalance(1110, $payer->code, $on);
        if (! $amt->isPositive() || $amt->isGreaterThan($owed)) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Receipt must be positive and not more than the balance owed ('.Money::q2($owed).'); record advances separately');
        }
        [$net, $extra] = Withholding::linesAndCheck($amt, $whtWithheld, $whtCertificateNo, $whvatWithheld, $whvatCertificateNo);
        $ch = Channel::find($channel);
        if ($ch === null || ! in_array((int) $ch->account, [1010, 1030, 1040, 1045], true)) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Invalid channel');
        }
        $j = Ledger::post($branchId, $on, 'CUSTREC', $reference, array_merge([[(int) $ch->account, $net, '0']], $extra, [[1110, '0', $amt, $payer->code]]), $user,
            "Receipt from {$payer->name}");
        Withholding::record($branchId, $payer->code, $on, $reference, $j->id, $amt, $whtWithheld, $whtCertificateNo, $whvatWithheld, $whvatTaxableValue,
            $whvatCertificateNo);
        Ar::allocateReceipt($payer->code, $amt, $on, $j->id, $allocations);

        return $j->id;
    }

    /** Restates the foreign-currency bank account at the closing rate (IFRS for SMEs 30.10); the difference goes to 7030. */
    public static function fxRevaluation(int $branchId, string $on, mixed $foreignBalance, mixed $rate, string $user, ?string $approver, int $account = 1035): ?int
    {
        if (! $approver || $approver === $user) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("Revaluations need a second person's approval");
        }
        if (! Money::d($rate)->isPositive()) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Rate must be positive');
        }
        $target = Money::q2(Money::d($foreignBalance)->multipliedBy($rate));
        $diff = Money::q2($target->minus(Reports::accountBalance($account, $on, [$branchId])));
        if ($diff->isZero()) {
            return null;
        }
        $lines = $diff->isPositive() ? [[$account, $diff, '0'], [7030, '0', $diff]] : [[7030, $diff->negated(), '0'], [$account, '0', $diff->negated()]];

        return Ledger::post($branchId, $on, 'FXREVAL', "FX-{$account}-{$on}", $lines, $user, "{$foreignBalance} at {$rate}", $approver)->id;
    }
}

####################################################################################################
##### FILE: app/Domain/PettyCash.php
####################################################################################################

<?php

namespace App\Domain;

use App\Models\CashCount;
use App\Models\PettyCashFloat;
use Brick\Math\BigDecimal;

/**
 * Petty cash vault (v1.3): an imprest float per unit kept in 1015. Money in and out is keyed in a PETTY batch (VOUCHER,
 * RECEIPT, TOPUP, BANKING). The vault never goes below nil and a top-up cannot take it above the float. A physical count by
 * denomination, witnessed by a second person, is compared with the book; the difference goes to 6700 only when a third person
 * approves. Port of services/pettycash.py.
 */
final class PettyCash
{
    public const DENOMINATIONS = ['200', '100', '50', '20', '10', '5', '2', '1', '0.5', '0.2', '0.1', '0.05', '0.01'];

    public static function getFloat(int $branchId): ?PettyCashFloat
    {
        return PettyCashFloat::where('branch_id', $branchId)->where('active', true)->first();
    }

    public static function setFloat(int $branchId, mixed $imprest, string $custodian, string $user, ?string $approver): PettyCashFloat
    {
        if (! $approver || $approver === $user) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("Setting a petty cash float needs a second person's approval");
        }
        if (! Money::d($imprest)->isPositive()) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('The float must be positive');
        }
        $f = PettyCashFloat::where('branch_id', $branchId)->first() ?? new PettyCashFloat(['branch_id' => $branchId, 'account_code' => 1015]);
        $f->fill(['imprest' => (string) Money::q2($imprest), 'custodian' => $custodian, 'active' => true])->save();
        Ledger::audit($user, 'PETTY_FLOAT', 'petty_cash_float', $branchId, 'imprest '.Money::q2($imprest)." custodian {$custodian} (approved {$approver})");

        return $f;
    }

    public static function balance(int $branchId, string $asOf): BigDecimal
    {
        return Money::q2(Reports::accountBalance(1015, $asOf, [$branchId]));
    }

    /** After each PETTY entry: the vault may not go below nil; a top-up may not exceed the float. */
    public static function checkAfterPosting(int $branchId, string $on, string $kind): void
    {
        $bal = self::balance($branchId, $on);
        if ($bal->isNegative()) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("Petty cash would go below nil (balance {$bal}) – top it up first");
        }
        $f = self::getFloat($branchId);
        if ($kind === 'TOPUP' && $f !== null && $bal->isGreaterThan(Money::d($f->imprest))) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("Top-up takes petty cash to {$bal}, above the float of ".Money::q2($f->imprest));
        }
    }

    public static function status(int $branchId, string $asOf): array
    {
        $f = self::getFloat($branchId);
        $bal = self::balance($branchId, $asOf);
        $last = CashCount::where('branch_id', $branchId)->where('account_code', 1015)->orderByDesc('count_date')->orderByDesc('id')->first();

        return ['float' => $f ? Money::q2($f->imprest) : null, 'custodian' => $f?->custodian, 'book_balance' => $bal,
            'top_up_to_float' => $f ? Money::q2(Money::d($f->imprest)->minus($bal)) : null,
            'last_count' => $last ? ['date' => $last->count_date, 'counted' => Money::q2($last->counted), 'book' => Money::q2($last->book),
                'variance' => Money::q2($last->variance), 'status' => $last->status] : null];
    }

    /** Physical count by denomination ["200" => 2, "0.5" => 6 ...]; vouchers paid but not yet keyed are listed separately. */
    public static function recordCount(int $branchId, string $on, array $denominations, string $countedBy, ?string $witnessedBy, int $accountCode = 1015,
        mixed $vouchersNotPosted = 0): CashCount
    {
        if (! $witnessedBy || $witnessedBy === $countedBy) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('A cash count needs a witness other than the person counting');
        }
        $keys = array_map(fn ($k) => (string) $k, array_keys($denominations));
        $bad = array_diff($keys, self::DENOMINATIONS);
        if ($bad) {
            sort($bad);
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Not a Ghana cedi note or coin: '.implode(', ', $bad));
        }
        $counted = BigDecimal::zero();
        $clean = [];
        foreach ($denominations as $k => $pieces) {
            if ((int) $pieces < 0) {
                throw new BusinessRuleError('Pieces cannot be negative');
            }
            $counted = $counted->plus(Money::d((string) $k)->multipliedBy((int) $pieces));
            $clean[(string) $k] = (int) $pieces;
        }
        $book = Money::q2(Reports::accountBalance($accountCode, $on, [$branchId]));
        $variance = Money::q2($counted->plus(Money::d($vouchersNotPosted))->minus($book));
        $c = CashCount::create(['branch_id' => $branchId, 'account_code' => $accountCode, 'count_date' => $on, 'denominations' => json_encode($clean),
            'counted' => (string) Money::q2($counted), 'book' => (string) $book, 'vouchers_not_posted' => (string) Money::q2($vouchersNotPosted),
            'variance' => (string) $variance, 'counted_by' => $countedBy, 'witnessed_by' => $witnessedBy, 'status' => 'COUNTED']);
        Ledger::audit($countedBy, 'CASH_COUNT', 'cash_count', $c->id, "{$accountCode}: counted ".Money::q2($counted).", book {$book}, variance {$variance}");

        return $c;
    }

    /** Shortage: Dr 6700 / Cr cash; surplus: Dr cash / Cr 6700. Approved by someone other than the counter, witness and poster. */
    public static function postVariance(int $countId, string $user, ?string $approver): ?int
    {
        $c = CashCount::find($countId);
        if ($c === null || $c->status !== 'COUNTED') {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Count not found or already posted');
        }
        if (! $approver || in_array($approver, [$c->counted_by, $c->witnessed_by, $user], true)) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('The variance must be approved by someone other than the counter, the witness and the person posting');
        }
        $v = Money::q2($c->variance);
        if ($v->isZero()) {
            $c->update(['status' => 'POSTED']);

            return null;
        }
        $lines = $v->isPositive() ? [[(int) $c->account_code, $v, '0'], [6700, '0', $v]] : [[6700, $v->negated(), '0'], [(int) $c->account_code, '0', $v->negated()]];
        $j = Ledger::post($c->branch_id, $c->count_date, 'CASHCOUNT', "COUNT-{$c->id}", $lines, $user, "Cash count variance {$v}", $approver);
        $c->update(['status' => 'POSTED', 'journal_id' => $j->id]);

        return $j->id;
    }
}

####################################################################################################
##### FILE: app/Domain/Purchasing.php
####################################################################################################

<?php

namespace App\Domain;

use App\Models\Account;
use App\Models\APInvoice;
use App\Models\Branch;
use App\Models\GoodsReceipt;
use App\Models\GoodsReceiptLine;
use App\Models\POLine;
use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\PurchaseOrder;
use App\Models\Requisition;
use App\Models\RequisitionLine;
use App\Models\Supplier;
use Brick\Math\BigDecimal;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

/**
 * Procure to pay, part 1: requisitions, purchase orders, goods received and services confirmed against an order.
 * Requisition (optional, from the reorder alert) -> order (draft -> approved; above po_approval_limit the approver needs
 * po.approve.high) -> goods receipt (Dr inventory, Cr 2015) or service confirmation (Dr expense, Cr 2015). 2015 is cleared when
 * the supplier invoice is matched (Ap), so at any month end 2015 = received not invoiced; grniReport lists what makes it up.
 * Over-receipt beyond the ordered quantity plus match_qty_tolerance is refused. Port of services/purchasing.py.
 */
final class Purchasing
{
    public const GRNI = 2015;

    public const OPEN_PO = ['APPROVED', 'PART_RECEIVED'];

    /** @param class-string<Model> $model */
    public static function nextNo(string $model, string $column, string $prefix): string
    {
        $n = $model::count() + 1;
        while ($model::where($column, sprintf('%s%06d', $prefix, $n))->exists()) {
            $n++;
        }

        return sprintf('%s%06d', $prefix, $n);
    }

    public static function getPo(string $poNo): PurchaseOrder
    {
        return PurchaseOrder::with(['lines', 'supplier'])->where('po_no', $poNo)->first() ?? throw new BusinessRuleError("Unknown purchase order {$poNo}");
    }

    public static function poTotal(PurchaseOrder $po): BigDecimal
    {
        return Money::q2(Money::sum($po->lines->map(fn ($l) => Money::d($l->qty)->multipliedBy($l->unit_price))->all()));
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ requisitions
    /** lines: sku (stock item) or description (service), qty, reason. */
    public static function createRequisition(int $branchId, string $on, array $lines, string $user): Requisition
    {
        if (! $lines) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('A requisition needs at least one line');
        }
        $built = [];
        foreach ($lines as $ln) {
            $prod = ! empty($ln['sku']) ? Inventory::productByCode($ln['sku']) : null;
            if (! Money::d((string) $ln['qty'])->isPositive()) {
                throw new BusinessRuleError('Quantities must be positive');
            }
            $built[] = ['product_id' => $prod?->id, 'description' => $prod ? $prod->name : ($ln['description'] ?? ''), 'qty' => (string) $ln['qty'],
                'reason' => $ln['reason'] ?? null];
        }
        $r = Requisition::create(['req_no' => self::nextNo(Requisition::class, 'req_no', 'RQ-'), 'branch_id' => $branchId, 'req_date' => $on,
            'requested_by' => $user, 'status' => 'OPEN']);
        foreach ($built as $b) {
            RequisitionLine::create($b + ['requisition_id' => $r->id]);
        }
        Ledger::audit($user, 'REQUISITION', 'requisition', $r->req_no, count($lines).' lines');

        return $r->load('lines');
    }

    /** Items at or below their reorder level. Quantity suggested: twice the reorder level less stock on hand. */
    public static function requisitionFromReorder(int $branchId, string $on, string $user): ?Requisition
    {
        $lines = [];
        foreach (Branches::reorderProducts($branchId) as $p) {
            $oh = Money::db(DB::table('stock_move')->join('stock_lot', 'stock_lot.id', '=', 'stock_move.lot_id')->where('stock_lot.branch_id', $branchId)
                ->where('stock_lot.product_id', $p->id)->where('stock_move.bucket', 'SALEABLE')->where('stock_move.move_date', '<=', $on)
                ->selectRaw('COALESCE(SUM(stock_move.qty), 0) AS v')->value('v') ?? '0');
            $level = Branches::reorderLevel($branchId, $p);
            if ($oh->isLessThanOrEqualTo($level)) {
                $lines[] = ['sku' => $p->sku, 'qty' => (string) BigDecimal::max($level->multipliedBy(2)->minus($oh), BigDecimal::one()),
                    'reason' => "on hand {$oh} ≤ reorder level {$level}"];
            }
        }

        return $lines ? self::createRequisition($branchId, $on, $lines, $user) : null;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ purchase orders
    private static function buildLines(array $lines): array
    {
        $out = [];
        foreach (array_values($lines) as $k => $ln) {
            $i = $k + 1;
            [$qty, $price] = [Money::d((string) $ln['qty']), Money::d((string) $ln['unit_price'])];
            if (! $qty->isPositive() || $price->isNegative()) {
                throw new BusinessRuleError("Line {$i}: quantity must be positive and price not negative");
            }
            if (! empty($ln['sku'])) {
                $prod = Inventory::productByCode($ln['sku']);
                $out[] = ['line_no' => $i, 'product_id' => $prod->id, 'account_code' => null, 'description' => $prod->name, 'qty' => (string) $qty,
                    'unit_price' => (string) $price, 'tax_code' => $prod->tax_code ?: 'EX'];
            } else {
                $acct = Account::find($ln['account_code'] ?? 0);
                if ($acct === null || $acct->control !== 'Manual allowed' || ($acct->statement !== 'PL' && $acct->line !== 'Property, plant and equipment')) {
                    throw new BusinessRuleError("Line {$i}: choose an expense (or fixed-asset) account for a service / non-stock line");
                }
                if (empty($ln['description'])) {
                    throw new BusinessRuleError("Line {$i}: describe the service");
                }
                $out[] = ['line_no' => $i, 'product_id' => null, 'account_code' => (int) $acct->code, 'description' => $ln['description'], 'qty' => (string) $qty,
                    'unit_price' => (string) $price, 'tax_code' => $ln['tax_code'] ?? 'SR20'];
            }
        }

        return $out;
    }

    private static function itemKey(array|POLine $ln): string
    {
        $ln = $ln instanceof POLine ? $ln->toArray() : $ln;

        return $ln['product_id'] ? 'P|'.$ln['product_id'] : 'S|'.$ln['account_code'].'|'.strtolower(trim((string) $ln['description']));
    }

    public static function possibleDuplicates(int $supplierId, string $on, array $lines, ?int $excludeId = null): array
    {
        $days = (int) Ledger::setting('duplicate_po_days', '14');
        $keys = array_map(fn ($l) => self::itemKey($l), $lines);
        $out = [];
        $q = PurchaseOrder::with('lines')->where('supplier_id', $supplierId)->whereIn('status', array_merge(['DRAFT'], self::OPEN_PO))
            ->where('order_date', '>=', date('Y-m-d', strtotime("{$on} -{$days} days")))->where('order_date', '<=', date('Y-m-d', strtotime("{$on} +{$days} days")))->orderBy('id');
        foreach ($q->get() as $po) {
            if ($po->id !== $excludeId && array_intersect($keys, $po->lines->map(fn ($l) => self::itemKey($l))->all())) {
                $out[] = $po->po_no;
            }
        }

        return $out;
    }

    /**
     * lines: goods [sku, qty (packs), unit_price (excl. tax, per pack)] or service [description, account_code, qty, unit_price, tax_code].
     * An order repeating an open order (same supplier and items within duplicate_po_days) is refused unless confirmed.
     */
    public static function createPo(int $branchId, string $supplierCode, string $on, array $lines, string $user, ?string $expectedDate = null, ?string $notes = null,
        ?string $requisitionNo = null, bool $confirmDuplicate = false): PurchaseOrder
    {
        $sup = Supplier::where('code', $supplierCode)->first() ?? throw new BusinessRuleError("Unknown supplier {$supplierCode}");
        if (! $lines) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('An order needs at least one line');
        }
        Branches::requireTrading($branchId, 'purchase orders');
        $built = self::buildLines($lines);
        $dups = self::possibleDuplicates($sup->id, $on, $built);
        if ($dups && ! $confirmDuplicate) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Possible duplicate of open order(s) '.implode(', ', $dups).' for the same items – confirm to raise it anyway');
        }
        $po = PurchaseOrder::create(['po_no' => self::nextNo(PurchaseOrder::class, 'po_no', 'PO-'), 'branch_id' => $branchId, 'supplier_id' => $sup->id,
            'order_date' => $on, 'expected_date' => $expectedDate, 'created_by' => $user, 'notes' => $notes, 'status' => 'DRAFT']);
        foreach ($built as $b) {
            POLine::create($b + ['po_id' => $po->id, 'qty_received' => '0', 'value_received' => '0', 'qty_invoiced' => '0', 'value_invoiced' => '0']);
        }
        $po->load('lines', 'supplier');
        if ($dups) {
            Ledger::audit($user, 'PO_DUPLICATE_CONFIRMED', 'purchase_order', $po->po_no, 'similar to '.implode(', ', $dups));
        }
        if ($requisitionNo) {
            $r = Requisition::where('req_no', $requisitionNo)->first();
            if ($r === null || $r->status !== 'OPEN') {
                throw new BusinessRuleError("Requisition {$requisitionNo} is not open");
            }
            $r->update(['status' => 'ORDERED', 'po_id' => $po->id]);
        }
        Ledger::audit($user, 'PO_CREATE', 'purchase_order', $po->po_no, "{$sup->code} ".self::poTotal($po));

        return $po;
    }

    /** Only before anything is received; an approved order goes back to draft and must be approved again. */
    public static function amendPo(string $poNo, array $lines, string $user): PurchaseOrder
    {
        $po = self::getPo($poNo);
        if (! in_array($po->status, ['DRAFT', 'APPROVED'], true) || $po->lines->contains(fn ($l) => ! Money::d($l->qty_received)->isZero())) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Only orders with nothing received can be amended');
        }
        $built = self::buildLines($lines);
        POLine::where('po_id', $po->id)->delete();
        foreach ($built as $b) {
            POLine::create($b + ['po_id' => $po->id, 'qty_received' => '0', 'value_received' => '0', 'qty_invoiced' => '0', 'value_invoiced' => '0']);
        }
        $was = $po->status;
        $po->update(['status' => 'DRAFT', 'approved_by' => null]);
        $po->load('lines');
        Ledger::audit($user, 'PO_AMEND', 'purchase_order', $po->po_no, "was {$was}; new total ".self::poTotal($po).' – needs approval again');

        return $po;
    }

    /** Above po_approval_limit the approver needs po.approve.high (finance manager). */
    public static function approvalPermission(PurchaseOrder $po): string
    {
        return self::poTotal($po)->isGreaterThan(Money::d(Ledger::setting('po_approval_limit', '5000'))) ? 'po.approve.high' : 'po.approve';
    }

    public static function approvePo(string $poNo, ?string $approver, string $user): PurchaseOrder
    {
        $po = self::getPo($poNo);
        if ($po->status !== 'DRAFT') {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("Order is {$po->status}, not a draft");
        }
        if (! $approver || in_array($approver, [$user, $po->created_by], true)) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('The order must be approved by someone other than the person who raised it');
        }
        $po->update(['status' => 'APPROVED', 'approved_by' => $approver]);
        Ledger::audit($approver, 'PO_APPROVE', 'purchase_order', $po->po_no, (string) self::poTotal($po));

        return $po;
    }

    public static function cancelPo(string $poNo, string $user, string $reason): void
    {
        $po = self::getPo($poNo);
        if ($po->lines->contains(fn ($l) => ! Money::d($l->qty_received)->isZero())) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Goods have been received – close the order instead');
        }
        $po->update(['status' => 'CANCELLED']);
        Ledger::audit($user, 'PO_CANCEL', 'purchase_order', $po->po_no, $reason);
    }

    /** Closes an order that will not be delivered in full; the outstanding quantity drops out of commitments. */
    public static function closePo(string $poNo, string $user, string $reason): void
    {
        $po = self::getPo($poNo);
        if (! in_array($po->status, self::OPEN_PO, true)) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("Order is {$po->status}");
        }
        $po->update(['status' => 'CLOSED']);
        Ledger::audit($user, 'PO_CLOSE', 'purchase_order', $po->po_no, $reason);
    }

    private static function line(PurchaseOrder $po, mixed $lineNo): POLine
    {
        return $po->lines->first(fn ($l) => (int) $l->line_no === (int) $lineNo) ?? throw new BusinessRuleError("Order {$po->po_no} has no line {$lineNo}");
    }

    private static function checkQty(POLine $ln, mixed $qty): void
    {
        $tol = Money::d(Ledger::setting('match_qty_tolerance', '0'));
        if (! Money::d((string) $qty)->isPositive()) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Quantity must be positive');
        }
        if (Money::d($ln->qty_received)->plus((string) $qty)->isGreaterThan(Money::d($ln->qty)->multipliedBy($tol->plus(1)))) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("Line {$ln->line_no}: receiving {$qty} would exceed the ordered {$ln->qty} (already received {$ln->qty_received})");
        }
    }

    private static function status(PurchaseOrder $po): void
    {
        $po->load('lines');
        if ($po->lines->every(fn ($l) => Money::d($l->qty_received)->isGreaterThanOrEqualTo($l->qty))) {
            $po->update(['status' => 'RECEIVED']);
        } elseif ($po->lines->contains(fn ($l) => ! Money::d($l->qty_received)->isZero())) {
            $po->update(['status' => 'PART_RECEIVED']);
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ receiving
    /** Goods received against an order. lines: [line_no, qty (packs), batch_no, expiry, nrv_per_unit?]. Part deliveries allowed. */
    public static function receive(string $poNo, string $on, array $lines, string $user, ?string $deliveryNote = null): GoodsReceipt
    {
        $po = self::getPo($poNo);
        if (! in_array($po->status, self::OPEN_PO, true)) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("Order {$po->po_no} is {$po->status} – only approved orders can be received");
        }
        Inventory::lockProducts(array_filter(array_map(fn ($x) => self::line($po, $x['line_no'])->product_id, $lines)));
        $grnNo = self::nextNo(GoodsReceipt::class, 'grn_no', 'GRN-');
        $p = new Poster;
        $pending = [];
        foreach ($lines as $x) {
            $ln = self::line($po, $x['line_no']);
            if ($ln->product_id === null) {
                throw new BusinessRuleError("Line {$ln->line_no} is a service – confirm it with confirm_service");
            }
            self::checkQty($ln, $x['qty']);
            $prod = Product::find($ln->product_id);
            [$lot, $units, $invCost] = Inventory::newLot($po->branch_id, $po->supplier, $prod, $x['batch_no'] ?? null, $x['expiry'] ?? null, (string) $x['qty'],
                $ln->unit_price, $on, $grnNo, isset($x['nrv_per_unit']) && $x['nrv_per_unit'] !== null ? (string) $x['nrv_per_unit'] : null);
            $p->dr(Inventory::inventoryAccount($prod), $invCost);
            $p->cr(self::GRNI, $invCost, "PO:{$po->po_no}");
            $pending[] = [$ln, Money::d((string) $x['qty']), $invCost, $lot, $units];
        }
        $j = Ledger::post($po->branch_id, $on, 'GRN', $grnNo, $p->lines(), $user, "{$po->po_no} {$po->supplier->code}");
        $grn = GoodsReceipt::create(['grn_no' => $grnNo, 'po_id' => $po->id, 'branch_id' => $po->branch_id, 'receipt_date' => $on, 'received_by' => $user,
            'delivery_note' => $deliveryNote, 'journal_id' => $j->id]);
        foreach ($pending as [$ln, $qty, $value, $lot, $units]) {
            $ln->update(['qty_received' => (string) Money::d($ln->qty_received)->plus($qty), 'value_received' => (string) Money::d($ln->value_received)->plus($value)]);
            Inventory::move($lot, $units, $value, 'RECEIPT', $grnNo, $on, 'SALEABLE', $j->id);
            GoodsReceiptLine::create(['receipt_id' => $grn->id, 'po_line_id' => $ln->id, 'qty' => (string) $qty, 'value' => (string) $value, 'lot_id' => $lot->id]);
        }
        self::status($po);
        $pids = array_unique(array_map(fn ($x) => $x[3]->product_id, $pending));
        sort($pids);
        foreach ($pids as $pid) {
            Inventory::equalise($pid, $on, $grnNo, $user);
        }

        return $grn;
    }

    /** Service (or non-stock item) received: lines [line_no, qty]. Expense recognised when received, not when invoiced. */
    public static function confirmService(string $poNo, string $on, array $lines, string $user, ?string $reference = null): GoodsReceipt
    {
        $po = self::getPo($poNo);
        if (! in_array($po->status, self::OPEN_PO, true)) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("Order {$po->po_no} is {$po->status}");
        }
        $grnNo = self::nextNo(GoodsReceipt::class, 'grn_no', 'GRN-');
        $p = new Poster;
        $pending = [];
        foreach ($lines as $x) {
            $ln = self::line($po, $x['line_no']);
            if ($ln->account_code === null) {
                throw new BusinessRuleError("Line {$ln->line_no} is a stock item – receive it with receive");
            }
            self::checkQty($ln, $x['qty']);
            $value = Money::q2(Money::d((string) $x['qty'])->multipliedBy($ln->unit_price));
            $p->dr((int) $ln->account_code, $value);
            $p->cr(self::GRNI, $value, "PO:{$po->po_no}");
            $pending[] = [$ln, Money::d((string) $x['qty']), $value];
        }
        $j = Ledger::post($po->branch_id, $on, 'GRN', $grnNo, $p->lines(), $user, "{$po->po_no} service confirmed");
        $grn = GoodsReceipt::create(['grn_no' => $grnNo, 'po_id' => $po->id, 'branch_id' => $po->branch_id, 'receipt_date' => $on, 'received_by' => $user,
            'delivery_note' => $reference, 'journal_id' => $j->id]);
        foreach ($pending as [$ln, $qty, $value]) {
            $ln->update(['qty_received' => (string) Money::d($ln->qty_received)->plus($qty), 'value_received' => (string) Money::d($ln->value_received)->plus($value)]);
            GoodsReceiptLine::create(['receipt_id' => $grn->id, 'po_line_id' => $ln->id, 'qty' => (string) $qty, 'value' => (string) $value]);
        }
        self::status($po);

        return $grn;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ reports
    /** Approved orders not yet received: what the business has committed to buy. */
    public static function commitments(?int $branchId = null): array
    {
        $rows = [];
        $q = PurchaseOrder::with(['lines', 'supplier'])->whereIn('status', self::OPEN_PO)->orderBy('order_date')->orderBy('id');
        if ($branchId) {
            $q->where('branch_id', $branchId);
        }
        foreach ($q->get() as $po) {
            foreach ($po->lines->sortBy('line_no') as $ln) {
                $out = Money::d($ln->qty)->minus($ln->qty_received);
                if ($out->isPositive()) {
                    $rows[] = ['po' => $po->po_no, 'supplier' => $po->supplier->name, 'line' => (int) $ln->line_no, 'item' => $ln->description, 'outstanding_qty' => $out,
                        'value' => Money::q2($out->multipliedBy($ln->unit_price)), 'expected' => $po->expected_date];
                }
            }
        }

        return ['rows' => $rows, 'total' => Money::q2(Money::sum(array_column($rows, 'value')))];
    }

    /** What makes up 2015: received (or confirmed) but not yet invoiced, by order line, tied to the ledger. */
    public static function grniReport(?string $asOf = null): array
    {
        $rows = [];
        foreach (POLine::with('po.supplier')->join('purchase_order', 'purchase_order.id', '=', 'po_line.po_id')->orderBy('purchase_order.id')->orderBy('po_line.line_no')
            ->select('po_line.*')->get() as $ln) {
            $open = Money::q2(Money::d($ln->value_received)->minus($ln->value_invoiced));
            if (! $open->isZero()) {
                $rows[] = ['po' => $ln->po->po_no, 'supplier' => $ln->po->supplier->name, 'line' => (int) $ln->line_no, 'item' => $ln->description,
                    'received_qty' => $ln->qty_received, 'invoiced_qty' => $ln->qty_invoiced, 'value_not_invoiced' => $open];
            }
        }
        $total = Money::q2(Money::sum(array_column($rows, 'value_not_invoiced')));
        $gl = Reports::accountBalance(self::GRNI, $asOf ?? '2999-12-31')->negated();

        return ['rows' => $rows, 'total' => $total, 'ties' => ['Received not invoiced vs GL 2015' => Schedules::tie($total, $gl)]];
    }

    /** Per supplier, orders dated in the period: on-time deliveries, fill rate, short-delivered lines, held invoices. */
    public static function supplierPerformance(string $start, string $end): array
    {
        $out = [];
        $z = BigDecimal::zero();
        foreach (PurchaseOrder::with(['lines', 'supplier'])->where('order_date', '>=', $start)->where('order_date', '<=', $end)->where('status', '<>', 'CANCELLED')
            ->orderBy('id')->get() as $po) {
            $code = $po->supplier->code;
            $r = $out[$code] ?? ['supplier' => $po->supplier->name, 'orders' => 0, 'with_due_date' => 0, 'on_time' => 0, 'ordered_value' => $z, 'received_value' => $z,
                'short_lines' => 0, 'held_invoices' => 0];
            $r['orders']++;
            $first = GoodsReceipt::where('po_id', $po->id)->min('receipt_date');
            if ($po->expected_date && $first) {
                $r['with_due_date']++;
                $r['on_time'] += substr((string) $first, 0, 10) <= $po->expected_date ? 1 : 0;
            }
            if (in_array($po->status, ['RECEIVED', 'CLOSED'], true)) {
                foreach ($po->lines as $ln) {
                    $r['ordered_value'] = $r['ordered_value']->plus(Money::q2(Money::d($ln->qty)->multipliedBy($ln->unit_price)));
                    $r['received_value'] = $r['received_value']->plus(Money::q2(Money::d($ln->qty_received)->multipliedBy($ln->unit_price)));
                    $r['short_lines'] += Money::d($ln->qty_received)->isLessThan($ln->qty) ? 1 : 0;
                }
            }
            $r['held_invoices'] += APInvoice::where('po_id', $po->id)->whereNotNull('hold_reason')->count();
            $out[$code] = $r;
        }
        $rows = [];
        foreach ($out as $code => $r) {
            $r['on_time_pct'] = $r['with_due_date'] ? Money::q2(Money::pdiv($r['on_time'], $r['with_due_date'])->multipliedBy(100)) : null;
            $r['fill_rate_pct'] = $r['ordered_value']->isZero() ? null : Money::q2(Money::pdiv($r['received_value'], $r['ordered_value'])->multipliedBy(100));
            $rows[] = ['code' => (string) $code] + $r;
        }
        usort($rows, fn ($a, $b) => strcmp($a['code'], $b['code']));

        return $rows;
    }

    /** Purchase order document to send to the supplier (A4 PDF). */
    public static function poPdf(string $poNo): string
    {
        $po = self::getPo($poNo);
        if ($po->status === 'DRAFT') {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Approve the order before sending it to the supplier');
        }
        $branch = Branch::find($po->branch_id);
        [$name, $tin] = [Ledger::setting('business_name', '') ?? '', Ledger::setting('business_tin', '') ?? ''];
        $e = fn ($s) => htmlspecialchars((string) $s, ENT_QUOTES);
        $fmt = fn ($v, $dp = 2) => number_format(Money::d($v)->toFloat(), $dp);
        $rows = '';
        foreach ($po->lines->sortBy('line_no') as $ln) {
            $qty = rtrim(rtrim(number_format(Money::d($ln->qty)->toFloat(), 3), '0'), '.');
            $rows .= "<tr><td>{$ln->line_no}</td><td>{$e($ln->description)}</td><td class=r>{$qty}</td><td class=r>{$fmt($ln->unit_price)}</td>"
                .'<td class=r>'.$fmt(Money::q2(Money::d($ln->qty)->multipliedBy($ln->unit_price))).'</td></tr>';
        }
        $html = '<html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><style>body{font-family:DejaVu Sans,sans-serif;font-size:10pt;color:#111}h1{font-size:18pt;margin:0}'
            .'h2{font-size:12pt}table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse}th{background:#10241B;color:#fff;text-align:left;padding:5px}'
            .'td{border:0.4pt solid #B9C1B9;padding:4px}.r{text-align:right}tr.t td{font-weight:bold;border:0}</style></head><body>'
            .'<h1>'.$e($name ?: 'PURCHASE ORDER').'</h1><div>'.($tin ? 'TIN '.$e($tin).' · ' : '').$e($branch->name).'</div>'
            .'<h2>Purchase order '.$e($po->po_no).' · dated '.date('d M Y', strtotime($po->order_date))
            .($po->expected_date ? ' · deliver by '.date('d M Y', strtotime($po->expected_date)) : '').'</h2>'
            .'<div>To: '.$e($po->supplier->name).($po->supplier->tin ? ' · TIN '.$e($po->supplier->tin) : '').'</div><br>'
            .'<table><tr><th>#</th><th>Item / service</th><th class=r>Qty</th><th class=r>Unit price (excl. tax)</th><th class=r>Amount</th></tr>'.$rows
            .'<tr class=t><td></td><td>Total before VAT, NHIL and GETFund</td><td></td><td></td><td class=r>'.$fmt(self::poTotal($po)).'</td></tr></table><br>'
            .'<p>Quote the order number on your delivery note and invoice. Deliver unexpired stock only, with batch numbers and expiry dates on the delivery note. '
            .'Prices exclude VAT, NHIL and GETFund, charged as applicable on your tax invoice.</p><br><p>Raised by '.$e($po->created_by).' · approved by '
            .$e($po->approved_by).'</p></body></html>';

        return Pdf::fromHtml($html, "Purchase order {$po->po_no}");
    }
}

####################################################################################################

<?php

namespace App\Domain;

use App\Models\APInvoice;
use App\Models\ARInvoice;
use App\Models\BankStatementBalance;
use App\Models\Branch;
use App\Models\CashCount;
use App\Models\CashUp;
use App\Models\StockCount;

/**
 * Period-end reconciliation pack (v1.3), for head office and every branch separately: inventory count and valuation,
 * receivables, payables (with goods received not invoiced), bank (each bank and mobile-money account to the statement balance
 * entered), cash (tills and the petty cash vault count) and the fixed asset register. Every section ends in ok true/false with
 * the differences listed; a unit with nothing in a section says so. Port of services/reconcile.py.
 */
final class Reconcile
{
    public const AR_CONTROLS = [1106 => 'Claims – pending submission', 1107 => 'Claims – submitted', 1108 => 'Claims – approved', 1110 => 'Corporate and credit customers'];

    public const AP_CONTROLS = [2010 => 'Trade payables – stock suppliers', 2020 => 'Other payables (bills)'];

    public const BANK_ACCOUNTS = [1030, 1035, 1040, 1045];

    public const INVENTORY_ACCOUNTS = [1200, 1205, 1210, 1215, 1220, 1240];

    public static function inventory(Branch $unit, string $start, string $asOf): array
    {
        $gl = [];
        foreach (self::INVENTORY_ACCOUNTS as $a) {
            $gl[$a] = Money::q2(Reports::accountBalance($a, $asOf, [$unit->id]));
        }
        if ($unit->is_head_office) {
            return ['note' => 'Head office holds no stock', 'ledger' => $gl, 'ok' => ! array_filter($gl, fn ($v) => ! $v->isZero())];
        }
        $rows = Inventory::valuation($unit->id, $asOf);
        $counts = [];
        foreach (StockCount::with('lines.lot.product')->where('branch_id', $unit->id)->where('count_date', '>=', $start)->where('count_date', '<=', $asOf)->orderBy('id')->get() as $c) {
            $diffs = [];
            foreach ($c->lines as $l) {
                if ($l->counted_qty !== null && ! Money::eq($l->counted_qty, $l->system_qty)) {
                    $diffs[] = ['sku' => $l->lot->product->sku, 'batch' => $l->lot->batch_no, 'system' => $l->system_qty, 'counted' => $l->counted_qty,
                        'difference' => Money::d($l->counted_qty)->minus($l->system_qty)];
                }
            }
            $counts[] = ['count_id' => $c->id, 'date' => $c->count_date, 'status' => $c->status, 'counted_by' => $c->counted_by, 'approved_by' => $c->approved_by,
                'variances' => $diffs];
        }
        $rec = Inventory::reconciliation($unit->id, $asOf);

        return ['valuation' => $rows, 'total_value' => Money::q2(Money::sum(array_column($rows, 'value'))),
            'quarantine_value' => Money::q2(Money::sum(array_column($rows, 'quarantine_value'))),
            'nrv_writedown_required' => Money::q2(Money::sum(array_column($rows, 'nrv_writedown'))),
            'expired_or_near_expiry' => array_values(array_filter($rows, fn ($r) => (bool) $r['alert'])), 'counts_in_period' => $counts,
            'last_count_missing' => ! $counts, 'subledger_to_ledger' => $rec, 'ok' => $rec['ok']];
    }

    public static function receivables(Branch $unit, string $start, string $asOf): array
    {
        [$out, $ok] = [[], true];
        foreach (self::AR_CONTROLS as $code => $name) {
            $sub = LedgerReports::subAccounts($code, $start, $asOf, [$unit->id]);
            $row = ['name' => $name, 'ledger' => $sub['gl_closing'], 'sub_accounts_total' => $sub['totals']['closing'], 'unassigned' => $sub['unassigned'],
                'ties' => $sub['ties_to_account'] && $sub['unassigned']->isZero()];
            if ($code === 1110) {
                $row['open_invoices'] = Money::q2(Money::sum(ARInvoice::where('branch_id', $unit->id)->where('invoice_date', '<=', $asOf)->orderBy('id')->get()
                    ->map(fn ($i) => Ar::openAmount($i))->all()));
                $row['note'] = 'Till credit sales to corporate customers are in the sub-ledger without an AR invoice';
            }
            $out[$code] = $row;
            $ok = $ok && $row['ties'];
        }
        $out['allowances'] = ['expected_claim_reductions_1109' => Money::q2(Reports::accountBalance(1109, $asOf, [$unit->id])->negated()),
            'impairment_1120' => Money::q2(Reports::accountBalance(1120, $asOf, [$unit->id])->negated())];
        $out['ok'] = $ok;

        return $out;
    }

    public static function payables(Branch $unit, string $start, string $asOf): array
    {
        [$out, $ok] = [[], true];
        foreach (self::AP_CONTROLS as $code => $name) {
            $sub = LedgerReports::subAccounts($code, $start, $asOf, [$unit->id]);
            $docs = Money::q2(Money::sum(APInvoice::where('branch_id', $unit->id)->where('payable_account', $code)->where('status', '<>', 'HELD')
                ->where('invoice_date', '<=', $asOf)->orderBy('id')->get()->map(fn ($i) => Ap::openAmount($i))->all()));
            $row = ['name' => $name, 'ledger' => Money::q2($sub['gl_closing']->negated()), 'sub_accounts_total' => Money::q2($sub['totals']['closing']->negated()),
                'unassigned' => Money::q2($sub['unassigned']->negated()), 'open_supplier_invoices' => $docs, 'ties' => $sub['ties_to_account'] && $sub['unassigned']->isZero(),
                'note' => 'Deliveries received with the invoice (no order) and opening balances sit in the sub-ledger without an AP invoice'];
            $out[$code] = $row;
            $ok = $ok && $row['ties'];
        }
        $out[2015] = ['name' => 'Goods and services received not invoiced', 'ledger' => Money::q2(Reports::accountBalance(2015, $asOf, [$unit->id])->negated())];
        $out['ok'] = $ok;

        return $out;
    }

    public static function bank(Branch $unit, string $asOf): array
    {
        [$out, $ok] = [[], true];
        foreach (self::BANK_ACCOUNTS as $code) {
            $gl = Reports::accountBalance($code, $asOf, [$unit->id]);
            $st = BankStatementBalance::where('branch_id', $unit->id)->where('account_code', $code)->where('statement_date', '<=', $asOf)
                ->orderByDesc('statement_date')->first();
            if ($st === null) {
                if ($gl->isZero()) {
                    continue;
                }
                $out[$code] = ['ledger' => Money::q2($gl), 'status' => 'Statement balance not entered – reconciliation cannot be completed', 'ok' => false];
                $ok = false;
                continue;
            }
            $r = CashBook::reconciliation($unit->id, $code, $st->statement_date, $st->closing_balance);
            $r['statement_date'] = $st->statement_date;
            $r['statement_reference'] = $st->reference;
            $out[$code] = $r;
            $ok = $ok && ($r['difference'] ?? Money::zero())->isZero();
        }
        if (! $out) {
            $out['note'] = 'No bank or mobile-money balances in this unit';
        }
        $out['ok'] = $ok;

        return $out;
    }

    public static function cash(Branch $unit, string $start, string $asOf): array
    {
        $ups = CashUp::where('branch_id', $unit->id)->where('cash_date', '>=', $start)->where('cash_date', '<=', $asOf)->orderBy('cash_date')->orderBy('id')->get();
        $tills = ['cash_ups' => $ups->count(), 'declared' => Money::q2(Money::sum($ups->pluck('declared')->all())),
            'expected' => Money::q2(Money::sum($ups->pluck('expected')->all())), 'variances' => Money::q2(Money::sum($ups->pluck('variance')->all())),
            'not_approved' => $ups->filter(fn ($c) => $c->status !== 'APPROVED')->map(fn ($c) => ['till' => $c->till, 'date' => $c->cash_date])->values()->all(),
            'missing' => $unit->is_head_office ? [] : CashBook::missingCashups($unit->id, $start, $asOf),
            'till_cash_ledger_1010' => Money::q2(Reports::accountBalance(1010, $asOf, [$unit->id]))];
        $counts = CashCount::where('branch_id', $unit->id)->where('count_date', '>=', $start)->where('count_date', '<=', $asOf)->orderBy('id')->get()
            ->map(fn ($c) => ['date' => $c->count_date, 'counted' => Money::q2($c->counted), 'book' => Money::q2($c->book),
                'vouchers_not_posted' => Money::q2($c->vouchers_not_posted), 'variance' => Money::q2($c->variance), 'counted_by' => $c->counted_by,
                'witnessed_by' => $c->witnessed_by, 'status' => $c->status])->all();
        $petty = PettyCash::status($unit->id, $asOf);
        $petty['counts_in_period'] = $counts;
        $petty['count_missing'] = ! $counts && ! $petty['book_balance']->isZero();
        $ok = ! $tills['missing'] && ! $tills['not_approved'] && ! $petty['count_missing']
            && ! array_filter($counts, fn ($c) => $c['status'] !== 'POSTED' && ! $c['variance']->isZero());

        return ['tills' => $tills, 'petty_cash_vault' => $petty, 'ok' => $ok];
    }

    public static function fixedAssets(Branch $unit, string $asOf): array
    {
        $r = Assets::register($unit->id, $asOf);
        $r['total_cost'] = Money::q2(Money::sum(array_map(fn ($a) => $a['cost'], array_filter($r['assets'], fn ($a) => ! $a['disposed_on']))));
        $r['total_carrying_amount'] = Money::q2(Money::sum(array_column($r['assets'], 'carrying_amount')));
        if (! $r['assets']) {
            $r['note'] = 'No fixed assets recorded for this unit';
        }

        return $r;
    }

    public static function unitPack(int $unitId, string $start, string $asOf): array
    {
        $u = Branch::find($unitId) ?? throw new BusinessRuleError('Unknown unit');
        $pack = ['unit' => $u->code, 'name' => $u->name, 'head_office' => (bool) $u->is_head_office, 'period' => [$start, $asOf],
            'inventory' => self::inventory($u, $start, $asOf), 'receivables' => self::receivables($u, $start, $asOf), 'payables' => self::payables($u, $start, $asOf),
            'bank' => self::bank($u, $asOf), 'cash' => self::cash($u, $start, $asOf), 'fixed_assets' => self::fixedAssets($u, $asOf)];
        $pack['ok'] = ! in_array(false, array_map(fn ($k) => (bool) $pack[$k]['ok'], ['inventory', 'receivables', 'payables', 'bank', 'cash', 'fixed_assets']), true);

        return $pack;
    }

    public static function allUnits(string $start, string $asOf, ?array $unitIds = null): array
    {
        $q = Branch::orderByDesc('is_head_office')->orderBy('code');
        if ($unitIds) {
            $q->whereIn('id', $unitIds);
        }
        $out = [];
        foreach ($q->get() as $u) {
            $out[$u->code] = self::unitPack($u->id, $start, $asOf);
        }

        return $out;
    }

    public static function recordStatementBalance(int $branchId, int $accountCode, string $statementDate, mixed $closingBalance, ?string $reference, string $user): BankStatementBalance
    {
        if (! in_array($accountCode, self::BANK_ACCOUNTS, true)) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Statement balances are for bank and mobile-money accounts (1030, 1035, 1040, 1045)');
        }
        $r = BankStatementBalance::firstOrNew(['branch_id' => $branchId, 'account_code' => $accountCode, 'statement_date' => $statementDate]);
        $r->fill(['closing_balance' => (string) Money::q2($closingBalance), 'reference' => $reference])->save();
        Ledger::audit($user, 'BANK_STATEMENT_BALANCE', 'bank_statement_balance', "{$accountCode}:{$statementDate}", (string) Money::q2($closingBalance));

        return $r;
    }
}
