<?php

namespace App\Domain;

use App\Models\APInvoice;
use App\Models\ARInvoice;
use App\Models\Branch;
use App\Models\Channel;
use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Models\Expense;
use App\Models\FilingRecord;
use App\Models\Journal;
use App\Models\JournalLine;
use App\Models\PayrollLine;
use App\Models\Sale;
use App\Models\Supplier;
use App\Models\SupplierPayment;
use App\Models\WhtType;
use App\Models\WhvatCredit;
use Brick\Math\BigDecimal;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

/**
 * Monthly statutory schedules for returns filed OUTSIDE the software (GRA Taxpayers Portal, SSNIT portal, Tier 2 trustee).
 * One TIN covers all units, so every schedule is for the whole business with a branch column. Each schedule ties to its GL
 * control account; filing is recorded (date, acknowledgement) and payment is posted here. Port of services/schedules.py.
 *
 * Due dates (Revenue Administration Act 915 / SSNIT practice): VAT/NHIL/GETFund – last working day of the following month;
 * PAYE, WHT and withholding VAT – 15th of the following month; SSNIT Tier 1 and Tier 2 – 14th.
 */
final class Schedules
{
    public const OUTPUT = [2100, 2105, 2110];

    public const INPUT = [2115, 2120, 2125];

    public const CONTROL = ['VAT' => [2130], 'PAYE' => [2140], 'SSNIT1' => [2150], 'SSNIT2' => [2155], 'WHT' => [2170, 2175], 'WHVAT' => [2178]];

    public const NAMES = ['VAT' => 'VAT, NHIL and GETFund', 'PAYE' => 'PAYE', 'SSNIT1' => 'SSNIT Tier 1 (13.5%)', 'SSNIT2' => 'Tier 2 pension (5%)',
        'WHT' => 'Withholding tax', 'WHVAT' => 'Withholding VAT (as agent)'];

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ dates and helpers
    public static function monthBounds(int $y, int $m): array
    {
        return [sprintf('%04d-%02d-01', $y, $m), date('Y-m-t', strtotime(sprintf('%04d-%02d-01', $y, $m)))];
    }

    public static function period(int $y, int $m): string
    {
        return sprintf('%04d-%02d', $y, $m);
    }

    private static function holidays(): array
    {
        return array_values(array_filter(array_map('trim', explode(',', Ledger::setting('public_holidays', '') ?? ''))));
    }

    private static function weekend(string $d): bool
    {
        return (int) date('N', strtotime($d)) >= 6;
    }

    public static function dueDates(int $y, int $m): array
    {
        [$ny, $nm] = $m === 12 ? [$y + 1, 1] : [$y, $m + 1];
        $hol = self::holidays();
        $vat = date('Y-m-t', strtotime(sprintf('%04d-%02d-01', $ny, $nm)));
        while (self::weekend($vat) || in_array($vat, $hol, true)) {
            $vat = date('Y-m-d', strtotime("{$vat} -1 day"));
        }
        $d = fn ($day) => sprintf('%04d-%02d-%02d', $ny, $nm, $day);
        $out = ['VAT' => $vat, 'PAYE' => $d(15), 'WHT' => $d(15), 'WHVAT' => $d(15), 'SSNIT1' => $d(14), 'SSNIT2' => $d(14)];
        $notes = array_map(fn ($v) => (self::weekend($v) || in_array($v, $hol, true)) ? 'falls on a weekend/holiday – confirm whether GRA/SSNIT moves it' : '', $out);

        return [$out, $notes];
    }

    public static function codes(): array
    {
        return Branch::orderBy('id')->pluck('code', 'id')->all();
    }

    /** Credits less debits in the period (positive = liability increased). */
    public static function glMovement(array $accounts, string $start, string $end, ?array $sources = null, ?array $excludeSources = ['VATCLOSE', 'TAXPAY'],
        ?int $branchId = null): BigDecimal
    {
        $q = DB::table('journal_line')->join('journal', 'journal.id', '=', 'journal_line.journal_id')->whereIn('journal_line.account_code', $accounts)
            ->where('journal.entry_date', '>=', $start)->where('journal.entry_date', '<=', $end);
        if ($sources) {
            $q->whereIn('journal.source', $sources);
        }
        if ($excludeSources) {
            $q->whereNotIn('journal.source', $excludeSources);
        }
        if ($branchId) {
            $q->where('journal.branch_id', $branchId);
        }

        return Money::q2(Money::db($q->selectRaw('COALESCE(SUM(journal_line.credit - journal_line.debit), 0) AS v')->value('v') ?? '0'));
    }

    public static function tie(mixed $schedule, mixed $gl): array
    {
        $diff = Money::q2(Money::d($schedule)->minus(Money::d($gl)));

        return ['schedule' => Money::q2($schedule), 'gl' => Money::q2($gl), 'difference' => $diff, 'ok' => $diff->isZero()];
    }

    public static function displayName(Employee $e): string
    {
        return implode(' ', array_filter([$e->first_name, $e->other_names, $e->surname])) ?: (string) $e->name;
    }

    /**
     * [line, sign, note]: this month's pay-run lines, less any reversed in the same month, plus negative lines for earlier
     * months' runs reversed in this month (a filed month is never rewritten).
     */
    public static function payrollLines(string $start, string $end): array
    {
        $rev = Journal::whereNotNull('reversal_of_id')->orderBy('id')->pluck('entry_date', 'reversal_of_id')->all();
        $out = [];
        foreach (PayrollLine::with('employee')->where('period_end', '>=', $start)->where('period_end', '<=', $end)->orderBy('branch_id')->orderBy('id')->get() as $l) {
            if (! (isset($rev[$l->journal_id]) && $rev[$l->journal_id] <= $end)) {
                $out[] = [$l, 1, ''];
            }
        }
        foreach ($rev as $orig => $d) {
            if ($start <= $d && $d <= $end) {
                foreach (PayrollLine::with('employee')->where('journal_id', $orig)->where('period_end', '<', $start)->orderBy('id')->get() as $l) {
                    $out[] = [$l, -1, 'Reversal of '.substr($l->period_end, 0, 7).' pay run'];
                }
            }
        }

        return $out;
    }

    private static function sg(int $sg, mixed $v): BigDecimal
    {
        return Money::d($v)->multipliedBy($sg);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ VAT
    public static function vat(int $y, int $m): array
    {
        [$start, $end] = self::monthBounds($y, $m);
        $codes = self::codes();
        $z = BigDecimal::zero();
        $blank = fn () => ['base' => $z, 'gross' => $z, 'vat' => $z, 'nhil' => $z, 'getfund' => $z, 'by_branch' => []];
        $rows = DB::table('sale_line')->join('sale', 'sale_line.sale_id', '=', 'sale.id')->join('product', 'sale_line.product_id', '=', 'product.id')
            ->where('sale.sale_date', '>=', $start)->where('sale.sale_date', '<=', $end)->groupBy('sale.branch_id', 'product.tax_code')
            ->selectRaw('sale.branch_id AS bid, product.tax_code AS code, SUM(sale_line.base) AS base, SUM(sale_line.gross) AS gross, SUM(sale_line.vat) AS vat,
                SUM(sale_line.nhil) AS nhil, SUM(sale_line.getfund) AS getfund')->get();
        $supplies = [];
        foreach ($rows as $r) {
            $k = $supplies[$r->code] ?? $blank();
            foreach (['base', 'gross', 'vat', 'nhil', 'getfund'] as $f) {
                $k[$f] = $k[$f]->plus(Money::db($r->{$f}));
            }
            $k['by_branch'][$codes[$r->bid]] = Money::q2(Money::db($r->gross));
            $supplies[$r->code] = $k;
        }
        $arRows = [];
        foreach (ARInvoice::with('payer')->where('invoice_date', '>=', $start)->where('invoice_date', '<=', $end)->orderBy('id')->get() as $inv) {
            $sg = $inv->kind === 'CREDIT' ? -1 : 1;
            $t = ['base' => $z, 'gross' => $z, 'vat' => $z, 'nhil' => $z, 'getfund' => $z, 'std' => $z, 'zr' => $z, 'ex' => $z];
            foreach (json_decode($inv->lines_json, true) as $x) {
                $code = $x['tax_code'] ?? 'SR20';
                $tx = Tax::addExclusive(Money::q2((string) $x['net']), Tax::ratesFor($code, $inv->invoice_date));
                $k = $supplies[$code] ?? $blank();
                foreach (['base', 'gross', 'vat', 'nhil', 'getfund'] as $f) {
                    $k[$f] = $k[$f]->plus(self::sg($sg, $tx[$f]));
                    $t[$f] = $t[$f]->plus(self::sg($sg, $tx[$f]));
                }
                $bc = $codes[$inv->branch_id];
                $k['by_branch'][$bc] = Money::q2(($k['by_branch'][$bc] ?? $z)->plus(self::sg($sg, $tx['gross'])));
                $supplies[$code] = $k;
                $kk = $code === 'SR20' ? 'std' : ($code === 'ZR' ? 'zr' : 'ex');
                $t[$kk] = $t[$kk]->plus(self::sg($sg, $code === 'SR20' ? $tx['base'] : $tx['gross']));
            }
            $arRows[] = ['branch' => $codes[$inv->branch_id], 'date' => $inv->invoice_date, 'receipt' => $inv->invoice_no, 'payer' => "Invoice to {$inv->payer->code}",
                'standard_excl_tax' => Money::q2($t['std']), 'zero_rated' => Money::q2($t['zr']), 'exempt' => Money::q2($t['ex']), 'vat' => Money::q2($t['vat']),
                'nhil' => Money::q2($t['nhil']), 'getfund' => Money::q2($t['getfund']), 'total' => Money::q2($t['gross']), 'evat' => 'PENDING', 'return_of' => null];
        }
        $sr = $supplies['SR20'] ?? [];
        [$outVat, $outNhil, $outGetf] = array_map(fn ($f) => Money::q2(Money::sum(array_map(fn ($x) => $x[$f], $supplies))), ['vat', 'nhil', 'getfund']);
        $salesList = [];
        foreach (Sale::with(['lines.product', 'payer'])->where('sale_date', '>=', $start)->where('sale_date', '<=', $end)->orderBy('branch_id')->orderBy('sale_date')
            ->orderBy('id')->get() as $sale) {
            $by = fn ($code, $f) => Money::sum($sale->lines->filter(fn ($l) => $l->product->tax_code === $code)->pluck($f)->all());
            $all = fn ($f) => Money::q2(Money::sum($sale->lines->pluck($f)->all()));
            $salesList[] = ['branch' => $codes[$sale->branch_id], 'date' => $sale->sale_date, 'receipt' => $sale->receipt_no, 'payer' => $sale->payer->payer_type,
                'standard_excl_tax' => Money::q2($by('SR20', 'base')), 'zero_rated' => Money::q2($by('ZR', 'gross')), 'exempt' => Money::q2($by('EX', 'gross')),
                'vat' => $all('vat'), 'nhil' => $all('nhil'), 'getfund' => $all('getfund'), 'total' => $all('gross'), 'evat' => $sale->evat_status,
                'return_of' => $sale->original_sale_id];
        }
        $salesList = array_merge($salesList, $arRows);
        $purchases = [];
        $js = Journal::with('lines')->where('entry_date', '>=', $start)->where('entry_date', '<=', $end)
            ->whereIn('source', ['RECEIPT', 'EXPENSE', 'ADJUST', 'APINV', 'APCRN', 'APDBN'])->orderBy('branch_id')->orderBy('entry_date')->orderBy('id')->get();
        foreach ($js as $j) {
            $tax = [];
            foreach (self::INPUT as $a) {
                $tax[$a] = Money::sum($j->lines->where('account_code', $a)->map(fn ($l) => Money::d($l->debit)->minus($l->credit))->all());
            }
            if (! array_filter($tax, fn ($v) => ! $v->isZero())) {
                continue;
            }
            if ($j->source === 'EXPENSE') {
                $e = Expense::where('journal_id', $j->id)->first();
                [$party, $tin, $value] = [$e->payee, $e->payee_tin, Money::d($e->net)];
            } elseif (in_array($j->source, ['APINV', 'APCRN', 'APDBN'], true)) {
                $inv = APInvoice::with('supplier')->where('journal_id', $j->id)->first();
                [$party, $tin] = [$inv->supplier->name, $inv->supplier->tin];
                $value = Money::d($inv->net)->multipliedBy($inv->kind === 'INVOICE' ? 1 : -1);
            } else {
                $supLines = $j->lines->where('account_code', 2010);
                $code = $supLines->first(fn ($l) => (bool) $l->party)?->party;
                $sup = $code ? Supplier::where('code', $code)->first() : null;
                [$party, $tin] = [$sup ? $sup->name : $code, $sup?->tin];
                $value = Money::sum($supLines->map(fn ($l) => Money::d($l->credit)->minus($l->debit))->all())->minus(Money::sum($tax));
            }
            $purchases[] = ['branch' => $codes[$j->branch_id], 'date' => $j->entry_date, 'document' => $j->source_ref, 'kind' => $j->source, 'supplier' => $party,
                'tin' => $tin, 'value_excl_tax' => Money::q2($value), 'input_vat' => Money::q2($tax[2115]), 'input_nhil' => Money::q2($tax[2120]),
                'input_getfund' => Money::q2($tax[2125]), 'flag' => $tin ? '' : 'SUPPLIER TIN MISSING'];
        }
        [$inVat, $inNhil, $inGetf] = array_map(fn ($k) => Money::q2(Money::sum(array_column($purchases, $k))), ['input_vat', 'input_nhil', 'input_getfund']);
        $summary = ['standard_rated_supplies_excl_tax' => Money::q2($sr['base'] ?? $z), 'zero_rated_supplies' => Money::q2($supplies['ZR']['gross'] ?? $z),
            'exempt_supplies' => Money::q2($supplies['EX']['gross'] ?? $z), 'outside_scope_supplies' => Money::q2($supplies['OS']['gross'] ?? $z),
            'output_vat' => $outVat, 'output_nhil' => $outNhil, 'output_getfund' => $outGetf, 'input_vat' => $inVat, 'input_nhil' => $inNhil,
            'input_getfund' => $inGetf, 'taxable_purchases_excl_tax' => Money::q2(Money::sum(array_column($purchases, 'value_excl_tax')))];
        $summary['net_payable'] = Money::q2($outVat->plus($outNhil)->plus($outGetf)->minus($inVat)->minus($inNhil)->minus($inGetf));
        $credits = WhvatCredit::where('receipt_date', '>=', $start)->where('receipt_date', '<=', $end)->orderBy('id')->get()->map(fn ($c) => [
            'branch' => $codes[$c->branch_id], 'date' => $c->receipt_date, 'customer' => $c->payer_code, 'reference' => $c->invoice_ref,
            'taxable_value' => $c->taxable_value, 'vat_withheld' => $c->amount, 'certificate' => $c->certificate_no])->all();
        $whvatCredit = Money::q2(Money::sum(array_column($credits, 'vat_withheld')));
        $bf = self::vatBroughtForward($y, $m);
        $summary['credit_brought_forward'] = Money::q2(BigDecimal::max($z, $bf));
        $summary['withholding_vat_credits'] = $whvatCredit;
        $available = $summary['credit_brought_forward']->plus($whvatCredit);
        $summary['amount_payable'] = Money::q2(BigDecimal::max($z, $summary['net_payable']->minus($available)));
        $summary['credit_carried_forward'] = Money::q2(BigDecimal::max($z, $available->minus($summary['net_payable'])));
        $unpaid = Money::q2(BigDecimal::max($z, $bf->negated()));
        $ties = ['output tax vs GL 2100-2110' => self::tie($outVat->plus($outNhil)->plus($outGetf), self::glMovement(self::OUTPUT, $start, $end)),
            'input tax vs GL 2115-2125' => self::tie($inVat->plus($inNhil)->plus($inGetf), self::glMovement(self::INPUT, $start, $end)->negated()),
            'withholding VAT credits vs GL 1175' => self::tie($whvatCredit, self::glMovement([1175], $start, $end)->negated())];
        $exc = $unpaid->isZero() ? [] : ["Earlier VAT of {$unpaid} not yet paid – settle it first"];
        foreach ($purchases as $p) {
            if ($p['flag']) {
                $exc[] = "{$p['document']}: {$p['flag']}";
            }
        }
        foreach ($salesList as $x) {
            if ($x['evat'] !== 'SUBMITTED') {
                $exc[] = "{$x['receipt']}: E-VAT {$x['evat']}";
            }
        }

        return ['period' => self::period($y, $m), 'summary' => $summary, 'sales' => $salesList, 'purchases' => $purchases, 'withholding_vat_credits' => $credits,
            'ties' => $ties, 'exceptions' => $exc];
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ PAYE and SSNIT
    public static function paye(int $y, int $m): array
    {
        [$start, $end] = self::monthBounds($y, $m);
        $codes = self::codes();
        $rows = [];
        foreach (self::payrollLines($start, $end) as [$l, $sg, $note]) {
            $e = $l->employee;
            $rows[] = ['branch' => $codes[$l->branch_id], 'staff_no' => $e->staff_no, 'name' => self::displayName($e), 'tin' => $e->tin, 'tax_status' => $l->tax_status,
                'basic' => self::sg($sg, $l->basic), 'allowances' => self::sg($sg, $l->allowances), 'overtime' => self::sg($sg, $l->overtime),
                'total_emoluments' => self::sg($sg, Money::q2(Money::d($l->basic)->plus($l->allowances)->plus($l->overtime))),
                'ssnit_employee' => self::sg($sg, $l->ssnit_employee), 'chargeable_income' => self::sg($sg, $l->chargeable), 'paye' => self::sg($sg, $l->paye),
                'overtime_tax' => self::sg($sg, $l->overtime_tax), 'total_tax' => self::sg($sg, Money::q2(Money::d($l->paye)->plus($l->overtime_tax))), 'note' => $note,
                'flag' => $e->tin ? '' : 'EMPLOYEE TIN (GHANA CARD PIN) MISSING'];
        }
        $total = Money::q2(Money::sum(array_column($rows, 'total_tax')));

        return ['period' => self::period($y, $m), 'rows' => $rows, 'total_paye' => $total,
            'ties' => ['PAYE vs GL 2140' => self::tie($total, self::glMovement([2140], $start, $end))],
            'exceptions' => array_values(array_map(fn ($r) => "{$r['staff_no']}: {$r['flag']}", array_filter($rows, fn ($r) => $r['flag'])))];
    }

    public static function ssnit(int $y, int $m): array
    {
        [$start, $end] = self::monthBounds($y, $m);
        $codes = self::codes();
        $rows = [];
        foreach (self::payrollLines($start, $end) as [$l, $sg, $note]) {
            if (! $l->ssnit_status) {
                continue;
            }
            $e = $l->employee;
            $rows[] = ['branch' => $codes[$l->branch_id], 'staff_no' => $e->staff_no, 'name' => self::displayName($e), 'ssnit_no' => $e->ssnit_no,
                'basic' => self::sg($sg, $l->basic), 'insurable_earnings' => self::sg($sg, $l->insurable), 'employee_5_5' => self::sg($sg, $l->ssnit_employee),
                'employer_13' => self::sg($sg, $l->employer_pension), 'tier1_13_5' => self::sg($sg, $l->tier1), 'tier2_5' => self::sg($sg, $l->tier2), 'note' => $note,
                'flag' => $e->ssnit_no ? '' : 'SSNIT NUMBER MISSING'];
        }
        $t1 = Money::q2(Money::sum(array_column($rows, 'tier1_13_5')));
        $t2 = Money::q2(Money::sum(array_column($rows, 'tier2_5')));

        return ['period' => self::period($y, $m), 'rows' => $rows, 'total_tier1' => $t1, 'total_tier2' => $t2,
            'ties' => ['Tier 1 vs GL 2150' => self::tie($t1, self::glMovement([2150], $start, $end)), 'Tier 2 vs GL 2155' => self::tie($t2, self::glMovement([2155], $start, $end))],
            'exceptions' => array_values(array_map(fn ($r) => "{$r['staff_no']}: {$r['flag']}", array_filter($rows, fn ($r) => $r['flag'])))];
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ WHT and WHVAT
    /** DT 0110 rows: resident status, TIN, name, location, contract amount, gross payment, WHT type (GRA code), rate, tax withheld. */
    public static function wht(int $y, int $m): array
    {
        [$start, $end] = self::monthBounds($y, $m);
        $codes = self::codes();
        $types = WhtType::all()->keyBy('name');
        $rows = [];
        foreach (SupplierPayment::where('pay_date', '>=', $start)->where('pay_date', '<=', $end)->where('wht_amount', '>', 0)->orderBy('id')->get() as $p) {
            $sup = Supplier::find($p->supplier_id);
            $rows[] = ['branch' => $codes[$p->branch_id], 'date' => $p->pay_date, 'resident_status' => $sup->resident_status ?: 'Resident', 'tin' => $sup->tin,
                'payee' => $sup->name, 'location' => $sup->location, 'contract_amount' => Money::d($p->contract_amount ?? $p->wht_base), 'base' => Money::d($p->wht_base),
                'wht_type' => $p->wht_type, 'wht' => Money::d($p->wht_amount), 'certificate' => $p->certificate_no];
        }
        foreach (Expense::where('exp_date', '>=', $start)->where('exp_date', '<=', $end)->where('wht_amount', '>', 0)->orderBy('id')->get() as $e) {
            $rows[] = ['branch' => $codes[$e->branch_id], 'date' => $e->exp_date, 'resident_status' => $e->payee_resident_status ?: 'Resident', 'tin' => $e->payee_tin,
                'payee' => $e->payee, 'location' => $e->payee_location, 'contract_amount' => Money::d($e->contract_amount ?? $e->net), 'base' => Money::d($e->net),
                'wht_type' => $e->wht_type, 'wht' => Money::d($e->wht_amount), 'certificate' => $e->wht_certificate_no];
        }
        foreach ($rows as &$r) {
            $wt = $types[$r['wht_type']] ?? null;
            $r['gra_code'] = $wt?->gra_code;
            $r['rate_pct'] = $r['base']->isZero() ? Money::zero() : Money::q2(Money::div20($r['wht'], $r['base'])->multipliedBy(100));
            $r['flag'] = implode('; ', array_filter([$r['tin'] ? '' : 'PAYEE TIN MISSING', $r['location'] ? '' : 'LOCATION MISSING',
                $r['gra_code'] ? '' : 'NO GRA CODE FOR WHT TYPE', ($wt && $wt->gra_code && $r['resident_status'] !== $wt->residency) ? 'RESIDENCY DOES NOT MATCH WHT TYPE' : '',
                $r['certificate'] ? '' : 'CERTIFICATE NOT ISSUED']));
        }
        unset($r);
        usort($rows, fn ($a, $b) => [$a['branch'], $a['date']] <=> [$b['branch'], $b['date']]);
        $total = Money::q2(Money::sum(array_column($rows, 'wht')));

        return ['period' => self::period($y, $m), 'rows' => $rows, 'total_wht' => $total,
            'ties' => ['WHT vs GL 2170 + 2175' => self::tie($total, self::glMovement([2170, 2175], $start, $end))],
            'exceptions' => array_values(array_map(fn ($r) => "{$r['payee']} {$r['date']}: {$r['flag']}", array_filter($rows, fn ($r) => $r['flag'])))];
    }

    /** Withholding VAT return for an appointed agent: withholdee, TIN, invoice date and number, payment date, taxable value, VAT withheld (7%), certificate. */
    public static function whvat(int $y, int $m): array
    {
        [$start, $end] = self::monthBounds($y, $m);
        $codes = self::codes();
        $rows = [];
        foreach (SupplierPayment::where('pay_date', '>=', $start)->where('pay_date', '<=', $end)->where('whvat_amount', '>', 0)->orderBy('id')->get() as $p) {
            $sup = Supplier::find($p->supplier_id);
            $rows[] = ['branch' => $codes[$p->branch_id], 'withholdee' => $sup->name, 'tin' => $sup->tin, 'invoice_date' => $p->invoice_date, 'invoice_no' => $p->invoice_no,
                'payment_date' => $p->pay_date, 'taxable_value' => Money::d($p->whvat_base), 'vat_withheld' => Money::d($p->whvat_amount), 'certificate' => $p->whvat_certificate_no];
        }
        foreach (Expense::where('exp_date', '>=', $start)->where('exp_date', '<=', $end)->where('whvat_amount', '>', 0)->orderBy('id')->get() as $e) {
            $rows[] = ['branch' => $codes[$e->branch_id], 'withholdee' => $e->payee, 'tin' => $e->payee_tin, 'invoice_date' => $e->invoice_date, 'invoice_no' => $e->invoice_no,
                'payment_date' => $e->exp_date, 'taxable_value' => Money::d($e->whvat_base), 'vat_withheld' => Money::d($e->whvat_amount), 'certificate' => $e->whvat_certificate_no];
        }
        usort($rows, fn ($a, $b) => [$a['payment_date'], $a['withholdee']] <=> [$b['payment_date'], $b['withholdee']]);
        foreach ($rows as $i => &$r) {
            $r['serial'] = $i + 1;
            $r['flag'] = implode('; ', array_filter([$r['tin'] ? '' : 'TIN MISSING', ($r['invoice_date'] && $r['invoice_no']) ? '' : 'INVOICE DATE/NUMBER MISSING',
                $r['certificate'] ? '' : 'CREDIT CERTIFICATE NOT ISSUED']));
        }
        unset($r);
        $total = Money::q2(Money::sum(array_column($rows, 'vat_withheld')));

        return ['period' => self::period($y, $m), 'nil' => ! $rows, 'rows' => $rows, 'total_taxable' => Money::q2(Money::sum(array_column($rows, 'taxable_value'))),
            'total_whvat' => $total, 'ties' => ['WHVAT vs GL 2178' => self::tie($total, self::glMovement([2178], $start, $end))],
            'exceptions' => array_values(array_map(fn ($r) => "{$r['serial']} {$r['withholdee']}: {$r['flag']}", array_filter($rows, fn ($r) => $r['flag'])))];
    }

    public static function all(int $y, int $m): array
    {
        return ['vat' => self::vat($y, $m), 'paye' => self::paye($y, $m), 'ssnit' => self::ssnit($y, $m), 'wht' => self::wht($y, $m), 'whvat' => self::whvat($y, $m)];
    }

    public static function amountDue(string $taxType, int $y, int $m): BigDecimal
    {
        return match ($taxType) {
            'VAT' => self::vat($y, $m)['summary']['amount_payable'],
            'PAYE' => self::paye($y, $m)['total_paye'],
            'SSNIT1' => self::ssnit($y, $m)['total_tier1'],
            'SSNIT2' => self::ssnit($y, $m)['total_tier2'],
            'WHT' => self::wht($y, $m)['total_wht'],
            'WHVAT' => self::whvat($y, $m)['total_whvat'],
            default => throw new BusinessRuleError("Tax type must be one of ['VAT', 'PAYE', 'SSNIT1', 'SSNIT2', 'WHT', 'WHVAT']"),
        };
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ filing calendar, filing record, VAT close, payment
    private static function days(string $a, string $b): int
    {
        return (int) round((strtotime($b) - strtotime($a)) / 86400);
    }

    public static function calendar(int $y, int $m, string $today): array
    {
        [$dues, $notes] = self::dueDates($y, $m);
        $ts = Ledger::setting('trading_start', '') ?? '';
        $before = $ts !== '' && self::monthBounds($y, $m)[1] < $ts;
        $period = self::period($y, $m);
        $out = [];
        foreach (['VAT', 'PAYE', 'SSNIT1', 'SSNIT2', 'WHT', 'WHVAT'] as $t) {
            $amt = self::amountDue($t, $y, $m);
            if ($t === 'WHVAT' && Ledger::setting('whvat_agent', 'No') !== 'Yes' && $amt->isZero()) {
                continue; // not an appointed agent and nothing withheld: no WHVAT return
            }
            $rec = FilingRecord::where('tax_type', $t)->where('period', $period)->first();
            $status = match (true) {
                $before => 'Before trading start',
                $rec && $rec->paid_on => 'Filed and paid',
                $rec && $rec->filed_on => $today <= $dues[$t] ? 'Filed – payment outstanding' : 'OVERDUE PAYMENT',
                $today > $dues[$t] => 'OVERDUE',
                self::days($today, $dues[$t]) <= 5 => 'Due within 5 days',
                default => 'Not yet due',
            };
            $out[] = ['tax' => self::NAMES[$t], 'code' => $t, 'period' => $period, 'due' => $dues[$t], 'note' => $notes[$t], 'weekday' => date('D', strtotime($dues[$t])),
                'amount' => $amt, 'filed_on' => $rec?->filed_on, 'reference' => $rec?->reference, 'paid_on' => $rec?->paid_on, 'status' => $status];
        }

        return $out;
    }

    /** Records a return filed on the GRA/SSNIT portal. The declared amount must equal the schedule, so the return and the books agree. */
    public static function recordFiling(string $taxType, int $y, int $m, string $filedOn, ?string $reference, mixed $amountDeclared, string $user): FilingRecord
    {
        $expected = self::amountDue($taxType, $y, $m);
        if (! Money::q2($amountDeclared)->isEqualTo($expected)) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Declared '.Money::q2($amountDeclared)." differs from the schedule {$expected}; correct the books or the return first");
        }
        if (! $reference) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Enter the portal acknowledgement / reference number');
        }
        $period = self::period($y, $m);
        $rec = FilingRecord::where('tax_type', $taxType)->where('period', $period)->first();
        if ($rec && $rec->filed_on) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("{$taxType} {$period} already recorded as filed on {$rec->filed_on} ({$rec->reference})");
        }
        $rec ??= new FilingRecord(['tax_type' => $taxType, 'period' => $period, 'paid_amount' => '0']);
        $rec->fill(['amount_declared' => (string) $expected, 'filed_on' => $filedOn, 'reference' => $reference, 'filed_by' => $user])->save();
        Ledger::audit($user, 'RETURN_FILED', 'filing_record', $rec->id, "{$taxType} {$period} {$expected} ref {$reference}");

        return $rec;
    }

    /** DT 0108 set for $year: due 30 April of the next year. Ties the annual tax to the twelve monthly PAYE returns recorded as filed. */
    public static function annualReturnStatus(int $year, string $today): array
    {
        $ded = PayrollReports::annualPayeDeductions($year);
        $rec = FilingRecord::where('tax_type', 'PAYE-ANN')->where('period', (string) $year)->first();
        $filed = FilingRecord::where('tax_type', 'PAYE')->where('period', 'like', "{$year}-%")->whereNotNull('filed_on');
        $monthly = Money::q2(Money::sum((clone $filed)->pluck('amount_declared')->all()));
        $monthsFiled = (clone $filed)->count();
        $due = ($year + 1).'-04-30';
        $status = match (true) {
            $rec && $rec->filed_on => 'Filed',
            ! $ded['rows'] => 'No payroll in the year',
            $today > $due => 'OVERDUE',
            $today >= ($year + 1).'-01-01' => self::days($today, $due) > 30 ? 'Due by 30 April' : 'Due within 30 days',
            default => 'Year not ended',
        };
        $tax = $ded['totals']['total_tax'] ?? Money::zero();

        return ['tax' => 'Annual PAYE return (DT 0108, 0108A, 0108B)', 'code' => 'PAYE-ANN', 'year' => $year, 'due' => $due, 'status' => $status, 'total_tax' => $tax,
            'employees' => count($ded['rows']), 'filed_on' => $rec?->filed_on, 'reference' => $rec?->reference,
            'checks' => $ded['checks'] + ["Annual tax vs monthly PAYE returns filed ({$monthsFiled} months)" => self::tie($tax, $monthly)]];
    }

    public static function recordAnnualFiling(int $year, string $filedOn, ?string $reference, mixed $amountDeclared, string $user): void
    {
        $st = self::annualReturnStatus($year, $filedOn);
        if ($st['filed_on']) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("The {$year} annual return was recorded as filed on {$st['filed_on']} ({$st['reference']})");
        }
        if (! Money::q2($amountDeclared)->isEqualTo(Money::q2($st['total_tax']))) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Declared '.Money::q2($amountDeclared).' differs from the annual schedule '.Money::q2($st['total_tax']));
        }
        if (! $reference) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Enter the portal acknowledgement / reference number');
        }
        FilingRecord::create(['tax_type' => 'PAYE-ANN', 'period' => (string) $year, 'amount_declared' => (string) Money::q2($amountDeclared), 'filed_on' => $filedOn,
            'reference' => $reference, 'filed_by' => $user, 'paid_amount' => '0']);
        Ledger::audit($user, 'RETURN_FILED', 'filing_record', "PAYE-ANN {$year}", "ref {$reference}");
    }

    /** Clears the month's output and input tax accounts of each unit into 2130 VAT settlement control (Cr = payable, Dr = credit). */
    public static function closeVat(int $y, int $m, string $on, string $user, ?string $approver): array
    {
        [$start, $end] = self::monthBounds($y, $m);
        $ref = 'VAT-'.self::period($y, $m);
        if (Journal::where('source', 'VATCLOSE')->where('source_ref', $ref)->exists()) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('VAT for '.self::period($y, $m).' already closed');
        }
        $ids = [];
        foreach (array_keys(self::codes()) as $bid) {
            $p = new Poster;
            foreach (array_merge(self::OUTPUT, self::INPUT, [1175]) as $a) { // 1175 = VAT withheld by customers (credit certificates)
                $mv = self::glMovement([$a], $start, $end, null, ['VATCLOSE', 'TAXPAY'], $bid);
                if ($mv->isPositive()) {
                    $p->dr($a, $mv);
                    $p->cr(2130, $mv);
                } elseif ($mv->isNegative()) {
                    $p->cr($a, $mv->negated());
                    $p->dr(2130, $mv->negated());
                }
            }
            if ($p->lines()) {
                $ids[] = Ledger::post($bid, $on, 'VATCLOSE', $ref, $p->lines(), $user, 'VAT return '.self::period($y, $m).' to settlement control', $approver)->id;
            }
        }

        return $ids;
    }

    /** Posts the payment. Each unit's own liability is cleared; another unit's share goes through 1195 (equal and opposite). */
    public static function pay(string $taxType, int $y, int $m, int $payingBranchId, string $on, string $channel, string $user, ?string $approver): int
    {
        if (! $approver || $approver === $user) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Tax payments need an approver other than the preparer');
        }
        $period = self::period($y, $m);
        [$start, $end] = self::monthBounds($y, $m);
        $rec = FilingRecord::where('tax_type', $taxType)->where('period', $period)->first();
        if ($rec === null || ! $rec->filed_on) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Record the filing (portal reference) before posting the payment');
        }
        if ($rec->paid_on) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("Already paid on {$rec->paid_on}");
        }
        $ch = Channel::find($channel);
        if ($ch === null || ! in_array((int) $ch->account, [1010, 1030, 1040], true)) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Pay from Cash, Bank or MoMo');
        }
        $accounts = self::CONTROL[$taxType] ?? throw new BusinessRuleError("Unknown tax type {$taxType}");
        $codes = self::codes();
        $shares = [];
        foreach (array_keys($codes) as $bid) {
            if ($taxType === 'VAT') { // 2130 per unit up to and including this month's close
                $v = DB::table('journal_line')->join('journal', 'journal.id', '=', 'journal_line.journal_id')->where('journal_line.account_code', 2130)
                    ->whereIn('journal.source', ['VATCLOSE', 'TAXPAY'])->where('journal.source_ref', '<=', "VAT-{$period}")->where('journal.source_ref', 'like', 'VAT-%')
                    ->where('journal.branch_id', $bid)->selectRaw('COALESCE(SUM(journal_line.credit - journal_line.debit), 0) AS v')->value('v');
                $shares[$bid] = [2130 => Money::q2(Money::db($v ?? '0'))];
            } else {
                $shares[$bid] = [];
                foreach ($accounts as $a) {
                    $shares[$bid][$a] = self::glMovement([$a], $start, $end, null, ['VATCLOSE', 'TAXPAY'], $bid);
                }
            }
        }
        $total = Money::q2(Money::sum(array_map(fn ($p) => Money::sum($p), $shares)));
        if ($taxType === 'VAT' && ! Journal::where('source', 'VATCLOSE')->where('source_ref', "VAT-{$period}")->exists()) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Close the VAT period (close_vat) before paying');
        }
        if (! $total->isPositive()) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Nothing payable for this period (a VAT credit is carried forward in 2130)');
        }
        if (! $total->isEqualTo(Money::q2($rec->amount_declared))) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("Ledger liability {$total} differs from the amount filed {$rec->amount_declared}");
        }
        $pl = new Poster;
        foreach ($shares as $bid => $parts) {
            $sub = Money::q2(Money::sum($parts));
            if ($sub->isZero()) {
                continue;
            }
            if ($bid === $payingBranchId) {
                foreach ($parts as $a => $v) {
                    $pl->dr($a, $v);
                }
            } else {
                $pl->dr(1195, $sub, "BR-{$codes[$bid]}");
                $o = new Poster;
                foreach ($parts as $a => $v) {
                    $o->dr($a, $v);
                }
                $o->cr(1195, $sub, "BR-{$codes[$payingBranchId]}");
                Ledger::post($bid, $on, 'TAXPAY', "{$taxType}-{$period}", $o->lines(), $user, self::NAMES[$taxType]." {$period} paid by branch {$codes[$payingBranchId]}", $approver);
            }
        }
        $pl->cr((int) $ch->account, $total);
        $j = Ledger::post($payingBranchId, $on, 'TAXPAY', "{$taxType}-{$period}", $pl->lines(), $user, self::NAMES[$taxType]." {$period}", $approver);
        $rec->update(['paid_on' => $on, 'paid_amount' => (string) $total]);

        return $j->id;
    }

    /** 2130 balance (all units) from earlier months' VAT closes and payments: Dr (+) = credit available, Cr (-) = unpaid. */
    public static function vatBroughtForward(int $y, int $m): BigDecimal
    {
        $v = DB::table('journal_line')->join('journal', 'journal.id', '=', 'journal_line.journal_id')->where('journal_line.account_code', 2130)
            ->whereIn('journal.source', ['VATCLOSE', 'TAXPAY'])->where('journal.source_ref', '<', 'VAT-'.self::period($y, $m))->where('journal.source_ref', 'like', 'VAT-%')
            ->selectRaw('COALESCE(SUM(journal_line.debit - journal_line.credit), 0) AS v')->value('v');

        return Money::q2(Money::db($v ?? '0'));
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ Excel pack
    public static function excelPack(int $y, int $m, string $today): string
    {
        $x = new Xlsx;
        $sch = self::all($y, $m);
        $sub = 'Period '.self::period($y, $m).' – prepared by the pharmacy system for filing on the GRA / SSNIT portals (all branches, one TIN)';
        $ws = $x->sheet('Calendar_and_ties', 'Filing calendar and reconciliations', $sub);
        $r = $x->table($ws, self::calendar($y, $m, $today)) + 2;
        if ($m <= 4) { // the previous year's annual employer return falls due on 30 April
            $st = self::annualReturnStatus($y - 1, $today);
            $x->put($ws, $r, 1, "{$st['tax']} {$st['year']}: due {$st['due']}, tax {$st['total_tax']}, {$st['status']}", true);
            $r += 2;
        }
        $x->put($ws, $r, 1, 'Schedule ties to the general ledger', true);
        foreach ($sch as $sc) {
            foreach ($sc['ties'] as $label => $t) {
                $r++;
                $x->row($ws, $r, [$label, $t['schedule'], $t['gl'], $t['difference'], $t['ok'] ? 'OK' : 'DIFFERENCE']);
            }
        }
        $r += 2;
        $x->put($ws, $r, 1, 'Exceptions to clear before filing', true);
        foreach ($sch as $name => $sc) {
            foreach ($sc['exceptions'] as $e) {
                $x->put($ws, ++$r, 1, strtoupper($name).": {$e}");
            }
        }
        $x->table($x->sheet('VAT_Summary', 'VAT, NHIL and GETFund – return working', $sub),
            array_map(fn ($k, $v) => ['line' => str_replace('_', ' ', $k), 'amount' => $v], array_keys($sch['vat']['summary']), $sch['vat']['summary']));
        $x->table($x->sheet('VAT_Sales', 'Sales schedule by receipt', $sub), $sch['vat']['sales']);
        $x->table($x->sheet('VAT_Purchases', 'Purchases with recoverable input tax', $sub), $sch['vat']['purchases']);
        $x->table($x->sheet('PAYE', 'PAYE schedule', $sub), $sch['paye']['rows']);
        $x->table($x->sheet('SSNIT', 'SSNIT Tier 1 and Tier 2 schedule', $sub), $sch['ssnit']['rows']);
        $x->table($x->sheet('WHT', 'Withholding tax schedule', $sub), $sch['wht']['rows']);
        $w8 = $x->sheet('WHVAT', 'Withholding VAT (as agent) and VAT withheld by customers', $sub);
        $last = $x->table($w8, $sch['whvat']['rows']);
        $x->table($w8, $sch['vat']['withholding_vat_credits'], $last + 3);

        return $x->bytes();
    }
}

####################################################################################################
##### FILE: app/Domain/Statements.php
####################################################################################################

<?php

namespace App\Domain;

use App\Models\Account;
use Brick\Math\BigDecimal;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

/**
 * Financial statements with comparatives (IFRS for SMEs Sections 3-8): profit or loss, financial position, cash flows,
 * changes in equity and notes; receivables and payables ageing. Inter-branch balances eliminated for the whole business.
 * Port of services/statements.py (the full IFRS set with 29 notes is in Ifrs).
 */
final class Statements
{
    public const EQUITY = ['Owner capital', 'Owner drawings', 'Retained earnings', 'Company equity (variant)'];

    public const BUCKETS = [[30, '0-30'], [60, '31-60'], [90, '61-90'], [1000000, 'over 90']];

    private static function equity(array $tb): BigDecimal
    {
        $codes = Account::whereIn('line', self::EQUITY)->pluck('code')->map(fn ($c) => (int) $c)->all();
        $t = BigDecimal::zero();
        foreach ($tb as $c => $v) {
            if (in_array($c, $codes, true)) {
                $t = $t->plus($v);
            }
        }

        return $t->negated();
    }

    public static function changesInEquity(string $start, string $end, ?array $branchIds = null): array
    {
        $opening = Reports::position(date('Y-m-d', strtotime("{$start} -1 day")), $branchIds);
        $closing = Reports::trialBalance($start, $end, $branchIds);
        $mv = function (array $codes) use ($opening, $closing) {
            $t = BigDecimal::zero();
            foreach ($codes as $c) {
                $t = $t->plus($closing[$c] ?? BigDecimal::zero())->minus($opening[$c] ?? BigDecimal::zero());
            }

            return $t->negated();
        };
        $pl = Reports::incomeStatement($closing);
        $openEq = self::equity($opening);
        [$capital, $drawings, $other] = [$mv([3050]), $mv([3055]), $mv([3010, 3040, 3020, 3030])];
        $closeEq = Money::q2($openEq->plus($capital)->plus($drawings)->plus($pl['profit'])->plus($other));
        $bsEq = Reports::balanceSheet($closing)['total_equity'];

        return ['opening' => Money::q2($openEq), 'capital_introduced' => Money::q2($capital), 'drawings' => Money::q2($drawings), 'profit' => $pl['profit'],
            'other' => Money::q2($other), 'closing' => $closeEq, 'per_balance_sheet' => $bsEq, 'check' => Money::q2($closeEq->minus($bsEq))];
    }

    public static function breakdown(array $tb, array $lines, int $sign = 1): array
    {
        $meta = Account::whereIn('line', $lines)->get()->keyBy('code');
        $out = [];
        ksort($tb);
        foreach ($tb as $c => $v) {
            if (isset($meta[$c]) && ! $v->isZero()) {
                $out[] = ['code' => $c, 'account' => $meta[$c]->name, 'amount' => Money::q2($v->multipliedBy($sign))];
            }
        }

        return $out;
    }

    public static function financialStatements(string $fyStart, string $kind = 'year', int $n = 1, ?array $branchIds = null): array
    {
        $cur = Reports::periodRange($fyStart, $kind, $n);
        $comp = Reports::comparativeRange($fyStart, $kind, $n);
        $elim = $branchIds === null;
        $block = function (?array $rng) use ($branchIds, $elim) {
            if ($rng === null) {
                return null;
            }
            [$a, $b] = $rng;
            $tb = Reports::trialBalance($a, $b, $branchIds);

            return ['period' => [$a, $b], 'pl' => Reports::incomeStatement($tb), 'bs' => Reports::balanceSheet($tb, $elim), 'cf' => Reports::cashFlow($a, $b, $branchIds),
                'soce' => self::changesInEquity($a, $b, $branchIds), 'tb' => $tb];
        };
        [$c, $p] = [$block($cur), $block($comp)];
        $tb = $c['tb'];
        $notes = [
            '1 Basis of preparation and policies' => [
                'framework' => Ledger::setting('ifrs_basis', 'IFRS for SMEs'),
                'reporting_entity' => Ledger::setting('business_name', 'Pharmacy').' (sole proprietorship)',
                'currency' => 'Ghana cedi (GHS)',
                'revenue' => 'Sales recognised at the point of sale net of VAT, NHIL, GETFund and discounts; NHIS/insurer revenue net of expected vetting reductions (variable consideration), trued up on vetting.',
                'inventories' => 'Lower of cost and net realisable value; cost formula '.strtolower(str_replace('_', ' ', Ledger::setting('cost_formula', 'WEIGHTED_AVERAGE'))).'; expired stock quarantined and written off.',
                'receivables' => 'Impairment recognised when there is objective evidence of loss (incurred-loss model).',
                'ppe' => 'Cost less straight-line depreciation over useful lives; residual values and lives reviewed annually.',
                'vat_status' => Ledger::setting('vat_registered', 'Yes') === 'Yes' ? 'VAT registered' : 'Not VAT registered: input tax included in cost',
            ],
            '2 Revenue' => self::breakdown($tb, ['Revenue'], -1),
            '3 Cost of sales' => self::breakdown($tb, ['Cost of sales']),
            '4 Operating expenses' => self::breakdown($tb, ['Employee costs', 'Premises costs', 'Administrative expenses', 'Selling and distribution',
                'Depreciation and amortisation', 'Impairment losses']),
            '5 Inventories' => self::breakdown($tb, ['Inventories']),
            '6 Property, plant and equipment and intangibles' => Assets::movementNote($c['period'][0], $c['period'][1], $branchIds),
            '7 Trade and other receivables' => self::breakdown($tb, ['Trade and other receivables']),
            '8 Cash and cash equivalents' => self::breakdown($tb, ['Cash and cash equivalents']),
            '9 Trade and other payables' => self::breakdown($tb, ['Trade and other payables'], -1),
            '10 Tax and employee payables' => self::breakdown($tb, ['Tax payables', 'Employee-related payables'], -1),
            '10A Current tax assets' => ['lines' => self::breakdown($tb, ['Current tax assets']),
                'explanation' => "1170: income tax withheld by customers and insurers (credit on the proprietor's income tax return); "
                    ."1175: VAT withheld by customers, used on the VAT return; both supported by the payers' certificates."],
            '11 Related parties (owner)' => ['capital_introduced' => $c['soce']['capital_introduced'], 'drawings' => $c['soce']['drawings'],
                'other' => "Disclose any other transactions with the owner's family or entities they control."],
        ];
        if ($elim) {
            $notes['12 Inter-branch balances'] = ['eliminated' => true, 'in_transit' => Money::q2($tb[1195] ?? BigDecimal::zero())];
        }
        unset($c['tb']);
        if ($p) {
            unset($p['tb']);
        }
        $checks = ['balance_sheet' => $c['bs']['check'], 'cash_flow' => $c['cf']['check'], 'equity' => $c['soce']['check'],
            'ppe_note' => $notes['6 Property, plant and equipment and intangibles']['check']];

        return ['current' => $c, 'comparative' => $p, 'notes' => $notes, 'checks' => $checks,
            'ok' => ! array_filter($checks, fn ($v) => ! $v->isZero())];
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ ageing
    /**
     * FIFO: each party's increases are invoices; decreases settle the oldest first. Journals whose net effect on the party
     * across the accounts is nil (reclassifications such as claim submission) are ignored.
     */
    public static function ageing(array $accounts, string $asOf, ?array $branchIds, int $increaseSign): array
    {
        $q = DB::table('journal_line')->join('journal', 'journal.id', '=', 'journal_line.journal_id')->whereIn('journal_line.account_code', $accounts)
            ->where('journal.entry_date', '<=', $asOf)->whereNotNull('journal_line.party')->orderBy('journal.entry_date')->orderBy('journal.id')->orderBy('journal_line.id');
        if ($branchIds) {
            $q->whereIn('journal.branch_id', $branchIds);
        }
        $net = [];
        foreach ($q->select('journal.id AS jid', 'journal.entry_date AS d', 'journal_line.party AS party', 'journal_line.debit AS dr', 'journal_line.credit AS cr')->get() as $r) {
            $k = $r->party."\0".$r->jid;
            $net[$k] ??= ['party' => $r->party, 'jid' => (int) $r->jid, 'd' => substr((string) $r->d, 0, 10), 'v' => BigDecimal::zero()];
            $net[$k]['v'] = $net[$k]['v']->plus(Money::db($r->dr)->minus(Money::db($r->cr))->multipliedBy($increaseSign));
        }
        $list = array_values($net);
        usort($list, fn ($a, $b) => [$a['d'], $a['jid']] <=> [$b['d'], $b['jid']]);
        $parties = [];
        foreach ($list as $x) {
            if (! $x['v']->isZero()) {
                $parties[$x['party']][] = [$x['d'], $x['v']];
            }
        }
        $out = [];
        foreach ($parties as $party => $items) {
            $open = [];
            foreach ($items as [$d, $v]) {
                if ($v->isPositive()) {
                    $open[] = [$d, $v];
                } else {
                    $pay = $v->negated();
                    while ($pay->isPositive() && $open) {
                        $take = BigDecimal::min($pay, $open[0][1]);
                        $open[0][1] = $open[0][1]->minus($take);
                        $pay = $pay->minus($take);
                        if ($open[0][1]->isZero()) {
                            array_shift($open);
                        }
                    }
                    if ($pay->isPositive()) {
                        array_unshift($open, [$d, $pay->negated()]); // overpayment / credit balance
                    }
                }
            }
            $row = [];
            foreach (self::BUCKETS as [, $lab]) {
                $row[$lab] = BigDecimal::zero();
            }
            foreach ($open as [$d, $v]) {
                $age = (int) round((strtotime($asOf) - strtotime($d)) / 86400);
                foreach (self::BUCKETS as [$lim, $lab]) {
                    if ($age <= $lim) {
                        $row[$lab] = $row[$lab]->plus($v);
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            $total = Money::sum($row);
            if (! $total->isZero()) {
                $out[] = ['party' => (string) $party, 'total' => Money::q2($total)] + array_map(fn ($v) => Money::q2($v), $row);
            }
        }
        usort($out, fn ($a, $b) => $b['total']->compareTo($a['total']));

        return $out;
    }

    public static function payablesAgeing(string $asOf, ?array $branchIds = null): array
    {
        return self::ageing([2010], $asOf, $branchIds, -1);
    }

    /** Claims (1106-1108, by claim) and corporate customers (1110). The expected-reduction allowance (1109) is shown separately. */
    public static function receivablesAgeing(string $asOf, ?array $branchIds = null): array
    {
        return ['claims' => self::ageing([1106, 1107, 1108], $asOf, $branchIds, 1), 'corporate' => self::ageing([1110], $asOf, $branchIds, 1),
            'allowance_expected_reductions' => Money::q2(Reports::accountBalance(1109, $asOf, $branchIds)->negated())];
    }
}

####################################################################################################

<?php

namespace App\Domain;

use App\Models\Account;
use App\Models\AuditLog;
use App\Models\ClaimEvent;
use App\Models\Expense;
use App\Models\Journal;
use App\Models\PayrollLine;
use App\Models\Sale;
use App\Models\StockLot;
use App\Models\StockMove;
use App\Models\SupplierPayment;
use Brick\Math\BigDecimal;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

/** Drill-down: statement line -> accounts -> ledger -> journal -> source document and audit trail. Port of services/views.py (receipts are in Sales). */
final class Views
{
    public static function lineAccounts(string $line, string $start, string $end, ?array $branchIds = null): array
    {
        $tb = Reports::trialBalance($start, $end, $branchIds);
        $accts = Account::where('line', $line)->orderBy('code')->get();
        if ($accts->isEmpty()) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("No accounts on statement line {$line}");
        }
        $rows = [];
        foreach ($accts as $a) {
            if (isset($tb[(int) $a->code])) {
                $rows[] = ['code' => (int) $a->code, 'name' => $a->name, 'balance' => $tb[(int) $a->code]];
            }
        }

        return ['line' => $line, 'total' => Money::q2(Money::sum(array_column($rows, 'balance'))), 'accounts' => $rows];
    }

    public static function accountLedger(int $code, string $start, string $end, ?array $branchIds = null, ?string $party = null): array
    {
        $acct = Account::find($code) ?? throw new BusinessRuleError("Unknown account {$code}");
        $f = function ($q) use ($branchIds, $party) {
            if ($branchIds) {
                $q->whereIn('journal.branch_id', $branchIds);
            }
            if ($party) {
                $q->where('journal_line.party', $party);
            }

            return $q;
        };
        $base = $f(DB::table('journal_line')->join('journal', 'journal.id', '=', 'journal_line.journal_id')->where('journal_line.account_code', $code)
            ->where('journal.entry_date', '<', $start));
        if ($acct->statement === 'PL') {
            $base->where('journal.entry_date', '>=', $start); // P&L accounts start each period at nil
        }
        $bal = Money::q2(Money::db($base->selectRaw('COALESCE(SUM(journal_line.debit - journal_line.credit), 0) AS v')->value('v') ?? '0'));
        $opening = $bal;
        $codes = Schedules::codes();
        $rows = [];
        $q = $f(DB::table('journal_line')->join('journal', 'journal.id', '=', 'journal_line.journal_id')->where('journal_line.account_code', $code)
            ->where('journal.entry_date', '>=', $start)->where('journal.entry_date', '<=', $end))->orderBy('journal.entry_date')->orderBy('journal.id')->orderBy('journal_line.id')
            ->select('journal.*', 'journal_line.party AS l_party', 'journal_line.memo AS l_memo', 'journal_line.debit', 'journal_line.credit');
        foreach ($q->get() as $r) {
            $bal = Money::q2($bal->plus(Money::db($r->debit))->minus(Money::db($r->credit)));
            $rows[] = ['date' => substr((string) $r->entry_date, 0, 10), 'journal_id' => (int) $r->id, 'branch' => $codes[$r->branch_id], 'source' => $r->source,
                'reference' => $r->source_ref, 'party' => $r->l_party, 'memo' => $r->l_memo ?: $r->memo, 'debit' => Money::q2(Money::db($r->debit)),
                'credit' => Money::q2(Money::db($r->credit)), 'balance' => $bal, 'posted_by' => $r->created_by, 'approved_by' => $r->approved_by];
        }

        return ['account' => $code, 'name' => $acct->name, 'opening' => $opening, 'closing' => $bal, 'lines' => $rows];
    }

    public static function journalDetail(int $journalId): array
    {
        $j = Journal::with('lines')->find($journalId) ?? throw new BusinessRuleError('Journal not found');
        $doc = null;
        if ($j->source === 'SALE') {
            $sale = Sale::with(['lines.product', 'payments', 'payer'])->where('journal_id', $j->id)->first();
            if ($sale) {
                $doc = ['type' => $sale->original_sale_id ? 'Return' : 'Sale', 'receipt' => $sale->receipt_no, 'date' => $sale->sale_date, 'till' => $sale->till,
                    'payer' => $sale->payer->code, 'cashier' => $sale->cashier, 'approved_by' => $sale->approved_by, 'prescription_ref' => $sale->prescription_ref,
                    'lines' => $sale->lines->map(fn ($l) => ['sku' => $l->product->sku, 'qty' => $l->qty, 'price' => $l->unit_price, 'gross' => $l->gross,
                        'vat' => $l->vat, 'cost' => $l->cost])->all(),
                    'payments' => $sale->payments->map(fn ($p) => ['channel' => $p->channel, 'amount' => $p->amount])->all(), 'evat' => $sale->evat_status];
            }
        } elseif ($j->source === 'EXPENSE') {
            $e = Expense::where('journal_id', $j->id)->first();
            if ($e) {
                $doc = ['type' => 'Expense', 'payee' => $e->payee, 'account' => $e->account_code, 'net' => $e->net, 'vat' => $e->vat, 'wht' => $e->wht_amount,
                    'channel' => $e->channel];
            }
        } elseif ($j->source === 'SUPPAY') {
            $p = SupplierPayment::where('journal_id', $j->id)->first();
            if ($p) {
                $doc = ['type' => 'Supplier payment', 'supplier_id' => $p->supplier_id, 'gross' => $p->gross, 'wht' => $p->wht_amount, 'certificate' => $p->certificate_no];
            }
        } elseif ($j->source === 'PAYROLL') {
            $doc = ['type' => 'Pay run', 'lines' => PayrollLine::with('employee')->where('journal_id', $j->id)->orderBy('id')->get()
                ->map(fn ($l) => ['staff' => $l->employee->staff_no, 'basic' => $l->basic, 'paye' => $l->paye, 'net' => $l->net_pay])->all()];
        } elseif ($j->source === 'CLAIM') {
            $doc = ['type' => 'Claim event', 'events' => ClaimEvent::where('journal_id', $j->id)->orderBy('id')->get()
                ->map(fn ($e) => ['event' => $e->event, 'amount' => $e->amount, 'cls' => $e->shortfall_class])->all()];
        }
        $moves = StockMove::where('journal_id', $j->id)->orderBy('id')->get()->map(fn ($m) => ['lot' => $m->lot_id, 'batch' => StockLot::find($m->lot_id)->batch_no,
            'qty' => $m->qty, 'value' => $m->value, 'kind' => $m->kind])->all();
        $trail = AuditLog::where('entity', 'journal')->where('entity_id', (string) $j->id)->orderBy('id')->get()
            ->map(fn ($a) => ['at' => $a->at, 'user' => $a->user, 'action' => $a->action, 'detail' => $a->detail])->all();

        return ['id' => $j->id, 'date' => $j->entry_date, 'source' => $j->source, 'reference' => $j->source_ref, 'memo' => $j->memo, 'posted_by' => $j->created_by,
            'approved_by' => $j->approved_by, 'created_at' => $j->created_at, 'reversal_of' => $j->reversal_of_id,
            'reversed_by' => Journal::where('reversal_of_id', $j->id)->value('id'), 'branch_id' => $j->branch_id,
            'lines' => $j->lines->map(fn ($l) => ['account' => $l->account_code, 'debit' => $l->debit, 'credit' => $l->credit, 'party' => $l->party])->all(),
            'document' => $doc, 'stock_moves' => $moves, 'audit_trail' => $trail];
    }
}

##### FILE: app/Domain/Xlsx.php
####################################################################################################

<?php

namespace App\Domain;

use Brick\Math\BigDecimal;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Cell\Coordinate;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Spreadsheet;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Style\Fill;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Worksheet\Worksheet;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Writer\Xlsx as XlsxWriter;

/**
 * Small wrapper over PhpSpreadsheet for the report packs, in the layout of the Python edition (openpyxl): title in A1 (bold 13),
 * subtitle in A2, header row in dark blue with white bold text, money as numbers with #,##0.00, dates as dd-mmm-yyyy.
 */
final class Xlsx
{
    public Spreadsheet $book;

    private bool $first = true;

    public function __construct()
    {
        $this->book = new Spreadsheet;
        $this->book->getProperties()->setCreator('PharmPOS')->setTitle('PharmPOS report');
    }

    public function sheet(string $title, ?string $heading = null, ?string $sub = null): Worksheet
    {
        if ($this->first) {
            $ws = $this->book->getActiveSheet();
            $this->first = false;
        } else {
            $ws = $this->book->createSheet();
        }
        $ws->setTitle(mb_substr($title, 0, 31));
        if ($heading !== null) {
            $ws->setCellValue('A1', $heading);
            $ws->getStyle('A1')->getFont()->setBold(true)->setSize(13);
        }
        if ($sub !== null) {
            $ws->setCellValue('A2', $sub);
        }

        return $ws;
    }

    public static function col(int $i): string
    {
        return Coordinate::stringFromColumnIndex($i);
    }

    /** Writes one value; BigDecimal as a number with 2 decimals, Y-m-d strings as Excel dates. */
    public function put(Worksheet $ws, int $row, int $col, mixed $v, bool $bold = false): void
    {
        $ref = self::col($col).$row;
        if ($v instanceof BigDecimal) {
            $ws->setCellValue($ref, $v->toFloat());
            $ws->getStyle($ref)->getNumberFormat()->setFormatCode('#,##0.00');
        } elseif (is_string($v) && preg_match('/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/', $v)) {
            $ws->setCellValue($ref, \PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Shared\Date::stringToExcel($v));
            $ws->getStyle($ref)->getNumberFormat()->setFormatCode('dd-mmm-yyyy');
        } elseif (is_bool($v)) {
            $ws->setCellValue($ref, $v ? 'Yes' : 'No');
        } elseif (is_array($v)) {
            $ws->setCellValue($ref, json_encode($v));
        } else {
            $ws->setCellValueExplicit($ref, $v, is_int($v) || is_float($v) ? \PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Cell\DataType::TYPE_NUMERIC
                : ($v === null ? \PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Cell\DataType::TYPE_NULL : \PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Cell\DataType::TYPE_STRING));
        }
        if ($bold) {
            $ws->getStyle($ref)->getFont()->setBold(true);
        }
    }

    public function row(Worksheet $ws, int $row, array $values, bool $bold = false, int $startCol = 1): void
    {
        foreach (array_values($values) as $i => $v) {
            $this->put($ws, $row, $startCol + $i, $v, $bold);
        }
    }

    public function header(Worksheet $ws, int $row, array $labels): void
    {
        foreach (array_values($labels) as $i => $label) {
            $ref = self::col($i + 1).$row;
            $ws->setCellValue($ref, $label);
            $st = $ws->getStyle($ref);
            $st->getFont()->setBold(true)->getColor()->setRGB('FFFFFF');
            $st->getFill()->setFillType(Fill::FILL_SOLID)->getStartColor()->setRGB('1F3864');
            $ws->getColumnDimension(self::col($i + 1))->setWidth(max(12, mb_strlen((string) $label) + 4));
        }
    }

    /** A table of associative rows with headers made from the keys ("total_tax" -> "Total Tax"). Returns the last row used. */
    public function table(Worksheet $ws, array $rows, int $start = 4, ?array $columns = null): int
    {
        if (! $rows) {
            $ws->setCellValue("A{$start}", 'No entries this month');

            return $start;
        }
        $keys = $columns ? array_keys($columns) : array_keys(reset($rows));
        $this->header($ws, $start, $columns ? array_values($columns) : array_map(fn ($k) => ucwords(str_replace('_', ' ', $k)), $keys));
        $r = $start;
        foreach ($rows as $row) {
            $r++;
            foreach ($keys as $i => $k) {
                $this->put($ws, $r, $i + 1, $row[$k] ?? null);
            }
        }

        return $r;
    }

    public function bytes(): string
    {
        $this->book->setActiveSheetIndex(0);
        $w = new XlsxWriter($this->book);
        ob_start();
        $w->save('php://output');

        return (string) ob_get_clean();
    }
}

##### FILE: app/Casts/Exact.php
####################################################################################################

<?php

namespace App\Casts;

use Brick\Math\BigDecimal;
use Brick\Math\RoundingMode;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Database\Eloquent\CastsAttributes;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use InvalidArgumentException;

/**
 * Exact decimal column (money 2 dp, unit costs 6 dp, quantities 3 dp, rates 5 dp). Values are kept as strings such as
 * "170.00" and quantised half away from zero on the way in. Floats are refused: they cannot hold pesewas exactly.
 */
class Exact implements CastsAttributes
{
    public function __construct(private string $scale = '2') {}

    public function get(Model $model, string $key, mixed $value, array $attributes): ?string
    {
        if ($value === null) {
            return null;
        }

        return (string) BigDecimal::of(is_float($value) ? (string) $value : $value)->toScale((int) $this->scale, RoundingMode::HALF_UP);
    }

    public function set(Model $model, string $key, mixed $value, array $attributes): ?string
    {
        if ($value === null) {
            return null;
        }
        if (is_float($value)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("Use a string or BigDecimal for {$key}, never a float");
        }

        return (string) BigDecimal::of((string) $value)->toScale((int) $this->scale, RoundingMode::HALF_UP);
    }
}

##### FILE: app/Http/Middleware/Authenticate.php
####################################################################################################

<?php

namespace App\Http\Middleware;

use App\Domain\PermissionDenied;
use App\Domain\Security;
use Closure;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;

/** Bearer token → signed-in user. With enforce_2fa = Yes, users who must have two-step sign-in can only enrol until it is on. */
class Authenticate
{
    public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next): Response
    {
        $h = (string) $request->header('Authorization');
        if (! str_starts_with($h, 'Bearer ')) {
            throw new PermissionDenied('Sign in first (Authorization: Bearer <token>)');
        }
        $u = Security::userFromToken(substr($h, 7));
        if (Security::twoStepRequired($u) && ! $request->is('api/auth/two-step/*')) {
            throw new PermissionDenied('Turn on two-step sign-in first (/api/auth/two-step/enrol, then /api/auth/two-step/confirm)');
        }
        $request->attributes->set('user', $u);

        return $next($request);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Middleware;

use Closure;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

/** Screens: no framing (click-jacking), no MIME sniffing, forms post only to this site, pages not cached by shared proxies. */
class SecurityHeaders
{
    public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next)
    {
        $res = $next($request);
        $res->headers->set('X-Frame-Options', 'DENY');
        $res->headers->set('X-Content-Type-Options', 'nosniff');
        $res->headers->set('Referrer-Policy', 'same-origin');
        $res->headers->set('Content-Security-Policy', "default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; "
            ."font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com; script-src 'unsafe-inline'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'");
        if (! $res->headers->has('Content-Disposition')) {
            $res->headers->set('Cache-Control', 'no-store, private');
        }

        return $res;
    }
}

####################################################################################################
##### FILE: app/Http/Middleware/TransactionPerRequest.php
####################################################################################################

<?php

namespace App\Http\Middleware;

use App\Domain\Integrity;
use Closure;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Commit when the request succeeds, roll back everything on any error (no partial postings). A controller may set the request
 * attribute "commit_on_error" (failed sign-ins: the attempt must count towards the lock-out). Afterwards the audit rows the
 * request wrote are sealed into the hash chain in a short transaction of their own; a failure there never fails the request.
 */
class TransactionPerRequest
{
    public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next): Response
    {
        $rid = $request->header('X-Request-ID') ?: substr(bin2hex(random_bytes(6)), 0, 12);
        $t0 = microtime(true);
        $level = DB::transactionLevel();
        DB::beginTransaction();
        try {
            $response = $next($request);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            DB::rollBack();
            throw $e;
        }
        $ok = ($response->getStatusCode() < 400 && ! $request->attributes->get('failed')) || $request->attributes->get('commit_on_error');
        $ok ? DB::commit() : DB::rollBack();
        while (DB::transactionLevel() > $level) {
            DB::rollBack();
        }
        try {
            Integrity::seal();
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            Log::warning('audit seal deferred: '.$e->getMessage());
        }
        $response->headers->set('X-Request-ID', $rid);
        Log::info(sprintf('%s %s %s %d %.0fms', $rid, $request->method(), $request->path(), $response->getStatusCode(), (microtime(true) - $t0) * 1000));

        return $response;
    }
}

####################################################################################################
##### FILE: app/Http/Middleware/WebAuth.php
####################################################################################################

<?php

namespace App\Http\Middleware;

use App\Domain\Security;
use App\Models\Branch;
use App\Models\User;
use Closure;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\View;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;

/**
 * Web screens: the session holds the signed-in user. Users with access to every branch open in the read-only "All branches"
 * view and pick a unit to work in; branch-limited users always work in one of their own branches.
 */
class WebAuth
{
    public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next): Response
    {
        $u = User::find($request->session()->get('uid'));
        if ($u === null || ! $u->active) {
            $request->session()->forget('uid');

            return redirect()->route('signin');
        }
        if ($request->session()->get('auth_at', 0) < time() - 60 * (int) config('session.lifetime', 120)) {
            $request->session()->flush();

            return redirect()->route('signin')->with('error', 'Signed out after a period of inactivity');
        }
        $request->session()->put('auth_at', time());
        $allowed = Security::branchIds($u);
        $units = Branch::orderBy('is_head_office')->orderBy('code')->get()->filter(fn ($b) => $allowed === null || in_array($b->id, $allowed, true))->values();
        $code = $request->session()->get('unit');
        $unit = $code ? $units->firstWhere('code', $code) : null;
        if ($unit === null && $allowed !== null) { // branch-limited users never see the all-branches view
            $unit = $units->firstWhere('id', $u->branch_id) ?? $units->first();
            $request->session()->put('unit', $unit?->code);
        }
        $request->attributes->set('user', $u);
        $request->attributes->set('unit', $unit);
        View::share(['me' => $u, 'unit' => $unit, 'units' => $units, 'allBranches' => $allowed === null]);

        return $next($request);
    }
}

####################################################################################################
##### FILE: app/Http/Controllers/Api/ApiController.php
####################################################################################################

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api;

use App\Domain\BusinessRuleError;
use App\Domain\Ledger;
use App\Domain\PermissionDenied;
use App\Domain\Security;
use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\Branch;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

/** Shared helpers: the signed-in user, branch look-up and scoping, approval blocks. */
abstract class ApiController extends Controller
{
    protected function user(Request $r): User
    {
        return $r->attributes->get('user');
    }

    /** Branch id for a code; with a permission, also checks the user may act in that branch. */
    protected function bid(?string $code, ?User $u = null, ?string $perm = null): int
    {
        $b = Branch::where('code', $code)->first();
        if ($b === null) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("Unknown branch {$code}");
        }
        if ($u !== null && $perm) {
            Security::require($u, $perm, $b->id);
        }

        return $b->id;
    }

    /** Branch-limited users only ever see their own branch(es); all-branch users see everything or the branch they pick. */
    protected function scope(User $u, ?string $branch): ?array
    {
        $allowed = Security::branchIds($u);
        if ($allowed !== null) {
            if ($branch) {
                $b = $this->bid($branch);
                if (! in_array($b, $allowed, true)) {
                    throw new PermissionDenied("{$u->username} is limited to other branches");
                }

                return [$b];
            }

            return $allowed;
        }

        return $branch ? [$this->bid($branch)] : null;
    }

    /** v1.2: runs $fn with cash lines paid by the named unit (normally head office); null = paid by the branch itself. */
    protected function paidBy(?string $code, User $u, string $perm, callable $fn): mixed
    {
        return $code ? Ledger::paidBy($this->bid($code, $u, $perm), $fn) : $fn();
    }

    protected function approve(Request $r, string $perm, ?int $branchId = null, mixed $amount = null, string $field = 'approval'): string
    {
        $a = $r->input($field);

        return Security::approve(is_array($a) ? $a : null, $perm, $this->user($r), $branchId, $amount);
    }

    /** JSON numbers become decimal strings (money is never handled as a float). */
    protected function strs(array $a): array
    {
        return array_map(fn ($v) => is_array($v) ? $this->strs($v) : (is_int($v) || is_float($v) ? (string) $v : $v), $a);
    }

    protected const APPROVAL_RULES = ['approval' => 'nullable|array', 'approval.approver' => 'required_with:approval|string',
        'approval.approver_secret' => 'required_with:approval|string'];
}

####################################################################################################
##### FILE: app/Http/Controllers/Api/AuthController.php
####################################################################################################

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api;

use App\Domain\BusinessRuleError;
use App\Domain\Ledger;
use App\Domain\PermissionDenied;
use App\Domain\Security;
use App\Models\Branch;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

/** Sign-in, two-step sign-in and users. */
class AuthController extends ApiController
{
    private const USER_RULES = ['username' => 'required|string|max:60', 'full_name' => 'required|string|max:120',
        'role' => 'required|string', 'password' => 'required|string', 'branch' => 'nullable|string'];

    public function setupAdmin(Request $r)
    {
        $x = $r->validate(self::USER_RULES);
        if (User::query()->exists()) {
            throw new PermissionDenied('Already set up');
        }
        if ($x['role'] !== 'admin') {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('The first user must be an administrator');
        }
        Security::createUser($x['username'], $x['full_name'], 'admin', $x['password'], 'setup');

        return ['ok' => true];
    }

    public function login(Request $r)
    {
        $x = $r->validate(['username' => 'required|string', 'password' => 'required|string', 'code' => 'nullable|string']);
        try {
            $u = Security::authenticate($x['username'], $x['password'], $x['code'] ?? null);
        } catch (BusinessRuleError $e) {
            $r->attributes->set('commit_on_error', true); // keep the failed attempt: it counts towards the lock-out
            throw $e;
        }
        $required = array_map('trim', explode(',', Ledger::setting('require_2fa_roles', '') ?? ''));

        $allowed = Security::branchIds($u);

        return ['token' => Security::issueToken($u), 'role' => $u->role, 'branch_id' => $u->branch_id,
            'all_branches' => $allowed === null, // screens open in the read-only "All branches" view; pick a branch to work in
            'branches' => $allowed === null ? null : Branch::whereIn('id', $allowed)->orderBy('code')->pluck('code')->all(),
            'two_step_enrolment_needed' => in_array($u->role, $required, true) && ! $u->totp_enabled];
    }

    /** Returns a secret and an otpauth:// link (show it as a QR code); not active until confirmed with a code. */
    public function enrol(Request $r)
    {
        return Security::enrollTotp($this->user($r));
    }

    public function confirm(Request $r)
    {
        $x = $r->validate(['code' => 'required|string']);
        Security::confirmTotp($this->user($r), $x['code']);

        return ['ok' => true];
    }

    public function reset(Request $r, string $username)
    {
        Security::require($this->user($r), 'users.manage');
        Security::resetTotp($username, $this->user($r)->username);

        return ['ok' => true];
    }

    public function index(Request $r)
    {
        Security::require($this->user($r), 'users.manage');

        return User::orderBy('username')->get()->map(fn ($x) => ['username' => $x->username, 'full_name' => $x->full_name,
            'role' => $x->role, 'branch_id' => $x->branch_id, 'active' => $x->active, 'two_step' => $x->totp_enabled])->all();
    }

    public function store(Request $r)
    {
        $u = $this->user($r);
        Security::require($u, 'users.manage');
        $x = $r->validate(self::USER_RULES);
        Security::createUser($x['username'], $x['full_name'], $x['role'], $x['password'], $u->username,
            ! empty($x['branch']) ? $this->bid($x['branch']) : null);

        return ['ok' => true];
    }

    public function disable(Request $r, string $username)
    {
        Security::require($this->user($r), 'users.manage');
        Security::setActive($username, false, $this->user($r)->username);

        return ['ok' => true];
    }

    /** Home branch plus further branches (e.g. an inventory officer covering two branches). Blank = all branches. */
    public function branches(Request $r, string $username)
    {
        $u = $this->user($r);
        Security::require($u, 'users.manage');
        Security::requireAllBranches($u);
        $x = $r->validate(['home_branch' => 'nullable|string', 'extra_branches' => 'array', 'extra_branches.*' => 'string']);
        Security::setUserBranches($username, ! empty($x['home_branch']) ? $this->bid($x['home_branch']) : null,
            array_map(fn ($c) => $this->bid($c), $x['extra_branches'] ?? []), $u->username);

        return ['ok' => true];
    }
}
