<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api;

use App\Domain\Batches;
use App\Domain\Security;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

/** Batch entry (GL, cash, AR, AP, stock, petty cash vault, bank) and recurring journals. */
class BatchController extends ApiController
{
    public const TYPE_PERMISSION = ['GL' => 'journal.create', 'CASH' => 'expense.create', 'PETTY' => 'expense.create', 'BANK' => 'cash.bank', 'AR' => 'ar.manage',
        'AP' => 'ap.manage', 'INV' => 'stock.adjust'];

    private function canCreate(User $u, string $type, ?int $branchId = null): void
    {
        Security::require($u, 'batch.create', $branchId);
        Security::require($u, self::TYPE_PERMISSION[$type], $branchId);
    }

    public function create(Request $r)
    {
        $x = $this->strs($r->validate(['branch' => 'required|string', 'type' => 'required|in:GL,CASH,AR,AP,INV,PETTY,BANK', 'description' => 'required|string|max:120',
            'control_total' => 'required|numeric', 'control_count' => 'required|integer|min:1']));
        $u = $this->user($r);
        $b = $this->bid($x['branch']);
        $this->canCreate($u, $x['type'], $b);

        return ['batch_no' => Batches::createBatch($x['type'], $b, $x['description'], $x['control_total'], (int) $x['control_count'], $u->username)->batch_no];
    }

    public function open(Request $r)
    {
        $u = $this->user($r);
        Security::require($u, 'reports.view');

        return Batches::openBatches($this->scope($u, $r->query('branch')));
    }

    public function register(Request $r)
    {
        $u = $this->user($r);
        Security::require($u, 'reports.view');

        return Batches::register($r->query('start'), $r->query('end'), $r->query('user'), $r->query('status'), $r->query('type'), $this->scope($u, $r->query('branch')));
    }

    public function show(Request $r, string $batchNo)
    {
        $u = $this->user($r);
        $l = Batches::listing($batchNo);
        Security::require($u, 'reports.view', $l['branch_id']);

        return $l;
    }

    private function batch(Request $r, string $batchNo): User
    {
        $b = Batches::get($batchNo);
        $u = $this->user($r);
        $this->canCreate($u, $b->batch_type, $b->branch_id);

        return $u;
    }

    public function addEntry(Request $r, string $batchNo)
    {
        $x = $r->validate(['kind' => 'required|string', 'date' => 'required|date_format:Y-m-d', 'reference' => 'required|string|max:60', 'payload' => 'required|array']);
        $u = $this->batch($r, $batchNo);
        $e = Batches::addEntry($batchNo, $x['kind'], $x['date'], $x['reference'], $u->username, $this->strs($x['payload']));

        return ['seq' => (int) $e->seq, 'amount' => $e->amount] + Batches::totals(Batches::get($batchNo));
    }

    public function updateEntry(Request $r, string $batchNo, int $seq)
    {
        $x = $r->validate(['date' => 'nullable|date_format:Y-m-d', 'reference' => 'nullable|string|max:60', 'payload' => 'nullable|array']);
        $u = $this->batch($r, $batchNo);
        $e = Batches::updateEntry($batchNo, $seq, $u->username, $x['date'] ?? null, $x['reference'] ?? null, isset($x['payload']) ? $this->strs($x['payload']) : null);

        return ['seq' => (int) $e->seq, 'amount' => $e->amount];
    }

    public function deleteEntry(Request $r, string $batchNo, int $seq)
    {
        Batches::deleteEntry($batchNo, $seq, $this->batch($r, $batchNo)->username);

        return ['ok' => true];
    }

    public function delete(Request $r, string $batchNo)
    {
        Batches::deleteBatch($batchNo, $this->batch($r, $batchNo)->username);

        return ['ok' => true];
    }

    public function check(Request $r, string $batchNo)
    {
        $b = Batches::get($batchNo);
        $u = $this->user($r);
        Security::require($u, 'reports.view', $b->branch_id);

        return Batches::check($batchNo, $u->username);
    }

    public function post(Request $r, string $batchNo)
    {
        $r->validate(['approval' => 'required|array'] + self::APPROVAL_RULES);
        $b = Batches::get($batchNo);
        $u = $this->user($r);
        Security::require($u, 'reports.view', $b->branch_id);
        $ap = $this->approve($r, 'batch.approve', $b->branch_id, $b->batch_type === 'INV' ? null : $b->control_total); // INV totals are quantities

        return Batches::postBatch($batchNo, $u->username, $ap);
    }

    public function reverse(Request $r, string $batchNo)
    {
        $x = $r->validate(['date' => 'required|date_format:Y-m-d', 'reason' => 'required|string', 'approval' => 'required|array'] + self::APPROVAL_RULES);
        $b = Batches::get($batchNo);
        $u = $this->user($r);
        $this->canCreate($u, $b->batch_type, $b->branch_id);
        $rb = Batches::reverseBatch($batchNo, $x['date'], $x['reason'], $u->username, $this->approve($r, 'batch.approve', $b->branch_id));

        return ['reversal_batch' => $rb->batch_no];
    }

    /** Body: the CSV text (Content-Type text/plain or text/csv). */
    public function importCsv(Request $r, string $batchNo)
    {
        $u = $this->batch($r, $batchNo);
        $n = Batches::importGlCsv($batchNo, $r->getContent(), $u->username);

        return ['journals_added' => $n] + Batches::totals(Batches::get($batchNo));
    }

    public function recurring(Request $r)
    {
        $x = $r->validate(['name' => 'required|string|max:60', 'branch' => 'required|string', 'lines' => 'required|array|min:2', 'start_month' => 'required|date_format:Y-m-d',
            'end_month' => 'nullable|date_format:Y-m-d', 'approval' => 'required|array'] + self::APPROVAL_RULES);
        $u = $this->user($r);
        $b = $this->bid($x['branch'], $u, 'journal.create');
        $rj = Batches::createRecurring($x['name'], $b, $this->strs($x['lines']), $x['start_month'], $u->username, $this->approve($r, 'journal.approve', $b), $x['end_month'] ?? null);

        return ['id' => $rj->id];
    }

    public function generate(Request $r)
    {
        $x = $r->validate(['period_end' => 'required|date_format:Y-m-d']);
        $u = $this->user($r);
        Security::require($u, 'journal.create');

        return ['batches' => Batches::generateRecurring($x['period_end'], $u->username)];
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api;

use App\Domain\BusinessRuleError;
use App\Domain\CashBook;
use App\Domain\Security;
use App\Models\BankStatementLine;
use App\Models\CashUp;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

/** Cash shifts (declare, supervisor approval), banking takings, cash between branches, bank statements and reconciliation. */
class CashController extends ApiController
{
    private const D = 'required|date_format:Y-m-d';

    public function declare(Request $r)
    {
        $x = $this->strs($r->validate(['branch' => 'required|string', 'till' => 'required|string', 'date' => self::D, 'counted' => 'required|numeric|min:0']));
        $u = $this->user($r);

        return CashBook::declareCash($this->bid($x['branch'], $u, 'cashup.declare'), $x['till'], $x['date'], $u->username, $x['counted']);
    }

    public function approveCashup(Request $r, int $cashupId)
    {
        $c = CashUp::find($cashupId) ?? throw new BusinessRuleError('Cash-up not found');
        $u = $this->user($r);
        Security::require($u, 'cashup.approve', $c->branch_id);

        return CashBook::approveCashup($cashupId, $u->username, $r->input('reason'));
    }

    public function missing(Request $r, string $branch)
    {
        $x = $r->validate(['start' => self::D, 'end' => self::D]);

        return CashBook::missingCashups($this->bid($branch, $this->user($r), 'reports.view'), $x['start'], $x['end']);
    }

    public function bankDeposit(Request $r)
    {
        $x = $this->strs($r->validate(['branch' => 'required|string', 'on' => self::D, 'amount' => 'required|numeric|gt:0', 'deposit_ref' => 'required|string',
            'approval' => 'required|array'] + self::APPROVAL_RULES));
        $u = $this->user($r);
        $b = $this->bid($x['branch'], $u, 'cash.bank');
        $ap = $this->approve($r, 'cashup.approve', $b);

        return ['journal_id' => CashBook::bankCash($b, $x['on'], $x['amount'], $x['deposit_ref'], $u->username, $ap)];
    }

    public function interBranch(Request $r)
    {
        $x = $this->strs($r->validate(['from_branch' => 'required|string', 'to_branch' => 'required|string', 'on' => self::D, 'amount' => 'required|numeric|gt:0',
            'from_channel' => 'required|string', 'to_channel' => 'required|string', 'reference' => 'nullable|string', 'approval' => 'required|array']
            + self::APPROVAL_RULES));
        $u = $this->user($r);
        $a = $this->bid($x['from_branch'], $u, 'cash.bank');
        $ap = $this->approve($r, 'cashup.approve', $a);

        return ['amount' => (string) CashBook::interBranch($a, $this->bid($x['to_branch']), $x['on'], $x['amount'], $x['from_channel'], $x['to_channel'],
            $x['reference'] ?? null, $u->username, $ap)];
    }

    public function importStatement(Request $r)
    {
        $x = $this->strs($r->validate(['branch' => 'required|string', 'account_code' => 'required|integer', 'lines' => 'required|array|min:1',
            'lines.*.date' => self::D, 'lines.*.amount' => 'required|numeric', 'lines.*.description' => 'required|string', 'lines.*.reference' => 'nullable|string']));
        $u = $this->user($r);
        $b = $this->bid($x['branch'], $u, 'bank.reconcile');
        $n = CashBook::importStatement($b, (int) $x['account_code'], $x['lines'], $u->username);

        return ['imported' => $n, 'matched' => CashBook::autoMatch($b, (int) $x['account_code'])];
    }

    public function postItem(Request $r, int $lineId)
    {
        $x = $r->validate(['contra_account' => 'required|integer']);
        $u = $this->user($r);
        $line = BankStatementLine::find($lineId) ?? throw new BusinessRuleError('Statement line not found');
        Security::require($u, 'bank.reconcile', $line->branch_id);

        return ['journal_id' => CashBook::postStatementItem($lineId, (int) $x['contra_account'], $u->username)];
    }

    public function reconciliation(Request $r)
    {
        $x = $this->strs($r->validate(['branch' => 'required|string', 'account_code' => 'required|integer', 'as_of' => self::D,
            'statement_balance' => 'required|numeric', 'gl_from' => 'nullable|date_format:Y-m-d']));

        return CashBook::reconciliation($this->bid($x['branch'], $this->user($r), 'bank.reconcile'), (int) $x['account_code'], $x['as_of'],
            $x['statement_balance'], $x['gl_from'] ?? null);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api;

use App\Domain\Admin;
use App\Domain\Branches;
use App\Domain\Ledger;
use App\Domain\Security;
use App\Models\Branch;
use App\Models\Payer;
use App\Models\Setting;
use App\Models\WhtType;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

/** Branches, payers, controlled settings, tax rates, PAYE tables and WHT rates. */
class ConfigController extends ApiController
{
    /** Administrator only. is_head_office: the non-trading head office unit (at most one). */
    public function addBranch(Request $r)
    {
        $u = $this->user($r);
        Security::require($u, 'users.manage');
        Security::requireAllBranches($u);
        $x = $r->validate(['code' => 'required|string|max:10', 'name' => 'required|string|max:120', 'is_head_office' => 'nullable|boolean']);
        $b = Branches::create($x['code'], $x['name'], $u->username, (bool) ($x['is_head_office'] ?? false));

        return ['ok' => true, 'branch_id' => $b->id];
    }

    public function branches(Request $r)
    {
        $allowed = Security::branchIds($this->user($r));

        return Branch::orderBy('is_head_office')->orderBy('code')->get()
            ->filter(fn ($b) => $allowed === null || in_array($b->id, $allowed, true))
            ->map(fn ($b) => ['code' => $b->code, 'name' => $b->name, 'head_office' => $b->is_head_office])->values()->all();
    }

    public function addPayer(Request $r)
    {
        $u = $this->user($r);
        Security::require($u, 'masterdata.manage');
        $x = $r->validate(['code' => 'required|string|max:20', 'name' => 'required|string|max:120',
            'payer_type' => 'required|in:Retail,NHIS,Insurer,Corporate', 'copay_pct' => 'nullable|numeric',
            'expected_reduction_pct' => 'nullable|numeric', 'credit_limit' => 'nullable|numeric', 'payment_terms_days' => 'nullable|integer']);
        Payer::create(['code' => $x['code'], 'name' => $x['name'], 'payer_type' => $x['payer_type'],
            'copay_pct' => (string) ($x['copay_pct'] ?? '1'), 'expected_reduction_pct' => (string) ($x['expected_reduction_pct'] ?? '0'),
            'credit_limit' => (string) ($x['credit_limit'] ?? '0'), 'claim_deadline_days' => 0, 'payment_terms_days' => $x['payment_terms_days'] ?? 30]);
        Ledger::audit($u->username, 'PAYER_CREATE', 'payer', $x['code']);

        return ['ok' => true];
    }

    public function settings(Request $r)
    {
        Security::require($this->user($r), 'reports.view');

        return Setting::orderBy('key')->pluck('value', 'key')->all();
    }

    public function putSetting(Request $r, string $key)
    {
        $u = $this->user($r);
        Security::require($u, 'settings.propose');
        $x = $r->validate(['value' => 'present|nullable|string', 'reason' => 'required|string'] + self::APPROVAL_RULES);
        $ap = $this->approve($r, 'settings.approve');
        Admin::changeSetting($key, (string) ($x['value'] ?? ''), $x['reason'], $u->username, $ap);

        return ['ok' => true];
    }

    public function history(Request $r)
    {
        Security::require($this->user($r), 'audit.view');

        return Admin::history($r->query('key'));
    }

    public function addTaxRate(Request $r)
    {
        $u = $this->user($r);
        Security::require($u, 'settings.propose');
        $x = $r->validate(['code' => 'required|string|max:10', 'description' => 'required|string', 'vat' => 'required|numeric',
            'nhil' => 'required|numeric', 'getfund' => 'required|numeric', 'effective_from' => 'required|date_format:Y-m-d',
            'legal_basis' => 'required|string'] + self::APPROVAL_RULES);
        $ap = $this->approve($r, 'settings.approve');
        Admin::addTaxRate($x['code'], $x['description'], (string) $x['vat'], (string) $x['nhil'], (string) $x['getfund'],
            $x['effective_from'], $x['legal_basis'], $u->username, $ap);

        return ['ok' => true];
    }

    public function payeBands(Request $r)
    {
        Security::require($this->user($r), 'reports.view');

        return Admin::payeTables();
    }

    public function newPayeTable(Request $r)
    {
        $u = $this->user($r);
        Security::require($u, 'settings.propose');
        $x = $r->validate(['effective_from' => 'required|date_format:Y-m-d', 'legal_basis' => 'required|string', 'bands' => 'required|array|min:1',
            'bands.*.annual_width' => 'nullable|numeric', 'bands.*.rate' => 'required|numeric'] + self::APPROVAL_RULES);
        $ap = $this->approve($r, 'settings.approve');
        Admin::setPayeBands($x['effective_from'], array_map(fn ($b) => [isset($b['annual_width']) ? (string) $b['annual_width'] : null,
            (string) $b['rate']], $x['bands']), $x['legal_basis'], $u->username, $ap);

        return ['ok' => true];
    }

    public function whtTypes(Request $r)
    {
        Security::require($this->user($r), 'reports.view');

        return WhtType::orderBy('name')->get()->map(fn ($w) => ['name' => $w->name, 'gra_code' => $w->gra_code, 'rate' => $w->rate,
            'residency' => $w->residency, 'final' => $w->final, 'always_withhold' => $w->always_withhold, 'description' => $w->description])->all();
    }

    public function whtRate(Request $r, string $name)
    {
        $u = $this->user($r);
        Security::require($u, 'settings.propose');
        $x = $r->validate(['rate' => 'required|numeric', 'legal_basis' => 'required|string'] + self::APPROVAL_RULES);
        $ap = $this->approve($r, 'settings.approve');
        Admin::changeWhtRate($name, (string) $x['rate'], $x['legal_basis'], $u->username, $ap);

        return ['ok' => true];
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api;

use App\Domain\Admin;
use App\Domain\Allocations;
use App\Domain\Assets;
use App\Domain\BusinessRuleError;
use App\Domain\Controls;
use App\Domain\GraForms;
use App\Domain\Ifrs;
use App\Domain\Ledger;
use App\Domain\LedgerReports;
use App\Domain\Money;
use App\Domain\Payables;
use App\Domain\Payroll;
use App\Domain\PayrollReports;
use App\Domain\Periodend;
use App\Domain\PermissionDenied;
use App\Domain\PettyCash;
use App\Domain\Reconcile;
use App\Domain\Reports;
use App\Domain\Schedules;
use App\Domain\Security;
use App\Domain\Statements;
use App\Domain\Views;
use App\Domain\Withholding;
use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Models\PriceListItem;
use App\Models\Payer;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

/**
 * Stage 3 API: payroll, tax schedules and GRA returns, period end, fixed assets, head office allocations, petty cash, the full
 * statements, master and sub-account reports, reconciliations and the other reports.
 */
class FinanceController extends ApiController
{
    private const D = 'required|date_format:Y-m-d';

    private const XLSX = 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet';

    private function file(string $data, string $type, string $name)
    {
        return response($data, 200, ['Content-Type' => $type, 'Content-Disposition' => "attachment; filename=\"{$name}\""]);
    }

    /** Whole business (null) or one unit the user may see. */
    private function units(User $u, ?string $unit): ?array
    {
        return $this->scope($u, $unit);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ employees and payroll
    private function payrollViewer(User $u): void
    {
        if (! (Security::can($u, 'payroll.prepare') || Security::can($u, 'payroll.approve'))) {
            throw new PermissionDenied("{$u->username} may not view payroll");
        }
    }

    private const EMP_RULES = ['surname' => 'string|max:60', 'first_name' => 'string|max:60', 'other_names' => 'nullable|string|max:60', 'role' => 'string|max:40',
        'basic' => 'numeric|min:0', 'allowances' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0', 'ssnit_status' => 'boolean', 'tax_status' => 'in:Resident,Non-Resident,Casual',
        'junior_staff' => 'boolean', 'tin' => 'nullable|string|max:30', 'ssnit_no' => 'nullable|string|max:30', 'pension_no' => 'nullable|string|max:30',
        'bank_name' => 'nullable|string|max:60', 'bank_account' => 'nullable|string|max:40', 'nationality' => 'nullable|string|max:40',
        'postal_address' => 'nullable|string|max:160', 'residential_address' => 'nullable|string|max:160'];

    public static function employeeDict(Employee $e): array
    {
        return ['staff_no' => $e->staff_no, 'branch_id' => $e->branch_id, 'surname' => $e->surname, 'first_name' => $e->first_name, 'other_names' => $e->other_names,
            'role' => $e->role, 'basic' => $e->basic, 'allowances' => $e->allowances, 'ssnit_status' => $e->ssnit_status ? 'Yes' : 'No', 'tax_status' => $e->tax_status,
            'junior_staff' => (bool) $e->junior_staff, 'ghana_card' => $e->tin, 'ssnit_no' => $e->ssnit_no, 'pension_no' => $e->pension_no, 'bank_name' => $e->bank_name,
            'bank_account' => $e->bank_account, 'nationality' => $e->nationality, 'postal_address' => $e->postal_address, 'residential_address' => $e->residential_address];
    }

    public function addEmployee(Request $r)
    {
        $x = $this->strs($r->validate(['branch' => 'required|string', 'staff_no' => 'required|string|max:20', 'surname' => 'required|string', 'first_name' => 'required|string',
            'role' => 'required|string', 'basic' => 'required|numeric|min:0'] + self::EMP_RULES));
        $u = $this->user($r);
        $b = $this->bid($x['branch'], $u, 'payroll.prepare');
        if (Employee::where('staff_no', $x['staff_no'])->exists()) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("Staff ID {$x['staff_no']} already exists");
        }
        unset($x['branch']);
        $e = new Employee($x + ['branch_id' => $b, 'allowances' => '0', 'ssnit_status' => true, 'tax_status' => 'Resident', 'junior_staff' => false]);
        $e->name = Schedules::displayName($e);
        $e->save();
        Ledger::audit($u->username, 'EMPLOYEE_CREATE', 'employee', $x['staff_no'], "basic {$x['basic']}, {$e->tax_status}, SSNIT ".($e->ssnit_status ? 'True' : 'False'));

        return ['ok' => true];
    }

    public function updateEmployee(Request $r, string $staffNo)
    {
        $e = Employee::where('staff_no', $staffNo)->first() ?? throw new BusinessRuleError('Unknown staff ID');
        $u = $this->user($r);
        Security::require($u, 'payroll.prepare', $e->branch_id);
        $x = $this->strs($r->validate(self::EMP_RULES + ['reason' => 'required|string|max:60']));
        $reason = $x['reason'];
        unset($x['reason']);
        $e->fill($x);
        $e->name = Schedules::displayName($e);
        $e->save();
        $keys = array_keys($x);
        sort($keys);
        Ledger::audit($u->username, 'EMPLOYEE_UPDATE', 'employee', $staffNo, json_encode($keys).": {$reason}");

        return ['ok' => true];
    }

    public function employees(Request $r)
    {
        $u = $this->user($r);
        $this->payrollViewer($u);
        $q = Employee::orderBy('staff_no');
        if ($br = $this->scope($u, $r->query('branch'))) {
            $q->whereIn('branch_id', $br);
        }

        return $q->get()->map(fn ($e) => self::employeeDict($e))->all();
    }

    public function runPayroll(Request $r)
    {
        $x = $r->validate(['branch' => 'required|string', 'month_end' => self::D, 'variables' => 'nullable|array'] + self::APPROVAL_RULES + ['approval' => 'required|array']);
        $u = $this->user($r);
        $b = $this->bid($x['branch'], $u, 'payroll.prepare');
        $ap = $this->approve($r, 'payroll.approve', $b);
        $vars = array_map(fn ($v) => array_filter($this->strs((array) $v), fn ($y) => $y !== null), $x['variables'] ?? []);
        [$jid, $lines] = Payroll::run($b, $x['month_end'], $u->username, $ap, $vars);

        return ['journal_id' => $jid, 'lines' => $lines];
    }

    public function expense(Request $r)
    {
        $x = $this->strs($r->validate(['branch' => 'required|string', 'date' => self::D, 'payee' => 'required|string|max:120', 'account_code' => 'required|integer',
            'net' => 'required|numeric|gt:0', 'tax_code' => 'nullable|string', 'supplier_charges_vat' => 'nullable|boolean', 'use' => 'nullable|in:Taxable,Exempt,Shared',
            'channel' => 'required|string', 'wht_type' => 'nullable|string', 'payee_tin' => 'nullable|string', 'payee_resident_status' => 'nullable|string',
            'payee_location' => 'nullable|string', 'contract_amount' => 'nullable|numeric', 'certificate_no' => 'nullable|string', 'invoice_no' => 'nullable|string',
            'invoice_date' => 'nullable|date_format:Y-m-d', 'whvat_certificate_no' => 'nullable|string', 'paid_by' => 'nullable|string'] + self::APPROVAL_RULES));
        $u = $this->user($r);
        $b = $this->bid($x['branch'], $u, 'expense.create');
        $ap = $r->input('approval') ? $this->approve($r, 'supplier.pay.approve', $b, $x['net']) : null;

        return $this->paidBy($x['paid_by'] ?? null, $u, 'expense.create', fn () => Payables::recordExpense($b, $x['date'], $x['payee'], (int) $x['account_code'], $x['net'],
            $x['tax_code'] ?? 'OS', (bool) ($x['supplier_charges_vat'] ?? false), $x['use'] ?? 'Shared', $x['channel'], $u->username, $x['wht_type'] ?? 'None',
            $x['payee_tin'] ?? null, $ap, $x['payee_resident_status'] ?? 'Resident', $x['payee_location'] ?? null, $x['contract_amount'] ?? null, $x['certificate_no'] ?? null,
            $x['invoice_no'] ?? null, $x['invoice_date'] ?? null, $x['whvat_certificate_no'] ?? null));
    }

    public function priceList(Request $r)
    {
        $x = $this->strs($r->validate(['payer' => 'required|string', 'sku' => 'required|string', 'price' => 'required|numeric|gt:0', 'effective_from' => self::D]));
        $u = $this->user($r);
        Security::require($u, 'masterdata.manage');
        $payer = Payer::where('code', $x['payer'])->first() ?? throw new BusinessRuleError("Unknown payer {$x['payer']}");
        $p = \App\Domain\Inventory::productByCode($x['sku']);
        PriceListItem::create(['payer_id' => $payer->id, 'product_id' => $p->id, 'price' => (string) Money::q2($x['price']), 'effective_from' => $x['effective_from'], 'reference' => $r->input('reference')]);
        Ledger::audit($u->username, 'PRICE_LIST', 'price_list_item', "{$x['payer']}:{$x['sku']}", "{$x['price']} from {$x['effective_from']}");

        return ['ok' => true];
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ allocations, petty cash, counts, statement balances
    public function allocate(Request $r)
    {
        $x = $this->strs($r->validate(['from_unit' => 'required|string', 'date' => self::D, 'lines' => 'required|array|min:1', 'lines.*.account_code' => 'required|integer',
            'lines.*.amount' => 'required|numeric|gt:0', 'basis' => 'required|string', 'to_branches' => 'nullable|array', 'shares' => 'nullable|array',
            'driver_start' => 'nullable|date_format:Y-m-d', 'driver_end' => 'nullable|date_format:Y-m-d', 'memo' => 'nullable|string', 'approval' => 'required|array']
            + self::APPROVAL_RULES));
        $u = $this->user($r);
        $src = $this->bid($x['from_unit'], $u, 'journal.create');
        $ap = $this->approve($r, 'journal.approve', $src, Money::sum(array_column($x['lines'], 'amount')));

        return Allocations::allocate($src, $x['date'], $x['lines'], $x['basis'], $u->username, $ap, $x['to_branches'] ?? null, $x['shares'] ?? null,
            $x['driver_start'] ?? null, $x['driver_end'] ?? null, $x['memo'] ?? null);
    }

        $c = PettyCash::recordCount($b, $x['date'], $x['denominations'], $u->username, $x['witnessed_by'], (int) ($x['account_code'] ?? 1015),

    public function postCount(Request $r, int $countId)
    {
        $r->validate(['approval' => 'required|array'] + self::APPROVAL_RULES);
        $u = $this->user($r);
        Security::require($u, 'cash.bank');

        return ['journal_id' => PettyCash::postVariance($countId, $u->username, $this->approve($r, 'cashup.approve'))];
    }

    public function statementBalance(Request $r)
    {
        $x = $this->strs($r->validate(['branch' => 'required|string', 'account_code' => 'required|integer', 'statement_date' => self::D, 'closing_balance' => 'required|numeric',
            'reference' => 'nullable|string']));
        $u = $this->user($r);
        Reconcile::recordStatementBalance($this->bid($x['branch'], $u, 'bank.reconcile'), (int) $x['account_code'], $x['statement_date'], $x['closing_balance'],
            $x['reference'] ?? null, $u->username);

        return ['ok' => true];
    }

    public function disclosure(Request $r, string $key)
    {
        $x = $this->strs($r->validate(['period_end' => self::D, 'text' => 'required|string', 'amount' => 'nullable|numeric']));
        $u = $this->user($r);
        Security::require($u, 'journal.create');
        $d = Ifrs::setDisclosure($key, $x['period_end'], $x['text'], $u->username, $x['amount'] ?? null);

        return ['ok' => true, 'key' => $d->key];
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ reports
    private function period(Request $r): array
    {
        $x = $r->validate(['fy_start' => self::D, 'kind' => 'nullable|in:month,quarter,half,ytd,year', 'n' => 'nullable|integer|min:1|max:12']);

        return [$x['fy_start'], $x['kind'] ?? 'year', (int) ($x['n'] ?? 1)];
    }

    public function trialBalance(Request $r)
    {
        $u = $this->user($r);
        Security::require($u, 'reports.view');
        [$fy, $kind, $n] = $this->period($r);
        [$a, $b] = Reports::periodRange($fy, $kind, $n);
        $tb = Reports::trialBalance($a, $b, $this->scope($u, $r->query('branch')));
        $meta = Reports::accounts();

        return ['period' => [$a, $b], 'rows' => array_map(fn ($c, $v) => ['code' => $c, 'name' => $meta[$c]->name, 'line' => $meta[$c]->line,
            'debit' => $v->isPositive() ? $v : Money::zero(), 'credit' => $v->isNegative() ? $v->negated() : Money::zero()], array_keys($tb), $tb),
            'difference' => Money::q2(Money::sum($tb))];
    }

    public function statements(Request $r)
    {
        $u = $this->user($r);
        Security::require($u, 'reports.view');
        [$fy, $kind, $n] = $this->period($r);

        return Statements::financialStatements($fy, $kind, $n, $this->scope($u, $r->query('branch')));

    }

    public function consolidated(Request $r)

    }

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api;

use App\Domain\BusinessRuleError;
use App\Domain\Integrity;
use App\Domain\Ledger;
use App\Domain\Money;
use App\Domain\Security;
use App\Models\AuditLog;
use App\Models\Journal;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

/** Manual journals, reversals, journal enquiry, audit log, integrity and backups. */
class LedgerController extends ApiController
{
    public function journal(Request $r)
    {
        $x = $r->validate(['branch' => 'required|string', 'date' => 'required|date_format:Y-m-d', 'reference' => 'required|string|max:60',
            'memo' => 'nullable|string|max:200', 'lines' => 'required|array|min:2', 'lines.*.account' => 'required|integer',
            'lines.*.debit' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0', 'lines.*.credit' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0', 'lines.*.party' => 'nullable|string'] + self::APPROVAL_RULES);
        $u = $this->user($r);
        $b = $this->bid($x['branch'], $u, 'journal.create');
        $amount = Money::sum(array_map(fn ($l) => (string) ($l['debit'] ?? '0'), $x['lines']));
        $ap = $this->approve($r, 'journal.approve', $b, $amount);
        $j = Ledger::post($b, $x['date'], 'MANUAL', $x['reference'], array_map(fn ($l) => [(int) $l['account'], (string) ($l['debit'] ?? '0'),
            (string) ($l['credit'] ?? '0'), $l['party'] ?? null], $x['lines']), $u->username, $x['memo'] ?? null, $ap);

        return ['journal_id' => $j->id];
    }

    public function reverse(Request $r, int $journalId)
    {
        $x = $r->validate(['on' => 'required|date_format:Y-m-d', 'reason' => 'required|string'] + self::APPROVAL_RULES);
        $u = $this->user($r);
        Security::require($u, 'journal.create');
        $ap = $this->approve($r, 'journal.approve');
        $j = Ledger::reverse($journalId, $x['on'], $u->username, "{$x['reason']} (approved {$ap})");

        return ['journal_id' => $j->id];
    }

    public function show(Request $r, int $journalId)
    {
        $u = $this->user($r);
        Security::require($u, 'reports.view');
        $j = Journal::find($journalId);
        $allowed = Security::branchIds($u);
        if ($j === null || ($allowed !== null && ! in_array($j->branch_id, $allowed, true))) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Journal not found');
        }

        return \App\Domain\Views::journalDetail($journalId);
    }

    public function auditLog(Request $r)
    {
        Security::require($this->user($r), 'audit.view');
        $q = AuditLog::orderByDesc('id')->limit(min((int) $r->query('limit', 200), 2000));
        foreach (['user', 'action', 'entity'] as $f) {
            if ($r->query($f)) {
                $q->where($f, $r->query($f));
            }
        }

        return $q->get()->all();
    }

    public function integrity(Request $r)
    {
        Security::require($this->user($r), 'audit.view');

        return Integrity::summary();
    }

    public function recordBackup(Request $r)
    {
        Security::require($this->user($r), 'system.backup');
        $x = $r->validate(['kind' => 'required|in:BACKUP,RESTORE_TEST', 'started_at' => 'required|date', 'finished_at' => 'nullable|date',
            'status' => 'required|in:OK,FAILED', 'location' => 'nullable|string', 'checksum' => 'nullable|string', 'detail' => 'nullable|string']);
        $id = Integrity::recordBackup($x['kind'], $x['started_at'], $x['finished_at'] ?? null, $x['status'], $x['location'] ?? null,
            $x['checksum'] ?? null, $x['detail'] ?? null);
        Ledger::audit($this->user($r)->username, 'BACKUP_RECORD', 'backup_record', $id, "{$x['kind']} {$x['status']}");

        return ['id' => $id];
    }

    public function backups(Request $r)
    {
        Security::require($this->user($r), 'audit.view');

        return Integrity::backupStatus(Ledger::utcnow());
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api;

use App\Domain\Branches;
use App\Domain\BusinessRuleError;
use App\Domain\Inventory;
use App\Domain\Ledger;
use App\Domain\Payables;
use App\Domain\Security;
use App\Models\Category;
use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\Supplier;
use App\Models\TaxRate;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

/** Shared lists: products (with each branch's own price, reorder level and active flag) and suppliers. */
class MasterDataController extends ApiController
{
    public function products(Request $r)
    {
        $u = $this->user($r);
        Security::require($u, 'reports.view');
        $b = $r->query('branch') ? $this->scope($u, $r->query('branch'))[0] : null;

        return Product::orderBy('sku')->get()->map(fn (Product $p) => ['sku' => $p->sku, 'name' => $p->name, 'barcode' => $p->barcode,
            'category' => $p->category_name, 'tax_code' => $p->tax_code, 'units_per_pack' => $p->units_per_pack, 'controlled' => (bool) $p->controlled,
            'retail_price' => $b ? Branches::retailPrice($b, $p) : $p->retail_price, 'reorder_level' => $b ? Branches::reorderLevel($b, $p) : $p->reorder_level,
            'active' => $b ? Branches::isActive($b, $p) : true])->all();
    }

    public function addProduct(Request $r)
    {
        $u = $this->user($r);
        Security::require($u, 'products.manage');
        $x = $r->validate(['sku' => 'required|string|max:30', 'name' => 'required|string|max:160', 'category' => 'required|string',
            'tax_code' => 'required|string', 'retail_price' => 'required|numeric|gt:0', 'barcode' => 'nullable|string|max:40',
            'units_per_pack' => 'nullable|numeric|gt:0', 'reorder_level' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0', 'controlled' => 'nullable|boolean']);
        if (Product::where('sku', $x['sku'])->exists()) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("Product {$x['sku']} already exists");
        }
        if (! Category::where('name', $x['category'])->exists()) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("Unknown category {$x['category']}");
        }
        if (! TaxRate::where('code', $x['tax_code'])->exists()) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError("Unknown tax code {$x['tax_code']}");
        }
        Product::create(['sku' => $x['sku'], 'name' => $x['name'], 'category_name' => $x['category'], 'tax_code' => $x['tax_code'],
            'retail_price' => (string) $x['retail_price'], 'barcode' => $x['barcode'] ?? null, 'units_per_pack' => (string) ($x['units_per_pack'] ?? '1'),
            'reorder_level' => (string) ($x['reorder_level'] ?? '0'), 'controlled' => (bool) ($x['controlled'] ?? false), 'sale_unit' => 'Unit', 'cold_chain' => false]);
        Ledger::audit($u->username, 'PRODUCT_CREATE', 'product', $x['sku'], "tax {$x['tax_code']} price {$x['retail_price']}");

        return ['ok' => true];
    }

    /** This branch's own selling price, reorder level and active flag for a shared product (blank = product default). */
    public function productBranch(Request $r, string $sku, string $branch)
    {
        $u = $this->user($r);
        $b = $this->bid($branch, $u, 'products.manage');
        $x = $r->validate(['retail_price' => 'nullable|numeric|gt:0', 'reorder_level' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0', 'active' => 'nullable|boolean',
            'clear' => 'nullable|array', 'clear.*' => 'in:retail_price,reorder_level']);
        $row = Branches::setProductBranch(Inventory::productByCode($sku), $b, $u->username, isset($x['retail_price']) ? (string) $x['retail_price'] : null,
            isset($x['reorder_level']) ? (string) $x['reorder_level'] : null, $x['active'] ?? null, $x['clear'] ?? []);

        return ['sku' => $sku, 'branch' => $branch, 'retail_price' => $row->retail_price, 'reorder_level' => $row->reorder_level, 'active' => (bool) $row->active];
    }

    public function reorder(Request $r, string $branch)
    {
        $u = $this->user($r);
        $b = $this->scope($u, $branch)[0];
        Security::require($u, 'reports.view', $b);

        return array_values(collect(Branches::reorderProducts($b))->all());
    }

    private const SUPPLIER_RULES = ['name' => 'string|max:160', 'tin' => 'nullable|string|max:20', 'vat_registered' => 'boolean', 'wht_type' => 'string',
        'resident_status' => 'in:Resident,NonResident,NRPermanentEstb', 'location' => 'nullable|string', 'payment_terms_days' => 'integer|min:0|max:365',
        'bank_name' => 'nullable|string', 'bank_account' => 'nullable|string', 'momo_number' => 'nullable|string'];

    public function suppliers(Request $r)
    {
        Security::require($this->user($r), 'reports.view');

        return Supplier::orderBy('code')->get()->all();
    }

    public function addSupplier(Request $r)
    {
        $u = $this->user($r);
        Security::require($u, 'masterdata.manage');
        $x = $r->validate(['code' => 'required|string|max:20', 'name' => 'required|string|max:160'] + self::SUPPLIER_RULES + ['approval' => 'required|array']
            + self::APPROVAL_RULES);
        $ap = $this->approve($r, 'settings.approve'); // supplier master data is change-controlled
        unset($x['approval']);
        Payables::createSupplier($x, $u->username, $ap);

        return ['ok' => true];
    }

    public function updateSupplier(Request $r, string $code)
    {
        $u = $this->user($r);
        Security::require($u, 'masterdata.manage');
        $x = $r->validate(self::SUPPLIER_RULES + ['reason' => 'required|string|max:60', 'approval' => 'required|array'] + self::APPROVAL_RULES);
        $ap = $this->approve($r, 'settings.approve');
        $reason = $x['reason'];
        unset($x['reason'], $x['approval']);
        Payables::updateSupplier($code, $x, $reason, $u->username, $ap);

        return ['ok' => true];
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api;

use App\Domain\Ap;
use App\Domain\Ar;
use App\Domain\BusinessRuleError;
use App\Domain\Money;
use App\Domain\Purchasing;
use App\Domain\Security;
use App\Models\APInvoice;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

/** Stage 4 API: requisitions, purchase orders, receiving, supplier invoices and payments, recurring bills, customer invoices. */
class PurchasingController extends ApiController
{
    private const D = 'required|date_format:Y-m-d';

    private const PO_LINES = ['lines' => 'required|array|min:1', 'lines.*.sku' => 'nullable|string', 'lines.*.description' => 'nullable|string',
        'lines.*.account_code' => 'nullable|integer', 'lines.*.qty' => 'required|numeric|gt:0', 'lines.*.unit_price' => 'required|numeric|min:0', 'lines.*.tax_code' => 'nullable|string'];

    public function requisition(Request $r)
    {
        $x = $this->strs($r->validate(['branch' => 'required|string', 'date' => self::D, 'lines' => 'required|array|min:1', 'lines.*.qty' => 'required|numeric|gt:0']));
        $u = $this->user($r);
        $req = Purchasing::createRequisition($this->bid($x['branch'], $u, 'po.create'), $x['date'], $x['lines'], $u->username);

        return ['req_no' => $req->req_no];
    }

    public function fromReorder(Request $r)
    {
        $x = $r->validate(['branch' => 'required|string', 'on' => self::D]);
        $u = $this->user($r);
        $req = Purchasing::requisitionFromReorder($this->bid($x['branch'], $u, 'po.create'), $x['on'], $u->username);

        return ['req_no' => $req?->req_no, 'lines' => $req ? $req->lines->map(fn ($l) => ['description' => $l->description, 'qty' => $l->qty, 'reason' => $l->reason])->all() : []];
    }

    public function createPo(Request $r)
    {
        $x = $this->strs($r->validate(['branch' => 'required|string', 'supplier' => 'required|string', 'date' => self::D, 'expected_date' => 'nullable|date_format:Y-m-d',
            'notes' => 'nullable|string', 'requisition_no' => 'nullable|string', 'confirm_duplicate' => 'nullable|boolean'] + self::PO_LINES));
        $u = $this->user($r);
        $po = Purchasing::createPo($this->bid($x['branch'], $u, 'po.create'), $x['supplier'], $x['date'], $x['lines'], $u->username, $x['expected_date'] ?? null,
            $x['notes'] ?? null, $x['requisition_no'] ?? null, (bool) ($x['confirm_duplicate'] ?? false));

        return ['po_no' => $po->po_no, 'total' => Purchasing::poTotal($po), 'approval_needed' => Purchasing::approvalPermission($po)];
    }

    public function showPo(Request $r, string $poNo)
    {
        $u = $this->user($r);
        $po = Purchasing::getPo($poNo);
        Security::require($u, 'reports.view', $po->branch_id);

        return ['po_no' => $po->po_no, 'branch_id' => $po->branch_id, 'supplier' => $po->supplier->code, 'supplier_name' => $po->supplier->name, 'status' => $po->status,
            'order_date' => $po->order_date, 'expected_date' => $po->expected_date, 'created_by' => $po->created_by, 'approved_by' => $po->approved_by, 'notes' => $po->notes,
            'total' => Purchasing::poTotal($po), 'lines' => $po->lines->sortBy('line_no')->values()->map(fn ($l) => ['line_no' => (int) $l->line_no,
                'description' => $l->description, 'sku' => $l->product?->sku, 'account_code' => $l->account_code, 'qty' => $l->qty, 'unit_price' => $l->unit_price,
                'tax_code' => $l->tax_code, 'qty_received' => $l->qty_received, 'qty_invoiced' => $l->qty_invoiced])->all()];
    }

    public function listPos(Request $r)
    {
        $u = $this->user($r);
        Security::require($u, 'reports.view');
        $q = \App\Models\PurchaseOrder::with(['supplier', 'lines'])->orderByDesc('id')->limit(200);
        if ($ids = $this->scope($u, $r->query('branch'))) {
            $q->whereIn('branch_id', $ids);
        }
        if ($r->query('status')) {
            $q->where('status', $r->query('status'));
        }

        return $q->get()->map(fn ($p) => ['po_no' => $p->po_no, 'branch_id' => $p->branch_id, 'supplier' => $p->supplier->name, 'order_date' => $p->order_date,
            'expected_date' => $p->expected_date, 'status' => $p->status, 'total' => Purchasing::poTotal($p)])->all();
    }

    public function amendPo(Request $r, string $poNo)
    {
        $x = $this->strs($r->validate(self::PO_LINES));
        $u = $this->user($r);
        Security::require($u, 'po.create', Purchasing::getPo($poNo)->branch_id);
        $po = Purchasing::amendPo($poNo, $x['lines'], $u->username);

        return ['po_no' => $po->po_no, 'status' => $po->status, 'total' => Purchasing::poTotal($po)];
    }

    public function approvePo(Request $r, string $poNo)
    {
        $r->validate(['approval' => 'required|array'] + self::APPROVAL_RULES);
        $u = $this->user($r);
        $po = Purchasing::getPo($poNo);
        Security::require($u, 'po.create', $po->branch_id);
        $ap = $this->approve($r, Purchasing::approvalPermission($po), $po->branch_id);

        return ['po_no' => Purchasing::approvePo($poNo, $ap, $u->username)->po_no, 'status' => 'APPROVED'];
    }

    public function cancelPo(Request $r, string $poNo)
    {
        $x = $r->validate(['reason' => 'required|string']);
        $u = $this->user($r);
        Security::require($u, 'po.create', Purchasing::getPo($poNo)->branch_id);
        Purchasing::cancelPo($poNo, $u->username, $x['reason']);

        return ['ok' => true];
    }

    public function closePo(Request $r, string $poNo)
    {
        $x = $r->validate(['reason' => 'required|string']);
        $u = $this->user($r);
        Security::require($u, 'po.approve', Purchasing::getPo($poNo)->branch_id);
        Purchasing::closePo($poNo, $u->username, $x['reason']);

        return ['ok' => true];
    }

    /** Goods lines carry batch_no and expiry; service lines only line_no and qty (confirmed, not received). */
    public function receive(Request $r, string $poNo)
    {
        $x = $this->strs($r->validate(['date' => self::D, 'delivery_note' => 'nullable|string', 'lines' => 'required|array|min:1', 'lines.*.line_no' => 'required|integer',
            'lines.*.qty' => 'required|numeric|gt:0', 'lines.*.batch_no' => 'nullable|string', 'lines.*.expiry' => 'nullable|date_format:Y-m-d',
            'lines.*.nrv_per_unit' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0']));
        $u = $this->user($r);
        $po = Purchasing::getPo($poNo);
        Security::require($u, 'po.receive', $po->branch_id);
        $goods = array_values(array_filter($x['lines'], fn ($l) => $po->lines->firstWhere('line_no', (int) $l['line_no'])?->product_id));
        $services = array_values(array_filter($x['lines'], fn ($l) => ! $po->lines->firstWhere('line_no', (int) $l['line_no'])?->product_id));
        $out = [];
        if ($goods) {
            $out[] = Purchasing::receive($poNo, $x['date'], $goods, $u->username, $x['delivery_note'] ?? null)->grn_no;
        }
        if ($services) {
            $out[] = Purchasing::confirmService($poNo, $x['date'], $services, $u->username, $x['delivery_note'] ?? null)->grn_no;
        }

        return ['grn' => $out, 'status' => Purchasing::getPo($poNo)->status];
    }

    public function poPdf(Request $r, string $poNo)
    {
        Security::require($this->user($r), 'reports.view');

        return response(Purchasing::poPdf($poNo), 200, ['Content-Type' => 'application/pdf', 'Content-Disposition' => "inline; filename=\"{$poNo}.pdf\""]);
    }

    public function performance(Request $r)
    {
        Security::require($this->user($r), 'reports.view');
        $x = $r->validate(['start' => self::D, 'end' => self::D]);

        return Purchasing::supplierPerformance($x['start'], $x['end']);
    }

    public function commitments(Request $r)
    {
        Security::require($this->user($r), 'reports.view');

        return Purchasing::commitments($r->query('branch') ? $this->bid($r->query('branch')) : null);
    }

    public function grni(Request $r)
    {
        Security::require($this->user($r), 'reports.view');

        return Purchasing::grniReport($r->query('as_of'));
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ payables
    public function apInvoice(Request $r)
    {
        $x = $this->strs($r->validate(['branch' => 'required|string', 'supplier' => 'required|string', 'kind' => 'nullable|in:INVOICE,CREDIT,DEBIT', 'invoice_no' => 'required|string',
            'invoice_date' => self::D, 'due_date' => 'nullable|date_format:Y-m-d', 'po_no' => 'nullable|string', 'credit_of' => 'nullable|string', 'lines' => 'required|array|min:1']));
        $u = $this->user($r);
        $inv = Ap::postInvoice($this->bid($x['branch'], $u, 'ap.manage'), $x['supplier'], $x['invoice_no'], $x['invoice_date'], $x['lines'], $u->username, $x['due_date'] ?? null,
            $x['po_no'] ?? null, $x['kind'] ?? 'INVOICE', $x['credit_of'] ?? null);

        return ['invoice_id' => $inv->id, 'status' => $inv->status, 'gross' => $inv->gross, 'hold_reason' => $inv->hold_reason];
    }

    public function held(Request $r)
    {
        Security::require($this->user($r), 'reports.view');

        return Ap::held();
    }

    public function release(Request $r, int $invoiceId)
    {
        $x = $r->validate(['reason' => 'required|string', 'approval' => 'required|array'] + self::APPROVAL_RULES);
        $u = $this->user($r);
        Security::require($u, 'ap.manage');

        return ['journal_id' => Ap::releaseHeld($invoiceId, $this->approve($r, 'ap.release'), $u->username, $x['reason'])];
    }

    public function pay(Request $r)
    {
        $x = $this->strs($r->validate(['branch' => 'required|string', 'date' => self::D, 'channel' => 'nullable|string', 'allocations' => 'required|array|min:1',
            'allocations.*.invoice_id' => 'required|integer', 'allocations.*.amount' => 'required|numeric|gt:0', 'certificate_no' => 'nullable|string',
            'whvat_certificate_no' => 'nullable|string', 'paid_by' => 'nullable|string', 'approval' => 'required|array'] + self::APPROVAL_RULES));
        $u = $this->user($r);
        $b = $this->bid($x['branch'], $u, 'supplier.pay');
        $ap = $this->approve($r, 'supplier.pay.approve', $b, Money::sum(array_column($x['allocations'], 'amount')));

        return $this->paidBy($x['paid_by'] ?? null, $u, 'supplier.pay', fn () => Ap::payInvoices($b, $x['date'], $x['channel'] ?? 'Bank', $x['allocations'], $u->username, $ap,
            $x['certificate_no'] ?? null, $x['whvat_certificate_no'] ?? null));
    }

    public function applyCredit(Request $r)
    {
        $x = $this->strs($r->validate(['credit_id' => 'required|integer', 'invoice_id' => 'required|integer', 'amount' => 'required|numeric|gt:0', 'date' => self::D]));
        $u = $this->user($r);
        Security::require($u, 'ap.manage');
        Ap::applyCredit((int) $x['credit_id'], (int) $x['invoice_id'], $x['amount'], $x['date'], $u->username);

        return ['ok' => true];
    }

    public function proposal(Request $r)
    {
        Security::require($this->user($r), 'supplier.pay');
        $x = $r->validate(['due_by' => self::D, 'branch' => 'nullable|string', 'supplier' => 'nullable|string']);

    }

    public function apAgeing(Request $r)
    {
        Security::require($this->user($r), 'reports.view');

        return Ap::ageing($r->validate(['as_of' => self::D])['as_of']);

    public function apInvoices(Request $r)
    {
        $u = $this->user($r);
        Security::require($u, 'reports.view');
        $q = APInvoice::with('supplier')->orderByDesc('id')->limit(300);
        if ($ids = $this->scope($u, $r->query('branch'))) {
            $q->whereIn('branch_id', $ids);
        }
        if ($r->query('status')) {
            $q->where('status', $r->query('status'));
        }

        return $q->get()->map(fn ($i) => ['invoice_id' => $i->id, 'supplier' => $i->supplier->code, 'supplier_name' => $i->supplier->name, 'kind' => $i->kind,
            'invoice_no' => $i->invoice_no, 'invoice_date' => $i->invoice_date, 'due_date' => $i->due_date, 'gross' => $i->gross, 'open' => Ap::openAmount($i),
            'status' => $i->status, 'hold_reason' => $i->hold_reason])->all();
    }

    public function statementRec(Request $r)
    {
        $x = $this->strs($r->validate(['supplier' => 'required|string', 'as_of' => self::D, 'closing_balance' => 'required|numeric', 'lines' => 'present|array']));
        Security::require($this->user($r), 'ap.manage');

        return Ap::statementReconciliation($x['supplier'], $x['lines'], $x['closing_balance'], $x['as_of']);

    public function priceVariances(Request $r)

        return Ap::priceVarianceReport($x['start'], $x['end']);

    public function paymentAdvice(Request $r)

        Security::require($this->user($r), 'supplier.pay');

    public function paymentAdviceXlsx(Request $r)
    {
        Security::require($this->user($r), 'supplier.pay');
        $x = $r->validate(['on' => self::D]);

        return response(Ap::paymentAdviceXlsx($x['on'], $r->query('branch') ? $this->bid($r->query('branch')) : null), 200, [
            'Content-Type' => 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet',
            'Content-Disposition' => "attachment; filename=\"supplier_payment_advice_{$x['on']}.xlsx\""]);
    }

    public function recurringBill(Request $r)
    {
        $x = $this->strs($r->validate(['code' => 'required|string', 'branch' => 'required|string', 'supplier' => 'required|string', 'start_month' => self::D,
            'end_month' => 'nullable|date_format:Y-m-d', 'day_of_month' => 'nullable|integer|min:1|max:28', 'lines' => 'required|array|min:1', 'approval' => 'required|array']
            + self::APPROVAL_RULES));
        $u = $this->user($r);
        $b = $this->bid($x['branch'], $u, 'ap.manage');
        $rb = Ap::createRecurringBill($x['code'], $b, $x['supplier'], $x['lines'], $x['start_month'], $u->username, $this->approve($r, 'supplier.pay.approve', $b),
            (int) ($x['day_of_month'] ?? 1), $x['end_month'] ?? null);

        return ['id' => $rb->id];
    }

    public function generateBills(Request $r)
    {
        $x = $r->validate(['period_end' => self::D]);
        $u = $this->user($r);
        Security::require($u, 'ap.manage');

        return ['batches' => Ap::generateRecurringBills($x['period_end'], $u->username)];
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ receivables
    public function arInvoice(Request $r)
    {
        $x = $this->strs($r->validate(['branch' => 'required|string', 'customer' => 'required|string', 'kind' => 'nullable|in:INVOICE,DEBIT,CREDIT', 'date' => self::D,
            'due_date' => 'nullable|date_format:Y-m-d', 'credit_of' => 'nullable|string', 'lines' => 'required|array|min:1', 'lines.*.account_code' => 'required|integer',
            'lines.*.description' => 'required|string', 'lines.*.net' => 'required|numeric|gt:0', 'lines.*.tax_code' => 'nullable|string'] + self::APPROVAL_RULES));
        $u = $this->user($r);
        $b = $this->bid($x['branch'], $u, 'ar.manage');
        $approver = $r->input('approval') ? $this->approve($r, 'ar.credit.approve', $b) : null;
        $kind = $x['kind'] ?? 'INVOICE';
        if ($kind === 'CREDIT' && ! $approver) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Credit notes need approval by someone other than the person raising them');
        }
        $inv = Ar::createInvoice($b, $x['customer'], $x['date'], $x['lines'], $u->username, $kind, $x['credit_of'] ?? null, $approver, $x['due_date'] ?? null);

        return ['invoice_no' => $inv->invoice_no, 'gross' => $inv->gross, 'due_date' => $inv->due_date];
    }

    public function arAgeing(Request $r)
    {
        Security::require($this->user($r), 'reports.view');

        return Ar::ageing($r->validate(['as_of' => self::D])['as_of']);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api;

use App\Domain\BusinessRuleError;
use App\Domain\Claims;
use App\Domain\Money;
use App\Domain\Sales;
use App\Domain\Security;
use App\Models\Sale;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

/** Point of sale, receipts, returns and insurer / NHIS claims. */
class SalesController extends ApiController
{
    private const D = 'required|date_format:Y-m-d';

    public function sale(Request $r)
    {
        $x = $this->strs($r->validate(['branch' => 'required|string', 'receipt_no' => 'required|string|max:60', 'date' => self::D, 'till' => 'required|string',
            'payer' => 'nullable|string', 'items' => 'required|array|min:1', 'items.*.code' => 'required|string', 'items.*.qty' => 'nullable|numeric|gt:0',
            'items.*.discount' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0', 'items.*.price_override' => 'nullable|numeric|gt:0', 'items.*.batch_no' => 'nullable|string',
            'payments' => 'present|array', 'payments.*.channel' => 'required|string', 'payments.*.amount' => 'required|numeric|min:0',
            'member_ref' => 'nullable|string', 'claim_no' => 'nullable|string', 'tendered' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0', 'client_uuid' => 'nullable|string|max:64',
            'prescription_ref' => 'nullable|string', 'prescriber' => 'nullable|string', 'dispenser' => 'nullable|array',
            'dispenser.approver' => 'required_with:dispenser|string', 'dispenser.approver_secret' => 'required_with:dispenser|string'] + self::APPROVAL_RULES));
        $u = $this->user($r);
        $b = $this->bid($x['branch'], $u, 'sale.create');
        $items = array_map(fn ($i) => $i + ['qty' => '1', 'discount' => '0'], $x['items']);
        $ap = $r->input('approval') ? $this->approve($r, 'discount.approve', $b, Money::sum(array_column($items, 'discount'))) : null;
        $disp = $r->input('dispenser') ? $this->approve($r, 'sale.dispense', $b, null, 'dispenser') : null;
        $sale = Sales::checkout($b, $x['receipt_no'], $x['date'], $x['till'], $x['payer'] ?? 'RETAIL', $items, $x['payments'], $u->username,
            $x['member_ref'] ?? null, $x['claim_no'] ?? null, $ap, $x['tendered'] ?? null, $x['client_uuid'] ?? null, $x['prescription_ref'] ?? null,
            $x['prescriber'] ?? null, $disp);
        $sale->load('lines.product');

        return ['sale_id' => $sale->id, 'receipt_no' => $sale->receipt_no, 'total' => (string) Money::sum($sale->lines->pluck('gross')->all()),
            'patient_pays' => (string) Money::sum($sale->lines->pluck('patient_portion')->all()), 'change_due' => (string) ($sale->change_due ?? '0.00'),
            'lines' => $sale->lines->map(fn ($l) => ['sku' => $l->product->sku, 'batch_lot' => $l->lot_id, 'qty' => (string) $l->qty, 'gross' => (string) $l->gross,
                'vat' => (string) $l->vat, 'nhil' => (string) $l->nhil, 'getfund' => (string) $l->getfund])->all(), 'evat_status' => $sale->evat_status];
    }

    public function receipt(Request $r, int $saleId)
    {
        $u = $this->user($r);
        $s = Sale::find($saleId) ?? throw new BusinessRuleError('Sale not found');
        if (! Security::can($u, 'reports.view')) {
            Security::require($u, 'sale.create', $s->branch_id);
        }
        $allowed = Security::branchIds($u);
        if ($allowed !== null && ! in_array($s->branch_id, $allowed, true)) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Sale not found');
        }

        return response(Sales::receiptText($saleId), 200, ['Content-Type' => 'text/plain; charset=utf-8']);
    }

    public function saleReturn(Request $r)
    {
        $x = $this->strs($r->validate(['branch' => 'required|string', 'original_receipt' => 'required|string', 'return_no' => 'required|string|max:60',
            'date' => self::D, 'items' => 'required|array|min:1', 'items.*.line_id' => 'required|integer', 'items.*.qty' => 'required|numeric|gt:0',
            'refund_channel' => 'required|string', 'approval' => 'required|array'] + self::APPROVAL_RULES));
        $u = $this->user($r);
        $b = $this->bid($x['branch'], $u, 'sale.create');
        $ap = $this->approve($r, 'sale.return.approve', $b);
        $ret = Sales::returnSale($b, $x['original_receipt'], $x['return_no'], $x['date'], $x['items'], $x['refund_channel'], $u->username, $ap);

        return ['return_id' => $ret->id];
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ claims
    public function submitClaim(Request $r, string $payer, string $claimNo)
    {
        $x = $r->validate(['on' => self::D]);
        $u = $this->user($r);
        Security::require($u, 'claims.manage');

        return ['journal_id' => Claims::submit(Claims::get($payer, $claimNo), $x['on'], $u->username)];
    }

    public function vetClaim(Request $r, string $payer, string $claimNo)
    {
        $x = $this->strs($r->validate(['approved_amount' => 'required|numeric|min:0', 'shortfall_class' => 'nullable|string', 'date' => self::D]));
        $u = $this->user($r);
        Security::require($u, 'claims.manage');

        return ['journal_id' => Claims::vet(Claims::get($payer, $claimNo), $x['date'], $x['approved_amount'], $u->username,
            $x['shortfall_class'] ?? 'Contractual pricing')];
    }

    public function claimPayment(Request $r, string $payer, string $claimNo)
    {
        $x = $this->strs($r->validate(['date' => self::D, 'amount' => 'required|numeric|gt:0', 'channel' => 'nullable|string',
            'wht_withheld' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0', 'wht_certificate_no' => 'nullable|string', 'whvat_withheld' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0',
            'whvat_certificate_no' => 'nullable|string']));
        $u = $this->user($r);
        Security::require($u, 'claims.manage');

        return ['journal_id' => Claims::receivePayment(Claims::get($payer, $claimNo), $x['date'], $x['amount'], $x['channel'] ?? 'Bank', $u->username,
            $x['wht_withheld'] ?? '0', $x['wht_certificate_no'] ?? null, $x['whvat_withheld'] ?? '0', $x['whvat_certificate_no'] ?? null)];
    }

    public function resolveClaim(Request $r, string $payer, string $claimNo)
    {
        $x = $this->strs($r->validate(['date' => self::D, 'recovered' => 'required|numeric|min:0', 'write_off_class' => 'nullable|string']));
        $u = $this->user($r);
        Security::require($u, 'claims.manage');

        return ['journal_id' => Claims::resolveDispute(Claims::get($payer, $claimNo), $x['date'], $x['recovered'], $u->username,
            $x['write_off_class'] ?? 'Contractual pricing')];
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api;

use App\Domain\BusinessRuleError;
use App\Domain\Inventory;
use App\Domain\Opening;
use App\Domain\Security;
use App\Models\StockCount;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

/** Goods received, adjustments, transfers between branches, stock counts, valuation and opening balances. */
class StockController extends ApiController
{
    private const D = 'required|date_format:Y-m-d';

    public function goodsReceipt(Request $r)
    {
        $x = $r->validate(['branch' => 'required|string', 'supplier' => 'required|string', 'invoice_no' => 'required|string|max:60', 'date' => self::D,
            'lines' => 'required|array|min:1', 'lines.*.sku' => 'required|string', 'lines.*.batch_no' => 'required|string', 'lines.*.expiry' => self::D,
            'lines.*.packs' => 'required|numeric|gt:0', 'lines.*.cost_per_pack' => 'required|numeric|gt:0', 'lines.*.nrv_per_unit' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0']
            + self::APPROVAL_RULES);
        $u = $this->user($r);
        $b = $this->bid($x['branch'], $u, 'stock.receive');
        $ap = $r->input('approval') ? $this->approve($r, 'po.approve', $b) : null;
        $lines = array_map(fn ($l) => ['sku' => $l['sku'], 'batch_no' => $l['batch_no'], 'expiry' => $l['expiry'], 'packs' => (string) $l['packs'],
            'cost_per_pack' => (string) $l['cost_per_pack'], 'nrv_per_unit' => isset($l['nrv_per_unit']) ? (string) $l['nrv_per_unit'] : null], $x['lines']);

        return ['journal_id' => Inventory::receiveGoods($b, $x['supplier'], $x['invoice_no'], $x['date'], $lines, $u->username, $ap)];
    }

    public function adjustment(Request $r)
    {
        $x = $r->validate(['branch' => 'required|string', 'date' => self::D, 'sku' => 'required|string', 'batch_no' => 'required|string',
            'adj_type' => 'required|string', 'qty' => 'required|numeric|gt:0', 'document_no' => 'nullable|string', 'reason' => 'nullable|string',
            'approval' => 'required|array'] + self::APPROVAL_RULES);
        $u = $this->user($r);
        $b = $this->bid($x['branch'], $u, 'stock.adjust');
        $ap = $this->approve($r, 'stock.adjust.approve', $b, Inventory::estimateValue($b, $x['sku'], $x['batch_no'], (string) $x['qty']));

        return ['journal_id' => Inventory::adjust($b, $x['date'], $x['sku'], $x['batch_no'], $x['adj_type'], (string) $x['qty'], $u->username, $ap,
            $x['document_no'] ?? null, $x['reason'] ?? '')];
    }

    public function transfer(Request $r)
    {
        $x = $r->validate(['from_branch' => 'required|string', 'to_branch' => 'required|string', 'sku' => 'required|string', 'qty' => 'required|numeric|gt:0',
            'date' => self::D, 'note_no' => 'required|string', 'batch_no' => 'nullable|string', 'approval' => 'required|array'] + self::APPROVAL_RULES);
        $u = $this->user($r);
        $a = $this->bid($x['from_branch'], $u, 'stock.transfer');
        $ap = $this->approve($r, 'stock.transfer.approve');
        $v = Inventory::transfer($a, $this->bid($x['to_branch']), $x['sku'], (string) $x['qty'], $x['date'], $x['note_no'], $u->username, $ap, $x['batch_no'] ?? null);

        return ['value_at_cost' => (string) $v];
    }

    public function openCount(Request $r)
    {
        $x = $r->validate(['branch' => 'required|string', 'on' => self::D]);
        $u = $this->user($r);
        $c = Inventory::openCount($this->bid($x['branch'], $u, 'stock.count'), $x['on'], $u->username);

        return ['count_id' => $c->id, 'sheet' => Inventory::countSheet($c)];
    }

    private function count(int $id): StockCount
    {
        return StockCount::find($id) ?? throw new BusinessRuleError('Stock count not found');
    }

    public function sheet(Request $r, int $countId)
    {
        $c = $this->count($countId);
        Security::require($this->user($r), 'stock.count', $c->branch_id);

        return ['count_id' => $c->id, 'status' => $c->status, 'sheet' => Inventory::countSheet($c)];
    }

    /** Body: {"<line_id>": counted quantity or null}. */
    public function recordCounts(Request $r, int $countId)
    {
        $c = $this->count($countId);
        $u = $this->user($r);
        Security::require($u, 'stock.count', $c->branch_id);
        $counts = [];
        foreach ($r->json()->all() as $k => $v) {
            if (! ctype_digit((string) $k) || ($v !== null && ! is_numeric($v))) {
                throw new BusinessRuleError('Send {"line id": counted quantity}');
            }
            $counts[(int) $k] = $v === null ? null : (string) $v;
        }
        Inventory::recordCounts($c, $counts, $u->username);

        return ['status' => $c->fresh()->status];
    }

    public function approveCount(Request $r, int $countId)
    {
        $c = $this->count($countId);
        $u = $this->user($r);
        Security::require($u, 'stock.count.approve', $c->branch_id);

        return ['variances' => Inventory::approveCount($c, $u->username)];
    }

    public function stock(Request $r, string $branch)
    {
        $x = $r->validate(['as_of' => self::D]);

        return Inventory::valuation($this->bid($branch, $this->user($r), 'reports.view'), $x['as_of']);
    }

    public function reconciliation(Request $r, string $branch)
    {
        $x = $r->validate(['as_of' => self::D]);

        return Inventory::reconciliation($this->bid($branch, $this->user($r), 'reports.view'), $x['as_of']);
    }

    public function nrv(Request $r, string $branch)
    {
        $x = $r->validate(['on' => self::D]);
        $u = $this->user($r);

        return ['journal_id' => Inventory::nrvTrueUp($this->bid($branch, $u, 'stock.adjust'), $x['on'], $u->username)];
    }

    /** Go-live balances for one unit: account balances and opening stock batches, approved by a second person. */
    public function opening(Request $r)
    {
        $x = $r->validate(['branch' => 'required|string', 'as_of' => self::D, 'balances' => 'array', 'balances.*.account' => 'required|integer',
            'balances.*.amount' => 'required|numeric', 'balances.*.party' => 'nullable|string', 'stock' => 'array', 'stock.*.sku' => 'required|string', 'stock.*.batch_no' => 'required|string', 'stock.*.expiry' => self::D,
            'stock.*.units' => 'required|numeric|gt:0', 'stock.*.unit_cost' => 'required|numeric|gt:0', 'stock.*.nrv_per_unit' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0', 'approval' => 'required|array'] + self::APPROVAL_RULES);
        $u = $this->user($r);
        $b = $this->bid($x['branch'], $u, 'journal.create');
        $ap = $this->approve($r, 'journal.approve', $b);
        $bal = array_map(fn ($l) => [(int) $l['account'], (string) $l['amount'], $l['party'] ?? null], $x['balances'] ?? []);

        $stock = array_map(fn ($l) => ['sku' => $l['sku'], 'batch_no' => $l['batch_no'], 'expiry' => $l['expiry'], 'units' => (string) $l['units'],
            'unit_cost' => (string) $l['unit_cost'], 'nrv_per_unit' => isset($l['nrv_per_unit']) ? (string) $l['nrv_per_unit'] : null], $x['stock'] ?? []);

        return ['journal_id' => Opening::load($b, $x['as_of'], $bal, $stock, $u->username, $ap)];
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api;

use App\Domain\BusinessRuleError;
use App\Domain\PermissionDenied;
use App\Domain\Security;
use App\Domain\Uploads;
use App\Models\Branch;
use App\Models\StockUpload;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

/** Upload products and stock (CSV only): template, validate (report, nothing saved), confirm (second person), cancel. */
class UploadsController extends ApiController
{
    public function template(Request $r)
    {
        Security::require($this->user($r), 'stock.upload');
        $ex = filter_var($r->query('examples', false), FILTER_VALIDATE_BOOLEAN);
        $name = $ex ? 'products_stock_template_with_examples.csv' : 'products_stock_template.csv';

        return response(Uploads::template($ex), 200, ['Content-Type' => 'text/csv', 'Content-Disposition' => "attachment; filename=\"{$name}\""]);
    }

    /** Send the CSV file as the request body (Content-Type text/csv) with ?file_name=. Returns the validation report; nothing is saved. */
    public function validateFile(Request $r)
    {
        $u = $this->user($r);
        Security::require($u, 'stock.upload');
        $raw = $r->getContent();
        if (strlen($raw) > 5_000_000) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('File too large (5 MB at most)');
        }

        return $this->checked($u, Uploads::report(Uploads::validate((string) $r->query('file_name', ''), $raw, $u->username)));
    }

    /** An inventory officer may load only into their own branches. */
    public function checked($u, array $rep): array
    {
        $allowed = Security::branchIds($u);
        if ($allowed !== null) {
            $codes = Branch::whereIn('id', $allowed)->pluck('code')->all();
            $outside = array_unique(array_filter(array_map(fn ($x) => strtoupper($x['branch']), $rep['report']['rows']), fn ($c) => $c !== '' && ! in_array($c, $codes, true)));
            if ($outside) {
                sort($outside);
                throw new PermissionDenied("{$u->username} may not load stock into branch(es) ".implode(', ', $outside));
            }
        }

        return $rep;
    }

    public function show(Request $r, int $uploadId)
    {
        Security::require($this->user($r), 'stock.upload');
        $up = StockUpload::find($uploadId) ?? throw new BusinessRuleError('Upload not found');

        return Uploads::report($up);
    }

    public function confirm(Request $r, int $uploadId)
    {
        $u = $this->user($r);
        Security::require($u, 'stock.upload');
        $r->validate(['approval' => 'required|array', 'override_duplicate' => 'nullable|boolean'] + self::APPROVAL_RULES);
        $up = StockUpload::find($uploadId) ?? throw new BusinessRuleError('Upload not found');
        $this->checked($u, Uploads::report($up));
        $ap = $this->approve($r, 'stock.upload.approve');

        return Uploads::confirm($uploadId, $u->username, $ap, (bool) $r->input('override_duplicate', false));
    }

    public function cancel(Request $r, int $uploadId)
    {
        Security::require($this->user($r), 'stock.upload');
        Uploads::cancel($uploadId, $this->user($r)->username);

        return ['ok' => true];
    }
}
