<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Web;

use App\Domain\Admin;
use App\Domain\Allocations;
use App\Domain\Assets;
use App\Domain\Batches;
use App\Domain\BusinessRuleError;
use App\Domain\Controls;
use App\Domain\Ifrs;
use App\Domain\Ledger;
use App\Domain\LedgerReports;
use App\Domain\Money;
use App\Domain\Pdf;
use App\Domain\Periodend;
use App\Domain\Reconcile;
use App\Domain\Reports;
use App\Domain\Security;
use App\Domain\Statements;
use App\Domain\Views;
use App\Domain\Xlsx;
use App\Models\Account;
use App\Models\Batch;
use App\Models\FixedAsset;
use App\Models\Journal;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

/** Entry batches, journals and ledger with period close, financial statements, reconciliations, reports, profit by branch. */
class AccountingWebController extends WebController
{
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ batches
    public function batches(Request $r)
    {
        $this->need($r, 'reports.view');
        $no = $r->query('batch');

        return view('screens.batches', ['title' => 'Entry batches', 'subtitle' => 'Key against a control total and count, check, a second person posts – all entries or none',
            'open' => Batches::openBatches($this->scope($r)), 'register' => array_slice(array_reverse(Batches::register(null, null, null, null, null, $this->scope($r))), 0, 40),
            'b' => $no ? Batches::listing($no) : null, 'type' => $r->query('type', 'GL'), 'kinds' => Batches::KINDS,
            'accounts' => Account::where('control', 'Manual allowed')->orderBy('code')->get()]);
    }

    private function batchUser(Request $r, string $type, ?int $branchId): void
    {
        $u = $this->user($r);
        Security::require($u, 'batch.create', $branchId);
        Security::require($u, \App\Http\Controllers\Api\BatchController::TYPE_PERMISSION[$type], $branchId);
    }

    public function batchCreate(Request $r)
    {
        $type = (string) $r->input('type');
        $unit = $this->workUnit($r, 'batch.create', $type === 'INV');
        $this->batchUser($r, $type, $unit->id);
        $b = Batches::createBatch($type, $unit->id, (string) $r->input('description'), $this->str($r, 'control_total', '0'), (int) $r->input('control_count'), $this->user($r)->username);

        return redirect()->route('batches', ['batch' => $b->batch_no])->with('ok', "Batch {$b->batch_no} opened – key the entries");
    }

    /** One entry: the form fields become the payload (blank fields left out; JOURNAL lines from the line rows). */
    public function batchEntry(Request $r, string $no)
    {
        $b = Batches::get($no);
        $this->batchUser($r, $b->batch_type, $b->branch_id);
        if ($r->input('action') === 'delete') {
            Batches::deleteEntry($no, (int) $r->input('seq'), $this->user($r)->username);

            return $this->done('Entry removed');
        }
        $kind = (string) $r->input('kind');
        $p = array_filter((array) $r->input('p', []), fn ($v) => $v !== null && $v !== '');
        foreach (['supplier_charges_vat'] as $flag) {
            if (isset($p[$flag])) {
                $p[$flag] = (bool) $p[$flag];
            }
        }
        if ($kind === 'JOURNAL') {
            $p['lines'] = array_values(array_filter(array_map(fn ($l) => array_filter($l, fn ($v) => $v !== null && $v !== ''), (array) $r->input('lines', [])),
                fn ($l) => ! empty($l['account'])));
        }
        foreach (['lines', 'allocations'] as $json) {
            if (isset($p[$json]) && is_string($p[$json])) {
                $p[$json] = json_decode($p[$json], true) ?? throw new BusinessRuleError("{$json}: not valid JSON");
            }
        }
        Batches::addEntry($no, $kind, $this->str($r, 'date', date('Y-m-d')), $this->str($r, 'reference'), $this->user($r)->username, $p);

        return $this->done('Entry added');
    }

    public function batchAction(Request $r, string $no)
    {
        $u = $this->user($r);
        if ($r->input('action') === 'recurring') {
            Security::require($u, 'journal.create');
            [$m, $start, $end] = $this->month($r);
            $made = Batches::generateRecurring($end, $u->username);

            return $this->done($made ? 'Recurring journals drafted in '.implode(', ', $made) : 'No recurring journals due this month');
        }
        $b = Batches::get($no);
        switch ($r->input('action')) {
            case 'check':
                Security::require($u, 'reports.view', $b->branch_id);
                $c = Batches::check($no, $u->username);

                return redirect()->back()->with($c['ready'] ? 'ok' : 'error', $c['ready'] ? 'Every entry would post and the batch agrees to its controls'
                    : 'Not ready: '.($c['balanced'] ? '' : "controls differ by {$c['total_difference']} / {$c['count_difference']} entries; ")
                    .implode('; ', array_map(fn ($e) => "entry {$e['seq']}: {$e['error']}", $c['errors'])));
            case 'post':
                Security::require($u, 'reports.view', $b->branch_id);
                $res = Batches::postBatch($no, $u->username, $this->approval($r, 'batch.approve', $b->branch_id, $b->batch_type === 'INV' ? null : $b->control_total));

                return $this->done("{$res['posted']} entries posted");
            case 'reverse':
                $this->batchUser($r, $b->batch_type, $b->branch_id);
                $rb = Batches::reverseBatch($no, $this->str($r, 'date', date('Y-m-d')), (string) $r->input('reason'), $u->username, $this->approval($r, 'batch.approve', $b->branch_id));

                return $this->done("Reversed by {$rb->batch_no}");
            case 'delete':
                $this->batchUser($r, $b->batch_type, $b->branch_id);
                Batches::deleteBatch($no, $u->username);

                return redirect()->route('batches')->with('ok', "Batch {$no} deleted");
            case 'import':
                $this->batchUser($r, $b->batch_type, $b->branch_id);
                $f = $r->file('file') ?? throw new BusinessRuleError('Choose the CSV file');
                $n = Batches::importGlCsv($no, (string) file_get_contents($f->getRealPath()), $u->username);

                return $this->done("{$n} journals imported into the batch");
        }
        throw new BusinessRuleError('Unknown action');
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ journals, ledger and period close
    public function ledger(Request $r)
    {
        $this->need($r, 'reports.view');
        [$m, $start, $end] = $this->month($r);
        $q = Journal::with('lines')->where('entry_date', '>=', $start)->where('entry_date', '<=', $end)->orderByDesc('id')->limit(150);
        if ($ids = $this->scope($r)) {
            $q->whereIn('branch_id', $ids);
        }
        $acct = $r->query('account');
        $jid = $r->query('journal');

        return view('screens.ledger', ['title' => 'Journals, ledger and period close', 'subtitle' => date('F Y', strtotime($start)).' · '.($this->unit($r)?->name ?? 'all units'),
            'journals' => $q->get(), 'accounts' => Account::orderBy('code')->get(), 'manual' => Account::where('control', 'Manual allowed')->orderBy('code')->get(),
            'ledger' => $acct ? Views::accountLedger((int) $acct, $start, $end, $this->scope($r), $this->str($r, 'party')) : null,
            'journal' => $jid ? Views::journalDetail((int) $jid) : null, 'locked' => Ledger::setting('locked_through'),
            'assets' => $this->unit($r) ? Assets::register($this->unit($r)->id, $end) : null, 'prepayments' => $this->unit($r) ? Periodend::prepaymentSchedule($this->unit($r)->id, $end) : [],
            'allocations' => Allocations::listing(), 'end' => $end]);
    }

    public function journal(Request $r)
    {
        $unit = $this->workUnit($r, 'journal.create');
        $lines = [];
        foreach ((array) $r->input('lines', []) as $l) {
            if (! empty($l['account'])) {
                $lines[] = [(int) $l['account'], (string) (($l['debit'] ?? '') ?: '0'), (string) (($l['credit'] ?? '') ?: '0'), ($l['party'] ?? '') ?: null];
            }
        }
        $amount = Money::sum(array_column($lines, 1));
        $j = Ledger::post($unit->id, $this->str($r, 'date', date('Y-m-d')), 'MANUAL', (string) $r->input('reference'), $lines, $this->user($r)->username,
            $this->str($r, 'memo'), $this->approval($r, 'journal.approve', $unit->id, $amount));

        return redirect()->route('ledger', ['journal' => $j->id])->with('ok', "Journal {$j->id} posted");
    }

    public function reverse(Request $r, int $id)
    {
        $u = $this->user($r);
        Security::require($u, 'journal.create');
        $ap = $this->approval($r, 'journal.approve');
        $j = Ledger::reverse($id, $this->str($r, 'date', date('Y-m-d')), $u->username, (string) $r->input('reason')." (approved {$ap})");

        return redirect()->route('ledger', ['journal' => $j->id])->with('ok', "Journal {$id} reversed by {$j->id}");
    }

    /** Month-end routines: depreciation, prepayment releases, accruals, allocations, period lock. */
    public function periodEnd(Request $r)
    {
        $u = $this->user($r);
        [$m, $start, $end] = $this->month($r);
        switch ($r->input('action')) {
            case 'depreciation':
                $unit = $this->workUnit($r, 'assets.manage');
                $j = Assets::runDepreciation($unit->id, $end, $u->username, $this->approval($r, 'assets.approve', $unit->id));

                return $this->done($j ? 'Depreciation posted' : 'Nothing to depreciate this month');
            case 'releases':
                $unit = $this->workUnit($r, 'journal.create');
                $j = Periodend::runReleases($unit->id, $end, $u->username, $this->approval($r, 'journal.approve', $unit->id));

                return $this->done($j ? 'Prepayment releases posted' : 'No prepayment releases this month');
            case 'prepayment':
                $unit = $this->workUnit($r, 'journal.create');
                Periodend::addPrepayment($unit->id, (string) $r->input('reference'), (string) $r->input('description'), (int) $r->input('prepaid_account', 1150),
                    (int) $r->input('expense_account'), (string) $r->input('amount'), $this->str($r, 'first_month', $start), (int) $r->input('months'));

                return $this->done('Prepayment scheduled');
            case 'accrual':
                $unit = $this->workUnit($r, 'journal.create');
                Periodend::addAccrual($unit->id, (string) $r->input('reference'), (string) $r->input('description'), (int) $r->input('expense_account'), (string) $r->input('amount'),
                    $end, $u->username, $this->approval($r, 'journal.approve', $unit->id, (string) $r->input('amount')));

                return $this->done('Accrual posted and its reversal dated the 1st of next month');
            case 'asset':
                $unit = $this->workUnit($r, 'assets.manage');
                $ch = $this->str($r, 'pay_channel');
                Assets::add($unit->id, (string) $r->input('tag'), (string) $r->input('description'), (int) $r->input('asset_account'), (string) $r->input('cost'),
                    $this->str($r, 'acquired_on', date('Y-m-d')), (int) $r->input('life_months'), $u->username, $this->str($r, 'residual', '0'), $ch,
                    $ch ? $this->approval($r, 'assets.approve', $unit->id) : null);

                return $this->done('Asset registered');
            case 'dispose':
                Security::require($u, 'assets.manage');
                $res = Assets::dispose((string) $r->input('tag'), $this->str($r, 'date', date('Y-m-d')), $this->str($r, 'proceeds', '0'), $this->str($r, 'channel'), $u->username,
                    $this->approval($r, 'assets.approve'));

                return $this->done("Disposed – gain or loss {$res['gain_loss']}");
            case 'allocate':
                $unit = $this->workUnit($r, 'journal.create');
                $lines = array_values(array_filter((array) $r->input('alloc', []), fn ($l) => ! empty($l['account_code']) && ($l['amount'] ?? '') !== ''));
                $shares = [];
                foreach ((array) $r->input('shares', []) as $code => $v) {
                    if ($v !== null && $v !== '') {
                        $shares[$code] = (string) $v;
                    }
                }
                $res = Allocations::allocate($unit->id, $end, $lines, (string) $r->input('basis'), $u->username,
                    $this->approval($r, 'journal.approve', $unit->id, Money::sum(array_column($lines, 'amount'))), null, $shares ?: null, $start, $end, $this->str($r, 'memo'));

                return $this->done("{$res['ref']} charged: ".implode(', ', array_map(fn ($k, $v) => "{$k} {$v}", array_keys($res['by_branch']), $res['by_branch'])));
            case 'lock':
                Security::require($u, 'settings.propose');
                Admin::changeSetting('locked_through', (string) $r->input('locked_through', $end), (string) $r->input('reason', 'month closed'), $u->username,
                    $this->approval($r, 'period.close'));

                return $this->done('Period locked');
        }
        throw new BusinessRuleError('Unknown action');
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ financial statements
    private function statementPeriod(Request $r): array
    {
        [$m] = $this->month($r);
        $kind = in_array($r->query('kind'), ['month', 'quarter', 'half', 'ytd', 'year'], true) ? $r->query('kind') : 'year';
        $mo = (int) substr($m, 5, 2);
        $n = match ($kind) { 'month', 'ytd' => $mo, 'quarter' => intdiv($mo - 1, 3) + 1, 'half' => $mo <= 6 ? 1 : 2, default => 1 };
        $fyStart = substr($m, 0, 4).'-'.Ledger::setting('fy_start_mmdd', '01-01');

        return [$fyStart, $kind, $n];
    }

    public function statements(Request $r)
    {
        $this->need($r, 'reports.view');
        [$fy, $kind, $n] = $this->statementPeriod($r);
        $fs = Ifrs::fullStatements($fy, $kind, $n, $this->scope($r));
        $tab = $r->query('tab', 'pl');
        $extra = [];
        if ($tab === 'accounts') {
            [$a, $b] = $fs['current']['period'];
            $extra['masters'] = LedgerReports::masterAccounts($a, $b, $this->scope($r));
            $extra['subs'] = $r->query('code') ? LedgerReports::subAccounts((int) $r->query('code'), $a, $b, $this->scope($r)) : null;
        }

        return view('screens.statements', ['title' => 'Financial statements', 'subtitle' => $fs['framework'].' · '.($this->unit($r)?->name ?? 'whole business, inter-unit balances eliminated'),
            'fs' => $fs, 'tab' => $tab, 'kind' => $kind] + $extra);
    }

    public function disclosure(Request $r)
    {
        $this->need($r, 'journal.create');
        Ifrs::setDisclosure((string) $r->input('key'), (string) $r->input('period_end'), (string) $r->input('text'), $this->user($r)->username, $this->str($r, 'amount'));

        return $this->done('Note text saved');
    }

    public function statementsExport(Request $r, string $format)
    {
        $this->need($r, 'reports.view');
        [$fy, $kind, $n] = $this->statementPeriod($r);
        $fs = Ifrs::fullStatements($fy, $kind, $n, $this->scope($r));
        $name = 'financial_statements_'.($this->unit($r)?->code ?? 'business').'_'.$fs['current']['period'][1];
        if ($format === 'pdf') {
            return response(Pdf::fromHtml(view('print.statements', ['fs' => $fs, 'unit' => $this->unit($r)])->render(), $fs['title']), 200,
                ['Content-Type' => 'application/pdf', 'Content-Disposition' => "attachment; filename=\"{$name}.pdf\""]);
        }

        return $this->file(self::statementsXlsx($fs), self::XLSX, "{$name}.xlsx");
    }

    /** Every statement and note on its own sheet; nested items flattened to "a › b" labels. */
    public static function statementsXlsx(array $fs): string
    {
        $x = new Xlsx;
        $flat = fn (array $a) => \App\View\Fmt::flat($a);
        $p = $fs['current']['period'];
        $sub = "Period {$p[0]} to {$p[1]} · {$fs['framework']} · GH₵";
        foreach (['profit_or_loss_and_oci' => 'Profit or loss and OCI', 'financial_position' => 'Financial position', 'changes_in_equity' => 'Changes in equity',
            'cash_flows' => 'Cash flows'] as $k => $title) {
            $ws = $x->sheet(substr($title, 0, 31), "{$fs['title']} – {$title}", $sub);
            $x->header($ws, 4, ['Line', 'Current period', 'Comparative']);
            $cur = $flat($fs['current'][$k]);
            $cmp = $fs['comparative'] ? array_column($flat($fs['comparative'][$k]), 1, 0) : [];
            foreach ($cur as $i => [$label, $v]) {
                $x->row($ws, 5 + $i, [$label, $v, $cmp[$label] ?? null]);
            }
            $ws->getColumnDimension('A')->setWidth(70);
        }
        $ws = $x->sheet('Notes', "{$fs['title']} – notes", $sub);
        foreach ($flat($fs['notes']) as $i => [$label, $v]) {
            $x->row($ws, 4 + $i, [$label, $v]);
        }
        $ws->getColumnDimension('A')->setWidth(90);
        $ws = $x->sheet('Opening position', 'Opening statement of financial position', $sub);
        foreach ($flat($fs['opening_statement_of_financial_position']) as $i => [$label, $v]) {
            $x->row($ws, 4 + $i, [$label, $v]);
        }
        $ws->getColumnDimension('A')->setWidth(90);
        $ws = $x->sheet('Checks', 'Checks and open items', $sub);
        $row = 4;
        foreach ($fs['checks'] as $k => $v) {
            $x->row($ws, $row++, [\App\View\Fmt::label($k), $v, $v->isZero() ? 'OK' : 'DIFFERENCE']);
        }
        foreach ($fs['open_items'] as $o) {
            $x->row($ws, ++$row, ['NOT YET COMPLETED', $o]);
        }

        return $x->bytes();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ reconciliations
    public function reconcile(Request $r)
    {
        $this->need($r, 'reports.view');
        [$m, $start, $end] = $this->month($r);

            'packs' => Reconcile::allUnits($start, $end, $this->scope($r)), 'end' => $end]);
    }

            $this->str($r, 'reference'), $this->user($r)->username);

        return $this->done('Statement balance recorded');
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ reports
    public function reports(Request $r)
    {
        $this->need($r, 'reports.view');
        [$m, $start, $end] = $this->month($r);
        $tab = $r->query('tab', 'tb');
        $ids = $this->scope($r);
        $data = match ($tab) {
            'tb' => ['tb' => Reports::trialBalance($start, $end, $ids)],
            'pack' => ['pack' => Reports::periodPack(substr($m, 0, 4).'-01-01', $ids)],
            'ageing' => ['rec' => Statements::receivablesAgeing($end, $ids), 'pay' => Statements::payablesAgeing($end, $ids)],
            'vat' => ['vat' => Reports::vatReturn($start, $end, $ids)],
            'alerts' => ['alerts' => Controls::alerts($start, $end, $ids, min($end, date('Y-m-d')))],
            'cd' => ['cd' => $this->unit($r) && Security::can($this->user($r), 'cd_register.view') ? Controls::controlledDrugRegister($this->unit($r)->id, $start, $end) : []],
            'audit' => ['audit' => Security::can($this->user($r), 'audit.view') ? \App\Models\AuditLog::orderByDesc('id')->limit(200)->get() : collect()],
            default => [],
        };

        return view('screens.reports', ['title' => 'Reports', 'subtitle' => date('F Y', strtotime($start)).' · '.($this->unit($r)?->name ?? 'all units'), 'tab' => $tab,
            'accounts' => Reports::accounts(), 'start' => $start, 'end' => $end] + $data);
    }

    public function reportExport(Request $r, string $what)
    {
        $this->need($r, 'reports.view');
        [$m, $start, $end] = $this->month($r);
        $ids = $this->scope($r);
        $x = new Xlsx;
        $unitName = $this->unit($r)?->name ?? 'All units';
        if ($what === 'tb') {
            $meta = Reports::accounts();
            $tb = Reports::trialBalance($start, $end, $ids);
            $rows = array_map(fn ($c, $v) => ['code' => $c, 'account' => $meta[$c]->name, 'line' => $meta[$c]->line, 'debit' => $v->isPositive() ? $v : null,
                'credit' => $v->isNegative() ? $v->negated() : null], array_keys($tb), $tb);
            $ws = $x->sheet('Trial_balance', "Trial balance – {$unitName}", "{$start} to {$end}");
            $last = $x->table($ws, $rows);
            $x->row($ws, $last + 1, ['', 'Total', '', Money::sum(array_filter(array_column($rows, 'debit'))), Money::sum(array_filter(array_column($rows, 'credit')))], true);

            return $this->file($x->bytes(), self::XLSX, "trial_balance_{$m}.xlsx");
        }
        if ($what === 'profit') {
            Security::requireAllBranches($this->user($r));
            $p = Reports::profitByBranch($start, $end);
            $ws = $x->sheet('Profit_by_branch', 'Profit by branch', "{$start} to {$end}");
            $codes = array_column($p['columns'], 'code');
            $x->header($ws, 4, array_merge(['Line'], array_column($p['columns'], 'name'), ['Total']));
            $row = 5;
            foreach ($p['profit_and_loss'] as $l) {
                $x->row($ws, $row++, array_merge([$l['label']], array_map(fn ($c) => $l['by_unit'][$c] ?? null, $codes), [$l['total']]));
            }
            $row++;
            foreach ($p['liabilities'] as $l) {
                $x->row($ws, $row++, array_merge([$l['label']], array_map(fn ($c) => $l['by_unit'][$c] ?? null, $codes), [$l['total']]));
            }
            $ws->getColumnDimension('A')->setWidth(36);

            return $this->file($x->bytes(), self::XLSX, "profit_by_branch_{$m}.xlsx");
        }
        abort(404);
    }

    public function profit(Request $r)
    {
        $this->need($r, 'reports.view');
        Security::requireAllBranches($this->user($r));
        [$m, $start, $end] = $this->month($r);
        $from = $r->query('from', substr($m, 0, 4).'-01-01');

        return view('screens.profit', ['title' => 'Profit by branch', 'subtitle' => date('d M Y', strtotime($from)).' to '.date('d M Y', strtotime($end)).' · total equals the consolidated profit and loss',
            'p' => Reports::profitByBranch($from, $end), 'from' => $from]);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Web;

use App\Domain\Admin;
use App\Domain\Branches;
use App\Domain\BusinessRuleError;
use App\Domain\Integrity;
use App\Domain\Ledger;
use App\Domain\Security;
use App\Models\Branch;
use App\Models\Payer;
use App\Models\Setting;
use App\Models\TaxRate;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Models\UserBranch;
use App\Models\WhtType;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

/** Users, units, two-step sign-in, integrity and backups; controlled settings, tax rates, PAYE tables, WHT rates. */
class AdminWebController extends WebController
{
    public function admin(Request $r)
    {
        $u = $this->user($r);
        $manage = Security::can($u, 'users.manage');
        $audit = Security::can($u, 'audit.view');

        return view('screens.admin', ['title' => 'Users, units and system', 'subtitle' => 'Each person signs in as themselves; approvals need a second person\'s password',
            'manage' => $manage, 'auditor' => $audit,
            'users' => $manage ? User::orderBy('username')->get() : collect(), 'extra' => UserBranch::get()->groupBy('user_id'),
            'branches' => Branch::orderByDesc('is_head_office')->orderBy('code')->get(), 'roles' => array_keys(Security::ROLES),
            'integrity' => $audit ? Integrity::summary() : null, 'payers' => Payer::orderBy('code')->get(),
            'enrol' => $r->session()->get('totp_enrol')]);
    }

    public function action(Request $r)
    {
        $u = $this->user($r);
        switch ($r->input('action')) {
            case 'branch':
                Security::require($u, 'users.manage');
                Security::requireAllBranches($u);
                Branches::create(strtoupper((string) $r->input('code')), (string) $r->input('name'), $u->username, $r->boolean('is_head_office'));

                return $this->done('Unit added');
            case 'user':
                Security::require($u, 'users.manage');
                if (strlen((string) $r->input('password')) < 10) {
                    throw new BusinessRuleError('Passwords need at least 10 characters');
                }
                $b = $r->filled('branch') ? Branch::where('code', $r->input('branch'))->firstOrFail()->id : null;
                Security::createUser((string) $r->input('username'), (string) $r->input('full_name'), (string) $r->input('role'), (string) $r->input('password'), $u->username, $b);

                return $this->done('User created – they should sign in and set up two-step sign-in');
            case 'disable':
                Security::require($u, 'users.manage');
                if ($r->input('username') === $u->username) {
                    throw new BusinessRuleError('You cannot disable yourself');
                }
                Security::setActive((string) $r->input('username'), false, $u->username);

                return $this->done('User disabled');
            case 'enable':
                Security::require($u, 'users.manage');
                Security::setActive((string) $r->input('username'), true, $u->username);

                return $this->done('User enabled');
            case 'branches':
                Security::require($u, 'users.manage');
                Security::requireAllBranches($u);
                $id = fn ($c) => Branch::where('code', $c)->first()?->id ?? throw new BusinessRuleError("Unknown unit {$c}");
                $extra = array_filter(array_map('trim', explode(',', (string) $r->input('extra_branches'))));
                Security::setUserBranches((string) $r->input('username'), $r->filled('home_branch') ? $id($r->input('home_branch')) : null, array_map($id, $extra), $u->username);

                return $this->done('Branch access saved');
            case 'reset2fa':
                Security::require($u, 'users.manage');
                Security::resetTotp((string) $r->input('username'), $u->username);

                return $this->done('Two-step sign-in reset – the user enrols again at next sign-in');
            case 'enrol':
                $r->session()->put('totp_enrol', Security::enrollTotp($u));

                return $this->done('Add the key below to your authenticator app, then confirm with a code');
            case 'confirm':
                Security::confirmTotp($u, (string) $r->input('code'));
                $r->session()->forget('totp_enrol');

                return $this->done('Two-step sign-in is on');
            case 'password':
                if (! Security::verifyPassword((string) $r->input('current'), $u->password_hash)) {
                    throw new BusinessRuleError('Current password is wrong');
                }
                if (strlen((string) $r->input('new')) < 10 || $r->input('new') !== $r->input('confirm')) {
                    throw new BusinessRuleError('New password needs at least 10 characters and must match the confirmation');
                }
                $u->update(['password_hash' => Security::hashPassword((string) $r->input('new'))]);
                Ledger::audit($u->username, 'PASSWORD_CHANGE', 'user', $u->username);

                return $this->done('Password changed');
            case 'payer':
                Security::require($u, 'masterdata.manage');
                if (! in_array($r->input('payer_type'), ['Retail', 'NHIS', 'Insurer', 'Corporate'], true)) {
                    throw new BusinessRuleError('Choose a payer type');
                }
                Payer::create(['code' => $r->input('code'), 'name' => $r->input('name'), 'payer_type' => $r->input('payer_type'),
                    'copay_pct' => $this->str($r, 'copay_pct', '1'), 'expected_reduction_pct' => $this->str($r, 'expected_reduction_pct', '0'),
                    'credit_limit' => $this->str($r, 'credit_limit', '0'), 'claim_deadline_days' => 0, 'payment_terms_days' => (int) $this->str($r, 'payment_terms_days', '30')]);
                Ledger::audit($u->username, 'PAYER_CREATE', 'payer', $r->input('code'));

                return $this->done('Customer / payer added');
            case 'backup':
                Security::require($u, 'system.backup');
                if (! in_array($r->input('kind'), ['BACKUP', 'RESTORE_TEST'], true) || ! in_array($r->input('status'), ['OK', 'FAILED'], true)) {
                    throw new BusinessRuleError('Choose the kind and status');
                }
                $id = Integrity::recordBackup((string) $r->input('kind'), (string) $r->input('started_at'), $this->str($r, 'finished_at'), (string) $r->input('status'),
                    $this->str($r, 'location'), $this->str($r, 'checksum'), $this->str($r, 'detail'));
                Ledger::audit($u->username, 'BACKUP_RECORD', 'backup_record', $id, "{$r->input('kind')} {$r->input('status')}");

                return $this->done('Backup recorded');
            case 'seal':
                Security::require($u, 'audit.view');
                $n = Integrity::seal();

                return $this->done("{$n} audit entries sealed into the hash chain");
        }
        throw new BusinessRuleError('Unknown action');
    }

    public function settings(Request $r)
    {
        $this->need($r, 'reports.view');
        $u = $this->user($r);

        return view('screens.settings', ['title' => 'Settings and tax tables', 'subtitle' => 'Every change needs a reason and a second person; the history is kept',
            'settings' => Setting::orderBy('key')->get(), 'taxes' => TaxRate::orderBy('code')->orderBy('effective_from')->get(), 'paye' => Admin::payeTables(),
            'wht' => WhtType::orderBy('name')->get(), 'history' => Security::can($u, 'audit.view') ? array_slice(array_reverse(Admin::history()), 0, 50) : [],
            'propose' => Security::can($u, 'settings.propose')]);
    }

    public function change(Request $r)
    {
        $u = $this->user($r);
        Security::require($u, 'settings.propose');
        $ap = $this->approval($r, 'settings.approve');
        switch ($r->input('action')) {
            case 'setting':
                Admin::changeSetting((string) $r->input('key'), (string) $r->input('value', ''), (string) $r->input('reason'), $u->username, $ap);

                return $this->done('Setting changed');
            case 'tax':
                Admin::addTaxRate((string) $r->input('code'), (string) $r->input('description'), (string) $r->input('vat'), (string) $r->input('nhil'),
                    (string) $r->input('getfund'), (string) $r->input('effective_from'), (string) $r->input('legal_basis'), $u->username, $ap);

                return $this->done('Tax rate added from '.$r->input('effective_from'));
            case 'paye':
                $bands = [];
                foreach ((array) $r->input('bands', []) as $b) {
                    if (($b['rate'] ?? '') !== '') {
                        $bands[] = [($b['annual_width'] ?? '') === '' ? null : (string) $b['annual_width'], (string) $b['rate']];
                    }
                }
                Admin::setPayeBands((string) $r->input('effective_from'), $bands, (string) $r->input('legal_basis'), $u->username, $ap);

                return $this->done('New PAYE table in force from '.$r->input('effective_from'));
            case 'wht':
                Admin::changeWhtRate((string) $r->input('name'), (string) $r->input('rate'), (string) $r->input('legal_basis'), $u->username, $ap);

                return $this->done('Withholding rate changed');
        }
        throw new BusinessRuleError('Unknown action');
    }
}

##### FILE: app/Http/Controllers/Web/AuthWebController.php
####################################################################################################

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Web;

use App\Domain\BusinessRuleError;
use App\Domain\Ledger;
use App\Domain\Security;
use App\Models\Branch;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

class AuthWebController extends WebController
{
    public function form(Request $r)
    {
        if (User::count() === 0) {
            return response('No users yet. Create the first administrator: POST /api/setup/admin (see README).', 200, ['Content-Type' => 'text/plain']);
        }

        return view('signin');
    }

    public function signin(Request $r)
    {
        $x = $r->validate(['username' => 'required|string', 'password' => 'required|string', 'code' => 'nullable|string']);
        try {
            $u = Security::authenticate($x['username'], $x['password'], $x['code'] ?? null);
        } catch (BusinessRuleError $e) {
            $r->attributes->set('commit_on_error', true); // the failed attempt counts towards the lock-out
            throw $e;
        }
        $r->session()->regenerate();
        $r->session()->put(['uid' => $u->id, 'auth_at' => time()]);
        $allowed = Security::branchIds($u);
        $home = $allowed === null ? null : (Branch::find($u->branch_id) ?? Branch::whereIn('id', $allowed)->orderBy('code')->first());
        $r->session()->put('unit', $home?->code);
        $start = Security::can($u, 'reports.view') ? 'dashboard' : (Security::can($u, 'sale.create') ? 'pos' : 'dashboard');

        return redirect()->route($start);
    }

    public function signout(Request $r)
    {
        if ($id = $r->session()->get('uid')) {
            Ledger::audit((string) User::find($id)?->username, 'LOGOUT', 'user', $id);
        }
        $r->session()->invalidate();
        $r->session()->regenerateToken();

        return redirect()->route('signin');
    }

    /** Unit and month at the top of every screen. */
    public function context(Request $r)
    {
        $u = $this->user($r);
        $code = $this->str($r, 'unit');
        $allowed = Security::branchIds($u);
        if ($code === null) {
            if ($allowed !== null) {
                throw new BusinessRuleError('Your account works in named branches only');
            }
            $r->session()->forget('unit');
        } else {
            $b = Branch::where('code', $code)->first() ?? throw new BusinessRuleError("Unknown unit {$code}");
            if ($allowed !== null && ! in_array($b->id, $allowed, true)) {
                throw new BusinessRuleError("{$u->username} is limited to other branches");
            }
            $r->session()->put('unit', $b->code);
        }
        if (preg_match('/^\d{4}-\d{2}$/', (string) $r->input('month'))) {
            $r->session()->put('month', $r->input('month'));
        }

        return redirect()->back();
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Web;

use App\Domain\BusinessRuleError;
use App\Domain\GraForms;
use App\Domain\Ledger;
use App\Domain\Payroll;
use App\Domain\PayrollReports;
use App\Domain\PettyCash;
use App\Domain\Schedules;
use App\Domain\Security;
use App\Models\Batch;
use App\Models\Branch;
use App\Models\CashCount;
use App\Models\Employee;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

/** Petty cash vault and bank, VAT/tax/GRA returns, payroll. */
class MoneyWebController extends WebController
{
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ petty cash vault and bank batches
    public function petty(Request $r)
    {
        $this->need($r, 'reports.view');
        [$m, $start, $end] = $this->month($r);
        $unit = $this->unit($r);
        $batches = Batch::whereIn('batch_type', ['PETTY', 'BANK'])->orderByDesc('id')->limit(40);
        if ($ids = $this->scope($r)) {
            $batches->whereIn('branch_id', $ids);
        }

        return view('screens.petty', ['title' => 'Petty cash vault and bank', 'subtitle' => ($unit?->name ?? 'All units').' · imprest float, vouchers, top-ups, counts and bank batches',
            'status' => $unit ? PettyCash::status($unit->id, $end) : null, 'batches' => $batches->get(), 'denoms' => PettyCash::DENOMINATIONS,
            'counts' => $unit ? CashCount::where('branch_id', $unit->id)->orderByDesc('id')->limit(10)->get() : collect(),
            'all' => $unit ? [] : Branch::orderBy('is_head_office', 'desc')->orderBy('code')->get()->map(fn ($b) => ['unit' => $b->name] + PettyCash::status($b->id, $end))->all()]);
    }

    public function setFloat(Request $r)
    {
        $unit = $this->workUnit($r, 'cash.bank');
        PettyCash::setFloat($unit->id, (string) $r->input('imprest'), (string) $r->input('custodian'), $this->user($r)->username, $this->approval($r, 'cashup.approve', $unit->id));

        return $this->done('Petty cash float set');
    }

    public function count(Request $r)
    {
        $u = $this->user($r);
        $unit = $this->workUnit($r, Security::can($u, 'cash.bank') ? 'cash.bank' : 'cashup.declare');
        $d = array_filter((array) $r->input('d', []), fn ($v) => $v !== null && $v !== '');
        $c = PettyCash::recordCount($unit->id, $this->str($r, 'date', date('Y-m-d')), array_map('intval', $d), $u->username, $this->str($r, 'witnessed_by'),
            (int) $r->input('account_code', 1015), $this->str($r, 'vouchers_not_posted', '0'));

        return $this->done("Counted {$c->counted} against book {$c->book}: variance {$c->variance}");
    }

    public function postVariance(Request $r, int $id)
    {
        $this->need($r, 'cash.bank');
        PettyCash::postVariance($id, $this->user($r)->username, $this->approval($r, 'cashup.approve'));

        return $this->done('Variance posted to cash over and short');
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ VAT, tax and GRA returns
    public function returns(Request $r)
    {
        $this->need($r, 'tax.schedules');
        [$m, $start, $end] = $this->month($r);
        [$y, $mm] = [(int) substr($m, 0, 4), (int) substr($m, 5, 2)];
        $tab = $r->query('tab', 'vat');

        return view('screens.returns', ['title' => 'VAT, tax and GRA returns', 'subtitle' => date('F Y', strtotime($start)).' · one TIN for the whole business · filed on the GRA and SSNIT portals',
            'tab' => $tab, 'y' => $y, 'm' => $mm, 'sch' => Schedules::all($y, $mm), 'calendar' => Schedules::calendar($y, $mm, date('Y-m-d')),
            'annual' => Schedules::annualReturnStatus($mm <= 4 ? $y - 1 : $y, date('Y-m-d')), 'closed' => \App\Models\Journal::where('source', 'VATCLOSE')
                ->where('source_ref', sprintf('VAT-%d-%02d', $y, $mm))->exists()]);
    }

    public function returnAction(Request $r)
    {
        $u = $this->user($r);
        [$m] = $this->month($r);
        [$y, $mm] = [(int) substr($m, 0, 4), (int) substr($m, 5, 2)];
        $tax = (string) $r->input('tax');
        switch ($r->input('action')) {
            case 'close':
                Security::require($u, 'tax.file');
                Schedules::closeVat($y, $mm, $this->str($r, 'date', date('Y-m-t', strtotime("{$m}-01"))), $u->username, $this->approval($r, 'period.close'));

                return $this->done('VAT period closed to 2130');
            case 'file':
                Security::require($u, 'tax.file');
                Schedules::recordFiling($tax, $y, $mm, $this->str($r, 'date', date('Y-m-d')), $this->str($r, 'reference'), (string) $r->input('amount'), $u->username);

                return $this->done("{$tax} filing recorded");
            case 'pay':
                Security::require($u, 'tax.file');
                $payer = Branch::where('code', $r->input('paying_branch'))->first() ?? throw new BusinessRuleError('Choose the paying unit');
                Schedules::pay($tax, $y, $mm, $payer->id, $this->str($r, 'date', date('Y-m-d')), $this->str($r, 'channel', 'Bank'), $u->username, $this->approval($r, 'tax.pay.approve'));

                return $this->done("{$tax} payment posted");
            case 'annual':
                Security::require($u, 'tax.file');
                Schedules::recordAnnualFiling((int) $r->input('year'), $this->str($r, 'date', date('Y-m-d')), $this->str($r, 'reference'), (string) $r->input('amount'), $u->username);

                return $this->done('Annual return filing recorded');
        }
        throw new BusinessRuleError('Unknown action');
    }

    public function returnFile(Request $r, string $what)
    {
        $this->need($r, 'tax.schedules');
        [$m] = $this->month($r);
        [$y, $mm] = [(int) substr($m, 0, 4), (int) substr($m, 5, 2)];

        return match ($what) {
            'pack' => $this->file(Schedules::excelPack($y, $mm, date('Y-m-d')), self::XLSX, "statutory_schedules_{$m}.xlsx"),
            'dt0110' => $this->file(GraForms::dt0110Xlsx($y, $mm), self::XLSX, "DT0110_WHT_return_{$m}.xlsx"),
            'wht-csv' => $this->file(GraForms::whtCsv($y, $mm), 'text/csv; charset=windows-1252', "wht_csv_{$m}.csv"),
            'whvat' => $this->file(GraForms::whvatXlsx($y, $mm), self::XLSX, "WHVAT_return_{$m}.xlsx"),
            'dt0108' => $this->file(GraForms::dt0108Xlsx((int) $r->query('year', $y - 1)), self::XLSX, 'DT0108B_annual_employees_'.$r->query('year', $y - 1).'.xlsx'),
            'payroll' => $this->file(PayrollReports::excel($y, $mm), self::XLSX, "payroll_{$m}.xlsx"),
            default => abort(404),
        };
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ payroll
    public function payroll(Request $r)
    {
        $u = $this->user($r);
        if (! (Security::can($u, 'payroll.prepare') || Security::can($u, 'payroll.approve'))) {
            $this->deny("{$u->username} may not view payroll");
        }
        [$m, $start, $end] = $this->month($r);
        [$y, $mm] = [(int) substr($m, 0, 4), (int) substr($m, 5, 2)];
        $emps = Employee::orderBy('staff_no');
        if ($ids = $this->scope($r)) {
            $emps->whereIn('branch_id', $ids);
        }

        return view('screens.payroll', ['title' => 'Payroll', 'subtitle' => date('F Y', strtotime($start)).' · PAYE bands in force, SSNIT Tier 1 13.5% and Tier 2 5%',
            'emps' => $emps->get(), 'register' => PayrollReports::register($y, $mm, $this->unit($r)?->id), 'advice' => PayrollReports::bankAdvice($y, $mm, $this->unit($r)?->id),
            'tier1' => PayrollReports::tier1($y, $mm), 'tier2' => PayrollReports::tier2($y, $mm), 'monthEnd' => $end]);
    }

    public function employee(Request $r)
    {
        $u = $this->user($r);
        $x = ['surname' => $this->str($r, 'surname'), 'first_name' => $this->str($r, 'first_name'), 'other_names' => $this->str($r, 'other_names'), 'role' => $this->str($r, 'role'),
            'basic' => $this->str($r, 'basic'), 'allowances' => $this->str($r, 'allowances', '0'), 'ssnit_status' => $r->boolean('ssnit_status'),
            'tax_status' => $this->str($r, 'tax_status', 'Resident'), 'junior_staff' => $r->boolean('junior_staff'), 'tin' => $this->str($r, 'tin'), 'ssnit_no' => $this->str($r, 'ssnit_no'),
            'pension_no' => $this->str($r, 'pension_no'), 'bank_name' => $this->str($r, 'bank_name'), 'bank_account' => $this->str($r, 'bank_account'),
            'nationality' => $this->str($r, 'nationality'), 'postal_address' => $this->str($r, 'postal_address'), 'residential_address' => $this->str($r, 'residential_address')];
        if (! in_array($x['tax_status'], Payroll::TAX_STATUSES, true)) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Choose a tax status');
        }
        $e = Employee::where('staff_no', $r->input('staff_no'))->first();
        if ($e) {
            Security::require($u, 'payroll.prepare', $e->branch_id);
            $e->fill(array_filter($x, fn ($v) => $v !== null));
            $e->name = Schedules::displayName($e);
            $e->save();
            Ledger::audit($u->username, 'EMPLOYEE_UPDATE', 'employee', $e->staff_no, (string) $r->input('reason', 'details updated'));

            return $this->done("Employee {$e->staff_no} updated");
        }
        $unit = $this->workUnit($r, 'payroll.prepare');
        if (! $x['surname'] || ! $x['first_name'] || ! $x['basic'] || ! $x['role']) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Surname, first name, role and basic salary are required');
        }
        $e = new Employee($x + ['branch_id' => $unit->id, 'staff_no' => (string) $r->input('staff_no')]);
        $e->name = Schedules::displayName($e);
        $e->save();
        Ledger::audit($u->username, 'EMPLOYEE_CREATE', 'employee', $e->staff_no, "basic {$e->basic}, {$e->tax_status}");

        return $this->done('Employee added');
    }

    public function run(Request $r)
    {
        $unit = $this->workUnit($r, 'payroll.prepare');
        $vars = [];
        foreach ((array) $r->input('v', []) as $staff => $v) {
            $v = array_filter($v, fn ($x) => $x !== null && $x !== '');
            if ($v) {
                $vars[$staff] = $v;
            }
        }
        [$m, $start, $end] = $this->month($r);
        [$jid] = Payroll::run($unit->id, $end, $this->user($r)->username, $this->approval($r, 'payroll.approve', $unit->id), $vars);

        return $this->done("Payroll for ".date('F Y', strtotime($end))." posted (journal {$jid})");
    }

    public function paySalaries(Request $r)
    {
        $unit = $this->workUnit($r, 'payroll.prepare');
        [$m, $start, $end] = $this->month($r);
        $ap = $this->approval($r, 'payroll.approve', $unit->id);
        $fn = fn () => Payroll::paySalaries($unit->id, $end, $this->str($r, 'channel', 'Bank'), $this->user($r)->username, $ap);
        $payer = $this->str($r, 'paid_by');
        if ($payer) {
            $b = Branch::where('code', $payer)->first() ?? throw new BusinessRuleError("Unknown unit {$payer}");
            Security::require($this->user($r), 'payroll.prepare', $b->id);
            $res = Ledger::paidBy($b->id, $fn);
        } else {
            $res = $fn();
        }

        return $this->done("Net salaries paid: GH₵ {$res['total']} to {$res['employees']} employees");
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Web;

use App\Domain\Ap;
use App\Domain\BusinessRuleError;
use App\Domain\Money;
use App\Domain\Payables;
use App\Domain\Purchasing;
use App\Domain\Security;
use App\Domain\Statements;
use App\Models\Account;
use App\Models\APInvoice;
use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\PurchaseOrder;
use App\Models\Supplier;
use App\Models\WhtType;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

/** Purchase orders and receiving; payables (supplier invoices, held invoices, payments, expenses, suppliers). */
class PurchasingWebController extends WebController
{
    public function index(Request $r)
    {
        $this->need($r, 'po.create');
        $q = PurchaseOrder::with(['supplier', 'lines'])->orderByDesc('id')->limit(100);
        if ($ids = $this->scope($r)) {
            $q->whereIn('branch_id', $ids);
        }
        $po = $r->query('po') ? Purchasing::getPo((string) $r->query('po')) : null;
        [$m, $start, $end] = $this->month($r);

        return view('screens.purchasing', ['title' => 'Purchase orders and receiving', 'subtitle' => 'Requisition → order → approval → goods received → supplier invoice (three-way match)',
            'pos' => $q->get(), 'po' => $po, 'suppliers' => Supplier::orderBy('code')->get(), 'products' => Product::orderBy('sku')->get(),
            'accounts' => Account::where('control', 'Manual allowed')->where('statement', 'PL')->orderBy('code')->get(),
            'commitments' => Purchasing::commitments($this->unit($r)?->id), 'grni' => Purchasing::grniReport($end),
            'performance' => Purchasing::supplierPerformance($start, $end)]);
    }

    public function create(Request $r)
    {
        $unit = $this->workUnit($r, 'po.create', true);
        $lines = [];
        foreach ((array) $r->input('lines', []) as $l) {
            if (! empty($l['sku']) || ! empty($l['description'])) {
                $lines[] = array_filter(['sku' => $l['sku'] ?? null, 'description' => $l['description'] ?? null, 'account_code' => $l['account_code'] ?? null,
                    'qty' => (string) ($l['qty'] ?? ''), 'unit_price' => (string) ($l['unit_price'] ?? ''), 'tax_code' => $l['tax_code'] ?? 'SR20'], fn ($v) => $v !== null && $v !== '');
            }
        }
        $po = Purchasing::createPo($unit->id, (string) $r->input('supplier'), $this->str($r, 'date', date('Y-m-d')), $lines, $this->user($r)->username,
            $this->str($r, 'expected_date'), $this->str($r, 'notes'), null, $r->boolean('confirm_duplicate'));

        return redirect()->route('purchasing', ['po' => $po->po_no])->with('ok', "Order {$po->po_no} raised (draft) – total ".Purchasing::poTotal($po));
    }

    public function fromReorder(Request $r)
    {
        $unit = $this->workUnit($r, 'po.create', true);
        $req = Purchasing::requisitionFromReorder($unit->id, date('Y-m-d'), $this->user($r)->username);

        return $this->done($req ? "Requisition {$req->req_no} created with {$req->lines->count()} items at or below their reorder level" : 'Nothing is at its reorder level');
    }

    public function action(Request $r, string $poNo)
    {
        $u = $this->user($r);
        $po = Purchasing::getPo($poNo);
        switch ($r->input('action')) {
            case 'approve':
                Security::require($u, 'po.create', $po->branch_id);
                Purchasing::approvePo($poNo, $this->approval($r, Purchasing::approvalPermission($po), $po->branch_id), $u->username);

                return $this->done("{$poNo} approved – it can be sent to the supplier");
            case 'cancel':
                Security::require($u, 'po.create', $po->branch_id);
                Purchasing::cancelPo($poNo, $u->username, (string) $r->input('reason', 'cancelled'));

                return $this->done("{$poNo} cancelled");
            case 'close':
                Security::require($u, 'po.approve', $po->branch_id);
                Purchasing::closePo($poNo, $u->username, (string) $r->input('reason', 'closed'));

                return $this->done("{$poNo} closed");
            case 'receive':
                Security::require($u, 'po.receive', $po->branch_id);
                $goods = $services = [];
                foreach ((array) $r->input('rec', []) as $lineNo => $x) {
                    if (($x['qty'] ?? '') === '' || ! Money::d((string) $x['qty'])->isPositive()) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    $ln = $po->lines->firstWhere('line_no', (int) $lineNo);
                    if ($ln?->product_id) {
                        $goods[] = ['line_no' => (int) $lineNo, 'qty' => (string) $x['qty'], 'batch_no' => $x['batch_no'] ?? null, 'expiry' => $x['expiry'] ?? null];
                    } else {
                        $services[] = ['line_no' => (int) $lineNo, 'qty' => (string) $x['qty']];
                    }
                }
                if (! $goods && ! $services) {
                    throw new BusinessRuleError('Enter the quantity received on at least one line');
                }
                $grn = [];
                if ($goods) {
                    $grn[] = Purchasing::receive($poNo, $this->str($r, 'date', date('Y-m-d')), $goods, $u->username, $this->str($r, 'delivery_note'))->grn_no;
                }
                if ($services) {
                    $grn[] = Purchasing::confirmService($poNo, $this->str($r, 'date', date('Y-m-d')), $services, $u->username, $this->str($r, 'delivery_note'))->grn_no;
                }

                return $this->done('Received: '.implode(', ', $grn));
        }
        throw new BusinessRuleError('Unknown action');
    }

    public function pdf(Request $r, string $poNo)
    {
        $this->need($r, 'reports.view');

        return response(Purchasing::poPdf($poNo), 200, ['Content-Type' => 'application/pdf', 'Content-Disposition' => "inline; filename=\"{$poNo}.pdf\""]);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ payables
    public function payables(Request $r)
    {
        $this->need($r, 'reports.view');
        [$m, $start, $end] = $this->month($r);
        $q = APInvoice::with('supplier')->orderByDesc('id')->limit(200);
        if ($ids = $this->scope($r)) {
            $q->whereIn('branch_id', $ids);
        }

        return view('screens.payables', ['title' => 'Payables and receivables', 'subtitle' => 'Supplier invoices, held invoices, payment run, expenses, WHT and WHVAT',
            'invoices' => $q->get(), 'held' => Ap::held(), 'proposal' => Ap::proposePayments(date('Y-m-d', strtotime($end.' +14 days')), $this->unit($r)?->id),
            'ageing' => Ap::ageing($end), 'payAgeing' => Statements::payablesAgeing($end, $this->scope($r)), 'suppliers' => Supplier::orderBy('code')->get(),
            'accounts' => Account::where('control', 'Manual allowed')->whereNotIn('code', [1010, 1015, 1030, 1035, 1040, 1045, 2010, 2020])->orderBy('code')->get(),
            'whtTypes' => WhtType::orderBy('name')->pluck('name'), 'variances' => Ap::priceVarianceReport($start, $end)]);
    }

    public function invoice(Request $r)
    {
        $unit = $this->workUnit($r, 'ap.manage');
        $poNo = $this->str($r, 'po_no');
        $lines = [];
        foreach ((array) $r->input('lines', []) as $l) {
            if ($poNo && ($l['line_no'] ?? '') !== '' && ($l['qty'] ?? '') !== '') {
                $lines[] = ['line_no' => (int) $l['line_no'], 'qty' => (string) $l['qty'], 'unit_price' => (string) $l['unit_price']];
            } elseif (! $poNo && ! empty($l['account_code']) && ($l['net'] ?? '') !== '') {
                $lines[] = ['account_code' => (int) $l['account_code'], 'description' => (string) ($l['description'] ?? ''), 'net' => (string) $l['net'],
                    'tax_code' => $l['tax_code'] ?? 'SR20', 'use' => $l['use'] ?? 'Shared'];
            }
        }
        $inv = Ap::postInvoice($unit->id, (string) $r->input('supplier'), $this->str($r, 'invoice_no'), $this->str($r, 'invoice_date', date('Y-m-d')), $lines,
            $this->user($r)->username, $this->str($r, 'due_date'), $poNo, $this->str($r, 'kind', 'INVOICE'), $this->str($r, 'credit_of'));

        return $this->done($inv->status === 'HELD' ? "Invoice HELD – {$inv->hold_reason}" : "Invoice posted – GH₵ {$inv->gross}");
    }

    public function release(Request $r, int $id)
    {
        $this->need($r, 'ap.manage');
        Ap::releaseHeld($id, $this->approval($r, 'ap.release'), $this->user($r)->username, (string) $r->input('reason'));

        return $this->done('Held invoice released and posted');
    }

    public function pay(Request $r)
    {
        $unit = $this->workUnit($r, 'supplier.pay');
        $allocs = [];
        foreach ((array) $r->input('pay', []) as $id => $amt) {
            if ($amt !== null && $amt !== '' && Money::d((string) $amt)->isPositive()) {
                $allocs[] = ['invoice_id' => (int) $id, 'amount' => (string) $amt];
            }
        }
        $ap = $this->approval($r, 'supplier.pay.approve', $unit->id, Money::sum(array_column($allocs, 'amount')));
        $fn = fn () => Ap::payInvoices($unit->id, $this->str($r, 'date', date('Y-m-d')), $this->str($r, 'channel', 'Bank'), $allocs, $this->user($r)->username, $ap,
            $this->str($r, 'certificate_no'), $this->str($r, 'whvat_certificate_no'));
        $payer = $this->str($r, 'paid_by');
        $out = $payer ? \App\Domain\Ledger::paidBy($this->payerUnit($r, $payer, 'supplier.pay'), $fn) : $fn();

        return $this->done(count($out).' payment(s) posted; WHT '.Money::sum(array_column($out, 'wht')).' withheld');
    }

    private function payerUnit(Request $r, string $code, string $perm): int
    {
        $b = \App\Models\Branch::where('code', $code)->first() ?? throw new BusinessRuleError("Unknown unit {$code}");
        Security::require($this->user($r), $perm, $b->id);

        return $b->id;
    }

    public function expense(Request $r)
    {
        $unit = $this->workUnit($r, 'expense.create');
        $fn = fn () => Payables::recordExpense($unit->id, $this->str($r, 'date', date('Y-m-d')), (string) $r->input('payee'), (int) $r->input('account_code'),
            (string) $r->input('net'), $this->str($r, 'tax_code', 'OS'), $r->boolean('supplier_charges_vat'), $this->str($r, 'use', 'Shared'), $this->str($r, 'channel', 'Bank'),
            $this->user($r)->username, $this->str($r, 'wht_type', 'None'), $this->str($r, 'payee_tin'), null, 'Resident', $this->str($r, 'payee_location'), null,
            $this->str($r, 'certificate_no'), $this->str($r, 'invoice_no'), $this->str($r, 'invoice_date'));
        $payer = $this->str($r, 'paid_by');
        $res = $payer ? \App\Domain\Ledger::paidBy($this->payerUnit($r, $payer, 'expense.create'), $fn) : $fn();

        return $this->done("Expense posted – gross {$res['gross']}, WHT {$res['wht']}, WHVAT {$res['whvat']}");
    }

    public function supplier(Request $r)
    {
        $u = $this->user($r);
        Security::require($u, 'masterdata.manage');
        $ap = $this->approval($r, 'settings.approve');
        $x = array_filter(['code' => $this->str($r, 'code'), 'name' => $this->str($r, 'name'), 'tin' => $this->str($r, 'tin'), 'vat_registered' => $r->boolean('vat_registered'),
            'wht_type' => $this->str($r, 'wht_type', 'None'), 'resident_status' => $this->str($r, 'resident_status', 'Resident'), 'location' => $this->str($r, 'location'),
            'payment_terms_days' => (int) $r->input('payment_terms_days', 30), 'bank_name' => $this->str($r, 'bank_name'), 'bank_account' => $this->str($r, 'bank_account'),
            'momo_number' => $this->str($r, 'momo_number')], fn ($v) => $v !== null);
        if (Supplier::where('code', $x['code'] ?? '')->exists()) {
            $code = $x['code'];
            unset($x['code']);
            Payables::updateSupplier($code, $x, (string) $r->input('reason', 'details updated'), $u->username, $ap);

            return $this->done("Supplier {$code} updated");
        }
        Payables::createSupplier($x, $u->username, $ap);

        return $this->done('Supplier added');
    }

    public function adviceXlsx(Request $r)

        $this->need($r, 'supplier.pay');
        $on = (string) $r->query('on', date('Y-m-d'));

        return $this->file(Ap::paymentAdviceXlsx($on, $this->unit($r)?->id), self::XLSX, "supplier_payment_advice_{$on}.xlsx");
    }

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Web;

use App\Domain\Ar;
use App\Domain\BusinessRuleError;
use App\Domain\CashBook;
use App\Domain\Claims;
use App\Domain\Money;
use App\Domain\Periodend;
use App\Domain\Reports;
use App\Domain\Sales;
use App\Domain\Security;
use App\Models\CashUp;
use App\Models\Channel;
use App\Models\Claim;
use App\Models\Payer;
use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\Sale;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

/** Point of sale, sales history and returns, cash shifts and bank, customers and claims. */
class SalesWebController extends WebController
{
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ point of sale
    public function pos(Request $r)
    {
        $this->need($r, 'sale.create');
        $unit = $this->unit($r);
        $products = $unit && ! $unit->is_head_office ? Product::orderBy('name')->get()->filter(fn ($p) => \App\Domain\Branches::isActive($unit->id, $p))
            ->map(fn ($p) => ['sku' => $p->sku, 'name' => $p->name, 'barcode' => $p->barcode, 'price' => \App\Domain\Branches::retailPrice($unit->id, $p),
                'tax' => $p->tax_code, 'controlled' => (bool) $p->controlled])->values()->all() : [];
        $last = $unit ? Sale::where('branch_id', $unit->id)->where('cashier', $this->user($r)->username)->orderByDesc('id')->first() : null;

        return view('screens.pos', ['title' => 'Point of sale', 'subtitle' => $unit ? "{$unit->name} · till sales post to the ledger as they are rung up"
            : 'Choose a branch at the top to sell', 'products' => $products, 'payers' => Payer::orderBy('code')->get(),
            'channels' => Channel::orderBy('name')->get(), 'receipt' => $last ? Sales::receiptText($last->id) : null, 'lastSale' => $last]);
    }

    public function sell(Request $r)
    {
        $u = $this->user($r);
        $unit = $this->workUnit($r, 'sale.create', true);
        $items = [];
        foreach ((array) $r->input('items', []) as $it) {
            if (empty($it['code'])) {
                continue;
            }
            $items[] = ['code' => trim($it['code']), 'qty' => (string) (($it['qty'] ?? '') ?: '1'), 'discount' => (string) (($it['discount'] ?? '') ?: '0')]
                + (! empty($it['batch_no']) ? ['batch_no' => $it['batch_no']] : []);
        }
        if (! $items) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Scan or type at least one item');
        }
        $payments = [];
        foreach ((array) $r->input('payments', []) as $p) {
            if (($p['amount'] ?? '') !== '' && Money::d((string) $p['amount'])->isPositive()) {
                $payments[] = ['channel' => $p['channel'], 'amount' => (string) $p['amount']];
            }
        }
        if (! $payments) { // nothing typed: the first channel takes the whole patient portion
            $payments[] = ['channel' => (string) (($r->input('payments')[0]['channel'] ?? null) ?: 'Cash'), 'amount' => 'BALANCE'];
        }
        $disc = Money::sum(array_column($items, 'discount'));
        $ap = $r->filled('approver') ? $this->approval($r, 'discount.approve', $unit->id, $disc) : null;
        $disp = null;
        if ($r->filled('dispenser')) {
            $disp = Security::approve(['approver' => $r->input('dispenser'), 'approver_secret' => (string) $r->input('dispenser_secret')], 'sale.dispense', $u, $unit->id);
        }
        $no = $this->str($r, 'receipt_no') ?? sprintf('%s-%s-%04d', $unit->code, date('ymd'), Sale::where('branch_id', $unit->id)->count() + 1);
        $sale = Sales::checkout($unit->id, $no, $this->str($r, 'date', date('Y-m-d')), $this->str($r, 'till', 'T1'), $this->str($r, 'payer', 'RETAIL'), $items, $payments,
            $u->username, $this->str($r, 'member_ref'), $this->str($r, 'claim_no'), $ap, $this->str($r, 'tendered'), null, $this->str($r, 'prescription_ref'),
            $this->str($r, 'prescriber'), $disp);

        return redirect()->route('pos')->with('ok', "Sale {$sale->receipt_no} recorded".($sale->change_due ? " – change GH₵ {$sale->change_due}" : ''));
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ sales history and returns
    public function sales(Request $r)
    {
        $this->need($r, 'reports.view');
        [$m, $start, $end] = $this->month($r);
        $q = Sale::with(['lines', 'payer'])->where('sale_date', '>=', $start)->where('sale_date', '<=', $end)->orderByDesc('sale_date')->orderByDesc('id');
        if ($ids = $this->scope($r)) {
            $q->whereIn('branch_id', $ids);
        }
        $rows = $q->limit(500)->get()->map(fn ($s) => ['id' => $s->id, 'date' => $s->sale_date, 'receipt' => $s->receipt_no, 'payer' => $s->payer->code,
            'cashier' => $s->cashier, 'kind' => $s->original_sale_id ? 'Return' : 'Sale', 'total' => Money::sum($s->lines->pluck('gross')->all()),
            'vat' => Money::sum($s->lines->pluck('vat')->all()), 'evat' => $s->evat_status])->all();
        $show = $r->query('sale') ? Sale::with('lines.product')->find((int) $r->query('sale')) : null;

        return view('screens.sales', ['title' => 'Sales history', 'subtitle' => date('F Y', strtotime($start)), 'rows' => $rows,
            'kpis' => Reports::salesKpis($start, $end, $this->scope($r)), 'show' => $show, 'receipt' => $show ? Sales::receiptText($show->id) : null]);
    }

    public function saleReturn(Request $r)
    {
        $unit = $this->workUnit($r, 'sale.create', true);
        $items = [];
        foreach ((array) $r->input('lines', []) as $lineId => $qty) {
            if ($qty !== null && $qty !== '' && Money::d((string) $qty)->isPositive()) {
                $items[] = ['line_id' => (int) $lineId, 'qty' => (string) $qty];
            }
        }
        if (! $items) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Enter the quantity returned on at least one line');
        }
        $ap = $this->approval($r, 'sale.return.approve', $unit->id);
        $ret = Sales::returnSale($unit->id, (string) $r->input('original_receipt'), $this->str($r, 'return_no') ?? 'RET-'.$r->input('original_receipt'),
            $this->str($r, 'date', date('Y-m-d')), $items, $this->str($r, 'refund_channel', 'Cash'), $this->user($r)->username, $ap);

        return redirect()->route('sales', ['sale' => $ret->id])->with('ok', "Return {$ret->receipt_no} recorded");
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ cash shifts and bank
    public function cash(Request $r)
    {
        $this->need($r, 'cashup.declare');
        [$m, $start, $end] = $this->month($r);
        $unit = $this->unit($r);
        $ups = CashUp::where('cash_date', '>=', $start)->where('cash_date', '<=', $end)->orderByDesc('cash_date')->orderByDesc('id');
        if ($ids = $this->scope($r)) {
            $ups->whereIn('branch_id', $ids);
        }
        $rec = null;
        if ($unit && $r->query('statement_balance') !== null && Security::can($this->user($r), 'bank.reconcile')) {
            $rec = CashBook::reconciliation($unit->id, (int) $r->query('account', 1030), $end, (string) $r->query('statement_balance'));
        }

        return view('screens.cash', ['title' => 'Cash shifts and bank', 'subtitle' => date('F Y', strtotime($start)).' · '.($unit?->name ?? 'all branches'),
            'ups' => $ups->get()->map(fn ($c) => ['id' => $c->id, 'date' => $c->cash_date, 'till' => $c->till, 'cashier' => $c->cashier, 'declared' => $c->declared,
                'expected' => $c->expected, 'variance' => $c->variance, 'status' => $c->status, 'supervisor' => $c->supervisor])->all(),
            'missing' => $unit && ! $unit->is_head_office ? CashBook::missingCashups($unit->id, $start, min($end, date('Y-m-d', strtotime('-1 day')))) : [],
            'expected' => $unit && ! $unit->is_head_office ? CashBook::expectedCash($unit->id, (string) $r->query('till', 'T1'), min($end, date('Y-m-d'))) : null,
            'rec' => $rec, 'balances' => $unit ? array_map(fn ($c) => ['account' => $c, 'balance' => Reports::accountBalance($c, $end, [$unit->id])],
                [1010, 1015, 1030, 1035, 1040, 1045]) : []]);
    }

    public function declare(Request $r)
    {
        $unit = $this->workUnit($r, 'cashup.declare', true);
        $res = CashBook::declareCash($unit->id, $this->str($r, 'till', 'T1'), $this->str($r, 'date', date('Y-m-d')), $this->user($r)->username, (string) $r->input('counted'));

        return $this->done("Cash declared (cash-up {$res['cashup_id']}) – a supervisor approves it and the variance is posted");
    }

    public function approveCashup(Request $r, int $id)
    {
        $c = CashUp::find($id) ?? throw new BusinessRuleError('Cash-up not found');
        Security::require($this->user($r), 'cashup.approve', $c->branch_id);
        CashBook::approveCashup($id, $this->user($r)->username, $this->str($r, 'reason'));

        return $this->done('Cash-up approved');
    }

    public function bankDeposit(Request $r)
    {
        $unit = $this->workUnit($r, 'cash.bank');
        $ap = $this->approval($r, 'cashup.approve', $unit->id);
        CashBook::bankCash($unit->id, $this->str($r, 'date', date('Y-m-d')), (string) $r->input('amount'), $this->str($r, 'deposit_ref'), $this->user($r)->username, $ap);

        return $this->done('Banking recorded');
    }

    /** Statement lines pasted or uploaded as CSV: date, description, amount, reference. */
    public function statement(Request $r)
    {
        $unit = $this->workUnit($r, 'bank.reconcile');
        $text = $r->hasFile('file') ? (string) file_get_contents($r->file('file')->getRealPath()) : (string) $r->input('text');
        $lines = [];
        foreach (preg_split('/\r\n|\n|\r/', trim($text)) as $i => $ln) {
            $c = str_getcsv($ln, ',', '"', '');
            if ($i === 0 && ! preg_match('/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/', trim($c[0] ?? ''))) {
                continue; // header
            }
            if (count($c) < 3) {
                continue;
            }
            $lines[] = ['date' => trim($c[0]), 'description' => trim($c[1]), 'amount' => str_replace(',', '', trim($c[2])), 'reference' => trim($c[3] ?? '') ?: null];
        }
        if (! $lines) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('No statement lines found: use date (YYYY-MM-DD), description, amount, reference');
        }
        $acct = (int) $r->input('account', 1030);
        $n = CashBook::importStatement($unit->id, $acct, $lines, $this->user($r)->username);
        $m = CashBook::autoMatch($unit->id, $acct);

        return $this->done("{$n} statement lines imported, {$m} matched to the ledger");
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ customers and claims
    public function claims(Request $r)
    {
        $this->need($r, 'claims.manage');
        [$m, $start, $end] = $this->month($r);
        $q = Claim::with('payer')->orderByDesc('id');
        if ($ids = $this->scope($r)) {
            $q->whereIn('branch_id', $ids);
        }
        $claims = $q->limit(300)->get()->map(fn ($c) => ['payer' => $c->payer->code, 'claim_no' => $c->claim_no, 'status' => $c->status, 'amount' => $c->amount,
            'expected_reduction' => $c->expected_reduction, 'approved' => $c->approved_amount, 'paid' => $c->paid_amount, 'submitted' => $c->submitted_on])->all();
        $corp = Payer::whereIn('payer_type', ['Corporate', 'Insurer'])->orderBy('code')->get()->map(fn ($p) => ['code' => $p->code, 'name' => $p->name, 'type' => $p->payer_type,
            'credit_limit' => $p->credit_limit, 'balance' => Reports::partyBalance(1110, $p->code, $end, $this->scope($r))])->all();

        return view('screens.claims', ['title' => 'Customers and claims', 'subtitle' => 'NHIS and insurer claims, corporate accounts and invoices',
            'claims' => $claims, 'corp' => $corp, 'ageing' => Ar::ageing($end), 'payers' => Payer::orderBy('code')->get()]);
    }

    public function claimAction(Request $r)
    {
        $u = $this->user($r);
        Security::require($u, 'claims.manage');
        $c = Claims::get((string) $r->input('payer'), (string) $r->input('claim_no'));
        $on = $this->str($r, 'date', date('Y-m-d'));
        match ($r->input('action')) {
            'submit' => Claims::submit($c, $on, $u->username),
            'vet' => Claims::vet($c, $on, (string) $r->input('amount'), $u->username, $this->str($r, 'shortfall_class', 'Contractual pricing')),
            'payment' => Claims::receivePayment($c, $on, (string) $r->input('amount'), $this->str($r, 'channel', 'Bank'), $u->username, $this->str($r, 'wht_withheld', '0'),
                $this->str($r, 'wht_certificate_no')),
            'resolve' => Claims::resolveDispute($c, $on, (string) $r->input('amount'), $u->username),
            default => throw new BusinessRuleError('Choose an action'),
        };

        return $this->done("Claim {$c->claim_no} updated");
    }

    public function customerReceipt(Request $r)
    {
        $unit = $this->workUnit($r, 'claims.manage');
        Periodend::customerReceipt($unit->id, (string) $r->input('payer'), $this->str($r, 'date', date('Y-m-d')), (string) $r->input('amount'), $this->str($r, 'channel', 'Bank'),
            (string) $r->input('reference'), $this->user($r)->username, $this->str($r, 'wht_withheld', '0'), $this->str($r, 'wht_certificate_no'),
            $this->str($r, 'whvat_withheld', '0'), null, $this->str($r, 'whvat_certificate_no'));

        return $this->done('Receipt recorded and allocated to the oldest invoices');
    }

    public function arInvoice(Request $r)
    {
        $unit = $this->workUnit($r, 'ar.manage');
        $kind = $this->str($r, 'kind', 'INVOICE');
        $ap = $kind === 'CREDIT' ? $this->approval($r, 'ar.credit.approve', $unit->id) : null;
        $inv = Ar::createInvoice($unit->id, (string) $r->input('payer'), $this->str($r, 'date', date('Y-m-d')), [['account_code' => (int) $r->input('account_code', 4070),
            'description' => (string) $r->input('description'), 'net' => (string) $r->input('net'), 'tax_code' => $this->str($r, 'tax_code', 'SR20')]],
            $this->user($r)->username, $kind, $this->str($r, 'credit_of'), $ap);

        return $this->done("{$inv->invoice_no} raised – GH₵ {$inv->gross}");
    }
}
