<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Web;

use App\Domain\Branches;
use App\Domain\BusinessRuleError;
use App\Domain\Inventory;
use App\Domain\Ledger;
use App\Domain\PermissionDenied;
use App\Domain\Security;
use App\Domain\Uploads;
use App\Models\Branch;
use App\Models\Category;
use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\StockCount;
use App\Models\StockUpload;
use App\Models\Supplier;
use App\Models\TaxRate;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

/** Stock and batches (receipts, adjustments, transfers, counts, expiry, products) and the products and stock upload. */
class StockWebController extends WebController
{
    public function index(Request $r)
    {
        $this->need($r, 'reports.view');
        [$m, $start, $end] = $this->month($r);
        $unit = $this->unit($r);
        $asOf = min($end, date('Y-m-d'));
        $rows = $unit && ! $unit->is_head_office ? Inventory::valuation($unit->id, $asOf) : [];
        $count = $unit ? StockCount::where('branch_id', $unit->id)->where('status', '<>', 'APPROVED')->orderByDesc('id')->first() : null;

        return view('screens.stock', ['title' => 'Stock and batches', 'subtitle' => ($unit?->name ?? 'Choose a branch').' · as at '.date('d M Y', strtotime($asOf))
            .' · cost formula '.strtolower(str_replace('_', ' ', Ledger::setting('cost_formula', 'WEIGHTED_AVERAGE'))).' ('.strtolower(Ledger::setting('cost_pool', 'COMPANY')).')',
            'rows' => $rows, 'rec' => $unit && ! $unit->is_head_office ? Inventory::reconciliation($unit->id, $asOf) : null, 'count' => $count,
            'sheet' => $count ? Inventory::countSheet($count) : [], 'suppliers' => Supplier::orderBy('code')->get(), 'branches' => Branch::where('is_head_office', false)->orderBy('code')->get(),
            'products' => Product::orderBy('sku')->get(), 'categories' => Category::orderBy('name')->pluck('name'), 'taxes' => TaxRate::distinct()->pluck('code'),
            'adj' => array_keys(Inventory::ADJ), 'reorder' => $unit && ! $unit->is_head_office ? Branches::reorderProducts($unit->id) : collect()]);
    }

    public function receive(Request $r)
    {
        $unit = $this->workUnit($r, 'stock.receive', true);
        $lines = [];
        foreach ((array) $r->input('lines', []) as $l) {
            if (! empty($l['sku'])) {
                $lines[] = ['sku' => $l['sku'], 'batch_no' => $l['batch_no'] ?? null, 'expiry' => $l['expiry'] ?? null, 'packs' => (string) $l['packs'],
                    'cost_per_pack' => (string) $l['cost_per_pack']];
            }
        }
        $ap = $r->filled('approver') ? $this->approval($r, 'po.approve', $unit->id) : null;
        Inventory::receiveGoods($unit->id, (string) $r->input('supplier'), (string) $r->input('invoice_no'), $this->str($r, 'date', date('Y-m-d')), $lines,
            $this->user($r)->username, $ap);

        return $this->done('Delivery received into stock and posted');
    }

    public function adjust(Request $r)
    {
        $unit = $this->workUnit($r, 'stock.adjust', true);
        $qty = (string) $r->input('qty');
        $ap = $this->approval($r, 'stock.adjust.approve', $unit->id, Inventory::estimateValue($unit->id, (string) $r->input('sku'), (string) $r->input('batch_no'), $qty));
        Inventory::adjust($unit->id, $this->str($r, 'date', date('Y-m-d')), (string) $r->input('sku'), (string) $r->input('batch_no'), (string) $r->input('adj_type'), $qty,
            $this->user($r)->username, $ap, $this->str($r, 'document_no'), (string) $r->input('reason', ''));

        return $this->done('Adjustment posted');
    }

    public function transfer(Request $r)
    {
        $unit = $this->workUnit($r, 'stock.transfer', true);
        $to = Branch::where('code', $r->input('to_branch'))->first() ?? throw new BusinessRuleError('Choose the receiving branch');
        $ap = $this->approval($r, 'stock.transfer.approve');
        $v = Inventory::transfer($unit->id, $to->id, (string) $r->input('sku'), (string) $r->input('qty'), $this->str($r, 'date', date('Y-m-d')), $this->str($r, 'note_no'),
            $this->user($r)->username, $ap, $this->str($r, 'batch_no'));

        return $this->done("Transferred to {$to->name} at cost GH₵ {$v}");
    }

    public function count(Request $r)
    {
        $u = $this->user($r);
        $action = $r->input('action');
        if ($action === 'open') {
            $unit = $this->workUnit($r, 'stock.count', true);
            Inventory::openCount($unit->id, $this->str($r, 'date', date('Y-m-d')), $u->username);

            return $this->done('Count sheet opened – quantities on the system are hidden until you enter the counts');
        }
        $c = StockCount::find((int) $r->input('count_id')) ?? throw new BusinessRuleError('Count not found');
        if ($action === 'record') {
            Security::require($u, 'stock.count', $c->branch_id);
            $counts = [];
            foreach ((array) $r->input('counted', []) as $id => $q) {
                if ($q !== null && $q !== '') {
                    $counts[(int) $id] = (string) $q;
                }
            }
            Inventory::recordCounts($c, $counts, $u->username);

            return $this->done('Counts recorded');
        }
        Security::require($u, 'stock.count.approve', $c->branch_id);
        $v = Inventory::approveCount($c, $u->username);

        return $this->done('Count approved – '.count($v).' variance lines posted');
    }

    public function nrv(Request $r)
    {
        $unit = $this->workUnit($r, 'stock.adjust', true);
        $j = Inventory::nrvTrueUp($unit->id, $this->str($r, 'date', date('Y-m-d')), $this->user($r)->username);

        return $this->done($j ? 'Net realisable value write-down brought up to date' : 'No change needed');
    }

    public function product(Request $r)
    {
        $u = $this->user($r);
        if ($r->input('action') === 'branch') {
            $unit = $this->workUnit($r, 'products.manage', true);
            Branches::setProductBranch(Inventory::productByCode((string) $r->input('sku')), $unit->id, $u->username, $this->str($r, 'retail_price'),
                $this->str($r, 'reorder_level'), $r->has('active') ? $r->boolean('active') : null);

            return $this->done("Branch price and reorder level saved for {$unit->name}");
        }
        Security::require($u, 'products.manage');
        if (Product::where('sku', $r->input('sku'))->exists()) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('That SKU already exists');
        }
        Product::create(['sku' => $r->input('sku'), 'name' => $r->input('name'), 'category_name' => $r->input('category'), 'tax_code' => $r->input('tax_code'),
            'retail_price' => (string) $r->input('retail_price'), 'barcode' => $this->str($r, 'barcode'), 'units_per_pack' => $this->str($r, 'units_per_pack', '1'),
            'reorder_level' => $this->str($r, 'reorder_level', '0'), 'controlled' => $r->boolean('controlled'), 'sale_unit' => 'Unit', 'cold_chain' => false]);
        Ledger::audit($u->username, 'PRODUCT_CREATE', 'product', $r->input('sku'), "tax {$r->input('tax_code')} price {$r->input('retail_price')}");

        return $this->done('Product added to the shared list');
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ upload
    public function upload(Request $r)
    {
        $this->need($r, 'stock.upload');
        $id = (int) $r->query('upload', $r->session()->get('upload_id', 0));
        $up = $id ? StockUpload::find($id) : null;

        return view('screens.upload', ['title' => 'Upload products and stock', 'subtitle' => 'CSV only · opening stock and cash purchases · checked first, nothing is saved until a second person confirms',
            'up' => $up ? Uploads::report($up) : null, 'history' => StockUpload::orderByDesc('id')->limit(20)->get()]);
    }

    public function template(Request $r)
    {
        $this->need($r, 'stock.upload');
        $ex = $r->boolean('examples');

        return $this->file(Uploads::template($ex), 'text/csv', $ex ? 'products_stock_template_with_examples.csv' : 'products_stock_template.csv');
    }

    public function uploadCheck(Request $r)
    {
        $u = $this->user($r);
        Security::require($u, 'stock.upload');
        $f = $r->file('file') ?? throw new BusinessRuleError('Choose the CSV file');
        if ($f->getSize() > 5_000_000) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('File too large (5 MB at most)');
        }
        $up = Uploads::validate($f->getClientOriginalName(), (string) file_get_contents($f->getRealPath()), $u->username);
        $this->ownBranches($u, Uploads::report($up));
        $r->session()->put('upload_id', $up->id);

        return redirect()->route('upload', ['upload' => $up->id])->with('ok', 'File checked – review the report below. Nothing has been saved yet.');
    }

    private function ownBranches($u, array $rep): void
    {
        $allowed = Security::branchIds($u);
        if ($allowed !== null) {
            $codes = Branch::whereIn('id', $allowed)->pluck('code')->all();
            $out = array_unique(array_filter(array_map(fn ($x) => strtoupper($x['branch']), $rep['report']['rows']), fn ($c) => $c !== '' && ! in_array($c, $codes, true)));
            if ($out) {
                throw new PermissionDenied("{$u->username} may not load stock into branch(es) ".implode(', ', $out));
            }
        }
    }

    public function uploadConfirm(Request $r, int $id)
    {
        $u = $this->user($r);
        Security::require($u, 'stock.upload');
        $up = StockUpload::find($id) ?? throw new BusinessRuleError('Upload not found');
        $this->ownBranches($u, Uploads::report($up));
        if ($r->input('action') === 'cancel') {
            Uploads::cancel($id, $u->username);

            return $this->done('Upload cancelled – nothing was loaded');
        }
        $res = Uploads::confirm($id, $u->username, $this->approval($r, 'stock.upload.approve'), $r->boolean('override_duplicate'));

        return $this->done("Loaded: {$res['products']} products, {$res['stock_rows']} stock rows, ".count($res['journals']).' journals');
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Web;

use App\Domain\BusinessRuleError;
use App\Domain\PermissionDenied;
use App\Domain\Security;
use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\Branch;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

/** Shared helpers for the screens: signed-in user, the working unit, the period, approvals typed by a second person. */
abstract class WebController extends Controller
{
    protected function user(Request $r): User
    {
        return $r->attributes->get('user');
    }

    protected function unit(Request $r): ?Branch
    {
        return $r->attributes->get('unit');
    }

    /** Unit ids for reports: the chosen unit, or null for all branches (only users with access to all branches). */
    protected function scope(Request $r): ?array
    {
        $u = $this->unit($r);

        return $u ? [$u->id] : null;
    }

    /** A unit to post in: the read-only "All branches" view cannot post. */
    protected function workUnit(Request $r, string $perm, bool $tradingOnly = false): Branch
    {
        $u = $this->unit($r);
        if ($u === null) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('You are in the read-only All branches view – choose a branch or head office at the top of the page to work in');
        }
        if ($tradingOnly && $u->is_head_office) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('Head office holds no stock and makes no sales – choose a branch');
        }
        Security::require($this->user($r), $perm, $u->id);

        return $u;
    }

    protected function need(Request $r, string $perm): void
    {
        Security::require($this->user($r), $perm, $this->unit($r)?->id);
    }

    protected function can(Request $r, string $perm): bool
    {
        return Security::can($this->user($r), $perm);
    }

    /** The second person's username and password typed into the approval box of a form. */
    protected function approval(Request $r, string $perm, ?int $branchId = null, mixed $amount = null): string
    {
        if (! $r->filled('approver')) {
            throw new BusinessRuleError('This needs a second person: enter their username and password in the approval box');
        }

        return Security::approve(['approver' => $r->input('approver'), 'approver_secret' => (string) $r->input('approver_secret')], $perm, $this->user($r),
            $branchId, $amount);
    }

    /** Selected month (YYYY-MM) and its first and last day. */
    protected function month(Request $r): array
    {
        $m = $r->query('month') ?: $r->session()->get('month', date('Y-m'));
        if (! preg_match('/^\d{4}-\d{2}$/', $m)) {
            $m = date('Y-m');
        }
        $r->session()->put('month', $m);

        return [$m, "{$m}-01", date('Y-m-t', strtotime("{$m}-01"))];
    }

    protected function done(string $msg)
    {
        return redirect()->back()->with('ok', $msg);
    }

    protected function str(Request $r, string $k, ?string $default = null): ?string
    {
        $v = $r->input($k);

        return $v === null || $v === '' ? $default : trim((string) $v);
    }

    protected function file(string $data, string $type, string $name)
    {
        return response($data, 200, ['Content-Type' => $type, 'Content-Disposition' => "attachment; filename=\"{$name}\""]);
    }

    protected const XLSX = 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet';

    protected function deny(string $msg): never
    {
        throw new PermissionDenied($msg);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\View;

use App\Domain\Money;
use Brick\Math\BigDecimal;

/** Display helpers for the screens: GH₵ amounts with separators, negatives in brackets (accounting style), dates. */
final class Fmt
{
    public static function m(mixed $v, bool $brackets = true): string
    {
        if ($v === null || $v === '') {
            return '–';
        }
        if (! $v instanceof BigDecimal && ! is_numeric($v)) {
            return (string) $v;
        }
        $d = Money::q2(is_float($v) ? (string) $v : $v);
        $s = number_format(abs($d->toFloat()), 2);
        if ($d->isNegative()) {
            return $brackets ? "({$s})" : "-{$s}";
        }

        return $s;
    }

    public static function q(mixed $v): string
    {
        if ($v === null || $v === '') {
            return '–';
        }
        $d = Money::d(is_float($v) ? (string) $v : $v)->stripTrailingZeros();

        return $d->getScale() > 0 ? rtrim(rtrim(number_format($d->toFloat(), 3), '0'), '.') : number_format($d->toFloat());
    }

    public static function d(?string $v): string
    {
        return $v ? date('d M Y', strtotime(substr($v, 0, 10))) : '–';
    }

    public static function pill(bool $ok, string $yes = 'OK', string $no = 'Difference'): string
    {
        return '<span class="pill '.($ok ? 'ok' : 'bad').'">'.e($ok ? $yes : $no).'</span>';
    }

    /** A label from a key: "total_tax" -> "Total tax". */
    public static function label(string $k): string
    {
        return ucfirst(str_replace('_', ' ', $k));
    }

    private static function isMoney(mixed $v): bool
    {
        return $v instanceof BigDecimal || (is_string($v) && preg_match('/^-?\d+\.\d{2,}$/', $v));
    }

    private static function cell(mixed $v): string
    {
        if (is_bool($v)) {
            return self::pill($v, 'Yes', 'No');
        }
        if ($v === null || $v === '') {
            return '–';
        }
        if (self::isMoney($v)) {
            return e(self::m($v));
        }
        if (is_array($v)) {
            return array_is_list($v) && ! array_filter($v, 'is_array') ? e(implode(', ', array_map(fn ($x) => self::plain($x), $v))) : self::data($v, 1);
        }

        return e((string) $v);
    }

    private static function plain(mixed $v): string
    {
        return is_bool($v) ? ($v ? 'Yes' : 'No') : (self::isMoney($v) ? self::m($v) : (string) $v);
    }

    /**
     * Any report structure as HTML: lists of records become tables, keyed structures become label/value tables
     * with nested parts as sub-sections. Amounts formatted, negatives in brackets, yes/no as pills.
     */
    public static function data(mixed $v, int $depth = 0): string
    {
        if (! is_array($v)) {
            return self::cell($v);
        }
        if ($v === []) {
            return '<div class="empty">Nothing to show</div>';
        }
        if (array_is_list($v) && array_filter($v, fn ($x) => is_array($x) && ! array_is_list($x)) === $v) {
            $cols = [];
            foreach ($v as $row) {
                foreach ($row as $k => $x) {
                    $cols[$k] = ($cols[$k] ?? false) || self::isMoney($x);
                }
            }
            $h = '<div class="scroll"><table class="tbl"><thead><tr>';
            foreach ($cols as $k => $money) {
                $h .= '<th class="'.($money ? 'num' : '').'">'.e(self::label((string) $k)).'</th>';
            }
            $h .= '</tr></thead><tbody>';
            foreach ($v as $row) {
                $h .= '<tr>';
                foreach ($cols as $k => $money) {
                    $h .= '<td class="'.($money ? 'num' : '').'">'.self::cell($row[$k] ?? null).'</td>';
                }
                $h .= '</tr>';
            }

            return $h.'</tbody></table></div>';
        }
        if (array_is_list($v)) {
            return implode('', array_map(fn ($x) => '<div>'.self::data($x, $depth + 1).'</div>', $v));
        }
        $flat = '';
        $nested = '';
        foreach ($v as $k => $x) {
            $label = e(self::label((string) $k));
            if (is_array($x) && $x !== [] && ! (array_is_list($x) && ! array_filter($x, 'is_array'))) {
                $tag = $depth === 0 ? 'h3' : 'h4';
                $nested .= "<{$tag} class=\"sub\">{$label}</{$tag}>".self::data($x, $depth + 1);
            } else {
                $flat .= '<tr><td>'.$label.'</td><td class="'.(self::isMoney($x) ? 'num' : '').'">'.self::cell($x).'</td></tr>';
            }
        }

        return ($flat ? '<div class="scroll"><table class="tbl kv"><tbody>'.$flat.'</tbody></table></div>' : '').$nested;
    }

    /** Nested statement structure as [label, value] rows; account rows {code, account, amount} become "code name". */
    public static function flat(array $a, string $prefix = ''): array
    {
        $out = [];
        foreach ($a as $k => $v) {
            $part = is_int($k) ? '#'.($k + 1) : self::label((string) $k);
            $label = $prefix === '' ? $part : $prefix.' › '.$part;
            if (is_array($v) && isset($v['code'], $v['amount'])) {
                $out[] = [($prefix === '' ? '' : $prefix.' › ').$v['code'].' '.($v['account'] ?? $v['name'] ?? ''), $v['amount']];
            } elseif (is_array($v) && $v) {
                $out = array_merge($out, self::flat($v, $label));
            } else {
                $out[] = [$label, is_array($v) ? null : $v];
            }
        }

        return $out;
    }
}

####################################################################################################
##### FILE: app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php
####################################################################################################

<?php

namespace App\Providers;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Support\ServiceProvider;
use RuntimeException;

class AppServiceProvider extends ServiceProvider
{
    public function register(): void
    {
        //
    }

    /** Production refuses unsafe configuration at start-up, as in the Python edition. */
    public function boot(): void
    {
        Model::preventLazyLoading(! $this->app->isProduction());
        if ($this->app->isProduction()) {
            $problems = [];
            $secret = (string) config('pharmpos.secret');
            if ($secret === config('pharmpos.dev_secret') || strlen($secret) < 32) {
                $problems[] = 'PHARMACY_SECRET must be set to a random value of at least 32 characters';
            }
            if (config('database.default') === 'sqlite') {
                $problems[] = 'DB_CONNECTION must be pgsql, mysql or mariadb in production (SQLite does not store money exactly or lock rows)';
            }
            if (config('app.debug')) {
                $problems[] = 'APP_DEBUG must be false in production';
            }
            if ($problems) {
                throw new RuntimeException('Unsafe production configuration: '.implode('; ', $problems));
            }
        }
    }
}

<?php

use App\Domain\Branches;
use App\Domain\SampleData;
use App\Domain\Security;
use App\Models\Branch;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Artisan;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

/* First administrator, units, and a training data set. Run from the server's command line (SSH or cPanel Terminal). */

Artisan::command('pharmpos:create-admin {username} {full_name}', function (string $username, string $full_name) {
    if (User::query()->exists()) {
        $this->error('Users already exist – create further users on the Branches, users and audit screen.');

        return 1;
    }
    $pw = $this->secret('Password (at least 10 characters)');
    if (strlen((string) $pw) < 10 || $pw !== $this->secret('Repeat the password')) {
        $this->error('Passwords too short or do not match.');

        return 1;
    }
    Security::createUser($username, $full_name, 'admin', $pw, 'setup');
    $this->info("Administrator {$username} created. Sign in at /signin and set up two-step sign-in under Branches, users and audit.");
})->purpose('Create the first administrator');

Artisan::command('pharmpos:add-unit {code} {name} {--head-office}', function (string $code, string $name) {
    DB::transaction(fn () => Branches::create(strtoupper($code), $name, 'setup', (bool) $this->option('head-office')));
    $this->info("Unit {$code} added.");
})->purpose('Add a branch, or the head office unit with --head-office');

Artisan::command('pharmpos:training-data {--force}', function () {
    if (Branch::query()->exists() && ! $this->option('force')) {
        $this->error('Units already exist. Training data is for an empty practice database only (use --force to add it anyway).');

        return 1;
    }
    DB::transaction(function () {
        SampleData::loadMaster();
        SampleData::loadBranchMonth('A');
        SampleData::loadBranchMonth('B');
        if (! Branch::where('is_head_office', true)->exists()) {
            Branches::create('HO', 'Head office', 'setup', true);
        }
    });
    $this->info('Training data loaded: branches A and B (November 2026 sample month) and head office. Never use this on the live database.');
})->purpose('Load the SAMPLE products, suppliers and one month for branches A and B (training only)');

    public function down(): void
    {

        if (DB::getDriverName() === 'pgsql') {
            foreach ($tables as $n) {
                DB::statement("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS \"{$n}\" CASCADE");
            }

            return;
        }
        Schema::disableForeignKeyConstraints();
        foreach ($tables as $n) {
            Schema::dropIfExists($n);
        }
        Schema::enableForeignKeyConstraints();
    }

<?php

namespace Database\Seeders;

use App\Domain\Integrity;
use App\Domain\ReferenceData;
use Illuminate\Database\Seeder;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

/** Reference data: run after every migration (php artisan db:seed --force). Safe to repeat. */
class DatabaseSeeder extends Seeder
{
    public function run(): void
    {
        $what = DB::transaction(fn () => ReferenceData::seedOrUpgrade());
        Integrity::seal(); // chain any audit rows written before this version
        $this->command?->info("Reference data {$what}.");
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests;

use App\Domain\Security;
use App\Models\Branch;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\TestCase as BaseTestCase;

/** Every test starts from a migrated, seeded database (reference data as in production). */
abstract class TestCase extends BaseTestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    protected bool $seed = true;

    protected function branch(string $code = 'A'): int
    {
        return Branch::firstOrCreate(['code' => $code], ['name' => "Branch {$code}"])->id;
    }

    protected function users(): void
    {
        foreach (['admin' => 'admin', 'acc' => 'accountant', 'fm' => 'finance_manager', 'pharm' => 'pharmacist', 'cash1' => 'cashier',
            'store1' => 'storekeeper', 'aud' => 'auditor'] as $u => $role) {
            Security::createUser($u, $u, $role, "{$u}-Pass99", 'setup');
        }
    }
}

##### FILE: tests/Feature/ApiTest.php

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Domain\Totp;
use App\Models\AuditLog;
use Tests\TestCase;

/** The stage 1 API end to end: set-up, sign-in, users, controlled settings, journals with approval limits, integrity. */
class ApiTest extends TestCase
{
    private function tok(string $u, string $p, ?string $code = null): array
    {
        $r = $this->postJson('/api/auth/login', ['username' => $u, 'password' => $p, 'code' => $code]);
        $r->assertOk();

        return ['Authorization' => 'Bearer '.$r->json('token')];
    }

    public function test_full_flow(): void
    {
        $this->getJson('/api/health')->assertOk()->assertJson(['status' => 'ok']);
        $this->postJson('/api/setup/admin', ['username' => 'admin', 'full_name' => 'Admin', 'role' => 'accountant', 'password' => 'AdminPass1'])
            ->assertStatus(422)->assertJson(['detail' => 'The first user must be an administrator']);
        $this->postJson('/api/setup/admin', ['username' => 'admin', 'full_name' => 'Admin', 'role' => 'admin', 'password' => 'AdminPass1'])->assertOk();
        $this->postJson('/api/setup/admin', ['username' => 'x', 'full_name' => 'X', 'role' => 'admin', 'password' => 'AdminPass1'])->assertForbidden();
        $adm = $this->tok('admin', 'AdminPass1');
        $this->postJson('/api/branches', ['code' => 'A', 'name' => 'Branch A'], $adm)->assertOk();
        foreach (['acc' => 'accountant', 'fm' => 'finance_manager', 'pharm' => 'pharmacist', 'cash1' => 'cashier'] as $u => $role) {
            $this->postJson('/api/users', ['username' => $u, 'full_name' => $u, 'role' => $role, 'password' => "{$u}-Pass99",
                'branch' => $u === 'cash1' ? 'A' : null], $adm)->assertOk();
        }
        $this->postJson('/api/users', ['username' => 'z', 'full_name' => 'z', 'role' => 'boss', 'password' => 'zzzzzzzz9'], $adm)
            ->assertStatus(422)->assertJsonPath('detail', fn ($d) => str_contains($d, 'Role must be one of'));
        $acc = $this->tok('acc', 'acc-Pass99');
        $cash = $this->tok('cash1', 'cash1-Pass99');
        $this->getJson('/api/users', $acc)->assertForbidden();
        $this->getJson('/api/settings', $cash)->assertForbidden();
        $this->getJson('/api/settings', $acc)->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('vat_registered', 'Yes');

        // controlled settings: reason and a second person with settings.approve
        $this->putJson('/api/settings/cashup_tolerance', ['value' => '10', 'reason' => 'busy', 'approval' => ['approver' => 'pharm',
            'approver_secret' => 'pharm-Pass99']], $acc)->assertStatus(422);
        $this->putJson('/api/settings/cashup_tolerance', ['value' => '10', 'reason' => 'busy', 'approval' => ['approver' => 'fm',
            'approver_secret' => 'fm-Pass99']], $acc)->assertOk();
        $this->getJson('/api/settings/history?key=cashup_tolerance', $acc)->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('0.new', '10');

        // manual journal: within the GHS 2,000 limit any approver with journal.approve; above it the finance manager (".high")
        $line = fn ($amt) => [['account' => 6110, 'debit' => $amt], ['account' => 1030, 'credit' => $amt]];
        $r = $this->postJson('/api/journals', ['branch' => 'A', 'date' => '2026-11-05', 'reference' => 'J-1', 'lines' => $line('150'),
            'approval' => ['approver' => 'fm', 'approver_secret' => 'fm-Pass99']], $acc)->assertOk();
        $jid = $r->json('journal_id');
        $this->getJson("/api/journals/{$jid}", $acc)->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('lines.0.debit', '150.00')->assertJsonPath('approved_by', 'fm');
        $this->postJson('/api/journals', ['branch' => 'A', 'date' => '2026-11-05', 'reference' => 'J-2', 'lines' => $line('100'),
            'approval' => ['approver' => 'acc', 'approver_secret' => 'acc-Pass99']], $acc)->assertStatus(422)
            ->assertJson(['detail' => 'Approval must come from a different person']);
        $this->postJson('/api/journals', ['branch' => 'A', 'date' => '2026-11-05', 'reference' => 'J-3', 'lines' => [['account' => 1010, 'debit' => 5],
            ['account' => 1030, 'credit' => 5]], 'approval' => ['approver' => 'fm', 'approver_secret' => 'fm-Pass99']], $acc)
            ->assertStatus(422)->assertJsonPath('detail', fn ($d) => str_contains($d, 'only be posted by its module'));
        $this->assertDatabaseMissing('journal', ['source_ref' => 'J-3']); // nothing posted on a rule failure
        $this->postJson("/api/journals/{$jid}/reverse", ['on' => '2026-11-06', 'reason' => 'duplicate', 'approval' => ['approver' => 'fm',
            'approver_secret' => 'fm-Pass99']], $acc)->assertOk();
        $this->postJson('/api/journals', ['branch' => 'A', 'date' => '2026-11-05', 'reference' => 'J-4', 'lines' => $line('100'),
            'approval' => ['approver' => 'fm', 'approver_secret' => 'fm-Pass99']], $cash)->assertForbidden();

        // PAYE table and WHT rate amendments
        $this->postJson('/api/paye-bands', ['effective_from' => '2027-01-01', 'legal_basis' => 'Act 2027', 'bands' => [['annual_width' => '8000',
            'rate' => '0'], ['annual_width' => null, 'rate' => '0.3']], 'approval' => ['approver' => 'fm', 'approver_secret' => 'fm-Pass99']], $acc)->assertOk();
        $this->getJson('/api/paye-bands', $acc)->assertOk()->assertJsonCount(2);
        $this->putJson('/api/wht-types/Goods/rate', ['rate' => '0.04', 'legal_basis' => 'Act', 'approval' => ['approver' => 'fm',
            'approver_secret' => 'fm-Pass99']], $acc)->assertOk();
        $this->getJson('/api/wht-types', $acc)->assertOk()->assertJsonFragment(['name' => 'Goods', 'rate' => '0.04000', 'gra_code' => 'WRESSUGEOA']);

        // two-step sign-in, enforcement and lock-out
        $this->putJson('/api/settings/enforce_2fa', ['value' => 'Yes', 'reason' => 'policy', 'approval' => ['approver' => 'fm',
            'approver_secret' => 'fm-Pass99']], $acc)->assertOk();
        $this->getJson('/api/settings', $acc)->assertForbidden()->assertJsonPath('detail', fn ($d) => str_contains($d, 'Turn on two-step'));
        $secret = $this->postJson('/api/auth/two-step/enrol', [], $acc)->assertOk()->json('secret');
        $this->postJson('/api/auth/two-step/confirm', ['code' => Totp::code($secret)], $acc)->assertOk();
        $this->getJson('/api/settings', $acc)->assertOk();
        $this->postJson('/api/auth/login', ['username' => 'acc', 'password' => 'acc-Pass99'])->assertStatus(422);
        $this->tok('acc', 'acc-Pass99', Totp::code($secret));
        for ($i = 0; $i < 5; $i++) {
            $this->postJson('/api/auth/login', ['username' => 'cash1', 'password' => 'wrong-pass1'])->assertStatus(422);
        }
        $this->postJson('/api/auth/login', ['username' => 'cash1', 'password' => 'cash1-Pass99'])->assertStatus(422)
            ->assertJsonPath('detail', fn ($d) => str_contains($d, 'Too many')); // failed attempts kept although each request failed

        // integrity and backups; every audit row is sealed after its request
        $this->postJson('/api/admin/backups', ['kind' => 'BACKUP', 'started_at' => '2026-12-20T02:00:00', 'status' => 'OK'], $adm)->assertForbidden();
        $s2 = $this->postJson('/api/auth/two-step/enrol', [], $adm)->assertOk()->json('secret'); // enforcement covers administrators too
        $this->postJson('/api/auth/two-step/confirm', ['code' => Totp::code($s2)], $adm)->assertOk();
        $this->postJson('/api/admin/backups', ['kind' => 'BACKUP', 'started_at' => '2026-12-20T02:00:00', 'status' => 'OK'], $adm)->assertOk();
        $this->postJson('/api/admin/backups', ['kind' => 'BACKUP', 'started_at' => '2026-12-20T02:00:00', 'status' => 'OK'], $acc)->assertForbidden();
        $this->getJson('/api/admin/backups', $adm)->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('last_backup', fn ($d) => str_starts_with($d, '2026-12-20'));
        $i = $this->getJson('/api/admin/integrity', $acc)->assertOk();
        $this->assertTrue($i->json('audit_chain.ok'));
        $this->assertSame(0, AuditLog::whereNull('hash')->count());
        $this->assertTrue($i->json('ledger.ok'));
        $this->assertContains('fm', $i->json('two_step.required_but_missing'));
        $this->getJson('/api/audit-log?action=LOGIN_FAILED', $acc)->assertOk()->assertJsonCount(7);
    }
}

####################################################################################################
##### FILE: tests/Feature/BranchesTest.php
####################################################################################################

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Domain\Branches;
use App\Domain\BusinessRuleError;
use App\Domain\Integrity;
use App\Domain\Ledger;
use App\Domain\PermissionDenied;
use App\Domain\Security;
use App\Models\Journal;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Tests\TestCase;

/** v1.2: head office unit, paying on behalf of branches, users in several branches, inventory officer role. */
class BranchesTest extends TestCase
{
    private function balance(int $code, ?int $unit = null, ?string $party = null): string
    {
        $q = DB::table('journal_line')->join('journal', 'journal.id', '=', 'journal_line.journal_id')->where('account_code', $code);
        if ($unit) {
            $q->where('journal.branch_id', $unit);
        }
        if ($party) {
            $q->where('party', $party);
        }

        return (string) \App\Domain\Money::q2((string) ($q->selectRaw('COALESCE(SUM(debit - credit), 0) AS b')->value('b') ?? '0'));
    }

    private function unitBalances(int $unit): bool
    {
        return \App\Domain\Money::eq(DB::table('journal_line')->join('journal', 'journal.id', '=', 'journal_line.journal_id')
            ->where('journal.branch_id', $unit)->selectRaw('COALESCE(SUM(debit - credit), 0) AS b')->value('b') ?? '0', '0');
    }

    public function test_one_head_office_and_it_holds_no_stock(): void
    {
        Branches::create('a', 'Branch A', 'admin');
        $ho = Branches::create('HO', 'Head office', 'admin', true);
        $this->assertTrue($ho->is_head_office);
        try {
            Branches::create('H2', 'Second', 'admin', true);
            $this->fail('second head office');
        } catch (BusinessRuleError $e) {
            $this->assertStringContainsString('already a head office unit (HO)', $e->getMessage());
        }
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('HO is the head office unit: it holds no stock or sales');
        Branches::requireTrading($ho->id);
    }

    public function test_head_office_pays_and_reversal_undoes_both_sides(): void
    {
        $a = Branches::create('A', 'Branch A', 'admin');
        $ho = Branches::create('HO', 'Head office', 'admin', true);
        // Branch A's cleaning GHS 300 paid from head office's bank:
        // A: Dr 6110 300 / Cr 1195 BR-HO 300      HO: Dr 1195 BR-A 300 / Cr 1030 300
        $j = Ledger::paidBy($ho->id, fn () => Ledger::post($a->id, '2026-12-01', 'EXPENSE', 'CLN-1', [[6110, '300', '0'], [1030, '0', '300']], 'acc', 'Cleaning'));
        $this->assertSame(['300.00', '-300.00', '0.00'], [$this->balance(6110, $a->id), $this->balance(1195, $a->id, 'BR-HO'), $this->balance(1030, $a->id)]);
        $this->assertSame(['-300.00', '300.00'], [$this->balance(1030, $ho->id), $this->balance(1195, $ho->id, 'BR-A')]);
        $this->assertTrue($this->unitBalances($a->id) && $this->unitBalances($ho->id));
        $this->assertSame('0.00', $this->balance(1195)); // eliminates on consolidation
        $this->assertSame('Cleaning (paid by HO)', Journal::find($j->id)->memo);
        Ledger::reverse($j->id, '2026-12-02', 'acc', 'keyed in error');
        $this->assertSame(['0.00', '0.00', '0.00'], [$this->balance(6110), $this->balance(1030), $this->balance(1195)]);
        // without cash lines nothing moves to the payer
        $k = Ledger::paidBy($ho->id, fn () => Ledger::post($a->id, '2026-12-03', 'SALE', 'R-1', [[1110, '10', '0'], [4020, '0', '10']], 'x'));
        $this->assertSame($a->id, $k->branch_id);
        $this->assertSame(1, Journal::where('source_ref', 'R-1')->count());
    }

    public function test_opening_stock_source_may_credit_opening_equity_with_approval(): void
    {
        $a = Branches::create('A', 'Branch A', 'admin');
        $j = Ledger::post($a->id, '2026-12-01', 'OPENSTOCK', 'UPL-1-OB', [[1205, '720', '0'], [9030, '0', '720']], 'store1', null, 'pharm');
        $this->assertSame(2, $j->lines()->count());
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('approver who is not the preparer');
        Ledger::post($a->id, '2026-12-01', 'OPENSTOCK', 'UPL-2-OB', [[1205, '1', '0'], [9030, '0', '1']], 'store1');
    }

    public function test_inventory_officer_in_two_branches(): void
    {
        $a = Branches::create('A', 'Branch A', 'admin');
        $b = Branches::create('B', 'Branch B', 'admin');
        $ho = Branches::create('HO', 'Head office', 'admin', true);
        try {
            Security::createUser('io', 'IO', 'inventory_officer', 'io-Pass99', 'admin');
            $this->fail('no branch');
        } catch (BusinessRuleError $e) {
            $this->assertStringContainsString('must be assigned to a branch', $e->getMessage());
        }
        $io = Security::createUser('io', 'IO', 'inventory_officer', 'io-Pass99', 'admin', $a->id);
        Security::setUserBranches('io', $a->id, [$b->id], 'admin');
        $io = $io->fresh();
        $this->assertSame([$a->id, $b->id], Security::branchIds($io));
        foreach (['products.manage', 'stock.upload', 'stock.adjust', 'stock.transfer', 'po.create', 'po.receive'] as $p) {
            Security::require($io, $p, $b->id);
        }
        foreach (['journal.create', 'users.manage', 'stock.adjust.approve'] as $p) {
            $this->assertFalse(Security::can($io, $p));
        }
        try {
            Security::require($io, 'stock.adjust', $ho->id);
            $this->fail('head office');
        } catch (PermissionDenied $e) {
            $this->assertStringContainsString('limited to other branches', $e->getMessage());
        }
        $this->expectException(PermissionDenied::class);
        Security::requireAllBranches($io);
    }

    public function test_api_branches_users_and_login_scope(): void
    {
        $this->postJson('/api/setup/admin', ['username' => 'admin', 'full_name' => 'Admin', 'role' => 'admin', 'password' => 'AdminPass1'])->assertOk();
        $adm = ['Authorization' => 'Bearer '.$this->postJson('/api/auth/login', ['username' => 'admin', 'password' => 'AdminPass1'])->json('token')];
        foreach ([['A', false], ['B', false], ['HO', true]] as [$c, $ho]) {
            $this->postJson('/api/branches', ['code' => $c, 'name' => $c, 'is_head_office' => $ho], $adm)->assertOk();
        }
        $this->postJson('/api/branches', ['code' => 'H2', 'name' => 'x', 'is_head_office' => true], $adm)->assertStatus(422);
        $this->postJson('/api/users', ['username' => 'io', 'full_name' => 'IO', 'role' => 'inventory_officer', 'password' => 'io-Pass99'], $adm)
            ->assertStatus(422);
        $this->postJson('/api/users', ['username' => 'io', 'full_name' => 'IO', 'role' => 'inventory_officer', 'password' => 'io-Pass99',
            'branch' => 'A'], $adm)->assertOk();
        $this->putJson('/api/users/io/branches', ['home_branch' => 'A', 'extra_branches' => ['B']], $adm)->assertOk();
        $login = $this->postJson('/api/auth/login', ['username' => 'io', 'password' => 'io-Pass99'])->assertOk();
        $this->assertSame([false, ['A', 'B']], [$login->json('all_branches'), $login->json('branches')]);
        $io = ['Authorization' => 'Bearer '.$login->json('token')];
        $this->assertSame(['A', 'B'], array_column($this->getJson('/api/branches', $io)->assertOk()->json(), 'code'));
        $this->postJson('/api/branches', ['code' => 'C', 'name' => 'C'], $io)->assertForbidden();
        $this->assertTrue($this->postJson('/api/auth/login', ['username' => 'admin', 'password' => 'AdminPass1'])->json('all_branches'));
        $this->assertTrue(Integrity::verifyAuditChain()['ok']);
        $this->assertSame(2, User::count());
    }
}

##### FILE: tests/Feature/ConcurrencyTest.php
####################################################################################################

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Domain\Integrity;
use App\Domain\Ledger;
use App\Models\AuditHead;
use App\Models\AuditLog;
use App\Models\Branch;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\DatabaseMigrations;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Artisan;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\TestCase as BaseTestCase;

/**
 * Real parallel processes against PostgreSQL or MySQL/MariaDB (skipped on SQLite): several workers write audit rows and seal at
 * the same time – including the very first seal, when the head row does not exist yet. The chain must never fork.
 */
class ConcurrencyTest extends BaseTestCase
{
    use DatabaseMigrations;

    protected bool $seed = true;

    public function test_parallel_posting_and_sealing_keep_the_chain_intact(): void
    {
        if (DB::getDriverName() === 'sqlite' || ! function_exists('pcntl_fork')) {
            $this->markTestSkipped('needs PostgreSQL or MySQL/MariaDB and pcntl');
        }
        $b = Branch::create(['code' => 'A', 'name' => 'A'])->id;
        AuditHead::query()->delete(); // force the first-seal race
        DB::disconnect();
        $workers = 6;
        $pids = [];
        for ($w = 0; $w < $workers; $w++) {
            $pid = pcntl_fork();
            if ($pid === 0) {
                DB::purge();
                $code = 0;
                try {
                    for ($i = 0; $i < 10; $i++) {
                        DB::transaction(fn () => Ledger::post($b, '2026-11-05', 'SALE', "W{$w}-{$i}", [[1010, '1', '0'], [4020, '0', '1']], "w{$w}"));
                        Integrity::seal();
                    }
                } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                    fwrite(STDERR, "worker {$w}: ".$e->getMessage()."\n");
                    $code = 1;
                }
                posix_kill(getmypid(), $code ? SIGTERM : SIGKILL); // exit at once, without running the parent's shutdown hooks
            }
            $pids[] = $pid;
        }
        $failed = 0;
        foreach ($pids as $pid) {
            pcntl_waitpid($pid, $status);
            $failed += (pcntl_wifsignaled($status) && pcntl_wtermsig($status) === SIGTERM) ? 1 : 0;
        }
        DB::purge();
        $this->assertSame(0, $failed, 'a worker failed');
        Integrity::seal();
        $v = Integrity::verifyAuditChain();
        $this->assertTrue($v['ok'], $v['message']);
        $this->assertSame(0, $v['unsealed']);
        $this->assertSame($workers * 10, AuditLog::where('action', 'POST')->count());
        $this->assertSame(1, AuditHead::count());
        $this->assertTrue(Integrity::ledgerBalanced()['ok']);
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Domain\Integrity;
use App\Domain\Ledger;
use App\Models\AuditLog;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Tests\TestCase;

class IntegrityTest extends TestCase
{
    public function test_row_hash_matches_the_python_edition(): void
    {
        $r = new AuditLog(['at' => '2026-11-30 09:15:02', 'user' => 'acc', 'action' => 'POST', 'entity' => 'journal', 'entity_id' => '12',
            'detail' => 'MANUAL J-1 100.00']);
        $r->id = 7;
        $this->assertSame('f221e4e62c23ea357fa4db0a7849ab7644dde578240602f58cdb55dc7467e94c', Integrity::rowHash(Integrity::GENESIS, $r));
    }

    public function test_chain_detects_edits_and_deletions(): void
    {
        for ($i = 0; $i < 3; $i++) {
            Ledger::audit('acc', 'TEST', 'x', $i, "entry {$i}");
        }
        $this->assertGreaterThanOrEqual(3, Integrity::seal());
        $v = Integrity::verifyAuditChain();
        $this->assertTrue($v['ok']);
        $this->assertSame(0, $v['unsealed']);
        $row = AuditLog::where('detail', 'entry 1')->first();
        DB::update("UPDATE audit_log SET detail = 'entry 1 (edited)' WHERE id = ?", [$row->id]);
        $v = Integrity::verifyAuditChain();
        $this->assertFalse($v['ok']);
        $this->assertSame($row->id, $v['broken_at']['audit_id']);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('BROKEN', $v['message']);
        DB::update("UPDATE audit_log SET detail = 'entry 1' WHERE id = ?", [$row->id]);
        $this->assertTrue(Integrity::verifyAuditChain()['ok']);
        DB::delete('DELETE FROM audit_log WHERE id = ?', [AuditLog::orderByDesc('chain_seq')->first()->id]);
        $this->assertFalse(Integrity::verifyAuditChain()['ok']);
    }

    public function test_backup_status(): void
    {
        $now = '2026-12-01 09:00:00';
        $this->assertContains('No backup has been taken yet', Integrity::backupStatus($now)['issues']);
        Integrity::recordBackup('BACKUP', '2026-12-01 02:00:00', '2026-12-01 03:00:00', 'OK', null, 'abc');
        $st = Integrity::backupStatus($now);
        $this->assertSame(['2026-12-01 02:00:00', ['No restore drill recorded – a backup that has not been restored is not proven']],
            [substr($st['last_backup'], 0, 19), $st['issues']]);
        Integrity::recordBackup('RESTORE_TEST', '2026-12-01 04:00:00', null, 'OK');
        $this->assertTrue(Integrity::backupStatus($now)['ok']);
        $this->assertSame(['Last good backup is 55 hours old'], Integrity::backupStatus('2026-12-03 09:00:00')['issues']);
        Integrity::recordBackup('BACKUP', '2026-12-02 02:00:00', null, 'FAILED');
        $this->assertStringContainsString('latest backup attempt failed (02 Dec 2026 02:00)', Integrity::backupStatus($now)['issues'][0]);
    }

    public function test_ledger_balance_check(): void
    {
        $b = $this->branch();
        $j = Ledger::post($b, '2026-11-05', 'SALE', 'R', [[1010, '10', '0'], [4020, '0', '10']], 'x');
        $this->assertTrue(Integrity::ledgerBalanced()['ok']);
        DB::update('UPDATE journal_line SET credit = 9 WHERE journal_id = ? AND account_code = 4020', [$j->id]);
        $tb = Integrity::ledgerBalanced();
        $this->assertFalse($tb['ok']);
        $this->assertSame([$j->id], $tb['unbalanced_journals']);
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Domain\BusinessRuleError;
use App\Domain\Ledger;
use App\Domain\Poster;
use App\Models\FilingRecord;
use App\Models\Journal;
use App\Models\Setting;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use Tests\TestCase;

class LedgerTest extends TestCase
{
    public function test_balanced_journal_posts_and_is_audited(): void
    {
        $b = $this->branch();
        $j = Ledger::post($b, '2026-11-05', 'MANUAL', 'J-1', [[6110, '100', '0'], [1030, '0', '100']], 'acc', 'Cleaning', 'fm');
        $this->assertSame(['100.00', '0.00'], [$j->lines()->orderBy('id')->first()->debit, $j->lines()->orderBy('id')->first()->credit]);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('audit_log', ['action' => 'POST', 'entity' => 'journal', 'entity_id' => (string) $j->id, 'detail' => 'MANUAL J-1 100.00']);
    }

    /** @return array<string, array{0: array, 1: string, 2?: string}> */
    public static function badJournals(): array
    {
        return [
            'unbalanced' => [[[6110, '100', '0'], [1030, '0', '99.99']], 'not balanced'],
            'unknown account' => [[[9999, '1', '0'], [1030, '0', '1']], 'Unknown account 9999'],
            'system only' => [[[1100, '1', '0'], [1030, '0', '1']], 'system-only'],
            'module only by hand' => [[[1010, '1', '0'], [1030, '0', '1']], 'only be posted by its module'],
            'negative' => [[[6110, '-1', '0'], [1030, '0', '-1']], 'Negative amount'],
            'no amounts' => [[[6110, '0', '0']], 'no amounts'],
        ];
    }

    #[DataProvider('badJournals')]
    public function test_rules_refuse_bad_journals(array $lines, string $msg): void
    {
        $this->expectException(BusinessRuleError::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage($msg);
        Ledger::post($this->branch(), '2026-11-05', 'MANUAL', 'X', $lines, 'acc', null, 'fm');
    }

    public function test_manual_journal_needs_a_different_approver(): void
    {
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('approver who is not the preparer');
        Ledger::post($this->branch(), '2026-11-05', 'MANUAL', 'X', [[6110, '5', '0'], [1030, '0', '5']], 'acc', null, 'acc');
    }

    public function test_module_postings_may_use_module_accounts(): void
    {
        $j = Ledger::post($this->branch(), '2026-11-05', 'SALE', 'R-1', [[1010, '10', '0'], [4020, '0', '10']], 'cash1');
        $this->assertSame(2, $j->lines()->count());
    }

    public function test_locked_period_and_filed_month(): void
    {
        $b = $this->branch();
        Setting::where('key', 'locked_through')->update(['value' => '2026-10-31']);
        try {
            Ledger::post($b, '2026-10-31', 'SALE', 'R', [[1010, '1', '0'], [4020, '0', '1']], 'x');
            $this->fail('locked period accepted');
        } catch (BusinessRuleError $e) {
            $this->assertStringContainsString('Period locked through 2026-10-31', $e->getMessage());
        }
        FilingRecord::create(['tax_type' => 'VAT', 'period' => '2026-11', 'amount_declared' => '0', 'filed_on' => '2026-12-20',
            'reference' => 'GRA-1', 'paid_amount' => '0']);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('2026-11 is closed: the VAT return was filed on 2026-12-20 (GRA-1)');
        Ledger::post($b, '2026-11-15', 'SALE', 'R', [[1010, '1', '0'], [4020, '0', '1']], 'x');
    }

    public function test_reversal_once_only(): void
    {
        $b = $this->branch();
        $j = Ledger::post($b, '2026-11-05', 'MANUAL', 'J-1', [[6110, '100', '0', 'S1'], [1030, '0', '100']], 'acc', null, 'fm');
        $r = Ledger::reverse($j->id, '2026-11-06', 'acc', 'keyed twice');
        $l = $r->lines()->where('account_code', 6110)->first();
        $this->assertSame(['0.00', '100.00', 'S1', 'REVERSAL'], [$l->debit, $l->credit, $l->party, $r->source]);
        $this->assertSame($j->id, Journal::find($r->id)->reversal_of_id);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('already reversed');
        Ledger::reverse($j->id, '2026-11-06', 'acc', 'again');
    }

    public function test_poster_merges_lines_by_account_and_party(): void
    {
        $p = new Poster;
        $p->dr(1010, '10.005');
        $p->dr(1010, '5');
        $p->cr(4020, '12.50');
        $p->cr(2100, '2.50');
        $p->dr(2100, '0.00');
        $lines = array_map(fn ($l) => [$l[0], (string) $l[1], (string) $l[2]], $p->lines());
        $this->assertSame([[1010, '15.01', '0.00'], [4020, '0.00', '12.50'], [2100, '0.00', '2.50']], $lines);
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Domain\Branches;
use App\Domain\Uploads;
use App\Domain\CashBook;
use App\Domain\Claims;
use App\Domain\Inventory;
use App\Domain\Money;
use App\Domain\Sales;
use App\Domain\SampleData;
use App\Models\Branch;
use App\Models\Journal;
use App\Models\JournalLine;
use App\Models\Sale;
use App\Models\SaleLine;
use App\Models\Setting;
use App\Models\StockCountLine;
use App\Models\StockLot;
use App\Models\StockMove;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * Stage 2 parity: the same scenario as tools/py_scenario.py (two branches with the sample month, a receipt at another price,
 * a transfer, a discounted sale with change, a return, quarantine and write-off, a stock count, a cash-up, the claim
 * lifecycle with tax withheld, cash banked) must give exactly the Python edition's journals, lot values, claim balances and
 * receipt text – under all three costing set-ups.
 */
class PythonParityStage2Test extends TestCase
{
    private const UPLOAD_CSV = "branch_code,source,sku,name,category,tax_code,retail_price,branch_retail_price,batch_no,expiry,quantity,unit_cost,date,"
        ."payment_channel,paid_by,supplier_code,supplier_vat_invoice,invoice_no\r\n"
        ."A,OPENING,P100,Cough syrup 100ml,OTC medicine,EX,30,,CS1,2028-01-31,40,18,2026-11-20,,,,,\r\n"
        ."B,OPENING,P100,,,,,32,CS1,2028-01-31,20,18,2026-11-20,,,,,\r\n"
        ."A,CASH_PURCHASE,P004,,,,,,BL9,2028-06-30,5,70.10,2026-11-21,Petty cash,,S002,Yes,CR-77\r\n"
        ."B,CASH_PURCHASE,P004,,,,,,BL8,2028-06-30,2,75.35,2026-11-21,Bank,HO,,No,R-12\r\n"
        ."A,PRODUCT_ONLY,P101,Thermometer,Medical device/consumable,SR20,45,,,,,,,,,,,\r\n";

    /** Upload and count ids come from the database sequence, which PostgreSQL and MariaDB do not rewind between tests. */
    private static function ref(?string $r): ?string
    {
        return $r === null ? null : preg_replace(['/^UPL-\d+-/', '/^COUNT-\d+$/'], ['UPL-n-', 'COUNT-n'], $r);
    }

    public static function setups(): array
    {
        return [['BATCH', 'BRANCH'], ['WEIGHTED_AVERAGE', 'BRANCH'], ['WEIGHTED_AVERAGE', 'COMPANY']];
    }

    #[DataProvider('setups')]
    public function test_same_ledger_as_python(string $policy, string $pool): void
    {
        $expected = json_decode(file_get_contents(__DIR__.'/../fixtures/stage2_python.json'), true)["{$policy}_{$pool}"];
        Setting::where('key', 'cost_formula')->update(['value' => $policy]);
        Setting::where('key', 'cost_pool')->update(['value' => $pool]);
        SampleData::loadMaster();
        $a = SampleData::loadBranchMonth('A');
        $b = SampleData::loadBranchMonth('B');
        Branches::create('HO', 'Head office', 'admin', true);
        $up = Uploads::validate('stock.csv', self::UPLOAD_CSV, 'store1');
        $this->assertSame(0, Uploads::report($up)['report']['error_count'], json_encode(Uploads::report($up)));
        Uploads::confirm($up->id, 'store1', 'pharm');
        Inventory::receiveGoods($b->id, 'S002', 'X-B-1', '2026-11-24', [['sku' => 'P004', 'batch_no' => 'BDL9', 'expiry' => '2028-06-30', 'packs' => '7', 'cost_per_pack' => '73.30']], 'store1', 'pharm');
        Inventory::transfer($a->id, $b->id, 'P004', '5', '2026-11-25', 'TN-1', 'store1', 'pharm');
        Sales::checkout($b->id, 'B-X1', '2026-11-26', 'T2', 'RETAIL', [['code' => 'P004', 'qty' => '3', 'discount' => '7.35']], [['channel' => 'Cash', 'amount' => '352.65']],
            'cash2', null, null, 'pharm', '400');
        $lineId = SaleLine::where('sale_id', Sale::where('receipt_no', 'B-X1')->value('id'))->value('id');
        $ret = Sales::returnSale($b->id, 'B-X1', 'B-RET1', '2026-11-27', [['line_id' => $lineId, 'qty' => '1']], 'Cash', 'cash2', 'pharm');
        Inventory::adjust($a->id, '2026-11-28', 'P002', 'PCM2508', 'Quarantine', '100', 'store1', 'pharm');
        Inventory::adjust($a->id, '2026-11-29', 'P002', 'PCM2508', 'Quarantine write-off', '100', 'store1', 'pharm', 'DISP-1');
        $c = Inventory::openCount($b->id, '2026-11-30', 'store1');
        $sheet = Inventory::countSheet($c);
        Inventory::recordCounts($c, collect($sheet)->where('sku', 'P003')->mapWithKeys(fn ($r) => [$r['line_id'] => '0'])->all(), 'store1');
        Inventory::recordCounts($c->fresh(), collect($sheet)->where('sku', '<>', 'P003')->mapWithKeys(fn ($r) => [$r['line_id'] => StockCountLine::find($r['line_id'])->system_qty])->all(), 'store1');
        Inventory::approveCount($c->fresh(), 'pharm');
        $cu = CashBook::declareCash($a->id, 'T1', '2026-11-05', 'SAMPLE Cashier', '168');
        CashBook::approveCashup($cu['cashup_id'], 'sup1');
        $cl = Claims::get('NHIS', 'SAMPLE-CLM-NHIS-001-A');
        Claims::submit($cl, '2026-11-30', 'acc');
        Claims::vet($cl->fresh(), '2026-12-10', '100', 'acc', 'Contractual pricing');
        Claims::receivePayment($cl->fresh(), '2026-12-15', '60', 'Bank', 'acc', '1.80', 'WHT-77');
        CashBook::bankCash($a->id, '2026-11-30', '100', 'DEP-1', 'acc', 'fm');

        $codes = Branch::pluck('code', 'id')->all();
        $journals = [];
        foreach (Journal::orderBy('id')->get() as $j) {
            $lines = JournalLine::where('journal_id', $j->id)->get()->map(fn ($l) => [(int) $l->account_code, (string) Money::q2($l->debit), (string) Money::q2($l->credit), $l->party ?? ''])->all();
            usort($lines, fn ($x, $y) => $x <=> $y);
            $journals[] = ['unit' => $codes[$j->branch_id], 'date' => $j->entry_date, 'source' => $j->source, 'ref' => self::ref($j->source_ref), 'lines' => $lines];
        }
        $this->assertSame(count($expected['journals']), count($journals), 'number of journals');
        foreach ($expected['journals'] as $i => $e) {
            $e['ref'] = self::ref($e['ref']);
            $this->assertEquals($e, $journals[$i], "journal {$i} ({$e['source']} {$e['ref']})");
        }
        $lots = [];
        foreach (StockLot::orderBy('id')->get() as $lot) {
            $q = Money::sum(StockMove::where('lot_id', $lot->id)->pluck('qty')->all());
            $v = Money::sum(StockMove::where('lot_id', $lot->id)->pluck('value')->all());
            $lots[] = ['unit' => $codes[$lot->branch_id], 'batch' => $lot->batch_no, 'qty' => $q->isZero() ? '0' : (string) $q->stripTrailingZeros(), 'value' => (string) Money::q2($v)];
        }
        $this->assertEquals($expected['lots'], $lots);
        $cl = $cl->fresh();
        $this->assertEquals($expected['claim'], ['status' => $cl->status, 'approved' => $cl->approved_amount, 'paid' => $cl->paid_amount]);
        $this->assertSame($expected['receipt'], Sales::receiptText($ret->original_sale_id));
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Domain\Allocations;
use App\Domain\Ap;

/**
 * Stages 3 and 4 parity: tools/py_scenario3.py runs two months of head office and branch activity in the Python edition –
 * payroll and salaries paid by head office, expenses and supplier payments with WHT and WHVAT, purchase orders, matched and held
 * supplier invoices, payments against invoices, customer invoices, receipts and credit notes, petty cash, bank, cash and GL
 * batches, assets, depreciation and a disposal, cost allocations, prepayments and accruals, VAT close, filing and payment of
 * every November return – and writes the journals and every report. This test runs the same calls and compares all of it:
 * the full IFRS statements (whole business and each unit), schedules, payroll outputs, the reconciliation pack, master and
 * sub-account reports, profit by branch, payables and receivables. Amounts must agree to the pesewa.
 */
class PythonParityStage34Test extends TestCase
{
    private function scenario(): array
    {
        foreach (['wht_agent' => 'Yes', 'whvat_agent' => 'Yes', 'business_name' => 'ALMEGA PHARMACY', 'business_tin' => 'C0000000001'] as $k => $v) {
            Setting::updateOrCreate(['key' => $k], ['value' => $v]);
        }
        SampleData::loadMaster();
        $a = SampleData::loadBranchMonth('A');
        $b = SampleData::loadBranchMonth('B');
        $ho = Branches::create('HO', 'Head office', 'admin', true);
        $ids = ['A' => $a->id, 'B' => $b->id, 'HO' => $ho->id];
        [$n30, $d1, $d15, $d31] = ['2026-11-30', '2026-12-01', '2026-12-15', '2026-12-31'];

        $staff = [
            ['A', 'E001', 'Mensah', 'Ama', null, 'Pharmacist', '6500.00', '800.00', 'Resident', true, false, 'GHA-1', 'SS1', 'PN1', 'GCB', '1001'],
            ['A', 'E002', 'Owusu', 'Kofi', 'Yaw', 'Cashier', '1500.00', '200.00', 'Resident', true, true, 'GHA-2', 'SS2', null, 'GCB', '1002'],
            ['A', 'E003', 'Boateng', 'Esi', null, 'Cleaner', '900.00', '0', 'Casual', false, false, null, null, null, null, null],
            ['B', 'E004', 'Smith', 'John', null, 'Pharmacist', '8000.00', '500.00', 'Non-Resident', true, false, 'GHA-4', 'SS4', 'PN4', 'Ecobank', '2001'],
            ['HO', 'E005', 'Asante', 'Akua', null, 'Accountant', '5200.00', '600.00', 'Resident', true, false, 'GHA-5', null, 'PN5', 'CAL', '3001'],
        ];
        foreach ($staff as [$u, $no, $sn, $fn, $on, $role, $basic, $allw, $ts, $ss, $jr, $tin, $ssn, $pn, $bank, $acct]) {
            Employee::create(['branch_id' => $ids[$u], 'staff_no' => $no, 'name' => '', 'surname' => $sn, 'first_name' => $fn, 'other_names' => $on, 'role' => $role,
                'basic' => $basic, 'allowances' => $allw, 'tax_status' => $ts, 'ssnit_status' => $ss, 'junior_staff' => $jr, 'tin' => $tin, 'ssnit_no' => $ssn,
                'pension_no' => $pn, 'bank_name' => $bank, 'bank_account' => $acct, 'nationality' => $no !== 'E004' ? 'Ghanaian' : 'British',
                'postal_address' => $no !== 'E003' ? 'P.O. Box 1, Accra' : null, 'residential_address' => 'Accra']);
        }
        Payroll::run($a->id, $n30, 'acc', 'fm', ['E002' => ['overtime' => '300', 'refunds' => '45.50']]);
        Payroll::run($b->id, $n30, 'acc', 'fm', ['E004' => ['overtime' => '250']]);
        Payroll::run($ho->id, $n30, 'acc', 'fm');
        Ledger::paidBy($ho->id, fn () => Payroll::paySalaries($a->id, $n30, 'Bank', 'acc', 'fm'));
        Payroll::paySalaries($b->id, $n30, 'Bank', 'acc', 'fm');

        Payables::recordExpense($a->id, '2026-11-25', 'Sample Telecom Ltd', 6130, '1250.40', 'SR20', true, 'Shared', 'Bank', 'acc', 'Services', 'C0004', 'fm', 'Resident',
            'Accra', null, null, 'TEL-11', '2026-11-20');
        Payables::recordExpense($ho->id, '2026-11-26', 'Sample Landlord', 6100, '3000', 'OS', false, 'Exempt', 'Bank', 'acc', 'Rent-commercial', 'P0003', 'fm', 'Resident',

    private const IDS = ['id', 'lot_id', 'count_id', 'invoice_id', 'journal_id', 'supplier_id', 'upload_id', 'line_id'];

    private static function isNum(mixed $v): bool
    {
        return is_int($v) || is_float($v) || (is_string($v) && preg_match('/^-?\d+(\.\d+)?$/', $v));
    }

    /** Deep comparison: numbers by value (so "5.0" equals "5.00"), everything else exactly; [] equals {}. Returns the differences. */
    private function diff(mixed $e, mixed $a, string $path, array &$out): void
    {
        if (count($out) > 25) {
            return;
        }
        if (is_array($e) && is_array($a)) {
            if (! $e && ! $a) {
                return;
            }
            $ke = array_map('strval', array_keys($e));
            $ka = array_map('strval', array_keys($a));
            if ($ke !== $ka && (array_diff($ke, $ka) || array_diff($ka, $ke) || array_is_list($e))) {
                $out[] = "{$path}: keys differ – python ".json_encode(array_values(array_diff($ke, $ka))).' php '.json_encode(array_values(array_diff($ka, $ke)))
                    .(array_is_list($e) ? ' (lengths '.count($e).'/'.count($a).')' : '');
                if (array_is_list($e)) {
                    return;
                }
            }
            foreach ($e as $k => $v) {
                if (in_array((string) $k, self::IDS, true)) {
                    continue; // database ids: PostgreSQL and MariaDB do not rewind sequences between tests
                }
                if (array_key_exists($k, $a)) {
                    $this->diff($v, $a[$k], "{$path}.{$k}", $out);
                }
            }

            return;
        }
        if (self::isNum($e) && self::isNum($a)) {
            if (! BigDecimal::of((string) $e)->isEqualTo(BigDecimal::of(is_float($a) ? (string) $a : (string) $a))) {
                $out[] = "{$path}: python {$e} php {$a}";
            }

            return;
        }
        if ($e !== $a) {
            $out[] = "{$path}: python ".json_encode($e).' php '.json_encode($a);
        }
    }

    public function test_same_books_and_reports_as_python(): void
    {
        $expected = json_decode(file_get_contents(__DIR__.'/../fixtures/stage34_python.json'), true);
        $actual = json_decode(json_encode($this->scenario()), true);
        $all = [];
        foreach ($expected as $section => $e) {
            $out = [];
            $this->diff($e, $actual[$section] ?? null, $section, $out);
            $all = array_merge($all, array_slice($out, 0, 8));
        }
        $this->assertSame([], $all, "Differences from the Python edition:\n".implode("\n", $all));
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Domain\Branches;
use App\Domain\SampleData;
use App\Domain\Security;
use Tests\TestCase;

/** Stage 5: the screens render for each role, sign-in and the read-only All branches view work, and forms post through the domain rules. */
class ScreensTest extends TestCase
{
    private const MONTH = '2026-11';

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        SampleData::loadMaster();
        $a = SampleData::loadBranchMonth('A');
        Branches::create('HO', 'Head office', 'admin', true);
        Security::createUser('admin', 'Admin', 'admin', 'admin-Pass99', 'setup');
        foreach (['acc' => 'accountant', 'fm' => 'finance_manager', 'pharm' => 'pharmacist'] as $u => $role) {
            Security::createUser($u, $u, $role, "{$u}-Pass99", 'admin');
        }
        Security::createUser('cash1', 'Cashier', 'cashier', 'cash1-Pass99', 'admin', $a->id);
    }

    private function signin(string $u): void
    {
        $this->post('/signin', ['username' => $u, 'password' => "{$u}-Pass99"])->assertRedirect();
    }

    public function test_signin_and_dashboard(): void
    {
        $this->get('/')->assertRedirect('/signin');
        $this->get('/signin')->assertOk()->assertSee('Authenticator code')->assertHeader('X-Frame-Options', 'DENY')->assertHeader('Content-Security-Policy');
        $this->post('/signin', ['username' => 'acc', 'password' => 'wrong'])->assertRedirect()->assertSessionHas('error', 'Invalid username or password');
        $this->signin('acc');
        $this->get('/')->assertOk()->assertSee('Dashboard')->assertSee('All branches – read only')->assertSee('Statutory deadlines');
        $this->post('/context', ['unit' => 'A', 'month' => '2026-11'])->assertRedirect();
        $this->get('/')->assertOk()->assertSee('November 2026');
    }

    private const SCREENS = ['/', '/pos', '/sales', '/cash', '/claims', '/stock', '/upload', '/purchasing', '/payables', '/petty', '/returns', '/payroll',
        '/batches', '/batches?type=PETTY', '/ledger', '/ledger?tab=account&account=1010', '/ledger?tab=manual', '/ledger?tab=periodend', '/ledger?tab=assets', '/ledger?tab=allocations',
        '/statements', '/statements?tab=fp', '/statements?tab=ce', '/statements?tab=cf', '/statements?tab=notes', '/statements?tab=opening', '/statements?tab=accounts&code=1000',
        '/statements?tab=checks', '/statements?kind=month', '/reconcile', '/reports', '/reports?tab=pack', '/reports?tab=ageing', '/reports?tab=vat', '/reports?tab=alerts',
        '/reports?tab=cd', '/reports?tab=audit', '/profit', '/admin', '/settings',
        '/returns?tab=paye', '/returns?tab=ssnit', '/returns?tab=wht', '/returns?tab=whvat', '/returns?tab=calendar'];

    /** Every screen, every role, in the All branches view and in branch A and head office: shown (200) or refused (403), never a fault. */
    public function test_every_screen_renders_for_every_role(): void
    {
        foreach (['admin', 'acc', 'fm', 'pharm', 'cash1'] as $user) {
            $this->flushSession();
            $this->signin($user);
            foreach ([null, 'A', 'HO'] as $unit) {
                if ($unit !== null) {
                    $this->post('/context', ['unit' => $unit, 'month' => self::MONTH]);
                } else {
                    $this->post('/context', ['unit' => '', 'month' => self::MONTH]);
                }
                foreach (self::SCREENS as $url) {
                    $res = $this->get($url);
                    $code = $res->getStatusCode();
                    $this->assertContains($code, [200, 403, 422], "{$user} {$unit} {$url}: {$code} ".($res->exception ? $res->exception->getMessage().' @ '.$res->exception->getFile().':'.$res->exception->getLine() : ''));
                    if ($code !== 200) {
                        $res->assertSee('This page cannot be shown');
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private function at(string $user, ?string $unit): void
    {
        $this->flushSession();
        $this->signin($user);
        $this->post('/context', ['unit' => $unit ?? '', 'month' => self::MONTH]);
    }

    private function ok($res, string $what): void
    {
        $res->assertRedirect();
        $this->assertNull(session('error'), "{$what}: ".session('error'));
        $this->assertNotNull(session('ok'), "{$what}: no confirmation");
    }

    public function test_all_branches_view_is_read_only_and_branch_users_are_held_to_their_branch(): void
    {
        $this->at('acc', null);

            ->assertRedirect()->assertSessionHas('error');
        $this->assertStringContainsString('read-only All branches', session('error'));
        $this->assertSame(0, \App\Models\Journal::where('source', 'MANUAL')->count());
        $this->at('cash1', null);
        $this->get('/pos')->assertOk()->assertSee('Branch A');
        $this->get('/profit')->assertStatus(403);
        $this->at('acc', 'HO');
        $this->post('/stock/nrv', [])->assertRedirect()->assertSessionHas('error', 'Head office holds no stock and makes no sales – choose a branch');
    }

    public function test_upload_check_then_second_person_confirms(): void

            ."A,OPENING,P901,Upload test tablets,,OTC medicine,EX,1,25.00,20,,,,UT1,2028-10-31,10,12.50,2026-11-30,,,,,,\n";
        $file = \Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile::fake()->createWithContent('stock.csv', $csv);
        $this->post('/upload/check', ['file' => $file])->assertRedirect();
        $this->assertNull(session('error'), (string) session('error'));
        $up = \App\Models\StockUpload::latest('id')->first();
        $this->get('/upload?upload='.$up->id)->assertOk()->assertSee('P901');
        $this->assertNull(\App\Models\Product::where('sku', 'P901')->first());
        $this->post("/upload/{$up->id}", ['approver' => 'acc', 'approver_secret' => 'acc-Pass99'])->assertSessionHas('error');
        $this->ok($this->post("/upload/{$up->id}", ['approver' => 'fm', 'approver_secret' => 'fm-Pass99']), 'confirm upload');

    }

    public function test_batch_keyed_checked_and_posted_by_a_second_person(): void

    public function test_manual_journal_failure_rolls_back_everything(): void
    {
        $this->at('acc', 'A');
        $n = \App\Models\Journal::count();
        $this->post('/ledger/journal', ['reference' => 'BAD', 'date' => '2026-11-20', 'lines' => [['account' => 6215, 'debit' => '10'], ['account' => 3010, 'credit' => '9']],
            'approver' => 'fm', 'approver_secret' => 'fm-Pass99'])->assertSessionHas('error');
        $this->assertSame($n, \App\Models\Journal::count());
        $this->ok($this->post('/ledger/journal', ['reference' => 'GOOD', 'date' => '2026-11-20', 'lines' => [['account' => 6215, 'debit' => '10'], ['account' => 3010, 'credit' => '10']],
            'approver' => 'fm', 'approver_secret' => 'fm-Pass99']), 'journal');
        $this->assertSame($n + 1, \App\Models\Journal::count());
    }

    public function test_exports_download(): void
    {
        $this->at('fm', null);
        foreach (['/statements/export/xlsx', '/reports/export/tb', '/reports/export/profit', '/returns/file/pack', '/returns/file/dt0110', '/returns/file/whvat', '/returns/file/payroll'] as $url) {
            $res = $this->get($url);
            $res->assertOk();
            $this->assertStringStartsWith('PK', $res->getContent(), $url);
            $this->assertStringContainsString('attachment;', $res->headers->get('Content-Disposition'), $url);
            $tmp = tempnam(sys_get_temp_dir(), 'x');
            file_put_contents($tmp, $res->getContent());
            $this->assertGreaterThan(0, \PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\IOFactory::load($tmp)->getSheetCount(), $url);
            unlink($tmp);
        }
        $pdf = $this->get('/statements/export/pdf');
        $pdf->assertOk();
        $this->assertStringStartsWith('%PDF', $pdf->getContent());
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Withholding TaxType', $this->get('/returns/file/wht-csv')->assertOk()->getContent());
        $this->at('acc', 'A');
        $this->assertStringContainsString('branch_code', $this->get('/upload/template')->assertOk()->getContent());
    }

    public function test_admin_and_controlled_settings(): void
    {
        $this->at('admin', null);
        $this->ok($this->post('/admin', ['action' => 'user', 'username' => 'inv1', 'full_name' => 'Inventory officer', 'role' => 'inventory_officer', 'password' => 'inv1-Pass9999', 'branch' => 'A']), 'user');
        $this->ok($this->post('/admin', ['action' => 'branches', 'username' => 'inv1', 'home_branch' => 'A', 'extra_branches' => 'HO']), 'branches');
        $this->post('/admin', ['action' => 'disable', 'username' => 'admin'])->assertSessionHas('error', 'You cannot disable yourself');
        $this->get('/admin')->assertOk()->assertSee('inv1');
        $this->at('acc', null);
        $this->post('/settings', ['action' => 'setting', 'key' => 'business_name', 'value' => 'ALMEGA PHARMACY', 'reason' => 'trading name', 'approver' => 'acc', 'approver_secret' => 'acc-Pass99'])->assertSessionHas('error');
        $this->ok($this->post('/settings', ['action' => 'setting', 'key' => 'business_name', 'value' => 'ALMEGA PHARMACY', 'reason' => 'trading name', 'approver' => 'fm', 'approver_secret' => 'fm-Pass99']), 'setting');
        $this->assertSame('ALMEGA PHARMACY', \App\Domain\Ledger::setting('business_name'));
        $this->get('/statements')->assertOk()->assertSee('ALMEGA PHARMACY');
    }
