####################################################################################################
##### FILE: tests/Feature/SecurityTest.php
####################################################################################################

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Domain\BusinessRuleError;
use App\Domain\PermissionDenied;
use App\Domain\Security;
use App\Domain\Totp;
use App\Models\Setting;
use App\Models\User;
use Tests\TestCase;

class SecurityTest extends TestCase
{
    public function test_password_hash_is_compatible_with_the_python_edition(): void
    {
        $python = 'pbkdf2$00112233445566778899aabbccddeeff$e8d8b38a7ecc03d9757dc9581a5fd3d5cd5fc2e10defa317f24b454bc32b96d2';
        $this->assertSame($python, Security::hashPassword('Secret-Pass1', hex2bin('00112233445566778899aabbccddeeff')));
        $this->assertTrue(Security::verifyPassword('Secret-Pass1', $python));
        $this->assertFalse(Security::verifyPassword('secret-pass1', $python));
        $this->assertFalse(Security::verifyPassword('x', 'garbage'));
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('at least 8');
        Security::hashPassword('short');
    }

    /** RFC 6238 appendix B (SHA-1 secret "12345678901234567890"), 6-digit codes; same values as the Python edition. */
    public function test_totp_rfc6238_vectors(): void
    {
        $secret = Totp::base32Encode('12345678901234567890');
        $this->assertSame('GEZDGNBVGY3TQOJQGEZDGNBVGY3TQOJQ', $secret);
        foreach ([59 => '287082', 1111111109 => '081804', 1234567890 => '005924', 2000000000 => '279037'] as $t => $code) {
            $this->assertSame($code, Totp::code($secret, $t));
        }
        $this->assertTrue(Totp::verify($secret, '287082', 59 + 30)); // one step of clock drift accepted
        $this->assertFalse(Totp::verify($secret, '287082', 59 + 90));
        $this->assertSame('12345678901234567890', Totp::base32Decode($secret));
    }

    public function test_roles_branches_and_approval_limits(): void
    {
        $this->users();
        $b = $this->branch();
        $cash = User::where('username', 'cash1')->first();
        $cash->update(['branch_id' => $this->branch('B')]);
        $this->assertTrue(Security::can($cash, 'sale.create'));
        $this->assertFalse(Security::can($cash, 'journal.create'));
        try {
            Security::require($cash, 'sale.create', $b);
            $this->fail('other branch');
        } catch (PermissionDenied $e) {
            $this->assertStringContainsString('limited to other branches', $e->getMessage());
        }
        $this->assertSame('journal.approve', Security::approvalPerm('journal.approve', '2000'));
        $this->assertSame('journal.approve.high', Security::approvalPerm('journal.approve', '2000.01'));
        $this->assertSame('po.approve', Security::approvalPerm('po.approve', '999999'));
        $this->assertSame('fm', Security::approve(['approver' => 'fm', 'approver_secret' => 'fm-Pass99'], 'journal.approve',
            User::where('username', 'acc')->first(), $b, '50000'));
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('may not journal.approve.high');
        Security::verifyApproval('pharm', 'pharm-Pass99', Security::approvalPerm('journal.approve', '50000'), 'acc');
    }

    public function test_approval_rules(): void
    {
        $this->users();
        foreach ([['acc', 'acc-Pass99', 'different person'], ['fm', 'wrong', 'credentials not valid'], ['cash1', 'cash1-Pass99', 'may not']] as [$ap, $pw, $msg]) {
            try {
                Security::verifyApproval($ap, $pw, 'journal.approve', 'acc');
                $this->fail($msg);
            } catch (BusinessRuleError $e) {
                $this->assertStringContainsString($msg, $e->getMessage());
            }
        }
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('audit_log', ['action' => 'APPROVAL_FAILED', 'entity_id' => 'fm']);
    }

    public function test_lock_out_and_two_step(): void
    {
        $this->users();
        $u = User::where('username', 'acc')->first();
        $e = Security::enrollTotp($u);
        $this->assertStringStartsWith('otpauth://totp/PharmPOS:acc?secret=', $e['otpauth_uri']);
        Security::confirmTotp($u->fresh(), Totp::code($e['secret']));
        try {
            Security::authenticate('acc', 'acc-Pass99');
            $this->fail('no code');
        } catch (BusinessRuleError $x) {
            $this->assertStringContainsString('6-digit code', $x->getMessage());
        }
        $this->assertSame('acc', Security::authenticate('acc', 'acc-Pass99', Totp::code($e['secret']))->username);
        for ($i = 0; $i < 5; $i++) {
            try {
                Security::authenticate('acc', 'wrong-password');
            } catch (BusinessRuleError) {
            }
        }
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('Too many failed');
        Security::authenticate('acc', 'acc-Pass99', Totp::code($e['secret']));
    }

    public function test_enforced_two_step_and_self_service_limits(): void
    {
        $this->users();
        $acc = User::where('username', 'acc')->first();
        $this->assertFalse(Security::twoStepRequired($acc));
        Setting::where('key', 'enforce_2fa')->update(['value' => 'Yes']);
        $this->assertTrue(Security::twoStepRequired($acc));
        $this->assertFalse(Security::twoStepRequired(User::where('username', 'cash1')->first()));
        try {
            Security::setActive('admin', false, 'admin');
            $this->fail('self-disable');
        } catch (BusinessRuleError $x) {
            $this->assertStringContainsString('your own access', $x->getMessage());
        }
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('Ask another administrator');
        Security::resetTotp('admin', 'admin');
    }

    public function test_tokens(): void
    {
        $this->users();
        $t = Security::issueToken(User::where('username', 'acc')->first());
        $this->assertSame('acc', Security::userFromToken($t)->username);
        $this->expectException(PermissionDenied::class);
        Security::userFromToken(substr($t, 0, -1).(str_ends_with($t, 'a') ? 'b' : 'a'));
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Domain\SampleData;
use App\Models\SaleLine;
use Tests\TestCase;

/** Stage 2 API end to end: products and branch prices, suppliers, receipts, sale and receipt, return, adjustment, transfer, count,
 * cash-up, banking, statement and reconciliation, claims, uploads with the inventory officer limited to their branch. */
class Stage2ApiTest extends TestCase
{
    private function tok(string $u): array
    {
        $r = $this->postJson('/api/auth/login', ['username' => $u, 'password' => "{$u}-Pass99"]);
        $r->assertOk();

        return ['Authorization' => 'Bearer '.$r->json('token')];
    }

    private function ap(string $u): array
    {
        return ['approver' => $u, 'approver_secret' => "{$u}-Pass99"];
    }

    public function test_stage2_flow(): void
    {
        $this->postJson('/api/setup/admin', ['username' => 'admin', 'full_name' => 'Admin', 'role' => 'admin', 'password' => 'admin-Pass99'])->assertOk();
        $adm = $this->tok('admin');
        foreach (['A' => 'Branch A', 'B' => 'Branch B'] as $c => $n) {
            $this->postJson('/api/branches', ['code' => $c, 'name' => $n], $adm)->assertOk();
        }
        $this->postJson('/api/branches', ['code' => 'HO', 'name' => 'Head office', 'is_head_office' => true], $adm)->assertOk();
        foreach (['acc' => ['accountant', null], 'fm' => ['finance_manager', null], 'pharm' => ['pharmacist', null], 'cash1' => ['cashier', 'A'],
            'store1' => ['storekeeper', null], 'io' => ['inventory_officer', 'B']] as $u => [$role, $br]) {
            $this->postJson('/api/users', ['username' => $u, 'full_name' => $u, 'role' => $role, 'password' => "{$u}-Pass99", 'branch' => $br], $adm)->assertOk();
        }
        SampleData::loadMaster();
        [$acc, $pharm, $cash, $store, $io] = [$this->tok('acc'), $this->tok('pharm'), $this->tok('cash1'), $this->tok('store1'), $this->tok('io')];

        // products: shared list, branch B's own price
        $this->postJson('/api/products', ['sku' => 'P050', 'name' => 'Oral rehydration salts', 'category' => 'OTC medicine', 'tax_code' => 'EX',
            'retail_price' => 4.5], $pharm)->assertOk();
        $this->postJson('/api/products', ['sku' => 'P050', 'name' => 'x', 'category' => 'OTC medicine', 'tax_code' => 'EX', 'retail_price' => 1], $pharm)
            ->assertStatus(422)->assertJson(['detail' => 'Product P050 already exists']);
        $this->putJson('/api/products/P050/branches/B', ['retail_price' => 5, 'reorder_level' => 10], $io)->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('retail_price', '5.00');
        $this->putJson('/api/products/P050/branches/A', ['retail_price' => 5], $io)->assertForbidden();
        $this->getJson('/api/products?branch=B', $io)->assertOk()->assertJsonFragment(['sku' => 'P050', 'retail_price' => '5.00']);
        $this->getJson('/api/products?branch=A', $io)->assertForbidden();

        // suppliers are change-controlled; the WHT code must match residence
        $this->postJson('/api/suppliers', ['code' => 'S900', 'name' => 'New wholesaler', 'approval' => $this->ap('fm')], $acc)->assertOk();
        $this->patchJson('/api/suppliers/S900', ['tin' => 'C0001234567', 'reason' => 'TIN received', 'approval' => $this->ap('fm')], $acc)->assertOk();
        $this->patchJson('/api/suppliers/S900', ['resident_status' => 'NonResident', 'wht_type' => 'Goods', 'reason' => 'x', 'approval' => $this->ap('fm')], $acc)
            ->assertStatus(422)->assertJsonPath('detail', fn ($d) => str_contains($d, 'is for Resident payees'));

        // goods received, then a sale with change, the receipt, a return
        $this->postJson('/api/goods-receipts', ['branch' => 'A', 'supplier' => 'S002', 'invoice_no' => 'INV-1', 'date' => '2026-11-02',
            'lines' => [['sku' => 'P004', 'batch_no' => 'BL1', 'expiry' => '2028-06-30', 'packs' => 20, 'cost_per_pack' => 70]], 'approval' => $this->ap('pharm')], $store)->assertOk();
        $s = $this->postJson('/api/sales', ['branch' => 'A', 'receipt_no' => 'R-1', 'date' => '2026-11-05', 'till' => 'T1',
            'items' => [['code' => 'P004', 'qty' => 2]], 'payments' => [['channel' => 'Cash', 'amount' => 240]], 'tendered' => 250], $cash)->assertOk();
        $this->assertSame('240.00', $s->json('total'));
        $this->assertSame('10.00', $s->json('change_due'));
        $this->postJson('/api/sales', ['branch' => 'B', 'receipt_no' => 'R-2', 'date' => '2026-11-05', 'till' => 'T1', 'items' => [['code' => 'P004']],
            'payments' => [['channel' => 'Cash', 'amount' => 120]]], $cash)->assertForbidden();
        $this->postJson('/api/sales', ['branch' => 'A', 'receipt_no' => 'R-3', 'date' => '2026-11-05', 'till' => 'T1',
            'items' => [['code' => 'P004', 'discount' => 5]], 'payments' => [['channel' => 'Cash', 'amount' => 115]]], $cash)
            ->assertStatus(422);
        $receipt = $this->get('/api/sales/'.$s->json('sale_id').'/receipt', $cash)->assertOk()->getContent();
        $this->assertStringContainsString('R-1', $receipt);
        $line = SaleLine::where('sale_id', $s->json('sale_id'))->value('id');
        $this->postJson('/api/returns', ['branch' => 'A', 'original_receipt' => 'R-1', 'return_no' => 'RET-1', 'date' => '2026-11-06',
            'items' => [['line_id' => $line, 'qty' => 1]], 'refund_channel' => 'Cash', 'approval' => $this->ap('pharm')], $cash)->assertOk();

        // adjustment, transfer to B, a count in B with a shortage
        $this->postJson('/api/adjustments', ['branch' => 'A', 'date' => '2026-11-07', 'sku' => 'P004', 'batch_no' => 'BL1', 'adj_type' => 'Damage write-off',
            'qty' => 1, 'approval' => $this->ap('store1')], $store)->assertStatus(422);
        $this->postJson('/api/adjustments', ['branch' => 'A', 'date' => '2026-11-07', 'sku' => 'P004', 'batch_no' => 'BL1', 'adj_type' => 'Damage write-off',
            'qty' => 1, 'approval' => $this->ap('pharm')], $store)->assertOk();
        $this->postJson('/api/transfers', ['from_branch' => 'A', 'to_branch' => 'B', 'sku' => 'P004', 'qty' => 5, 'date' => '2026-11-08', 'note_no' => 'TN-1',
            'approval' => $this->ap('pharm')], $store)->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('value_at_cost', '350.00');
        $c = $this->postJson('/api/stock-counts', ['branch' => 'B', 'on' => '2026-11-09'], $io)->assertOk();
        $lineId = collect($c->json('sheet'))->firstWhere('sku', 'P004')['line_id'];
        $this->postJson('/api/stock-counts/'.$c->json('count_id').'/counts', [(string) $lineId => 4], $io)->assertOk();
        $v = $this->postJson('/api/stock-counts/'.$c->json('count_id').'/approve', [], $pharm)->assertOk();
        $this->assertNotEmpty($v->json('variances'));
        $this->getJson('/api/stock/B?as_of=2026-11-30', $io)->assertOk();
        $this->getJson('/api/stock/A/reconciliation?as_of=2026-11-30', $acc)->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('ok', true);

        // cash: declare, approve, bank it, statement and reconciliation
        $cu = $this->postJson('/api/cashups', ['branch' => 'A', 'till' => 'T1', 'date' => '2026-11-05', 'counted' => 240], $cash)->assertOk();
        $this->postJson('/api/cashups/'.$cu->json('cashup_id').'/approve', [], $pharm)->assertOk();
        $this->postJson('/api/cash/bank-deposit', ['branch' => 'A', 'on' => '2026-11-06', 'amount' => 120, 'deposit_ref' => 'DEP-1',
            'approval' => $this->ap('fm')], $acc)->assertOk();
        $this->postJson('/api/bank/statements', ['branch' => 'A', 'account_code' => 1030, 'lines' => [
            ['date' => '2026-11-06', 'amount' => 120, 'description' => 'Cash deposit', 'reference' => 'DEP-1'],
            ['date' => '2026-11-30', 'amount' => -15, 'description' => 'Bank charges']]], $acc)->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('matched', 1);
        $rec = $this->getJson('/api/bank/reconciliation?branch=A&account_code=1030&as_of=2026-11-30&statement_balance=105', $acc)->assertOk();
        $this->assertNotEmpty($rec->json());

        // uploads: the inventory officer may load only into B, and a second person confirms
        $this->get('/api/uploads/products-stock/template.csv?examples=1', $io)->assertOk()->assertHeader('Content-Type', 'text/csv; charset=utf-8');
        $csv = "branch_code,source,sku,batch_no,expiry,quantity,unit_cost,date\r\nA,OPENING,P050,O1,2028-01-31,10,2,2026-11-01\r\n";
        $this->call('POST', '/api/uploads/products-stock?file_name=s.csv', [], [], [], $this->server($io), $csv)->assertForbidden();
        $csv = str_replace('A,OPENING', 'B,OPENING', $csv);
        $up = $this->call('POST', '/api/uploads/products-stock?file_name=s.csv', [], [], [], $this->server($io), $csv)->assertOk();
        $this->assertSame(0, $up->json('errors'));
        $this->postJson('/api/uploads/'.$up->json('upload_id').'/confirm', ['approval' => $this->ap('pharm')], $io)->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('status', 'CONFIRMED');
        $this->getJson('/api/uploads/'.$up->json('upload_id'), $io)->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('status', 'CONFIRMED');
    }

    private function server(array $headers): array
    {
        return ['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION' => $headers['Authorization'], 'CONTENT_TYPE' => 'text/csv', 'HTTP_ACCEPT' => 'application/json'];
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Domain\SampleData;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\IOFactory;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * Stages 3 and 4 through the API: employees and payroll, expenses, supplier payments, assets, VAT close and filing, purchase
 * order to payment, customer invoice, batches, allocation, petty cash, full statements and reconciliations, and every file
 * export (Excel packs, GRA forms, WHT CSV, purchase order PDF) opened again to prove it is a valid file.
 */
class Stage34ApiTest extends TestCase
{
    private function tok(string $u): array
    {
        return ['Authorization' => 'Bearer '.$this->postJson('/api/auth/login', ['username' => $u, 'password' => "{$u}-Pass99"])->assertOk()->json('token')];
    }

    private function ap(string $u): array
    {
        return ['approver' => $u, 'approver_secret' => "{$u}-Pass99"];
    }

    private function xlsx(string $bytes): \PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Spreadsheet
    {
        $f = tempnam(sys_get_temp_dir(), 'x').'.xlsx';
        file_put_contents($f, $bytes);
        $book = IOFactory::load($f);
        unlink($f);

        return $book;
    }

    public function test_stage34_flow(): void
    {
        $this->postJson('/api/setup/admin', ['username' => 'admin', 'full_name' => 'Admin', 'role' => 'admin', 'password' => 'admin-Pass99'])->assertOk();
        $adm = $this->tok('admin');
        $this->postJson('/api/branches', ['code' => 'A', 'name' => 'Branch A'], $adm)->assertOk();
        $this->postJson('/api/branches', ['code' => 'HO', 'name' => 'Head office', 'is_head_office' => true], $adm)->assertOk();
        foreach (['acc' => 'accountant', 'fm' => 'finance_manager', 'pharm' => 'pharmacist', 'store1' => 'storekeeper'] as $u => $role) {
            $this->postJson('/api/users', ['username' => $u, 'full_name' => $u, 'role' => $role, 'password' => "{$u}-Pass99"], $adm)->assertOk();
        }
        SampleData::loadMaster();
        [$acc, $fm, $pharm, $store] = [$this->tok('acc'), $this->tok('fm'), $this->tok('pharm'), $this->tok('store1')];
        $this->postJson('/api/goods-receipts', ['branch' => 'A', 'supplier' => 'S002', 'invoice_no' => 'INV-1', 'date' => '2026-11-02',
            'lines' => [['sku' => 'P004', 'batch_no' => 'BL1', 'expiry' => '2028-06-30', 'packs' => 20, 'cost_per_pack' => 70]], 'approval' => $this->ap('pharm')], $store)->assertOk();

        // payroll
        $this->postJson('/api/employees', ['branch' => 'A', 'staff_no' => 'E1', 'surname' => 'Mensah', 'first_name' => 'Ama', 'role' => 'Pharmacist', 'basic' => 6500,
            'allowances' => 800, 'tin' => 'GHA-1', 'ssnit_no' => 'SS1', 'pension_no' => 'P1', 'bank_name' => 'GCB', 'bank_account' => '1'], $acc)->assertOk();
        $run = $this->postJson('/api/payroll/run', ['branch' => 'A', 'month_end' => '2026-11-30', 'approval' => $this->ap('fm')], $acc)->assertOk();
        $this->assertSame('E1', $run->json('lines.0.0'));
        $this->postJson('/api/payroll/2026/11/pay-salaries', ['branch' => 'A', 'paid_by' => 'HO', 'approval' => $this->ap('fm')], $acc)->assertOk();
        $this->getJson('/api/payroll/2026/11/register', $acc)->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('checks.Earnings - deductions = net.ok', true);
        $this->getJson('/api/payroll/2026/11/register', $store)->assertForbidden();
        $book = $this->xlsx($this->get('/api/payroll/2026/11/pack.xlsx', $acc)->assertOk()->getContent());
        $this->assertContains('SSNIT_Tier1', $book->getSheetNames());

        // expense, supplier payment, asset, depreciation
        $this->postJson('/api/expenses', ['branch' => 'A', 'date' => '2026-11-20', 'payee' => 'Telecom', 'account_code' => 6300, 'net' => 500, 'tax_code' => 'SR20',
            'supplier_charges_vat' => true, 'use' => 'Shared', 'channel' => 'Bank'], $acc)->assertOk();
        $this->postJson('/api/supplier-payments', ['branch' => 'A', 'supplier' => 'S002', 'date' => '2026-11-21', 'gross' => 1000, 'wht_base' => 1000, 'channel' => 'Bank',
            'approval' => $this->ap('fm')], $acc)->assertOk();
        $this->postJson('/api/assets', ['branch' => 'A', 'tag' => 'FA1', 'description' => 'Fridge', 'asset_account' => 1530, 'cost' => 6000, 'acquired_on' => '2026-10-10',
            'life_months' => 60, 'pay_channel' => 'Bank', 'approval' => $this->ap('fm')], $acc)->assertOk();
        $this->postJson('/api/assets/depreciation', ['branch' => 'A', 'period_end' => '2026-11-30', 'approval' => $this->ap('fm')], $acc)->assertOk()
            ->assertJsonPath('journal_id', fn ($v) => $v > 0);

        // VAT close and filing; the schedules pack and GRA forms open as workbooks
        $this->postJson('/api/schedules/2026/11/close-vat', ['on' => '2026-11-30', 'approval' => $this->ap('fm')], $acc)->assertOk();
        $sch = $this->getJson('/api/schedules/2026/11', $acc)->assertOk();
        $this->assertTrue($sch->json('paye.ties.PAYE vs GL 2140.ok'));
        $this->postJson('/api/filings/PAYE/2026/11', ['filed_on' => '2026-12-10', 'reference' => 'GRA-1', 'amount_declared' => $sch->json('paye.total_paye')], $acc)->assertOk();
        $this->postJson('/api/filings/PAYE/2026/11/pay', ['paying_branch' => 'HO', 'date' => '2026-12-11', 'approval' => $this->ap('fm')], $acc)->assertOk();
        $this->assertContains('VAT_Sales', $this->xlsx($this->get('/api/schedules/2026/11/pack.xlsx', $acc)->assertOk()->getContent())->getSheetNames());
        $this->assertSame('GHANA REVENUE AUTHORITY', $this->xlsx($this->get('/api/returns/2026/11/wht.xlsx', $acc)->assertOk()->getContent())->getActiveSheet()->getCell('A1')->getValue());
        $this->assertStringContainsString('TABLE DATA', $this->get('/api/returns/2026/11/wht.csv', $acc)->assertOk()->getContent());
        $this->assertSame('DT0108B', $this->xlsx($this->get('/api/returns/annual/2026/dt0108.xlsx', $acc)->assertOk()->getContent())->getActiveSheet()->getTitle());
        $this->xlsx($this->get('/api/returns/2026/11/whvat.xlsx', $acc)->assertOk()->getContent());

        // purchase order to payment
        $po = $this->postJson('/api/purchase-orders', ['branch' => 'A', 'supplier' => 'S002', 'date' => '2026-12-01', 'lines' => [['sku' => 'P004', 'qty' => 10, 'unit_price' => 70],
            ['description' => 'Cleaning', 'account_code' => 6140, 'qty' => 1, 'unit_price' => 200]]], $store)->assertOk();
        $no = $po->json('po_no');
        $this->postJson("/api/purchase-orders/{$no}/approve", ['approval' => $this->ap('store1')], $store)->assertStatus(422);
        $this->postJson("/api/purchase-orders/{$no}/approve", ['approval' => $this->ap('pharm')], $store)->assertOk();
        $this->postJson("/api/purchase-orders/{$no}/receive", ['date' => '2026-12-03', 'lines' => [['line_no' => 1, 'qty' => 10, 'batch_no' => 'BX', 'expiry' => '2029-01-31'],
            ['line_no' => 2, 'qty' => 1]]], $store)->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('status', 'RECEIVED');
        $pdf = $this->get("/api/purchase-orders/{$no}/pdf", $acc)->assertOk()->getContent();
        $this->assertStringStartsWith('%PDF', $pdf);
        $inv = $this->postJson('/api/ap/invoices', ['branch' => 'A', 'supplier' => 'S002', 'invoice_no' => 'SX-1', 'invoice_date' => '2026-12-04', 'po_no' => $no,
            'lines' => [['line_no' => 1, 'qty' => 10, 'unit_price' => 70], ['line_no' => 2, 'qty' => 1, 'unit_price' => 200]]], $acc)->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('status', 'OPEN');
        $this->getJson('/api/purchasing/received-not-invoiced?as_of=2026-12-31', $acc)->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('total', '0.00');
        $this->postJson('/api/ap/payments', ['branch' => 'A', 'date' => '2026-12-10', 'allocations' => [['invoice_id' => $inv->json('invoice_id'), 'amount' => 300]],
            'approval' => $this->ap('fm')], $acc)->assertOk();
        $this->xlsx($this->get('/api/ap/payment-advice.xlsx?on=2026-12-10', $acc)->assertOk()->getContent());

        // customer invoice and receipt
        $ar = $this->postJson('/api/ar/invoices', ['branch' => 'A', 'customer' => 'CORP-A', 'date' => '2026-12-02', 'lines' => [['account_code' => 4070,
            'description' => 'Screening', 'net' => 1000, 'tax_code' => 'SR20']]], $acc)->assertOk();
        $this->postJson('/api/customer-receipts', ['branch' => 'A', 'payer' => 'CORP-A', 'date' => '2026-12-15', 'amount' => $ar->json('gross'), 'channel' => 'Bank',
            'reference' => 'R1'], $acc)->assertOk();

        // batches: a petty cash vault batch for head office, posted by a second person; a failing entry posts nothing
        $this->putJson('/api/petty-cash/HO/float', ['imprest' => 1000, 'custodian' => 'Akua', 'approval' => $this->ap('fm')], $acc)->assertOk();
        $b = $this->postJson('/api/batches', ['branch' => 'HO', 'type' => 'PETTY', 'description' => 'Week 1', 'control_total' => 1100, 'control_count' => 2], $acc)
            ->assertOk()->json('batch_no');
        $this->postJson("/api/batches/{$b}/entries", ['kind' => 'TOPUP', 'date' => '2026-12-05', 'reference' => 'T1', 'payload' => ['from_channel' => 'Bank', 'amount' => 1000]], $acc)->assertOk();
        $this->postJson("/api/batches/{$b}/entries", ['kind' => 'VOUCHER', 'date' => '2026-12-06', 'reference' => 'V1', 'payload' => ['payee' => 'Taxi', 'account_code' => 6215,
            'net' => 100]], $acc)->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('balanced', true);
        $chk = $this->postJson("/api/batches/{$b}/check", [], $acc)->assertOk();
        $this->assertTrue($chk->json("ready"), json_encode($chk->json()));
        $this->postJson("/api/batches/{$b}/post", ['approval' => $this->ap('acc')], $acc)->assertStatus(422);
        $this->postJson("/api/batches/{$b}/post", ['approval' => $this->ap('fm')], $acc)->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('posted', 2);
        $this->getJson('/api/petty-cash/HO?as_of=2026-12-31', $acc)->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('book_balance', '900.00');
        $bad = $this->postJson('/api/batches', ['branch' => 'HO', 'type' => 'PETTY', 'description' => 'Too much', 'control_total' => 5000, 'control_count' => 1], $acc)->json('batch_no');
        $this->postJson("/api/batches/{$bad}/entries", ['kind' => 'VOUCHER', 'date' => '2026-12-07', 'reference' => 'V2', 'payload' => ['payee' => 'X', 'account_code' => 6215,
            'net' => 5000]], $acc)->assertOk();
        $this->postJson("/api/batches/{$bad}/post", ['approval' => $this->ap('fm')], $acc)->assertStatus(422)
            ->assertJsonPath('detail', fn ($d) => str_contains($d, 'below nil'));
        $this->getJson('/api/petty-cash/HO?as_of=2026-12-31', $acc)->assertJsonPath('book_balance', '900.00');

        // allocation, statements, reconciliations, dashboard, master accounts
        $this->postJson('/api/allocations', ['from_unit' => 'HO', 'date' => '2026-12-31', 'lines' => [['account_code' => 6215, 'amount' => 100]], 'basis' => 'EQUAL',
            'approval' => $this->ap('fm')], $acc)->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('by_branch.A', '100.00');
        $fs = $this->getJson('/api/reports/full-statements?fy_start=2026-01-01', $acc)->assertOk();
        $this->assertTrue($fs->json('ok'));
        $this->assertCount(29, $fs->json('notes'));
        $this->getJson('/api/reports/full-statements?fy_start=2026-01-01&unit=HO', $acc)->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('ok', true);
        $this->getJson('/api/reports/reconciliations?start=2026-12-01&as_of=2026-12-31', $acc)->assertOk()->assertJsonStructure(['HO', 'A']);
        $this->getJson('/api/reports/dashboard?today=2026-12-31', $acc)->assertOk()->assertJsonStructure(['month_sales', 'statutory_deadlines', 'integrity']);
        $this->getJson('/api/reports/master-accounts?start=2026-12-01&end=2026-12-31', $acc)->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('balanced', true);
        $this->getJson('/api/reports/profit-by-branch?start=2026-11-01&end=2026-12-31', $acc)->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('total_agrees_to_consolidated', true);
        $this->getJson('/api/reports/alerts?start=2026-12-01&end=2026-12-31', $acc)->assertOk();
        $this->getJson('/api/reports/trial-balance?fy_start=2026-01-01', $acc)->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('difference', '0.00');
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Domain\Admin;
use App\Domain\BusinessRuleError;
use App\Domain\Tax;
use App\Models\Setting;
use App\Models\SettingChange;
use App\Models\WhtType;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use Tests\TestCase;

class TaxAndSettingsTest extends TestCase
{
    /** Values computed by the Python edition (app/services/tax.py) – both editions must agree to the pesewa. */
    public static function pythonSplits(): array
    {
        return [
            ['100', '83.33', '12.50', '2.08', '2.08'],
            ['59.99', '49.99', '7.50', '1.25', '1.25'],
            ['1', '0.83', '0.12', '0.02', '0.02'],
            ['0.05', '0.04', '0.01', '0.00', '0.00'],
            ['12345.67', '10288.06', '1543.21', '257.20', '257.20'],
        ];
    }

    #[DataProvider('pythonSplits')]
    public function test_inclusive_split_matches_python(string $gross, string $base, string $vat, string $nhil, string $getf): void
    {
        $s = Tax::splitInclusive($gross, Tax::ratesFor('SR20', '2026-11-01'));
        $this->assertSame([$base, $vat, $nhil, $getf], [(string) $s['base'], (string) $s['vat'], (string) $s['nhil'], (string) $s['getfund']]);
        $this->assertTrue($s['net_revenue']->plus($s['vat'])->plus($s['nhil'])->plus($s['getfund'])->isEqualTo($s['gross']));
    }

    public function test_exclusive_and_exempt_and_unregistered(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame('432.00', (string) Tax::addExclusive('360', Tax::ratesFor('SR20', '2026-11-01'))['gross']);
        $this->assertSame('50.00', (string) Tax::splitInclusive('50', Tax::ratesFor('EX', '2026-11-01'))['base']);
        Setting::where('key', 'vat_registered')->update(['value' => 'No']);
        $this->assertTrue(Tax::ratesFor('SR20', '2026-11-01')['total']->isZero());
        $this->assertSame('0.15', (string) Tax::ratesFor('SR20', '2026-11-01', false)['vat']->toScale(2));
    }

    public function test_rate_change_is_effective_dated_and_needs_second_person(): void
    {
        try {
            Admin::addTaxRate('SR20', 'Standard', '0.16', '0.025', '0.025', '2027-01-01', 'Budget 2027', 'acc', 'acc');
            $this->fail('self-approved');
        } catch (BusinessRuleError $e) {
            $this->assertStringContainsString("second person's approval", $e->getMessage());
        }
        Admin::addTaxRate('SR20', 'Standard', '0.16', '0.025', '0.025', '2027-01-01', 'Budget 2027', 'acc', 'fm');
        $this->assertSame('0.15000', (string) Tax::ratesFor('SR20', '2026-12-31')['vat']);
        $this->assertSame('0.16000', (string) Tax::ratesFor('SR20', '2027-01-01')['vat']);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('already starts on that date');
        Admin::addTaxRate('SR20', 'Standard', '0.17', '0.025', '0.025', '2027-01-01', 'again', 'acc', 'fm');
    }

    public function test_settings_are_validated_and_kept_in_history(): void
    {
        foreach ([['vat_registered', 'Maybe'], ['approval_limit_journal', 'abc'], ['locked_through', '2026-02-30'], ['enforce_2fa', 'yes']] as [$k, $v]) {
            try {
                Admin::changeSetting($k, $v, 'test', 'acc', 'fm');
                $this->fail("{$k}={$v} accepted");
            } catch (BusinessRuleError $e) {
                $this->assertStringContainsString("Invalid value for {$k}", $e->getMessage());
            }
        }
        Admin::changeSetting('cashup_tolerance', '10', 'Busy tills', 'acc', 'fm');
        $this->assertSame('10', Setting::find('cashup_tolerance')->value);
        $h = Admin::history('cashup_tolerance');
        $this->assertSame(['5', '10', 'acc', 'fm'], [$h[0]['old'], $h[0]['new'], $h[0]['by'], $h[0]['approved_by']]);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('reason is required');
        Admin::changeSetting('cashup_tolerance', '20', '', 'acc', 'fm');
    }

    public function test_paye_table_amendment(): void
    {
        $t = Admin::payeTables();
        $this->assertCount(1, $t);
        $this->assertSame(['First', '7056.00', '588.00', '0.00000'], array_values(array_slice($t[0]['bands'][0], 0, 4)));
        $this->assertSame(['Exceeding', '600000.00', '50000.00'], array_values(array_slice($t[0]['bands'][6], 0, 3)));
        foreach ([[[['1000', '0'], ['2000', '0.1']], 'open-ended'], [[['1000', '1.5'], [null, '0.3']], 'between 0 and 1'],
            [[[null, '0'], [null, '0.3']], 'Only the last band']] as [$bands, $msg]) {
            try {
                Admin::setPayeBands('2027-01-01', $bands, 'Budget', 'acc', 'fm');
                $this->fail($msg);
            } catch (BusinessRuleError $e) {
                $this->assertStringContainsString($msg, $e->getMessage());
            }
        }
        Admin::setPayeBands('2027-01-01', [['8000', '0'], ['40000', '0.15'], [null, '0.3']], 'Act 2027', 'acc', 'fm');
        $t = Admin::payeTables();
        $this->assertSame(['2026-12-31', '2099-12-31'], [$t[0]['effective_to'], $t[1]['effective_to']]);
        $this->assertSame('48000.00', $t[1]['bands'][2]['annual_width']);
        $this->assertSame(1, SettingChange::where('key', 'paye_bands')->count());
    }

    public function test_wht_rate_change(): void
    {
        Admin::changeWhtRate('Goods', '0.04', 'Finance Act 2027', 'acc', 'fm');
        $this->assertSame('0.04000', WhtType::find('Goods')->rate);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('Unknown WHT type');
        Admin::changeWhtRate('Nope', '0.04', 'x', 'acc', 'fm');
    }
}

####################################################################################################
##### FILE: tests/Feature/UploadsTest.php
####################################################################################################

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Domain\Branches;
use App\Domain\BusinessRuleError;
use App\Domain\Inventory;
use App\Domain\Money;
use App\Domain\SampleData;
use App\Domain\Uploads;
use App\Models\AuditLog;
use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\StockLot;
use App\Models\StockUpload;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Tests\TestCase;

/** Products and stock CSV upload: report first, nothing saved until a second person confirms, duplicates blocked. Mirrors the Python tests. */
class UploadsTest extends TestCase
{
    private const GOOD = "branch_code,source,sku,name,category,tax_code,retail_price,branch_retail_price,batch_no,expiry,quantity,unit_cost,date,"
        ."payment_channel,paid_by,supplier_code,supplier_vat_invoice,invoice_no\r\n"
        ."A,OPENING,P100,Cough syrup 100ml,OTC medicine,EX,30,,CS1,2028-01-31,40,18,2026-12-01,,,,,\r\n"
        ."B,OPENING,P100,,,,,32,CS1,2028-01-31,20,18,2026-12-01,,,,,\r\n"
        ."A,CASH_PURCHASE,P004,,,,,,BL9,2028-06-30,5,70,2026-12-02,Petty cash,,S002,Yes,CR-77\r\n"
        ."B,CASH_PURCHASE,P004,,,,,,BL8,2028-06-30,2,75,2026-12-02,Bank,HO,,No,R-12\r\n"
        ."A,PRODUCT_ONLY,P101,Thermometer,Medical device/consumable,SR20,45,,,,,,,,,,,\r\n";

    private function bal(int $code, int $unit, ?string $party = null): string
    {
        $q = DB::table('journal_line')->join('journal', 'journal.id', '=', 'journal_line.journal_id')->where('account_code', $code)->where('journal.branch_id', $unit);
        if ($party) {
            $q->where('party', $party);
        }

        return (string) Money::q2(Money::db($q->selectRaw('COALESCE(SUM(debit - credit), 0) AS b')->value('b') ?? '0'));
    }

    private function tbOk(int $unit): bool
    {
        return Money::db(DB::table('journal_line')->join('journal', 'journal.id', '=', 'journal_line.journal_id')->where('journal.branch_id', $unit)
            ->selectRaw('COALESCE(SUM(debit - credit), 0) AS b')->value('b') ?? '0')->isZero();
    }

    private function units(): array
    {
        SampleData::loadMaster();

        return [Branches::create('A', 'Branch A', 'admin'), Branches::create('B', 'Branch B', 'admin'), Branches::create('HO', 'Head office', 'admin', true)];
    }

    private function fails(callable $fn, string $msg): void
    {
        try {
            $fn();
            $this->fail("expected: {$msg}");
        } catch (BusinessRuleError $e) {
            $this->assertStringContainsString($msg, $e->getMessage());
        }
    }

    public function test_validates_first_then_confirms_once(): void
    {
        [$a, $b, $ho] = $this->units();
        $this->fails(fn () => Uploads::validate('stock.xlsx', 'x', 'store1'), 'CSV only');
        $this->fails(fn () => Uploads::validate('stock.csv', "PK\x03\x04....", 'store1'), 'Excel workbook');
        $tpl = preg_split('/\r\n/', trim(substr(Uploads::template(true), 3)));
        $this->assertSame(Uploads::COLUMNS, explode(',', $tpl[0]));
        $this->assertCount(1 + count(Uploads::EXAMPLES), $tpl);
        $bad = "branch_code,source,sku,batch_no,expiry,quantity,unit_cost,date,payment_channel,invoice_no\r\n"
            ."A,CASH_PURCHASE,P004,Z1,2028-01-01,5,70,2026-12-02,Credit,INV-9\r\n"
            ."HO,OPENING,P004,Z2,2028-01-01,5,70,2026-12-02,,\r\n"
            ."A,OPENING,P999,Z3,2026-11-30,5,70,2026-12-02,,\r\n";
        $up = Uploads::validate('bad.csv', $bad, 'store1');
        $rep = Uploads::report($up)['report'];
        $msgs = array_map(fn ($r) => implode(' | ', $r['errors']), $rep['rows']);
        $this->assertSame(3, $rep['error_count']);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('supplier credit goes through Purchases', $msgs[0]);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('head office unit', $msgs[1]);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('name is required for a new product', $msgs[2]);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('has expired', $msgs[2]);
        $this->fails(fn () => Uploads::confirm($up->id, 'store1', 'pharm'), 'rows now have errors');

        $nProducts = Product::count();
        $up = Uploads::validate('stock.csv', self::GOOD, 'store1');
        $rep = Uploads::report($up)['report'];
        $this->assertSame(0, $rep['error_count'], json_encode($rep));
        $this->assertSame($nProducts, Product::count());
        $this->assertSame(0, StockLot::where('source_ref', 'like', 'UPL-%')->count());
        $this->assertSame(['720.00', '360.00', '350.00', '70.00'], [$rep['totals']['A']['opening_stock'], $rep['totals']['B']['opening_stock'],
            $rep['totals']['A']['cash_purchases'], $rep['totals']['A']['input_tax']]);
        $this->fails(fn () => Uploads::confirm($up->id, 'store1', 'store1'), 'second person');
        $out = Uploads::confirm($up->id, 'store1', 'pharm');
        $this->assertSame(['CONFIRMED', 3], [$out['status'], $out['products']]);
        $p100 = Product::where('sku', 'P100')->first();
        $this->assertTrue(Branches::retailPrice($b->id, $p100)->isEqualTo(32) && Branches::retailPrice($a->id, $p100)->isEqualTo(30));
        $this->assertSame('45.00', (string) Product::where('sku', 'P101')->value('retail_price'));
        $this->assertSame(['-720.00', '-360.00'], [$this->bal(9030, $a->id), $this->bal(9030, $b->id)]);
        $this->assertSame(['-420.00', '52.50', '8.75'], [$this->bal(1015, $a->id), $this->bal(2115, $a->id), $this->bal(2120, $a->id)]);
        $this->assertSame(['-150.00', '-150.00', '150.00'], [$this->bal(1030, $ho->id), $this->bal(1195, $b->id, 'BR-HO'), $this->bal(1195, $ho->id, 'BR-B')]);
        foreach ([$a, $b, $ho] as $u) {
            $this->assertTrue($this->tbOk($u->id), "unit {$u->code} balances");
        }
        $this->assertTrue(Inventory::reconciliation($a->id, '2026-12-31')['ok']);
        $this->assertTrue(Inventory::reconciliation($b->id, '2026-12-31')['ok']);
        $this->fails(fn () => Uploads::confirm($up->id, 'store1', 'pharm'), 'is CONFIRMED');
        $again = Uploads::validate('stock-copy.csv', self::GOOD, 'store1');
        $this->assertSame($up->id, (int) $again->duplicate_of);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('already loaded', Uploads::report($again)['report']['duplicate_warning']);
        $this->fails(fn () => Uploads::confirm($again->id, 'store1', 'pharm'), 'already loaded');
        $this->fails(fn () => Uploads::confirm($again->id, 'store1', 'pharm', true), 'has already been loaded'); // CR-77 cannot load twice
    }

    public function test_override_is_audited_and_cancel(): void
    {
        $this->units();
        $csv = "branch_code,source,sku,name,category,tax_code,retail_price\r\nA,PRODUCT_ONLY,P200,Gauze,Medical device/consumable,SR20,5\r\n";
        $first = Uploads::validate('p.csv', $csv, 'store1');
        Uploads::confirm($first->id, 'store1', 'pharm');
        $second = Uploads::validate('p.csv', $csv, 'store1');
        Uploads::confirm($second->id, 'store1', 'pharm', true);
        $this->assertTrue((bool) StockUpload::find($second->id)->override_duplicate);
        $this->assertSame(1, AuditLog::where('action', 'UPLOAD_CONFIRM')->where('detail', 'like', '%DUPLICATE OF%')->count());
        $third = Uploads::validate('p.csv', $csv, 'store1');
        Uploads::cancel($third->id, 'store1');
        $this->assertSame('CANCELLED', StockUpload::find($third->id)->status);
        $this->fails(fn () => Uploads::cancel($third->id, 'store1'), 'Only a validated upload');
    }

    public function test_semicolon_and_windows_1252_files(): void
    {
        $this->units();
        $csv = "branch_code;source;sku;name;category;tax_code;retail_price\r\nA;PRODUCT_ONLY;P300;Caf\xE9 cream;Non-medicine (cosmetics, supplements);SR20;12.50\r\n";
        $rep = Uploads::report(Uploads::validate('p.csv', $csv, 'store1'));
        $this->assertSame(0, $rep['errors'], json_encode($rep));
        $this->fails(fn () => Uploads::validate('p.csv', "sku,name\r\nP1,x\r\n", 'store1'), 'Missing columns: branch_code, source');
    }
}

####################################################################################################
##### FILE: tools/gen_models.py
####################################################################################################

"""Generates Eloquent models (one per table) from the Python edition's SQLAlchemy model."""
import sys, os, re
sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1]); outdir = sys.argv[2]
from sqlalchemy import Boolean, Integer, Numeric, inspect
from sqlalchemy.orm import RelationshipDirection
from app.db import Base
import app.models  # noqa
for m in Base.registry.mappers:
    cls = m.class_; t = m.local_table; name = cls.__name__
    pk = [c.name for c in t.primary_key.columns]
    casts = []
    for c in t.columns:
        typ = getattr(c.type, "impl", c.type)
        if isinstance(typ, Numeric): casts.append(f"'{c.name}' => Exact::class.':{typ.scale}'")
        elif isinstance(typ, Boolean): casts.append(f"'{c.name}' => 'boolean'")
        elif isinstance(typ, Integer): casts.append(f"'{c.name}' => 'integer'")
    rels = []
    for r in m.relationships:
        tgt = r.mapper.class_.__name__
        if r.direction == RelationshipDirection.ONETOMANY:
            fk = list(r.remote_side)[0].name; lk = list(r.local_columns)[0].name
            rels.append(f"    public function {r.key}(): HasMany\n    {{\n        return $this->hasMany({tgt}::class, '{fk}', '{lk}');\n    }}")
        elif r.direction == RelationshipDirection.MANYTOONE:
            fk = list(r.local_columns)[0].name; ok = list(r.remote_side)[0].name
            rels.append(f"    public function {r.key}(): BelongsTo\n    {{\n        return $this->belongsTo({tgt}::class, '{fk}', '{ok}');\n    }}")
    doc = (cls.__doc__ or "").strip().split("\n")[0] if cls.__doc__ and not cls.__doc__.startswith("Mapped") else ""
    incr = "true" if (pk == ["id"]) else "false"
    keytype = "int" if isinstance(getattr(t.c[pk[0]].type, "impl", t.c[pk[0]].type), Integer) else "string"
    uses = ["use App\\Casts\\Exact;", "use Illuminate\\Database\\Eloquent\\Model;"]
    if any("HasMany" in r for r in rels): uses.append("use Illuminate\\Database\\Eloquent\\Relations\\HasMany;")
    if any("BelongsTo" in r for r in rels): uses.append("use Illuminate\\Database\\Eloquent\\Relations\\BelongsTo;")
    if not any("Exact::" in c for c in casts): uses.remove("use App\\Casts\\Exact;")
    body = f"""<?php

namespace App\\Models;

{chr(10).join(sorted(uses))}

/**
 * Table {t.name}. Generated from the Python edition's app/models.py ({name}).{(chr(10) + ' * ' + doc) if doc else ''}
 */
class {name} extends Model
{{
    protected $table = '{t.name}';

    protected $primaryKey = '{pk[0]}';

    public $incrementing = {incr};

    protected $keyType = '{keytype}';

    public $timestamps = false;

    protected $guarded = [];

    protected function casts(): array
    {{
        return [
{''.join('            ' + c + ',' + chr(10) for c in casts)}        ];
    }}
{(chr(10) + (chr(10)+chr(10)).join(rels) + chr(10)) if rels else ''}}}
"""
    open(os.path.join(outdir, f"{name}.php"), "w").write(body)
print(len(Base.registry.mappers), "models")

####################################################################################################
##### FILE: tools/gen_refdata.py
####################################################################################################

import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1])
from app import seed, coa_seed
def php(v, ind=0):
    p = "    " * ind
    if v is None: return "null"
    if isinstance(v, bool): return "true" if v else "false"
    if isinstance(v, int): return str(v)
    if isinstance(v, str): return "'" + v.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("'", "\\'") + "'"
    if isinstance(v, dict):
        return "[\n" + "".join(f"{p}    {php(k)} => {php(x, ind+1)},\n" for k, x in v.items()) + p + "]"
    if isinstance(v, (list, tuple)):
        if all(not isinstance(x, (list, tuple, dict)) for x in v):
            return "[" + ", ".join(php(x) for x in v) + "]"
        return "[\n" + "".join(f"{p}    {php(x, ind+1)},\n" for x in v) + p + "]"
    raise TypeError(type(v))
consts = dict(
    COA=coa_seed.COA, SETTINGS=seed.SETTINGS, TAX=seed.TAX, CATEGORIES=seed.CATEGORIES, CHANNELS=seed.CHANNELS, WHT=seed.WHT,
    ANNUAL_PAYE_BANDS=seed.ANNUAL_PAYE_BANDS,
)
print("<?php\n\nnamespace App\\Domain;\n\n/**\n * Reference data – generated by tools/gen_refdata.py from the Python edition (app/seed.py, app/coa_seed.py, v1.1).\n"
      " * Same chart of accounts, settings, tax codes, WHT types and PAYE bands. Review every rate before go-live.\n */\nfinal class ReferenceTables\n{")
print("    public const FAR = '2099-12-31';")
print(f"    public const PAYE_EFFECTIVE_FROM = '{seed.PAYE_EFFECTIVE_FROM.isoformat()}';")
print(f"    public const PAYE_LEGAL_BASIS = {php(seed.PAYE_LEGAL_BASIS)};")
print(f"    public const MODULE_ONLY_SINCE_V09 = {php(list(seed.MODULE_ONLY_SINCE_V09))};")
for k, v in consts.items():
    print(f"\n    public const {k} = {php(v, 1)};")
print("}")

####################################################################################################
##### FILE: tools/gen_schema.py
####################################################################################################

"""Generates the Laravel schema migration from the Python SQLAlchemy model, so both editions share one data model."""
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1])
from sqlalchemy import Boolean, Date, DateTime, Integer, Numeric, String, Text, CheckConstraint, UniqueConstraint
from app.db import Base
import app.models  # noqa

def php(v):
    if isinstance(v, bool): return "true" if v else "false"
    if isinstance(v, (int, float)): return repr(v)
    return "'" + str(v).replace("'", "\\'") + "'"

def short(name):
    return name if len(name) <= 60 else name[:50] + "_" + format(abs(hash(name)) % 10**8, "08d")

out, fks, checks = [], [], []
for t in Base.metadata.sorted_tables if False else Base.metadata.tables.values():
    out.append(f"        Schema::create('{t.name}', function (Blueprint $t) {{")
    pk = [c.name for c in t.primary_key.columns]
    for c in t.columns:
        ty = c.type
        typ = getattr(ty, "impl", ty)
        if isinstance(ty, Integer) or isinstance(typ, Integer):
            if c.primary_key and c.autoincrement in (True, "auto") and c.name == "id" and len(pk) == 1:
                out.append(f"            $t->increments('id');"); continue
            line = f"$t->{'unsignedInteger' if c.foreign_keys or c.primary_key else 'integer'}('{c.name}')"
        elif isinstance(typ, Numeric):
            line = f"$t->decimal('{c.name}', {typ.precision}, {typ.scale})"
        elif isinstance(typ, Text) or (isinstance(typ, String) and typ.length is None):
            line = f"$t->text('{c.name}')"
        elif isinstance(typ, String):
            line = f"$t->string('{c.name}', {typ.length})"
        elif isinstance(typ, Boolean):
            line = f"$t->boolean('{c.name}')"
        elif isinstance(typ, DateTime):
            line = f"$t->dateTime('{c.name}')"
        elif isinstance(typ, Date):
            line = f"$t->date('{c.name}')"
        else:
            raise SystemExit(f"type {ty} on {t.name}.{c.name}")
        if c.foreign_keys and not isinstance(typ, Integer):
            pass
        if c.nullable and not c.primary_key: line += "->nullable()"
        if c.default is not None and c.default.is_scalar:
            v = c.default.arg
            if isinstance(typ, Numeric): v = str(v)
            line += f"->default({php(v)})"
        if c.server_default is not None and "now" in str(getattr(c.server_default, "arg", "")).lower():
            line += "->useCurrent()"
        if c.primary_key and len(pk) == 1: line += "->primary()"
        if c.unique: line += f"->unique('{short(t.name + '_' + c.name + '_unique')}')"
        if c.index: line += f"->index('{short(t.name + '_' + c.name + '_index')}')"
        out.append("            " + line + ";")
        for fk in c.foreign_keys:
            fks.append((t.name, c.name, fk.column.table.name, fk.column.name))
    for con in t.constraints:
        if isinstance(con, UniqueConstraint) and len(con.columns) > 1:
            cols = ", ".join(f"'{x.name}'" for x in con.columns)
            out.append(f"            $t->unique([{cols}], '{short(t.name + '_' + '_'.join(x.name for x in con.columns) + '_unique')}');")
        if isinstance(con, CheckConstraint):
            checks.append((t.name, str(con.sqltext)))
    out.append("        });")
body = "\n".join(out)
fk_lines = []
for tn, cn, rt, rc in fks:
    fk_lines.append(f"            Schema::table('{tn}', fn (Blueprint $t) => $t->foreign('{cn}', '{short(tn + '_' + cn + '_fk')}')->references('{rc}')->on('{rt}'));")
ck_lines = [f"            DB::statement(\"ALTER TABLE {tn} ADD CONSTRAINT {short(tn + '_check_' + str(i))} CHECK ({sql})\");" for i, (tn, sql) in enumerate(checks)]
tables = list(Base.metadata.tables)
drops = "\n".join(f"        Schema::dropIfExists('{n}');" for n in reversed(tables))
print(f"""<?php

// Generated by tools/gen_schema.py from the Python edition's app/models.py (v1.1) – one data model for both editions.
// Foreign keys and CHECK constraints are added on PostgreSQL and MySQL/MariaDB; SQLite (development only) skips them.

use Illuminate\\Database\\Migrations\\Migration;
use Illuminate\\Database\\Schema\\Blueprint;
use Illuminate\\Support\\Facades\\DB;
use Illuminate\\Support\\Facades\\Schema;

return new class extends Migration
{{
    public function up(): void
    {{
{body}
        if (DB::getDriverName() !== 'sqlite') {{
{chr(10).join(fk_lines)}
{chr(10).join(ck_lines)}
        }}
    }}

    public function down(): void
    {{
        $tables = [{", ".join(repr(n) for n in reversed(tables))}];
        if (DB::getDriverName() === 'pgsql') {{
            foreach ($tables as $n) {{
                DB::statement("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS \\"{{$n}}\\" CASCADE");
            }}

            return;
        }}
        Schema::disableForeignKeyConstraints();
        foreach ($tables as $n) {{
            Schema::dropIfExists($n);
        }}
        Schema::enableForeignKeyConstraints();
    }}
}};""")
print(len(tables), "tables", len(fks), "fks", file=sys.stderr)

"""Runs the stage 2 comparison scenario in the Python edition and writes the expected ledger to tests/fixtures (JSON).
The PHP test runs the same scenario and must produce identical journals, stock values and claim balances to the pesewa."""
import json
import sys
from datetime import date as D
from decimal import Decimal

sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1])
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, select
from sqlalchemy.pool import StaticPool

from app.db import Base, make_session_factory
from app.models import Branch, Journal, Setting, StockLot, StockMove
from app.sample_data import load_branch_month, load_master
from app.seed import seed_reference_data
from app.services import branches, cash, claims, inventory, sales


UPLOAD_CSV = (
    "branch_code,source,sku,name,category,tax_code,retail_price,branch_retail_price,batch_no,expiry,quantity,unit_cost,date,"
    "payment_channel,paid_by,supplier_code,supplier_vat_invoice,invoice_no\r\n"
    "A,OPENING,P100,Cough syrup 100ml,OTC medicine,EX,30,,CS1,2028-01-31,40,18,2026-11-20,,,,,\r\n"
    "B,OPENING,P100,,,,,32,CS1,2028-01-31,20,18,2026-11-20,,,,,\r\n"
    "A,CASH_PURCHASE,P004,,,,,,BL9,2028-06-30,5,70.10,2026-11-21,Petty cash,,S002,Yes,CR-77\r\n"
    "B,CASH_PURCHASE,P004,,,,,,BL8,2028-06-30,2,75.35,2026-11-21,Bank,HO,,No,R-12\r\n"
    "A,PRODUCT_ONLY,P101,Thermometer,Medical device/consumable,SR20,45,,,,,,,,,,,\r\n"
)


def run(policy, pool):
    e = create_engine("sqlite://", connect_args={"check_same_thread": False}, poolclass=StaticPool)
    Base.metadata.create_all(e)
    s = make_session_factory(e)()
    seed_reference_data(s)
    s.merge(Setting(key="cost_formula", value=policy))
    s.merge(Setting(key="cost_pool", value=pool))
    s.flush()
    load_master(s)
    a = load_branch_month(s, "A")
    b = load_branch_month(s, "B")
    branches.create_branch(s, code="HO", name="Head office", user="admin", is_head_office=True)
    from app.services import uploads
    up = uploads.validate(s, file_name="stock.csv", raw=UPLOAD_CSV.encode(), user="store1")
    assert uploads.report(up)["report"]["error_count"] == 0, uploads.report(up)
    uploads.confirm(s, upload_id=up.id, user="store1", approver="pharm")
    # receipts at different prices in B, a transfer, a return, an adjustment, a count, cash-up, claim lifecycle
    inventory.receive_goods(s, branch_id=b.id, supplier_code="S002", invoice_no="X-B-1", on=D(2026, 11, 24),
                            lines=[dict(sku="P004", batch_no="BDL9", expiry=D(2028, 6, 30), packs=7, cost_per_pack=Decimal("73.30"))], user="store1", approver="pharm")
    inventory.transfer(s, from_branch_id=a.id, to_branch_id=b.id, sku="P004", qty=5, on=D(2026, 11, 25), note_no="TN-1", user="store1", approver="pharm")
    sales.checkout(s, branch_id=b.id, receipt_no="B-X1", on=D(2026, 11, 26), till="T2", payer_code="RETAIL", items=[dict(code="P004", qty=3, discount=Decimal("7.35"))],
                   payments=[dict(channel="Cash", amount=Decimal("352.65"))], cashier="cash2", approver="pharm", tendered=400)
    ret = sales.return_sale(s, branch_id=b.id, original_receipt="B-X1", return_no="B-RET1", on=D(2026, 11, 27), items=[dict(line_id=s.scalar(select(__import__("app.models", fromlist=["x"]).SaleLine.id).join(__import__("app.models", fromlist=["x"]).Sale).where(__import__("app.models", fromlist=["x"]).Sale.receipt_no == "B-X1")), qty=1)],
                             refund_channel="Cash", cashier="cash2", approver="pharm")
    inventory.adjust(s, branch_id=a.id, on=D(2026, 11, 28), sku="P002", batch_no="PCM2508", adj_type="Quarantine", qty=100, user="store1", approver="pharm")
    inventory.adjust(s, branch_id=a.id, on=D(2026, 11, 29), sku="P002", batch_no="PCM2508", adj_type="Quarantine write-off", qty=100, user="store1", approver="pharm", document_no="DISP-1")
    c = inventory.open_count(s, branch_id=b.id, on=D(2026, 11, 30), user="store1")
    sheet = inventory.count_sheet(c)
    inventory.record_counts(s, c, {r["line_id"]: (Decimal(0) if r["sku"] == "P003" else None) for r in sheet if r["sku"] == "P003"}, "store1")
    rest = {r["line_id"]: s.get(__import__("app.models", fromlist=["x"]).StockCountLine, r["line_id"]).system_qty for r in sheet if r["sku"] != "P003"}
    inventory.record_counts(s, c, rest, "store1")
    inventory.approve_count(s, c, "pharm")
    cu = cash.declare_cash(s, branch_id=a.id, till="T1", on=D(2026, 11, 5), cashier="SAMPLE Cashier", counted=Decimal("168"))
    cash.approve_cashup(s, cashup_id=cu["cashup_id"], supervisor="sup1")
    cl = claims.get_claim(s, "NHIS", "SAMPLE-CLM-NHIS-001-A")
    claims.submit(s, cl, D(2026, 11, 30), "acc")
    claims.vet(s, cl, D(2026, 12, 10), Decimal("100"), "acc", "Contractual pricing")
    claims.receive_payment(s, cl, D(2026, 12, 15), Decimal("60"), "Bank", "acc", wht_withheld=Decimal("1.80"), wht_certificate_no="WHT-77")
    cash.bank_cash(s, branch_id=a.id, on=D(2026, 11, 30), amount=100, deposit_ref="DEP-1", user="acc", approver="fm")
    s.flush()
    codes = {x.id: x.code for x in s.scalars(select(Branch))}
    journals = []
    for j in s.scalars(select(Journal).order_by(Journal.id)):
        lines = sorted([(l.account_code, str(Decimal(l.debit).quantize(Decimal("0.01"))), str(Decimal(l.credit).quantize(Decimal("0.01"))), l.party or "") for l in j.lines])
        journals.append(dict(unit=codes[j.branch_id], date=str(j.entry_date), source=j.source, ref=j.source_ref, lines=[list(x) for x in lines]))
    lots = []
    for lot in s.scalars(select(StockLot).order_by(StockLot.id)):
        q = sum((Decimal(m.qty) for m in s.scalars(select(StockMove).where(StockMove.lot_id == lot.id))), Decimal(0))
        v = sum((Decimal(m.value) for m in s.scalars(select(StockMove).where(StockMove.lot_id == lot.id))), Decimal(0))
        lots.append(dict(unit=codes[lot.branch_id], batch=lot.batch_no, qty=format(q.normalize(), "f") if q else "0", value=str(v.quantize(Decimal("0.01")))))
    cl = claims.get_claim(s, "NHIS", "SAMPLE-CLM-NHIS-001-A")
    return dict(journals=journals, lots=lots, claim=dict(status=cl.status, approved=str(cl.approved_amount), paid=str(cl.paid_amount)),
                receipt=__import__("app.services.views", fromlist=["x"]).receipt_text(s, ret.original_sale_id))


out = {f"{p}_{q}": run(p, q) for p, q in (("BATCH", "BRANCH"), ("WEIGHTED_AVERAGE", "BRANCH"), ("WEIGHTED_AVERAGE", "COMPANY"))}
json.dump(out, open(sys.argv[2], "w"), indent=1)
print({k: (len(v["journals"]), len(v["lots"])) for k, v in out.items()})

def enc(o):
    if isinstance(o, Decimal):
        return str(o)
    if isinstance(o, D):
        return o.isoformat()
    if isinstance(o, (set, frozenset)):
        return sorted(o)
    return str(o)

    ):
        bt = batches.create_batch(s, batch_type=typ, branch_id=unit, description=typ, control_total=0, control_count=len(entries), user="acc")
        for i, (kind, payload) in enumerate(entries, 1):
            batches.add_entry(s, batch_no=bt.batch_no, kind=kind, entry_date=D15, reference=f"{typ}-{i}", payload=payload, user="acc")
        t = batches.totals(bt)
        bt.control_total = t["entered_total"]
        batches.post_batch(s, batch_no=bt.batch_no, user="acc", approver="fm")
    c = pettycash.record_count(s, branch_id=ho.id, on=D31, denominations={"200": 5, "100": 3, "20": 2, "0.5": 4}, counted_by="Akua", witnessed_by="acc")
    pettycash.post_variance(s, count_id=c.id, user="acc", approver="fm")

    # ---- December: allocation, depreciation, disposal, releases
    allocations.allocate(s, from_unit_id=ho.id, on=D31, lines=[dict(account_code=6100, amount="3000")], basis="PERCENT", shares={"A": 60, "B": 40},
                         user="acc", approver="fm", memo="Rent")
    allocations.allocate(s, from_unit_id=ho.id, on=D31, lines=[dict(account_code=6015, amount="5000"), dict(account_code=6210, amount="1333.33")],
                         basis="REVENUE", driver_start=D(2026, 11, 1), driver_end=N30, user="acc", approver="fm", memo="Admin")
    for u in (a, b, ho):
        assets.run_depreciation(s, branch_id=u.id, period_end=D31, user="acc", approver="fm")
    assets.dispose(s, tag="FA-002", on=D(2027, 1, 10), proceeds="6500", channel="Bank", user="acc", approver="fm")
    periodend.run_releases(s, branch_id=a.id, period_end=D31, user="acc", approver="fm")
    reconcile.record_statement_balance(s, branch_id=a.id, account_code=1030, statement_date=D31, closing_balance="1000", reference="ST-12", user="acc")
    ifrs.set_disclosure(s, key="going_concern", period_end=D31, text="The owner has confirmed continued support for at least 12 months.", user="acc")
    s.flush()

    # ---- outputs
    codes = {x.id: x.code for x in s.scalars(select(Branch))}
    journals = []
    for j in s.scalars(select(Journal).order_by(Journal.id)):
        lines = sorted([(l.account_code, str(Decimal(l.debit).quantize(Decimal("0.01"))), str(Decimal(l.credit).quantize(Decimal("0.01"))), l.party or "")
                        for l in j.lines])
        journals.append(dict(unit=codes[j.branch_id], date=str(j.entry_date), source=j.source, ref=j.source_ref, lines=[list(x) for x in lines]))
    unit_ids = [None, [a.id], [b.id], [ho.id]]
    out = dict(
        journals=journals,
        trial_balance={str(k): v for k, v in reports.trial_balance(s, D(2026, 11, 1), D31).items()},
        statements=[ifrs.full_statements(s, fy_start=D(2026, 1, 1), kind="year", n=1, unit_ids=u) for u in unit_ids],
        statements_month=ifrs.full_statements(s, fy_start=D(2026, 1, 1), kind="month", n=12),
        financial_statements=statements.financial_statements(s, fy_start=D(2026, 1, 1)),
        schedules=[schedules.all_schedules(s, 2026, m) for m in (11, 12)],
        calendar=schedules.calendar(s, 2026, 12, D(2027, 1, 20)),
        payroll=dict(register=payroll_reports.register(s, 2026, 11), advice=payroll_reports.bank_advice(s, 2026, 11),
                     tier1=payroll_reports.tier1_schedule(s, 2026, 11), tier2=payroll_reports.tier2_schedule(s, 2026, 11),
                     annual=payroll_reports.annual_paye_deductions(s, 2026), info=payroll_reports.annual_employee_information(s, 2026),
                     status=schedules.annual_return_status(s, 2026, D(2027, 2, 1))),
        reconcile=reconcile.all_units(s, D1, D31),
        masters=[ledger_reports.master_accounts(s, D1, D31, u) for u in unit_ids],
        subs=[ledger_reports.sub_accounts(s, c, D(2026, 11, 1), D31) for c in (1195, 2010, 2020, 1110, 2190)],
        profit_by_branch=reports.profit_by_branch(s, D(2026, 11, 1), D31),
        consolidated=reports.consolidated(s, D1, D31),
        vat_return=reports.vat_return(s, D1, D31),
        kpis=reports.sales_kpis(s, D(2026, 11, 1), D31),
        ap=dict(ageing=ap.ageing(s, D31), proposals=ap.propose_payments(s, due_by=D(2027, 3, 1)), statement=ap.statement_reconciliation(
            s, supplier_code="S002", statement_lines=[dict(document="S2-901", amount="804.70"), dict(document="S2-999", amount="50")],
            closing_balance="1000", as_of=D31), advice=ap.payment_advice(s, on=D(2026, 12, 20)), variance=ap.price_variance_report(s, D1, D31)),
        ar=ar.ageing(s, D31),
        purchasing=dict(commitments=purchasing.commitments(s), grni=purchasing.grni_report(s, D31),
                        performance=purchasing.supplier_performance(s, D1, D31)),
        ageing=dict(rec=statements.receivables_ageing(s, D31), pay=statements.payables_ageing(s, D31)),
        assets=[assets.register(s, u.id, D(2027, 1, 31)) for u in (a, b, ho)],
        petty=pettycash.status(s, ho.id, D31),
        vat_monitor=controls.vat_threshold_monitor(s, D31),
        cd_register=controls.controlled_drug_register(s, branch_id=a.id, start=D(2026, 11, 1), end=D31),
    )
    return out


res = run()
json.dump(json.loads(json.dumps(res, default=enc)), open(sys.argv[2], "w"), indent=1)
print(len(res["journals"]), "journals; statements ok:", [st["ok"] for st in res["statements"]])

<?php

namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasMany;

/**
 * Table journal. Generated from the Python edition's app/models.py (Journal).
 * Immutable once posted. Corrections are reversals (reversal_of_id), never edits.
 */
class Journal extends Model
{
    protected $table = 'journal';

    protected $primaryKey = 'id';

    public $incrementing = true;

    protected $keyType = 'int';

    public $timestamps = false;

    protected $guarded = [];

    protected function casts(): array
    {
        return [
            'id' => 'integer',
            'branch_id' => 'integer',
            'reversal_of_id' => 'integer',
            'batch_id' => 'integer',
        ];
    }

    public function lines(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(JournalLine::class, 'journal_id', 'id');
    }
}

####################################################################################################
##### FILE: app/Models/POLine.php
####################################################################################################

<?php

namespace App\Models;

use App\Casts\Exact;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;

/**
 * Table po_line. Generated from the Python edition's app/models.py (POLine).
 * Goods line (product_id set: received into stock) or service / non-stock line (account_code set: confirmed, expensed).
 */
class POLine extends Model
{
    protected $table = 'po_line';

    protected $primaryKey = 'id';

    public $incrementing = true;

    protected $keyType = 'int';

    public $timestamps = false;

    protected $guarded = [];

    protected function casts(): array
    {
        return [
            'id' => 'integer',
            'po_id' => 'integer',
            'line_no' => 'integer',
            'product_id' => 'integer',
            'account_code' => 'integer',
            'qty' => Exact::class.':3',
            'unit_price' => Exact::class.':6',
            'qty_received' => Exact::class.':3',
            'qty_invoiced' => Exact::class.':3',
            'value_received' => Exact::class.':2',
            'value_invoiced' => Exact::class.':2',
        ];
    }

    public function po(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(PurchaseOrder::class, 'po_id', 'id');
    }

    public function product(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Product::class, 'product_id', 'id');
    }
}

    protected $primaryKey = 'id';

    public $incrementing = true;

    protected $keyType = 'int';

    protected $guarded = [];

    protected function casts(): array
    {
        return [
            'id' => 'integer',

            'payer_id' => 'integer',
